article.articleHeadline: 联合国拨款6000万美元以加速应对刚果（金）等地埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN allocates US$60 million to accelerate Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and other areas.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the United Nations announced $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to accelerate Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and surrounding regions. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no approved vaccines or therapeutics. The affected areas face armed conflict and high population movement, complicating relief efforts and access to zones controlled by armed groups. The UN aims to ensure safe, sustained access for humanitarian workers and to bolster community-level actions, early warning, and surveillance, with strong government coordination. UN humanitarian coordinators for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan are in close contact, and additional personnel will be deployed this weekend to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がコンゴ民主共和国などのエボラ出血熱感染症対策を加速させるため6000万米ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが存在し、国連による緊急資金投入という国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、ウガンダとスーダンは周辺地域として言及されているが、確認された患者報告の中心はDRCである。ワクチンや治療薬が未承認で、武装勢力による紛争が対応を複雑にしている状況は深刻。国連による迅速な資金動員と多国間調整体制の構築が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行リスクを最高レベルに引き上げ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk of an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the highest level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been escalated to very high risk by the World Health Organization. As of May 22, 2026, confirmed Ebola cases total 82 with 7 confirmed fatalities; approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are under investigation. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said that despite confirmed numbers, transmission is likely larger, with health workers struggling to trace contacts in an unstable region. Regional risk is high, global risk remains low. In response, WHO is prioritizing the use of existing therapies to assess effectiveness against Bundibugyo and pursuing development of a strain-specific vaccine; even with accelerated effort, vaccine or antiviral candidates could take six to nine months to advance. Ongoing guidance from WHO is anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行リスクを最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス確認症例82人・死亡7人、疑い例750人・疑い死亡177人の大規模発生。公衆衛生に対する深刻な影響、予想外の新規ワクチンなし株の出現、地域リスク高、国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限リスク有り。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus株の出現は既承認ワクチンが無効であり、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬開発に6～9ヶ月要することから、短期的な対応能力が極めて限定的。不安定な地域での接触追跡の困難さにより、実際の感染拡大規模がWHO報告値より大きい可能性を指摘。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Mondial-2026: Avec Ebola, la sélection congolaise doit s'isoler pour assurer sa venue, dit la Maison Blanche
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: With Ebola, the Congolese national team must isolate to ensure its attendance, says the White House.
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 — The White House says the Congolese national football team must isolate in a 21-day 'bubble' to prevent Ebola contamination if they want to enter the United States for the World Cup, less than a month away. Washington stressed these health precautions are required for participation in the U.S.-hosted tournament. Ebola is the pathogen of concern, and the measure targets entry by the Congolese squad. No outbreak counts or symptom details are provided. No cases are confirmed in the article, and no exposure sources or transmission timelines are given. The directive illustrates how disease-control and travel restrictions can affect attendance at major events, linking public health to sport.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップ：エボラ対策として、コンゴ選手団は米国入国のため21日間の隔離が必要と米ホワイトハウス発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ病のコンゴでの現在の流行状況、確認症例、実際の感染リスク情報が記事に記載されていない。本記事は将来のスポーツイベント開催における仮定的な渡航制限措置についての報道であり、進行中の感染症危機ではなく、政策・外交的な話題である。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴの現在のエボラ流行状況ではなく、2026年ワールドカップ出場に向けた米国の渡航制限措置についての政策報道である。実際の感染症イベント（発生例、流行規模など）の情報がないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判断。米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 江飛宇Science 》伊波拉病毒：我們對它瞭解多少？距離有效治療還有多遠？ - 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: How much do we know about it? How far are we from an effective treatment? - International
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Central Africa is experiencing another Ebola outbreak, initially detected in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and then crossing into Uganda, with hundreds of suspected cases and over 100 deaths. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The article probes what is known about Ebola, how it spreads, and how to prevent further transmission. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in what was then Zaire (DRC), near the Ebola River, with the name derived from the river. The outbreak’s high fatality rate and limited international communication at the time contributed to delayed global attention, amid broader AIDS concerns. The piece notes some similarities between Ebola and HIV to be explored further. The article is member-only content with further details behind a paywall.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：私たちはそれについてどの程度知っているか？有効な治療法までどのくらい遠いか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、複数国での流行と100名以上の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCで初発し、その後ウガンダへ拡大したことが記事に記載されている。複数の高リスク基準に該当し、WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的な関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国拨款加速应对刚果（金）等地伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN funding accelerates the response to Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) and other areas.
article.articleSummary: UN funds $60 million to accelerate the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) and surrounding areas as Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks persist. On May 21, Congolese healthcare workers in PPE buried a deceased Ebola patient, highlighting the ongoing risk. WHO is leading the response, but there is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus at present. The funding, disclosed by UN humanitarian affairs chief Martin Griffiths on May 22, aims to speed life-saving operations in a region plagued by conflict and high population movement, which complicates access for aid workers. The UN stresses that emergency response cannot be impeded; containment relies on rapid, coordinated community action, strong government cooperation, and effective early warning and surveillance systems. This weekend, UN agencies and partners will deploy additional personnel, with humanitarian coordinators in DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan engaged.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国などのエボラ出血熱流行への対応を加速するため資金配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreakは承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、地域紛争と高い人口移動により封じ込めが困難であり、国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株の流行は新興の脅威であり、承認済みワクチン・治療法の欠如、地域の紛争と人口移動が対応を複雑にしている。UN資金配分（$60M）と多国間調整の規模から、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا: ارتفاع خطر الإصابة بالفيروس إلى مستوى "مرتفع للغاية" في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية - BBC News عربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The risk of infection with the virus rises to an 'extremely high' level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - BBC News Arabic.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the World Health Organization upgrades the Ebola public health risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to extremely high locally, with Africa-wide risk elevated and global risk still considered low. The outbreak centers in eastern DRC, involving the Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage, for which there is no proven vaccine. Reported figures include 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths, alongside 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. Uganda reports 2 confirmed cases and 1 death among people who recently arrived from DRC. Security and conflict in eastern regions, including areas near Bunia in Ituri Province, complicate responses. A vaccine targeting Bundibugyo is under development at Oxford using a platform similar to the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine, with animal studies underway and human trials potentially in 1–3 months if materials are available. Serum Institute of India plans large-scale production once materials are secured. A Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) has been declared, though not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: コンゴ民主共和国でウイルス感染リスクが「極めて高い」レベルに上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo系統）の大規模感染の可能性、PHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認例）、および未承認ワクチンのための国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: DRC東部（Bunia地域）でのエボラ感染、ウガンダでの二次感染確認、ワクチン開発地としてのイギリス・インド関与により対象国はDRCとインドに限定。Bundibugyo系統は既承認ワクチンが効果なく、セキュリティ上の懸念も併存。PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: The suspected death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is over 130 - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has a death toll exceeding 130, with more than 500 suspected cases reported. The World Health Organization warns about the speed and scale of infections, noting that containment is very difficult because the Ebola virus is rare, vaccines are scarce, and testing capacity is limited in the affected areas. The article does not provide laboratory-confirmed case counts beyond the totals stated, nor does it give geographic breakdowns or transmission details. The report highlights the significant diagnostic and vaccine access challenges facing response efforts, underscoring the precarious nature of the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行による死亡者数は130人超と推定される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生への深刻な影響を有し、500件以上の疑い症例と130人以上の死亡が報告されており、国際的拡大のリスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限につながる可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは極めて高い致命率とヒト-ヒト感染能を持つ。ワクチン不足、検査能力の限界、ケースの確認不足が挙げられ、対応能力に重大な懸念がある。WHOが警告している点からも国際的な関心が高いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Шесть пациентов с симптомами Эболы сбежали из больницы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six patients with Ebola symptoms escaped from a hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, six patients with fever compatible with Ebola escaped from a hospital in Rwampara, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after locals set the Alima-founded facility on fire. The medical center was treating a man under suspicion of Ebola who died; relatives demanded the body, but clinicians refused due to the high risk of infection. The blaze destroyed tents and medical equipment at the NGO-run center, complicating ongoing care. The incident underscores safety and outbreak-management challenges around suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and illustrates how community unrest can disrupt medical services, with no details provided on laboratory confirmation or outcomes for the escapees.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症状の患者6人がコンゴの病院から逃げる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病に関連した重大な公衆衛生事象。患者の逃亡と医療施設の機能喪失により、感染拡大リスク、国際的拡散可能性、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在し、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）北東部のRwamparaで発生したエボラ疑い患者の逃亡事案を記述している。ルワンダはKigali Provinceが発生地域として挙げられているが、サマリー本文ではDRCのみが主要な発生地として記載されており、ルワンダでの確定事案は記述されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。患者の逃亡、医療施設の焼失、感染確認の遅延（laboratory confirmationの詳細なし）は、outbreak management能力の深刻な喪失を示唆しており、リージョナル・グローバルな関心事となる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da eboladan yayılıyor! Salgında ölenlerin sayısı 160'a yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Congo! The death toll from the outbreak has risen to 160.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared May 15 in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu). As of the latest government report (May 23, 2026), 671 cases and 160 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 13 new confirmed cases (12 in Ituri, 1 in North Kivu) were reported. 1,261 contacts are being followed, bringing total contacts to 1,441. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. The World Health Organization updated the risk assessment to national level 'very high', regional level 'high', and global level 'low'. Uganda has suspended all cross-border passenger traffic with the DRC to prevent spread. Background notes: Ebola virus outbreaks were first identified in 1976 near Nzara (Sudan) and Yambuku (DRC).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大！ 発生での死亡者数が160人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo variant）の確定的な発生で、671例・160死亡、ワクチンと承認治療薬がない、複数国での国境措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ発生が確認されているのはDRCのIturi県とNorth Kivu県。Bundibugyo variant でワクチンと承認治療薬がない点が重大。WHO risk assessment が national 'very high'、regional 'high'。ウガンダが国境を閉鎖。2026年5月15日の発生宣言で、5月23日時点で671例・160死亡。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Summits postponed due to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has led to the postponement of two major gatherings. The inaugural big-cat conservation summit, aimed at protecting seven key big cat species and drawing delegates from about 95 countries across Asia, Africa and the Americas, will be rescheduled after African nations grappling with Ebola; the environment ministry said new dates would be announced later. Separately, India and the African Union postponed the fourth India-Africa Forum Summit in New Delhi for the same reason. The postponements highlight ongoing biodiversity protection efforts and Africa's role in global conservation. Prime Minister Narendra Modi previously championed an alliance of global leaders to curb poaching, building on India's push to safeguard tigers and other big cats.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症流行による首脳会議の延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2項目該当。エボラウイルス疾患は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCでの流行が95ヵ国の参加者を含む国際会議の延期を招いており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行が主題。Bluedotが付与した「発生地域」にはNew Delhi、Canary Islands、District of Columbiaなども含まれているが、これらは会議開催予定地またはニュースメディア拠点であり、実際のウイルス発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストではDRCとインドのみが該当する実際の関連国。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Ungkap 750 Kasus Dugaan Ebola di Kongo, Ancaman Wabah Meluas Picu Kekhawatiran Global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Reveals 750 Suspected Ebola Cases in the Congo as Outbreak Threat Widens, Sparking Global Concern.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the World Health Organization reports about 750 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the outbreak threat widens. Field medical teams are actively monitoring suspected cases, performing laboratory tests to confirm Ebola infection, and tracing close contacts to curb transmission. Ground conditions are fragile, with limited health infrastructure, poor transport access, and difficulties reaching remote villages, hindering rapid outbreak control. Local health authorities, with international partners, are intensifying prevention measures, including distributing medical aid, deploying rapid response teams, and expanding health services in districts with the highest case loads. The WHO warns that ongoing new cases could worsen epidemiological dynamics and raise cross-regional spread risk, and it urges international communities and local governments to boost preparedness, strengthen early-detection systems, and intensify public education on Ebola transmission and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ疑い例750例を発表、感染拡大の脅威が懸念を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクすべてが現実的である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模疑い例集団発生。DRCの脆弱な保健インフラと地理的アクセスの困難さが制御を複雑化。WHO警告による国際的懸念の高まり。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak risk level raised to 'very high' in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has been raised to 'very high' national risk, 'high' regional risk, and 'low' global risk as WHO declares a public emergency of international concern; the strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. There are 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths, with roughly 177 suspected deaths and about 750 suspected cases. Uganda remains stable with two cases linked to travel from the DRC, one fatal; intensified contact tracing and a canceled mass gathering have helped limit spread. A US national infected in Congo has been transferred to Germany for care, and another American with high-risk contact has been moved to the Czech Republic. An experimental antiviral, Obeldesivir, could be used among Ebola contacts under strict protocol to prevent disease. The outbreak likely began about two months ago and was declared last Friday; surveillance shows early signs of case finding but transmission continues and numbers will rise for some time.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の発生リスクレベルがコンゴで「非常に高い」に引き上げられた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数国への波及、致死的な病原体、国際感染リスク、渡航制限の可能性あり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで発生するエボラ出血熱。サマリーにUSA、Germany、Czechiaへの患者移送が記載されているが、これらの国での感染発生は記載されておらず、患者搬出による接触のみ。DRCが主発生地域。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、致死率の高い病原体、ヒト-ヒト感染、地域レベルでの広がりリスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo: El retorno del ébola invisible
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo: The Return of the Invisible Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An imported Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) case in Kampala, Uganda (May 11) prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, has at least 106 deaths and about 400 suspected cases. BDBV, confirmed by genomic sequencing in Kinshasa on May 15, differs from Ebola Zaire, with slower replication and an estimated case fatality rate of 30–50%, enabling longer pre-symptomatic spread. Initial Zaire-targeted PCR tests yielded false negatives, delaying detection in Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia. Transmission occurs via contact with infectious fluids; fruit bats are reservoirs. Four health workers died at Mongbwalu General Reference Hospital. Ituri hosts ~273,000 internally displaced people amid militia conflict; Rwanda closed borders; South Sudan activated detection; US CDC travel ban (May 18) affects travelers from DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days. Experimental measures (Ervebo cross-protection ~50%, MBP-134, NV-387) are under evaluation; none licensed.

triage.headline_ja: Bundibugyo: 目に見えないエボラウイルスの帰還
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)によるWHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数国への拡大、国際的な渡航制限実施。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)はZaire型と異なり、潜伏期間が長く検出が遅れた。DRCのイトゥーリ州での発生（106死、400疑い例）、ウガンダのカンパラでの輸入症例（5月11日）、WHO PHEIC宣言（5月17日）、複数国による国境閉鎖・検疫強化、米国CDCによる渡航禁止措置（5月18日）が実施されている。内戦地域での発生で管理困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Минакова: меры в аэропортах исключат завоз лихорадки Эбола в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Minakova: Measures at airports will prevent the importation of Ebola fever into Russia.
article.articleSummary: Russia is not at risk of importing Ebola fever thanks to effective airport screening and quarantine procedures, developed and refined during the 2014–2016 outbreak. Infectious disease specialist Dr. Yulia Minakova notes that International Health Regulations trigger immediate medical assessment for travelers arriving from outbreak countries, with suspected cases placed under quarantine. Laboratory testing allows rapid exclusion of Ebola, preventing further transmission. Airport medical teams are well-practiced, leveraging experience from prior outbreaks. The piece also cites WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who characterized the risk of Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo as very high. Emphasis is on imported/exported-case management through border screening, quarantine, and confirmatory diagnostics. Keywords: Ebola, Russia, airport measures, screening, quarantine, laboratory confirmation, DRC, WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ミナコバ医師：空港での対策によりエボラ熱のロシアへの持ち込みを防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を背景としているが、主題はロシアの防御措置と輸入リスク評価であり、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクを報告していない。IHR基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にRussian Federationを含めているが、記事サマリーではロシアはエボラ流行地域ではなく、DRCでの発生に対する防御対策の実施地としてのみ言及されている。記事の主題は予防措置であり、実際の感染症イベントではない。DRCでのエボラ発生自体は背景情報だが、具体的な患者数や詳細な流行状況は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ повышает риск Эболы в Конго до  очень высокого
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises Ebola risk in Congo to very high.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the WHO raised the Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo to very high at the national level (regional high, global low). Congo reports 82 confirmed Ebola cases, 7 confirmed deaths, 177 suspected deaths, and about 750 probable cases, indicating sustained transmission and a high potential for rapid spread. In neighboring Uganda, measures including intensive contact tracing and cancellation of large gatherings have helped curb transmission. A crowd burned an Ebola treatment center after authorities attempted to remove the body of a local victim, illustrating social tensions surrounding the outbreak. Travel advisories were issued for Ukrainians regarding travel to the DRC. The update underscores ongoing challenges in infection control and community engagement as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ熱リスクを非常に高いレベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ熱の確認症例82例、死亡7例、疑い例177例、可能性例約750例の報告があり、国家レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外の事態、地域を超えた国際拡大リスク、渡航制限が既に発生している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ熱発生を主題としている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウクライナへの渡航勧告が言及されているが、ウクライナは発生国ではなく対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。WHOが国家レベルで「非常に高い」リスク評価を発出した重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Dugaan Ebola di Kongo Tembus 750 Kasus, WHO Mulai Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Kongo Surpasses 750 Cases, WHO on Alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, around 750 suspected Ebola virus disease cases have been detected across multiple regions of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggering a WHO alert. Field teams are conducting laboratory tests to confirm infections and tracing close contacts to curb transmission. Despite these efforts, the health situation remains very fragile due to weak infrastructure and difficult access to remote villages, hindering rapid response to new suspected cases. To suppress spread, WHO says local health authorities, with international partners, must sustain prevention measures, provide medical assistance, and deploy rapid-response teams to the hardest-hit areas. The ongoing appearance of new suspected cases could complicate the epidemiology of the outbreak. International and local health agencies are urged to boost preparedness and public-awareness campaigns on transmission routes and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの疑わしいエボラ患者750人を超える、WHOが警戒開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク（750例超）はIHR基準の4つすべて該当し、WHOが既に警戒を発令。公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが全て認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高致死率で、複数地域への拡散、弱い保健インフラ、遠隔地へのアクセス困難が報告されている。WHOの警戒発令とともに国際的支援の必要性が明記されており、極めて高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ підвищує ризик Ебола в Конго до  дуже високого
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises Ebola risk in Congo to a very high level.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22-23, 2026, the World Health Organization raised the risk that an Ebola strain circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo could become a national outbreak to very high, with regional risk high and global risk low. In DRC, 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, including 7 confirmed deaths; 177 suspected fatalities and 750 probable cases remain under investigation. Officials warned the potential for rapid spread is high to very high, altering the outbreak dynamics. Meanwhile, neighboring Uganda reported effective containment measures, including intensive contact tracing and the cancellation of mass gatherings. A Congo incident underscored community tensions, with a mob burning an Ebola treatment center after authorities were prevented from taking the body of a local Ebola victim. Ukrainians were urged to refrain from travel to the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラリスクを非常に高いレベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4基準全て該当。WHOが国家レベルのアウトブレイクリスクを「非常に高い」と評価し、複数国での症例報告と社会政治的関心の高まりが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクであり、DRCの症例数（82確認症例、7死亡、177疑い死亡、750可能性例）が詳述されている。ウガンダについては封じ込め措置の成功が記載されており、現在の検証された発生地域はDRCのみ。ウクライナはウクライナ国民への渡航勧告について言及されているが、発生地域ではない。WHOの評価（国家リスク：非常に高い、地域リスク：高、世界リスク：低）は、この地域特異的な脅威の確認を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgınında 160 kişi öldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 160 people died in the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 160 Ebola deaths as of May 23, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 13 new laboratory-confirmed cases were identified—12 in Ituri Province and 1 in North Kivu—raising the total contacts under follow-up to 1,441 (1,261 currently tracked). Since May 15, Ituri has logged 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, triggering an outbreak declaration. The World Health Organization has indicated that the DRC and neighboring Uganda Ebola outbreaks constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare variant for which there is no licensed treatment or vaccine. Ebola emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC near the Ebola River; the 2013–2017 West Africa outbreak infected about 30,000 people and claimed more than 11,000 lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行で160人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が拡大し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。ウガンダへの越境リスク、治療法・ワクチンなし、高い死亡率が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）におけるエボラ出血熱の流行が主題。ウガンダへの越境リスク言及あるも、現時点でウガンダでの発生は記述されていない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な亜種）で治療法・ワクチンなし。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع خطر الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا إلى مستوى "مرتفع للغاية" في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of Ebola infection rises to an 'extremely high' level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO raised the public health risk from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to extremely high locally, with Africa-wide risk high and global risk low, as of May 23, 2026. The outbreak centers in eastern DR Congo and involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no proven vaccine and an approximate one-third fatality rate. Confirmed cases total 82 with 7 deaths; 750 suspected infections and 177 suspected deaths have also been reported. Uganda records two confirmed cases and one death, all linked to travel from DR Congo. Oxford University is developing a Bundibugyo vaccine; animal studies are underway and human trials are expected in 2–3 months. Serum Institute of India plans large-scale production once materials are available from Oxford; a Bundibugyo-specific candidate could take 6–9 months to reach testing. WHO notes a PHEIC declared last weekend but says it is not a pandemic, with response hampered by insecurity in eastern DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱感染リスクがコンゴ民主共和国で「極めて高い」レベルに上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の集団発生で死亡例が確認され、国際的な懸念が高く、WHOがPHEIC宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にDRC（82確定症例、7死亡、750疑似症例、177疑似死亡）とウガンダ（2確定症例、1死亡）での発生を記述。インドはセラム研究所がBundibugyo専用ワクチンの大規模製造を計画していることで言及されている。WHOはPHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン開発中だが人間試験まで2～3ヶ月要する。東部DRコンゴの不安定性が対応を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Ward in Congo Burns After Residents Turn Against Medics
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo species, with no vaccine or therapies and late detection by perhaps two months after the first infection. The World Health Organization reports 177 killed and 750 infected. An international aid group’s isolation ward at a hospital on the city’s edge was burned when residents stormed the facility seeking the body of a suspected victim, Elie Munungo (28). Five suspected Ebola patients were inside the ward; later, the remains of a second man were burned. The incident underscores mistrust toward medics amid ongoing outbreak, with many presenting late after consulting traditional healers. Across Bunia, masks are common but supplies are strained. The UN halted flights to Congo from Uganda on Friday; a cure could take up to six months, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ病棟が火災 住民が医療従事者に反発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。ブンディブギョ種エボラの稀な発生、高い死亡率、医療施設への暴動による対応崩壊のリスクが顕著。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ種エボラはワクチン・治療法がなく、検出が2ヶ月遅延。医療施設への暴力的な侵入、遺体の焼却、伝統医療への依存による遅発症例報告など、アウトブレイク対応の深刻な崩壊を示唆。ウガンダへのUN便が停止され、国際的な移動制限が実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: CDC says green card holders who were recently in countries where Ebola is spreading can't reenter U.S.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatments, drives new U.S. travel restrictions. As of 2026-05-23, the CDC barred entry to foreigners who have been in three unspecified countries in the previous three weeks, while Americans must re-enter via Washington Dulles International Airport with enhanced screening. The move marks one of the strictest U.S. measures during Ebola outbreaks, including the 2014-2016 West Africa crisis that killed over 11,000. The agency stressed the rule is not a permanent ban on lawful permanent residents but a discretionary tool. The current outbreak, centered largely in the Congo, has produced more than 700 suspected cases and over 150 suspected deaths. WHO officials warn the virus may have been spreading for months before detection due to limited testing for Bundibugyo. An Air France flight from the Congo was diverted to Montreal earlier this week.

triage.headline_ja: CDCは最近エボラが流行している国にいた永住権保持者の米国再入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの稀な株（ワクチンなし）による複数国での複数国での集団発生で700症例以上、150死亡以上。国際的な旅行制限、米国への入国禁止、飛行経路の変更など国際的影響が明らかであり、IHR基準3項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴを中心とする集団発生を主題としており、スーダンとウガンダは言及されているが、当該国でのエボラ症例数や流行状況の具体的記述がないため対象国リストに含めない。カナダ・米国への飛行機経路変更は結果として記載されているが、感染症の実際の発生地は対象国のコンゴのみ。WHO警告あり、複数の稀なワクチン・治療法なしの株（Bundibugyo）での大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Ante incremento de contagios y muertes, la OMS eleva a "muy alto" el riesgo por el brote de ébola en África - Cambio de Michoacán
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid rising infections and deaths, the WHO raises the risk to "very high" for the Ebola outbreak in Africa - Cambio de Michoacán
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Central Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths; Uganda confirms 2 cases, including 1 death, linked to travel from DRC. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved specific therapy, with case fatality up to about 50%. WHO has raised the risk in DRC to 'very high' and expanded contact tracing to 1,400 people as the outbreak grows. It circulated for roughly two months in Ituri Province before authorities acknowledged its severity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the situation is especially complicated by conflict, displacement, and a mobile mining population, with distrust toward external authorities. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, but global risk is considered 'low.'

triage.headline_ja: 感染者と死亡者の増加に伴い、WHO はアフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行のリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行（DRC と Uganda で確認）であり、IHR 基準 4 つすべてに該当し、WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern を宣言している。即座にフル Risk Assessment が必要。
triage.notes: Uganda でも確認例があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。WHO が PHEIC 宣言（2026 年 5 月 17 日）し、高い公衆衛生上の関心がある。Bundibugyo 株は致死率約 50%、ワクチンなし。DRC では約 750 疑い例、177 死亡報告。紛争・人口移動・採鉱人口の流動性が管理を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Ambiental intensifica ações educativas contra arboviroses, roedores e caracol africano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental Surveillance intensifies educational actions against arboviruses, rodents, and the Giant African snail.
article.articleSummary: Environmental surveillance in João Pessoa, Brazil intensifies educational actions against arboviruses, rodents, and the Giant African snail. On Friday, May 22, agents from the Municipal Health Secretariat visited the Cabo Branco beachfront to promote prevention of arboviroses, rodents, and the Giant African snail. Coordinated by the GVAM, the effort has conducted 76 educational activities in the first four months of 2026, targeting schools, health units, markets, and tourist zones. The program aims to curb urban pests and arboviruses amid local surveillance: dengue totals 1,648 cases with one death confirmed and one under investigation; chikungunya has 18 cases; Zika is zero. Emphasized symptoms include fever and body aches; calf pain is highlighted as a signal of leptospirosis after water or mud exposure, with urgent medical care advised. Officials stress shared responsibility and community engagement, including visiting tourists who praised the preventive actions.

triage.headline_ja: 環境監視がアルボウイルス、ネズミ、ジャイアントアフリカンカタツムリに対する教育活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ、レプトスピラ症）が同時報告されており、ブラジル北東部での公衆衛生的関心は存在するが、報告内容は予防啓発活動であり、新たな流行の急速拡大を示唆する情報は限定的。情報充実のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルの対象国リストへの含有確認: 3469034はリスト内に含まれる。記事サマリーはジョアン・ペッソア（ブラジル北東部）での教育啓発キャンペーンに焦点を当てており、実際の流行データ（デング1,648例と1死亡、チクングニア18例、ジカ0例）は示されているが、急速な悪化や異常な増加の兆候は記述されていない。ネズミ対策やアフリカンカタツムリの防除と並行した統合的な公衆衛生キャンペーンとして位置付けられている。レプトスピラ症の言及は水や泥への曝露後の症状認識啓発であり、急性の流行警告ではない。ウイルス媒介蚊の制御と環境衛生を含む長期的な曝露リスク管理と、蚊媒介感染症の流行性から2つのWPRO基準に該当。政府および市民の関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: El nuevo brote de ébola se expandió sin frenos durante tres semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak spread unchecked for three weeks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, has produced 134 deaths, over 500 suspected cases, and 30 laboratory-confirmed infections as of May 23, 2026. The index case, a hospital worker who developed fever and hematemesis on April 24, died three days later; three weeks of negative results followed because the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a rarer strain not targeted by tests for the Zaire lineage. Bunia’s lab lacked sequencing capacity and archived negatives, delaying confirmation until May 14 when Kinshasa’s lab identified Bundibugyo. On May 15, Uganda reported an imported case—a Congolese national who had travelled to Kampala and died there; the WHO declared a public health emergency, with risk elevated to the highest national/regional level. A first Goma (North Kivu) case appeared around May 16–17; Goma—near the Rwanda border with over 1 million residents—now hosts a key Bundibugyo-capable lab (Rodolphe Mérieux) under rebel protection, complicating diagnostics. The border with Rwanda was closed as international responses vary, and the US invoked Title 42 for 30 days.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が3週間にわたって制御不能な状態で拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の新規流行で134人の死亡と500人以上の疑い例を報告。稀なBundibugyo株で検査の遅延が生じ、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大を確認。WHO が公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国で国境閉鎖・渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Bunia、Kinshasa、Goma）が主要な発生地。ウガンダの輸入症例も言及されているが、DRC由来の感染事例の拡大として記述されている。本評価ではDRCを verified_locations に含める。WPRは対象地域外であるため WPRO基準の適用対象外だが、IHR基準により PICKUP 判定が確定している。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا تعتزم تعليق تأشيرات من زاروا البلدان المتضررة من الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States plans to suspend visas for those who visited Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: The United States plans to suspend visa issuance for travelers who were in Ebola-affected South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), or Uganda within 21 days before US travel, per The Wall Street Journal citing State Department cables. The measure is part of a broader outbreak containment effort as officials warn the Ebola situation could be the worst in at least a decade. The CDC is coordinating with Kenya’s Ministry of Health to prevent cross-border transmission and has deployed staff in Uganda to monitor and coordinate the response. The WHO raised the Bundibugyo ebolavirus risk in the DRC to very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally. Uganda has intensified contact tracing and canceled mass gatherings; a US citizen who had contact with a high-risk person was moved to the Czech Republic. In the DRC: 82 confirmed cases, 7 confirmed deaths, 177 suspected deaths, and about 750 suspected cases; no vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の影響を受けた国を訪問した人々のビザ発行を一時停止予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（高リスク種Bundibugyo）の多国間での活発な流行が報告されており、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施される段階にある。IHR基準で3つ以上該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限措置が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの検証により実際の流行地は南スーダン、DRC、ウガンダとして記述されている。対象国リストとの照合では、DRC（203312）のみが該当。チェコは患者の隔離地としての記載であり、ウガンダは記事に記載されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。米国の渡航制限措置は対応措置であり発生地ではない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は高致命性で、DRCでの確認症例82件、死亡7件、疑い症例約750件という活発な流行状況が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Banco Mundial dice está respondiendo al brote de ébola, y aumentará la financiación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Bank says it is responding to the Ebola outbreak, and will increase funding.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak with 82 confirmed cases, seven confirmed deaths, 177 total deaths, and about 750 suspected cases; Uganda has two confirmed cases. The World Bank has deployed staff and resources to DRC and is preparing a comprehensive funding package to rapidly mobilize more funds. A US$250 million health project approved in March 2024 to bolster outbreak detection and response remains largely undisbursed (roughly US$200 million). The UN released about US$60 million from an emergency fund; the United States is sending a rapid-response team and funding around 50 emergency-response clinics. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, with national risk in DRC rated as very high. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) has a case fatality rate up to 40%. The Bank is working with Gavi to accelerate vaccine development, with about a week needed to assess severity and impact; concerns extend to South Sudan and Burundi.

triage.headline_ja: 世界銀行がエボラ出血熱の流行に対応していると発表し、資金調達を増加させると述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、複数国での確認例と国際的な支援体制の構築が報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダで2例の確認事例が報告されているが、記事サマリー上の主題はDRCのエボラ流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。スーダン、ブルンジは地理的懸念として記載されているが、確認事例の報告がないため除外。US は資金支援主体として言及されているが感染国ではないため除外。WHO公式宣言（PHEIC）、高い致命率（BDBV 40%まで）、国際的な資金動員・支援体制の急速な構築により、シグナル度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Đội tuyển Congo: 21 ngày cấm cung vì Ebola, vé World Cup treo lơ lửng!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese national team: 21-day ban due to Ebola, World Cup tickets hanging in the balance!
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak with over 130 deaths and about 600 suspected cases, prompting a World Health Organization Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Congo national football team faces a 21-day “bubble” requirement to enter the United States for the World Cup, under the supervision of US officials who warn that breaking the bubble could jeopardize visas. The US CDC has imposed a 30-day entry ban for foreigners who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past three weeks. Most Congo players and head coach Sébastien Desabre live abroad (primarily in France); any newcomer must have a separate bubble, as a single symptomatic case could endanger qualification. Two American doctors in Europe are under CDC surveillance for Ebola exposure; a Belgium stop may be considered to test the team. Congo’s schedule shifts to European friendlies (Denmark in Liège on 3 June, Chile in southern Spain on 9 June) ahead of Houston travel on 11 June if the bubble holds.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表：エボラのため21日間の隔離、ワールドカップ出場が危機に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、エボラウイルス病による国際保健上の大きな懸念、PHEIC発令済み、複数国への国際的影響が明確
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはDRC、ウガンダ、スーダン、米国、ベルギーなど複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は民主共和国コンゴでのエボラ流行。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。PHEIC発令済み、130人以上の死亡、約600人の疑い患者、複数国への旅行制限措置あり。ワールドカップなど国際スポーツイベントへの影響で社会的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo activa paquete de ayuda del Banco Mundial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo activates World Bank aid package.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts aid. The World Bank confirms deployment of staff and resources and is preparing a financial package to accelerate surveillance and response; about $200 million of a 2024-approved $250 million health project remains available for immediate use against the outbreak. South Sudan and Burundi raise concerns due to weak health systems, while Uganda has epidemiological capacity yet faces budget constraints. The UN has released $60 million from an emergency fund, and the United States has deployed medical teams and funding for about 50 clinics. As of 2026-05-23, the outbreak reports 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 177 suspected deaths, and nearly 750 probable infections. The WHO has raised the national risk to very high and declared an emergency due to regional spread toward Uganda and neighboring countries. The Bundibugyo strain carries about 40 percent mortality, while vaccine development is being accelerated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラがWorld Bankの援助パッケージを発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。高リスク病原体（エボラウイルス）、多数の確認例・疑い例・推定感染例、複数国への地域的拡大、死亡報告あり、WHO宣言による国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに米国が含まれていますが、記事サマリーは米国の「展開」（医療チーム派遣）であり、アウトブレイク発生地はDRCです。南スーダン、ブルンジ、ウガンダは懸念対象地域として言及されていますが、現在の確認ケースはDRCに集中しており、これら3国は対象国リストに含まれていないため検証ロケーションから除外します。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の40%致死率、WHA発表による非常に高い国家リスク評定、複数国への地域的拡大の可能性が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội chủ động ứng phó nguy cơ dịch bệnh do virus Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi proactively responds to the risk of an Ebola virus disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Hanoi is preparing for potential Ebola virus disease (EVD) importation amid an outbreak in the DRC and Uganda caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV). Measures at Noi Bai International Airport screen and isolate passengers from these countries and collect data for contact tracing. Hanoi health authorities require training for border-control and infection-prevention staff, and coordination with media to educate the public. District surveillance, epidemiologic investigations, and rapid notification to the Hanoi CDC for isolation and testing are prioritized. Hospitals should maintain isolation zones and stock diagnostics and PPE under the '4 at site' principle. WHO reports over 500 suspected BDBV cases and 130 deaths (24 Apr–19 May 2026); on 16 May, PHEIC was declared. EVD incubation is 2–21 days; transmission from fruit bats and direct contact with blood/fluids; no specific treatment or vaccine for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、エボラウイルス病の流入リスクに積極的に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のBDBV流行に対するベトナムの対応準備事例であり、対象国における輸入症例リスク対応を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナム（ハノイ）のエボラ対応準備であり、DRCとウガンダでの流行に対する輸入症例警戒態勢を示している。Hanoi（ID 1581130）はVietnam内の都市であるため、国レベルの verified_locations に統合。WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）宣言済み（16 May 2026）。BDBV（Bundibugyo virus）による流行で500+ 疑い例、130死亡報告。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Alagoinhas intensifica estratégia de imunização contra Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alagoinhas Health Department intensifies immunization strategy against influenza
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, Alagoinhas, Bahia, Brazil's Health Department intensified its influenza vaccination campaign, scheduling two May Saturdays. A fixed vaccination point will operate at the Health Surveillance headquarters in downtown, while mobile teams will visit strategic urban and rural areas. On 30 May, neighborhood-based Family Health Units will stay open to improve access. Bedridden patients will be reached by mobile vaccination teams, and a dedicated home-care unit will serve elderly and chronically ill residents in areas without local posts, with appointments via WhatsApp at (75) 99198-0160. Vaccination remains available at all Family Health Units, but coverage is only 22% of the target 35,904 (8,020 vaccinated). Among priority groups: 24% of elderly, 15% of children, and 43% of pregnant women have been immunized. The vaccine is safe and free; those in priority groups should visit the nearest post with ID and vaccination card. Additional May 30 units will be announced.

triage.headline_ja: アラゴイニャス保健局がインフルエンザ予防接種戦略を強化
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの予防接種キャンペーン実施に関する記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。ルーチンな公衆衛生対策の報道であるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインフルエンザの新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、ブラジル・バイア州のアラゴイニャス市における既知のインフルエンザ対策として予防接種キャンペーンを強化しているというルーチン公衆衛生活動に関する報道である。ワクチン接種率が目標値の22%にとどまっているという課題はあるが、これは感染症危機的状況ではなく、通常の予防接種推進活動であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: EU pide aislamiento a selección de la RD del Congo para prevenir contagios de ébola antes del Mundial 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU calls for isolation of the DR Congo national team to prevent Ebola infections ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) triggers U.S. travel safeguards ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup (begins June 11, 2026). The DRC national football team must stay in a 21‑day “sanitary bubble” before entering the United States, with the bubble maintained in Belgium while players train in Liège; failure to comply could bar travel to the U.S. The WHO has declared an international health emergency for the eastern DRC outbreak, which so far reports 82 confirmed cases and seven deaths, with a very high national risk. The team will base in Houston, Texas, for the tournament and play warmups in the U.S. (Portugal in Houston on June 17; Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 27) and a June 23 match in Guadalajara, Mexico against Colombia. U.S. border controls require enhanced screening for travelers from affected regions, including Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan in the prior 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: EU、エボラ感染予防のためコンゴ民主共和国代表の隔離を要請 2026年ワールドカップ前
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的流行宣言に該当し、IHR基準で2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い（国際スポーツイベント絡み、複数国での管理対応）。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が主題であり、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言が発令されている。確認症例82件、死亡7件、国家リスク評価は非常に高い。複数国（米国、ベルギー、メキシコ、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での検疫・スクリーニング対応が展開中。記事の「発生地域」フィールドには対象国外（メキシコ、米国など）も含まれているが、サマリーに基づき流行の実発生地はDRCのみとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Experimental treatments could help U.S. Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 — A U.S. missionary infected with Ebola is being treated in a German hospital and has received drugs aimed at reducing symptoms after exposure, along with other therapies, according to U.S. health officials. There are no vaccines or therapies specifically approved for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, which has caused an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo with about 750 infections and 177 deaths. The patient, identified by the Serge Christian mission organization as Dr. Peter Stafford, is not named by the CDC due to privacy rules, and officials would not disclose which treatments are being used. The case highlights the limited medical options for Bundibugyo Ebola and ongoing challenges in managing this outbreak outside the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 実験的治療がアメリカのエボラ患者を助ける可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響）。エボラ出血熱の確認患者が発生し、DRCでの流行規模も大きく（750感染、177死亡）、国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、確認患者がドイツで治療されている点は支援・医療体制の文脈。DRCが対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に追加。アメリカ・ドイツは対象国ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株による深刻な流行状況と限定的な治療選択肢が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam strengthens preparedness against Ebola outbreak risks
article.articleSummary: By 18 May, Congo’s Ituri and North Kivu provinces reported 516 suspected Ebola cases with 131 deaths; four healthcare workers died in Ituri on 5 May from Bundibugyo-strain infections. Uganda confirmed two imported cases from the DRC, including an elderly male who died on 14 May after severe symptoms. WHO assesses the risk as high in affected countries and the region, but low globally, including Vietnam, which has no Ebola cases. Ebola, a highly dangerous Group A disease with fatality rates up to 90%, spreads from wild animals (fruit bats, porcupines, primates) to humans and then via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects. Six Orthoebolavirus strains exist; vaccines and specific treatments are currently available only for the Ebola strain, not for Sudan or Bundibugyo. Vietnam reinforces monitoring of inbound travellers from outbreak areas and prepares rapid response teams and outbreak response plans.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムがエボラウイルス感染症の流行リスクへの備えを強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで実際の流行が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ただしベトナムは記事サマリーで「ケースなし」「グローバルリスク低い」と明記されており、主要なシグナル対象地域ではなく、記事の主題は「準備態勢の強化」である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、現在の評価基準では不十分な情報があるため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがVietnamをリスク地域として含めているが、記事サマリーでは『ベトナムではエボラケースなし、グローバルリスク低い』と明記されており、ベトナムは実際の流行発生地ではなく、準備態勢強化のニュースソースである。したがってverified_locationsからVietnamを除外。DRCとウガンダが実際の流行地だが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、DRCのみリストアップ。既知の流行であり新規シグナルではないが、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EU exige aislamiento a RD Congo antes del Mundial por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU Demands DR Congo Isolation Ahead of the World Cup Over Ebola
article.articleSummary: 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an outbreak that the WHO has declared an international health emergency; national risk is rated 'very high'. The United States requires the DR Congo national team to stay in a 21-day biosecure bubble in Belgium before traveling to Houston for World Cup 2026, with any entrants from outside the bubble kept separate. The team is currently gathering in Liège, Belgium, ahead of a Houston base for Group K that opens with Portugal on June 17 in Houston, then Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara, and Uzbekistan on June 27 in Atlanta. Washington has tightened entry screening at Dulles for travelers from Ebola-affected areas; the Congo delegation in Europe may not be subject to that criterion. The CDC is coordinating to ensure a safe World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: EUがエボラを理由にワールドカップ前にコンゴ民主共和国の隔離を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数国への国際的な拡大リスク、および主要イベント（ワールドカップ2026）を通じた国際的な移動制限の懸念が存在。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、かつ政府・国際機関の対応が既に行われている。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCでのエボラ発生を主題としている。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言が発令済み。82確定例、7死亡。ワールドカップ2026を通じた国際的な感染リスク管理が活発化しており、米国・EU・CDCが対応に当たっている。Bluedot APIが列挙した複数地域（米国、ベルギー、メキシコなど）は主に対応拠点や影響を受ける可能性のある場所であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉死亡增　WHO：民主剛果風險升至最高級別 | 國際焦點 | 國際 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths rise; WHO says the risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to the highest level.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization raised the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak to the highest risk level as deaths rise. DR Congo reports 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, a rarer variant with no approved vaccine or therapy; WHO is evaluating existing treatments for activity against this strain. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that security conditions are highly unstable and contact tracing remains extremely challenging. Uganda reports two returnees diagnosed and one death; Rwanda imposes entry restrictions on foreigners who passed through DRC, with health measures for entrants. An American who worked in DRC tested positive and was transferred to Germany; another high-risk American contact was moved to the Czech Republic. Radboud University Medical Center in the Netherlands has isolated a patient with low infection probability pending results. Global risk remains low, regional risk high.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死亡増加、WHO：民主共和国コンゴのリスク最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、WHO最高リスク評価、国際的な患者移送・入国制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC(民主共和国コンゴ)におけるエボラアウトブレイク。ウガンダ、ルワンダ、オランダ、ドイツ、チェコに言及されているが、これらは患者移送先または二次感染対応国。DRCが発生地となっている唯一の対象国。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）による感染、ワクチン未承認、セキュリティ上の課題、接触者追跡の困難性などが記載されており、リスク要因が明確。WHO最高リスク評価がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. mantiene bajo el riesgo de contagio en el país por el nuevo brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Remains at Risk of Contagion Within the Country Due to the New Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda and South Sudan prompts U.S. health actions. Officials say the risk to the U.S. remains low, as Ebola transmits through direct contact with bodily fluids. The CDC issued a travel ban blocking entry to non-U.S. nationals who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days; U.S. citizens, nationals, and residents may enter under health screening. DHS redirected flights from these countries to Washington Dulles Airport for enhanced screening, including temperature checks, a brief questionnaire, and a health assessment on arrival; testing is not currently performed. Directing flights to a single airport reflects low traveler volume. Separately, an American doctor infected with Ebola in the DRC is hospitalized in Berlin’s Charité, described as weak but not critical. The U.S. government has activated an interagency response to contain the outbreak and curb international spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国は新しいエボラ出血熱の流行による国内での感染リスクを低く保っている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での発生、および国際的な公衆衛生対応が確認される。対象国のDRCで確認されたシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ出血熱流行を報じており、米国とドイツでの対応も記載。発生地域リストにはUgandaが含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国として含める。エボラ出血熱は高い感染力と致死率を有する感染症であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の両方で全項目に該当。米国の旅行禁止措置、CDC指示、DHS対応の実施が確認され、政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲部分地区暴发埃博拉疫情，印度-非洲峰会推迟_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa, India–Africa Summit postponed
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks are active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of May 20, 2026, the World Health Organization designated these outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Dozens of laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with about 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths. There is currently no available vaccine for this Ebola strain. India has not reported any cases, but health authorities issued advisories for travelers arriving from Ebola-affected regions. In New Delhi, the 4th India–Africa Forum Summit, originally scheduled for May 28–31, was postponed; the new dates will be determined through bilateral discussions. The summit’s theme is 'India–Africa Innovation, Resilience and Inclusive Transformation Partnership.' The postponement follows the PHEIC designation and underscores evolving geopolitics in India–Africa relations.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの一部地域でエボラ出血熱が流行、インド・アフリカサミットが延期される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、PHEIC指定による異常性、複数国での国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。シグナルとして即座にフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の流行はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで報告されており、これらは対象国リストに含まれない（UgandaはGeoNames ID 226074で対象外）。インドについては、確定症例の報告はないが、渡航アドバイザリーを発出している保健当局の関心の高さが示されており、インド・アフリカサミットの延期という政治的影響が生じているため、verified_locationsに含める。WHO によるPHEIC指定により国際的緊急度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspenden velorios en el Congo por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Funerals suspended in Congo due to an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading rapidly in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with neighboring Uganda also affected. In Bunia and surrounding areas, authorities suspended funerals and gatherings of more than 50 people to curb transmission. Frontline health workers report shortages of resources and, in some communities, resistance fueled by anger toward responders, complicating containment efforts. The World Health Organization’s Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus discussed the situation at a May 22, 2026 press conference at WHO headquarters in Geneva. The report emphasizes rapid spread and public-health measures rather than providing case or death counts. Cross-border risk to Uganda is highlighted, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance, community engagement, and adequate logistics to manage the outbreak in a resource-limited setting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行により葬儀を中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、WHO事務局長による言及など高い社会政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Bunia地域）における急速なエボラ流行、ウガンダへの越境リスク、保健資源不足、社会的抵抗を報告しており、WHO事務局長が2026年5月22日にジュネーブのWHO本部での記者会見で言及している。Genevaおよびスイスは記事発表地点（WHO本部の所在地）であり、疾患の実際の発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kiadta a legmagasabb fokú riasztást a WHO: terjed a halálos vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO has issued the highest level alert: the deadly virus is spreading.
article.articleSummary: WHO has issued the highest level alert as a deadly Ebola virus, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, spreads beyond the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ituri Province outbreak has escalated, with deaths nearing a hundred as cases rise rapidly. The virus has crossed borders into Uganda, with confirmed infections in Kampala, and has appeared in Kinshasa, the DRC capital of about 20 million, raising concern about urban transmission. No licensed vaccine exists; vaccine development is underway with clinical trials by Moderna and the University of Oxford, but mass deployment is not yet available. The outbreak prompted international concern; WHO has not yet imposed travel bans or border closures. Internet searches and public concern surged globally, including Europe and Hungary, as of 2026-05-23.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が最高レベルの警戒を発令：致死的なウイルスが拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がDRCからウガンダへ国境を越えて拡大し、キンシャサの大都市でも確認。死亡者数増加、ワクチン未承認、国際的な公衆衛生上の危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとハンガリーも言及しているが、検証対象国リストではウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）とハンガリーは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただしウガンダでの確認例（Kampala）が記載されているため、将来的には地域検証ルール適用時に再評価が必要。エボラウイルスBundibugyo株の国際的拡大は極めて深刻なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS elevó el riesgo del brote de ébola en Congo mientras avanza la búsqueda de tratamientos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO raised the risk of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the search for treatments progresses.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths under epidemiological investigation. WHO raised risk levels to very high nationwide, high regionally, and low globally due to rising cases and operational challenges amid insecurity and displacement. Violent conflict in eastern DRC has displaced over 100,000 people recently, with roughly 4 million in urgent humanitarian need, 2 million displaced, and about 10,000 facing acute hunger. Internationally, a U.S. health worker tested positive and was evacuated to Germany; another high-risk contact was moved to the Czech Republic for monitoring. Uganda remains relatively stable with 2 cases and 1 death and no new infections, aided by aggressive contact tracing and event cancellations. Treatments advancing include two monoclonal antibodies and an antiviral for post-exposure prophylaxis; vaccines for this variant are not yet available, though Oxford/SII adenoviral vaccine is under study, pending animal data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者数が増加する中、WHOがリスク評価を引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目中3項目以上満たす。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（米国、ドイツ、チェコ共和国での確認例）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（82確認例、死亡者あり、750の疑い例）、異常性の確認されており、シグナルとして優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。米国、ドイツ、チェコ共和国での事例は渡航関連の二次発生であり、対象国リストに含まれていない。ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、記事では2例1死亡で新規感染なしと記載されており、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。武装紛争に伴う大規模な人口移動（10万人以上）が感染拡大を助長する重大なリスク要因となっており、治療薬・ワクチンの開発状況も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads panic in Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, extending to South Sudan, triggers panic in Nigeria. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) reports no Nigerian case and has activated emergency measures at entry points—enhanced surveillance, lab testing, IPC, case management, contact tracing, and risk communication—in coordination with Port Health Services. NCDC Director-General Dr. Jide Idris notes an imported Uganda link to the DRC outbreak; Nigeria’s porous borders and concerns about airport officials fuel alarm. EVD is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhoea, and bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids. WHO and Africa CDC declared a public health emergency, citing 81 suspected deaths and over 246 confirmed cases as of May 17, 2026. Some Nigerians call for a 21-day quarantine for officials returning from East Africa (Kenya, Rwanda).

triage.headline_ja: エボラがナイジェリアにパニックをもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（WHO・Africa CDC公式宣言、81死亡246確定例）、異常性（地域的な拡大）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での流行、ナイジェリアへの脅威）、渡航制限リスク（21日隔離提案）。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行。ナイジェリアは脅威を受ける国として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではなく、パニック対応状況の記述。対象国リスト内でDRCのみがサマリーで確認された実際の発生地。Sudan、Mozambique、Rwanda、Kenya、Nigeriaは対象国リストに含まれず、またはサマリーで実発生地として明記されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: อนามัยโลกเล็งใช้ยาต้านไวรัสทดลอง กับกลุ่มสัมผัสใกล้ชิดผู้ป่วยอีโบลา | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization eyes using experimental antiviral drugs for close contacts of Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization raises the Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'very high' nationally and 'high' regionally, with global risk deemed 'low.' The move follows rapid transmission potential and cross-border spread concerns. Since transmission was confirmed on May 15, at least 177 deaths among suspected cases and about 750 suspected infections have been reported; Uganda has two laboratory-confirmed cases and one death, with the situation described as stabilized. WHO plans to use Obeldesivir, an experimental oral antiviral for coronavirus in trials by Gilead Sciences, in close contacts of Ebola patients. Officials warn the outbreak may have been circulating for months before detection, suggesting higher true numbers than publicly reported.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラ患者との濃厚接触者に対して試験段階の抗ウイルス薬の使用を検討 | デイリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルスBundibugyo株の大規模発生は国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象。DRCでの高リスク評価、死亡数177名、疑似患者約750名、ウガンダへの越境伝播、新規治療アプローチの導入など、複数の懸念が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。エボラBundibugyo株は遺伝子型M（EBOVとは異なる）であり、検出困難性と隠れた伝播期間の指摘は実際の患者数が報告値を大きく上回る可能性を示唆。WHO による実験段階の抗ウイルス薬（Obeldesivir）導入の検討は、病原体管理の観点から新規対応を示しており注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MATI MASSAL! 26 Ekor Babi Milik Warga Payangan Gianyar Mati, Sempat Alami Sesak Nafas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass Die-Off! 26 Pigs Owned by Payangan Residents in Gianyar Die, Briefly Experienced Shortness of Breath.
article.articleSummary: Mass die-off of pigs in Gianyar, Bali, Indonesia, with suspected African Swine Fever (ASF). In Banjar Susut, Payangan, and surrounding banjars, 17 piglets and 9 sows died, affecting five farmers; other Payangan banjars report similar losses. On May 22, 2026, the farmer burned carcasses. Before death, pigs showed fever, inappetence, and shortness of breath, dying within about three days. Some deceased pigs tested in laboratories as ASF-suspect; authorities say mass death in Susut has not been confirmed, but ASF-suspect cases exist elsewhere. Government and local agencies call for biosafety and biosecurity measures in pig farms; suspicion that transmission may occur via contaminated feed or worker movement. Authorities urged further research to confirm cause and guide response and reassure farmers.

triage.headline_ja: 大量死! ペイヤンガン在住の26頭の豚がギャニャルで死亡、呼吸困難を経験
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリ州で豚の大量死とアフリカンスワインフィーバー（ASF）の疑い例が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上（異常性・長期曝露・流行可能性）に該当する。動物における新興感染症の重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバリ州ギャニャルのペイヤンガンにおけるASF疑い例の豚大量死を述べており、実際の発生地はインドネシアであることが確認される。ASFは動物への影響に分類されているが、豚肉産業を通じた食料安全保障と国際的な貿易規制リスクがある。確認検査結果待ちで、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹個案到訪南投 足跡重疊民眾自主健康管理至6/3 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles case visits Nantou; footprints overlap; public self-health management through June 3 - Liberty Health Net
article.articleSummary: Measles case in Nantou, Taiwan: a foreign woman in her 30s diagnosed after arriving from Thailand on May 12. She was infectious during May 14–16 and visited Puli, Sun Moon Lake Xiangshan Visitor Center, Jiuz Cultural Village, and Qingjing Farm. Nantou County Health Bureau traced 38 contacts; all asymptomatic to date, with exposure footprints published and self-health management advised through June 3, 2026. Those with overlapping exposure should monitor for fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, photophobia, tearing, or conjunctivitis and seek care promptly, while avoiding public places and wearing masks during self-monitoring. The virus lasts 1–2 hours in the environment; sites were disinfected and health education provided. International measles activity remains high in Japan, Vietnam, Central Asia, the Americas, and Europe; travelers are urged to consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before travel and to perform 18-day post-travel self-monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹個案到訪南投 足跡重疊民眾自主健康管理至6/3
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例であり、接触者38名の追跡と公開された曝露足跡により、地域内での伝播リスク（ヒト-ヒト感染、流行しやすさ）が確認されている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: タイから輸入された麻疹症例。台湾（WPRO地域）での接触者追跡と公開曝露足跡は、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。記事サマリーで明示されている発生地域はタイからの輸入例であり、実際の感染確認はタイとベトナムで記述されている。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。スペイン・カナリア諸島の言及は記事内で確認できず、この情報は Bluedot API の誤分類と判断。

locations.name: Saint Helena, Ascension, and Tristan da Cunha

article.articleHeadline: El peligros de las ratas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The danger of rats
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) emerged in late 2019 in Wuhan, China. Europe’s first case was in France; Valencia reported a death from a coronavirus contracted in Nepal. Spain’s first confirmed case was a German in La Gomera. Two years later the pandemic killed about 7 million people. Spain’s deaths around 92,000–121,800. The article notes hantavirus as a current concern, with no available treatment or vaccine. As of May 9, 2026, Argentina had 101 hantavirus infections and 32 deaths; On April 24, 30 passengers from 12 nationalities disembarked on Saint Helena after a first death aboard. Rats spread leptospirosis, salmonellosis, plague (bubonic), hantavirus, and rabies via urine, feces, saliva, hair, and fleas. The Black Death in 14th-century Europe killed about 30 million, with mortality around 60% of the population.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミの危険性
triage.triage_reason: 複数の対象国（中国、アルゼンチン）を含む多様な感染症（レプトスピラ症、ハンタウイルス、ペスト、ラビエス、COVID-19）が言及されているが、記事が歴史的背景（黒死病）や一般的な啓発に重点を置いており、具体的な現在の流行規模や新規事例の詳細が不明確。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の感染症（特にハンタウイルス流行がアルゼンチンで101感染、32死亡と記載）とCOVID-19パンデミックの歴史的背景を混在させている。中国でのCOVID-19起源の記述、アルゼンチンでの現在のハンタウイルス流行データが含まれるが、他の国（スペイン、フランス、グアテマラ、ネパール、聖ヘレナ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事の焦点が過去のパンデミス歴史と一般的なネズミ媒介感染症啓発にあるため、現在進行中の新規イベントとしての明確性に欠ける。

article.articleHeadline: OMS eleva ao nível máximo o alerta para epidemia de ebola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises Ebola epidemic alert to the highest level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted the World Health Organization to raise the alert to the highest level. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the virus is spreading rapidly, lifting the outbreak risk from high to very high. Seven deaths and 82 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the DRC, with more than 170 suspected deaths under investigation. Cases have also been documented in neighboring Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. The region faces civil war, hampering containment and response efforts. There is no vaccine for this Ebola variant, according to the WHO. The situation underscores the need for enhanced surveillance, laboratory confirmation, infection control, and international support to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行警戒レベルを最高レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱は最高級の公衆衛生脅威であり、国際的拡大の兆候（ウガンダへの越境感染）、WHOによる最高レベルアラート発令、国際支援の必要性が明白。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境感染も言及されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。WHOが警戒レベルを最高度に引き上げ、ワクチン不在、内戦による対応困難、国際支援必要との記述あり。これはフルRRA実施が必須のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland intensifies efforts to contain African Swine Fever outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Nagaland's Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services Department has intensified efforts to contain an African swine fever (ASF) outbreak affecting various parts of the state, including Dimapur. The department is closely monitoring the situation through district veterinary officers and field staff, conducting surveillance, containment, awareness campaigns, sample collection, and biosecurity measures. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease that affects pigs and does not infect humans, posing no public health risk but causing significant economic losses for pig farmers. Authorities are urging immediate reporting of sudden sickness or pig deaths to nearby veterinary offices and enforcing strict restrictions on movement, sale, or transport of pigs and pork products from affected areas. Public cooperation is critical; do not dispose of dead pigs in rivers or open areas, maintain farm hygiene, and avoid spreading unverified information.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド州、アフリカ豚コレラの発生の封じ込めに向けて努力を強化
triage.triage_reason: ASFは動物疾病で公衆衛生リスクはないが、経済的影響と地域的な流行リスクが存在。情報が不十分であり、疫学的トレンド確認が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾患であり直接的な公衆衛生的深刻性は低い。ただし、ナガランド州での発生は同地域における異常事象であり、豚農業に対する経済的影響が存在。ASFのヒト-ヒト感染はなく、公衆衛生的リスクはない旨が明記されている。当該地域での継続的なサーベイランスと封じ込め努力の進展を注視することが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: chefe da OMS na África adverte sobre subestimar propagação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Regional Director for Africa warns against underestimating the spread.
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, the WHO Regional Director for Africa warned against underestimating the Ebola outbreak in the Congo (DRC), noting it has attracted relatively little global attention compared with a concurrent hantavirus outbreak that affected cruise ship passengers from 23 countries, including major powers. The director stressed that a single exposure can put everyone at risk and urged stronger attention to Ebola. Ebola is a virus that is often fatal, causing fever, body aches, vomiting, and diarrhea, and it spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, contaminated materials, or people who have died from the disease. No case counts are provided in the article, and the message emphasizes vigilance and international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO アフリカ地域事務局長が感染拡大の過小評価に対して警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。DRCでのエボラ出血熱の発生は公衆衛生上深刻であり、国際的関心も高い。WHO幹部による公式警告は政府・国際機関の関心が高いことを示唆。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月23日のWHOアフリカ地域事務局長による公式声明に基づいている。エボラ出血熱は高致死率病原体で、接触感染による拡大リスク有り。同時期のハンタウイルスアウトブレイク（23カ国の船舶乗客に影響）との対比により、グローバルな関心構造の問題を浮き彫りにしている。具体的な患者数は記事に記載されていないが、WHO幹部の警告発出自体が事態の重要性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉病毒肆虐　刚果（金）足球员进美国前须隔离
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus ravages DR Congo; Congolese footballers must be quarantined before entering the United States.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) prompts a 21-day quarantine for the DR Congo World Cup squad before entering the United States. WHO data show 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo. To minimize risk, U.S. officials require the team to stay in a training 'bubble' in Belgium and only travel to Houston no earlier than June 11 for their Group Stage match against Portugal on June 17. The team is temporarily exempt from a broader U.S. travel ban affecting non-U.S. citizens who recently visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. The aim is to safeguard public health as the World Cup unfolds across the United States, Mexico and Canada.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが猛威　コンゴ（民）サッカー選手は米国入国前に隔離が必須
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。対象国DRCでのエボラ流行と国際的な移動制限措置が講じられている状況は、シグナル識別の対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCにおけるエボラ流行」と「それに伴う国際的な渡航制限措置（米国への隔離要件）」である。DRCのエボラ流行が唯一の対象国であり、他国（米国、メキシコ、カナダ、スーダン、ウガンダ等）は対象外のため除外。82確認症例、7確認死亡、約750疑い症例という規模と、ワクチン・特異的治療がないBundibugyo株の危険性から、深刻性と重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 미국, 에볼라 바이러스 확산 지역 방문자에 비자 발급 중단
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States suspends visa issuance for visitors who have visited areas where the Ebola virus is spreading.
article.articleSummary: United States suspends visa issuance for foreigners who have visited Ebola-affected areas within 21 days before US travel, targeting the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The policy follows a May 21 Wall Street Journal report. A Congo-born passenger on a French passenger aircraft was denied US entry on May 20, and the flight diverted to Montreal, Canada, where he underwent screening with no symptoms. U.S. CBP says the passenger boarded due to an airline error, and entry restrictions aim to reduce Ebola risk. WHO warns Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has raised the national risk level from High to Very High. As of May 23, 2026, DRC reports 82 confirmed cases and seven deaths; suspected cases total around 750 with about 177 deaths. Ongoing outbreak and border screening emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルス拡散地域の訪問者へのビザ発給を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡散、国際的な入国制限措置の発動、複数国での確認症例と死亡者が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は米国、カナダ、フランス、スーダン、ウガンダなど複数地域に言及しているが、対象国リストでは DRC（203312）のみが該当。DRC でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確認82例、死亡7例、疑い症例約750例、死亡約177例）が主題。WHO がリスクレベルを High から Very High に引き上げており、国際的関心および各国政府の対応（米国のビザ発給停止、フランス機の迂回など）が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Kini 'Selevel' COVID-19 di Awal Pandemi, Ini Antisipasi Kemenkes RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Now On Par With COVID-19 at the Start of the Pandemic, This Is the Indonesian Ministry of Health's Anticipation.
article.articleSummary: On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), equating its global urgency with the early COVID-19 pandemic. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health expresses confidence in readiness, citing adequate diagnostic capacity and ongoing quarantine and screening for potential Ebola entry. As of May 22, 2026, Ebola has not been detected in Indonesia. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono, speaking in Banda Aceh, noted swift internal actions, including forwarding guidance to Andi Saguni (Director General of Disease Control) who immediately convened a nationwide meeting with heads of BKK and issued a circular on vigilance for Ebola. The focus remains vigilant preparedness and border screening, rather than domestic cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、パンデミック初期のCOVID-19と同等に インドネシア保健省の対策
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラ熱をPHEIC宣言し国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念が存在。複数国（DRC、インドネシア）での国際関心と準備態勢が報告されており、IHR基準および社会的・政治的関心の両面でシグナル条件を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラ熱のPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）がWHOから正式に発表され、DRCでの発生が主要な焦点。インドネシアは対象国として含まれ、同国の公衆衛生当局による積極的な準備態勢（国境スクリーニング、診断能力、隔離準備）が報告されている。現時点でインドネシア国内での感染は未検出だが、国際的警戒態勢が整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mondial-2026: Avec Ebola, la sélection congolaise doit s'isoler pour assurer sa venue, dit la Maison Blanche
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: With Ebola, the Congolese national team must isolate to ensure its participation, says the White House.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo triggers a 21-day isolation bubble for the DR Congo national football team before entering the United States for the 2026 World Cup, with arrival planned in Houston on June 11. Any accompanying personnel must maintain a separate bubble, and symptomatic individuals could prevent the team from competing. DR Congo is in Group K, facing Portugal on June 17 in Houston, Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara, and Uzbekistan on June 27 in Atlanta. The World Health Organization has issued an international health alert for the 17th Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, with 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths; Ebola is a hemorrhagic fever that has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades. The United States has tightened border controls, banning entry for foreign nationals who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days; the Congo team is reportedly in Europe and may not meet these criteria. Enhanced screening at Washington Dulles applies to travelers from affected areas, with CDC coordinating internationally for a safe World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ：エボラ，コンゴ選手団が米国入国前に21日間隔離が必要と米ホワイトハウス
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の東部コンゴ民主共和国での流行（確認例82例，死亡7例）は公衆衛生への重大な影響，国際的拡大リスク，渡航制限を伴う異常事態である。IHR基準3つ以上該当し，国際スポーツイベント（2026年ワールドカップ）を背景とした社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており，米国やメキシコの地名は2026年ワールドカップ関連の渡航制限・試合開催地としてのコンテキストに過ぎないため，verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOが第17回エボラ流行として国際保健上の警告を発出。米国が21日以内にウガンダ，DRC，南スーダン訪問者の入国禁止などの国境管理を強化。

article.articleHeadline: ഇ​ബോ​ള, ഹാ​ന്ത വൈ​റ​സ് ഭീ​ഷ​ണി: ജാ​ഗ്ര​ത ശ​ക്ത​മാ​ക്കി സൗ​ദി,തീ​ർ​ത്ഥാ​ട​ക​രു​ടെ ആ​രോ​ഗ്യ​കാ​ര്യ​ങ്ങ​ളി​ൽ സൂ​ക്ഷ്​​മ നി​രീ​ക്ഷ​ണം | Ebola, Hanta virus threat: Saudi Arabia steps up vigilance, closely monitors pilgrims' health | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Hanta virus threat: Saudi Arabia steps up vigilance, closely monitors pilgrims' health
article.articleSummary: Ebola and Hantavirus threats prompt Saudi Arabia to heighten vigilance for Hajj pilgrims. In the wake of WHO's May 17 declaration that the Congo Ebola outbreak is a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, Saudi health authorities report no Ebola or Hantavirus cases in the kingdom. Since July 2019, strict Ebola precautions are in place. Entry visas for travelers from affected regions are temporarily suspended, with current restrictions based on risk assessments. Saudi Arabia's epidemiological surveillance system is fully prepared to protect pilgrims, residents, and visitors. During the Hajj season, health defenses at air, sea, and land borders have been expanded and dedicated response teams deployed. Health education and guidance for travelers from affected areas have intensified; daily infection surveillance for Hajj-bound pilgrims from neighboring countries is active. Suspected cases are promptly managed, with ongoing domestic-international coordination. Hantavirus is currently considered low risk; monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス、ハンタウイルスの脅威：サウジアラビアが警戒を強化し、巡礼者の健康を厳密に監視
