triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は1つのみ該当（異常性）で基準未満だが、WHOによるコンゴでのエボラ宣言（PHEIC）と関連し、スクリーニング基準で異常/予想外および流行しやすさで該当。情報不足（実際の症例がない）のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはコンゴでのエボラ発生（WHOがPHEIC宣言）であり、サウジアラビアはこれへの警戒態勢報道である。サウジアラビア国内での実症例は報告されていない。Hantavirusはサウジでは低リスク評価。DRCが唯一の検証地域。

article.articleHeadline: Fresh Ebola Outbreak Confirmed in DRC's Ituri Province; WHO Ramps Up Regional Emergency Support
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, WHO Africa officially confirms a new Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Emergency support is rapidly scaled up to assist Kinshasa. The outbreak is distinct from the Kasai Province Ebola outbreak declared over on 1 December 2025, and Uganda’s Kampala outbreak ended in April 2025, with no nationwide outbreaks currently declared there. Local media report up to 139 deaths among about 600 suspected cases, though global health authorities maintain conservative figures pending verification. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids (blood, vomit, feces, sweat) and contaminated surfaces. Ebola pathophysiology involves immune suppression followed by a cytokine storm, viral sepsis, and disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC), potentially causing multi-organ failure. Nigeria emphasizes proactive regional surveillance as it monitors the developing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRC イトゥリ州での新たなエボラ出血熱が確認、WHO は地域緊急支援を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による新規発生、複数国への波及可能性、高い致死率。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウガンダとナイジェリアも含まれているが、サマリー上では主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）である。ウガンダのカンパラ患者発生は2025年4月に終了、ナイジェリアは監視段階であり、現在の新規発生はDRCに限定される。Bundibugyo株の新規発生は稀であり、高い致死率（推定23%）を示唆。WHO による地域対応支援の拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог рассказала об особенности лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virologist described the features of Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever is an acute infectious disease caused by a filovirus. Reported symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle and headache pain, sore throat and abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, with hemorrhagic manifestations possible. As of May 23, 2026, Russian virologist Elena Malinnikova notes that large Ebola outbreaks occur regularly and cyclically every few years, and that safety measures are covered under Russia’s federal project 'Sanitary Shield.' Russian specialists also assist in Ebola control efforts in other countries. The World Health Organization has previously declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda an international public health emergency of international concern. The article emphasizes ongoing vigilance and safety protocols rather than current case counts or treatment details.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者がエボラ熱の特徴について説明
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ熱の一般的な特徴と過去の発生について述べたインフォメーション記事であり、現在の新規発生イベント、現在のケース数、または流行状況に関する具体的な情報が含まれていない。歴史的な文脈のみで、即時的なシグナルとしては不明確。
triage.notes: 記事は現在進行中のエボラ発生イベントを報告するものではなく、ロシアのウイルス学者によるエボラ熱に関する教育的解説である。DRCとウガンダにおけるWHOの過去の宣言が言及されているが、現在の新規患者数や現在の流行状況の情報は不含。ウガンダはCEPR対象国リストに未含。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. halts visa issuance for travelers from Ebola-hit African nations - says WSJ By Investing.com
article.articleSummary: U.S. suspends visa issuance for travelers who have visited South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), or Uganda within 21 days of planned arrival, and blocks re-entry for certain lawful permanent residents. This follows a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak centered on the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Originating in eastern Congo’s Ituri province, the outbreak was identified by WHO on May 15; by May 23, WHO reported 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The U.S. has allocated $23 million to fund up to 50 localized treatment clinics in affected regions. The CDC is deploying staff to Uganda for surveillance, laboratory testing, and contact tracing, coordinating with Kenya to prevent cross-border transmission. Critics cite the dismantling of USAID, while the State Department points to a five-year, $1.2 billion agreement with the DRC signed in February to sustain regional support.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ感染が報告されたアフリカ諸国からの旅行者に対するビザ発行を一時停止 - WSJが報道
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（750疑い症例、177疑い死亡）、国際的な渡航制限措置、米国を含む複数国への拡大懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イツリ州）が主要な発生地域であり、ウガンダ・南スーダンは接触者追跡対象国。米国はGeoNamesに含まれるが、記事の感染症イベント主体はDRCのため verified_locations に米国は含めない。WHOが5月15日に識別、5月23日時点で750疑い症例・177疑い死亡と報告。ワクチン・治療法なしのBundibugyo株による流行は高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: 베트남, 에볼라 바이러스 유입 차단 '총력'...선제적 방역망 가동
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam mobilizes all-out efforts to block Ebola virus entry; proactive epidemic-prevention network activated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemics in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda continue to unfold; Vietnam's Ministry of Health has launched urgent surveillance and preventive measures to block potential entry of the virus. On May 22, a video conference on Ebola surveillance and control was held. WHO Vietnam notes the outbreak dynamics remain complex; and while regional and global risk is assessed as low, the threat of export to other countries persists, prompting proactive action. Vietnam reports no Ebola cases to date; risk of introduction through travelers remains non-zero. The Preventive Medicine Department, in collaboration with WHO Vietnam, is monitoring outbreak developments and updating IHR channels, directing provincial health authorities to strengthen surveillance, especially for arrivals from affected areas. The Central Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology and Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute have ordered dedicated diagnostic reagents per WHO guidelines; delivery expected in about a week.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、エボラウイルス流入遮断に「総力」...先制的防疫網稼働
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。既知の流行国（DRC、ウガンダ）からベトナムへの輸入リスク対応であり、地域検証で確実にベトナムが対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行の継続を背景に、ベトナムが渡航者経由での流入リスクに対応するために監視・防疫体制を強化したことを主題としている。ベトナムでのエボラ症例は報告されていないが、IHR連絡先の更新、診断試薬の調達など、準備・警戒段階の対応が進行中である。Ho Chi Minh CityはベトナムのPPLA（主要都市）であり、確認された発生地域に含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: US temporarily bans entry of green card holders over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the United States temporarily banned entry of lawful permanent residents who have traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days due to Ebola concerns. Previously exempt from a 30-day Ebola ban, green card holders are now restricted as the CDC seeks to prevent virus importation, arguing this balance protects public health during an emergency response. The World Health Organization has raised the risk from the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola to 'very high' and designated the DRC and Uganda outbreaks as emergencies of international concern. The policy relies on Title 42 of public health law, and the CDC first issued the order the prior Monday; green card holders have historically been shielded from entry bans, and COVID-era Title 42 did not apply to them.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ懸念により永住権保持者の入国を一時的に禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、WHO PHEIC指定、複数国での流行、米国による入国制限措置といった国際的影響が明確。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際のエボラ流行発生地はDRC（民主コンゴ）とウガンダ。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。米国による入国禁止措置は国際的な渡航制限に該当し、IHR Annex2基準を完全に満たす。WHO PHEIC指定はPHEICステータスの確認が必要だが、サマリーで'emergencies of international concern'と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Selección del Congo será aislada en Estados Unidos para el Mundial 2026 ante brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo national team will be isolated in the United States ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers the Congo national football team to be isolated in the United States for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Players must complete a 21-day quarantine in Belgium before attempting to enter the United States; non-compliance will bar entry. The squad is training in Belgium for two warm-up matches before their World Cup debut versus Portugal on June 17 at Houston. They then face Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara, and Uzbekistan in Atlanta to close the group. The U.S. government will deny entry if quarantine is not observed. In the DRC, around 600 suspected Ebola cases have been reported with 139 confirmed deaths. Measures reflect outbreak control and cross-border travel restrictions related to the Ebola situation in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に伴い、コンゴ代表がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を理由に2026年ワールドカップのため米国で隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。DRC内で600例の疑い例と139人の死亡が報告されており、国際スポーツイベントへの影響を通じて国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはメキシコ、ジョージア州など多数の場所が含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラ流行は民主共和国コンゴ（DRC）で発生していることが明確。他地域は隔離措置や国際的対応の場所であり、発生地ではない。DRCの患者数（600疑い例、139確認死亡）は重大な公衆衛生的影響を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 暴增至3倍！　民主剛果「伊波拉疑似病例」1周飆750例、177死 | ETtoday國際新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tripled! Ebola suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surge to 750 in a week, with 177 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing a rapidly expanding Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain. Suspected cases total nearly 750 with 177 deaths, a threefold rise from about 246 cases and 65 deaths a week earlier. Most cases are concentrated in Ituri Province, with the Rwampara area highlighted; two cases have been reported in neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization has raised the country’s risk to very high, while regional risk remains high and global risk is low. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo virus. Frontline responses face funding cuts, equipment shortages, and workforce constraints, hindering case reporting and contact tracing. A potential antiviral, obeldesivir, is under clinical study to prevent illness among contacts. Community distrust and violence against relief efforts further complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: 3倍に急増！コンゴ民主共和国の「エボラ疑い症例」1週間で750例に、177人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（疑い症例750例、死亡177例）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国レベルのリスク評価を「非常に高い」に引き上げており、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク。1週間で症例3倍増（246→750例）、死亡2.7倍増（65→177例）。Ituri州が中心だが、ウガンダでも2例確認。WHOは国レベルリスク「非常に高い」、地域は「高い」、グローバルは「低い」と評価。治療法・ワクチン不足、資金・装備・人的資源制約、コミュニティ不信が対応を阻害。obeldesivir臨床試験中。

article.articleHeadline: Atlanta y Houston se suman a la lista de aeropuertos que pueden recibir pasajeros de tres países en medio de brote de ébola - WTOP News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Atlanta and Houston join the list of airports that can receive passengers from three countries amid an Ebola outbreak - WTOP News.
article.articleSummary: Amid a rapidly advancing Ebola outbreak in Africa, the United States expands entry screening to travelers who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days. Beginning after 11:59 p.m. Miami time on specified dates, flights arriving at Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson, Houston’s George Bush Intercontinental, and Washington Dulles International will be routed to health screening for these passengers. Dulles already handles such checks and will receive at least 10 CDC staff to assist. Title 42 will be invoked for at least 30 days, restricting entry for non-citizens with recent exposure, with ongoing monitoring. Travelers go to a dedicated screening area for travel-history questions and temperature checks; asymptomatic individuals receive guidance, while symptomatic travelers are isolated and tested. An Air France flight was diverted after a Congo-born passenger was denied entry.

triage.headline_ja: アトランタとヒューストンがエボラ流行の中で3カ国からの乗客を受け入れられる空港リストに追加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。アフリカでのエボラ急速拡大、複数国への国際的拡大、米国での入国スクリーニング強化、渡航制限措置の実施。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月配信で将来日付。アフリカでのエボラ流行がアフリカ地域（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン）で発生していることを示唆。発生地域リストにはアフリカ、DRC、ウガンダ、スーダンが含まれるが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国での空港スクリーニング強化は対応措置であり、米国でのエボラ発生ではない。Title 42発動、複数米国空港への航空便ルート変更、CDC人員配置は政府の公衆衛生上の懸念の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. suspende visados para viajeros procedentes de países africanos afectados por el ébola Por Investing.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. suspends visas for travelers from African countries affected by Ebola. By Investing.com.
article.articleSummary: US suspends visa issuance for travelers who have visited South Sudan, the DRC, or Uganda within the prior 21 days, and bars re-entry for lawful permanent residents who recently traveled to affected countries. The measure targets an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, originated in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, and identified by WHO on 15 May 2025. As of Friday, WHO reports 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. The United States has declared an emergency and earmarked $23 billion to support up to 50 local treatment clinics in the affected regions. The CDC is deploying staff to Uganda for surveillance, testing, and contact tracing, in coordination with Kenya’s MOH to prevent cross-border transmission. Critics say USAID restructuring weakened health networks, while the State Department cites a five-year $1.2 billion health agreement with the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱の影響を受けたアフリカ諸国からの旅行者に対するビザ発行を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク（750疑似症例、177死亡）は深刻であり、複数国での報告と渡航制限措置の実施により、国際的な関心と対応が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生地はItturi州（DRC）、South Sudan、Uganda、Kenyaであるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。アウトブレイク初期段階で750疑似症例、177死亡、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数国への国際対応が展開されている。米国が23億ドルを拠出し、CDCをウガンダに派遣するなど、強い国際的対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 美国将埃博拉疫情相关旅行禁令扩大至绿卡持有者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. expands Ebola outbreak-related travel ban to green card holders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concerns prompt the United States to widen a travel ban to include green card holders. On May 22, U.S. authorities announced a temporary ban barring lawful permanent residents who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days from entering the United States. Previously, U.S. citizens, nationals, and green card holders were exempt from the Ebola travel ban, but the CDC stated on May 22 that expanding the ban to green card holders is a necessary measure to prevent the virus from entering the country. The policy targets travelers with recent exposure to Ebola-affected regions; no domestic cases or outbreak figures are provided in the article. The move underscores ongoing concerns about Ebola outbreaks in central and eastern Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ感染症関連の渡航禁止令をグリーンカード保持者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで確認されており、米国が渡航禁止令を拡大するなど国際的対応が取られている。IHR基準の「国際的に拡大するリスク」「渡航・貿易を制限するリスク」に該当し、かつスクリーニング基準「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにウガンダ(226074)と南スーダン(366755)も含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めない。ただし、DRCにおけるエボラ発生が確認されており、米国の対応は国際的関心を示唆している。記事では具体的な患者数や死亡数は未記載だが、当局による迅速な対応から重大性が推定される。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉死亡人數攀升 WHO：民主剛果風險升至最高級別 - 國際 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll climbs; WHO: Risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to the highest level.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, has been raised to the highest risk level by the World Health Organization (WHO) on May 22, 2026, and labeled a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The DRC reports 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, with roughly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths under investigation. WHO says the outbreak is likely larger than confirmed figures, and the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species is suspected, for which no approved vaccines or therapies exist; existing treatments are being evaluated for activity against this strain. Healthcare workers operate in highly unstable security zones, with strict contact tracing. Ituri authorities have banned public gatherings, restricted funerals to professional teams, prohibited non-medical vehicles from transporting bodies, limited gatherings to 50 people, and suspended the local football league.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死亡者数が増加、WHO：民主共和国コンゴのリスクが最高レベルに上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生脅威で、国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）に指定され、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus種であり、承認されたワクチンや治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。既存治療法の有効性評価が進行中。医療体制が不安定な治安状況下にあり、感染拡大のリスクが高い。WHOによるPHEIC指定は最高レベルのシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: США приостановили выдачу виз гражданам из стран, охваченных Эболой От Investing.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States suspended visa issuance to citizens of Ebola-affected countries — Investing.com.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved vaccine or treatment. As of May 22, 2026, the World Health Organization reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, the outbreak identified on May 15 and spreading before official recognition. The United States has suspended visa issuance for travelers who visited South Sudan, the DRC, or Uganda within 21 days before planned entry, also restricting recent permanent residents. Washington allocates $23 million to fund up to 50 local clinics to bolster care in affected regions. The CDC is deploying specialists to Uganda for epidemiologic surveillance, laboratory testing, and contact tracing, and coordinating with Kenya’s Ministry of Health to prevent cross-border spread. Critics argue that USAID restructuring weakened local health networks, while the State Department cites a February five-year, $1.2 billion public health agreement with the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行国の市民へのビザ発給を一時停止 — Investing.com
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数の疑い症例（750例）と死亡（177例）、国際的な渡航制限措置、複数国への拡大リスク、および米国による国際的な対応措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri Province）である。ウガンダとケニアは監視・予防対策の対象国として言及されているが、実際の確認症例の主要な発生地はDRCに限定されている。Bundibugyo strain、承認されたワクチン・治療法なし、5月22日時点で750疑い症例・177死亡報告。米国による多層的な対応（ビザ停止、資金配分、CDC派遣）が実施されており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: Warum Zoonosen-AuslÃ¶ser wieder eskalieren
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: Why Zoonotic Triggers Are Escalating Again.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to grow, the 17th outbreak since the virus was first identified in 1976. Experts point to zoonotic triggers: fruit bats as viral reservoirs, frequent human–wildlife interactions, and porous cross-border movement with Uganda. Bushmeat markets supply primates and bats, and spillover can occur when contaminated food or environments bring virus into households, even without direct wildlife contact. The region near national parks hosts bats and primates; households interact with forest edges, gardens, and markets, increasing exposure risk. Public health emphasis on trusted, locally embedded communication, involving district authorities, health officials, religious leaders, and especially women’s groups who manage food preparation and child care. Data quality for contact tracing and border management are crucial, with WHO-supported programs and rapid diagnostics and vaccines referenced as critical components.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：人獣共通感染病の引き金がなぜ再び拡大しているのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスの第17次流行で重篤な公衆衛生影響、ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での流行が主題であり、ウガンダは越境リスク地域として言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCに限定される。人獣共通感染症の動物・環境ファクターが強調されており、公開情報による世間の関心も高い。WHO支援プログラムおよび急速診断・ワクチン配備が言及されており、国際支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: 미국, 에볼라 발생 아프리카 국가 여행자 비자 발급 중단 - WSJ By Investing.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Halts Tourist Visa Issuance for Ebola-Affected African Countries - WSJ by Investing.com
article.articleSummary: U.S. suspends tourist visa issuance for travelers who have visited within 21 days to South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), or Uganda amid an Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The policy also restricts re-entry for U.S. green-card holders returning from these countries. The outbreak began in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, and WHO officially confirmed it on May 15; as of May 23, WHO reported 177 suspected deaths and 750 suspected cases. The United States has allocated $23 million to support up to 50 local treatment clinics across affected areas. The CDC is deploying personnel to Uganda for surveillance, laboratory testing, and contact tracing, and is working with Kenya to curb cross-border spread. The push follows restructuring of U.S. foreign aid; critics say it weakened local health networks, though the State Department cites a $1.2 billion, five-year public-health accord with the DRC signed in February.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ発生アフリカ国家への観光ビザ発給中止 - WSJ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の確認された流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。死亡177人、疑い症例750人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な渡航制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イツリ州）を主要な発生地として言及している。スーダン、ケニア、ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリーではDRCが流行の中心地として記述されており、ウガンダはCDC展開地として言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定した。米国の渡航制限措置はビザ政策に関する対応措置であり、国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola: ONU afirma que puede haber una mayor catástrofe humanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: UN Says There Could Be a Greater Humanitarian Catastrophe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia epicenter) is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a case fatality rate of 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Declared around May 15, the outbreak has prompted WHO to classify it as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global epidemic risk remains low. The UN World Food Programme warns of a potential humanitarian catastrophe without rapid, large-scale action; Bunia is serving as the operational center, with 46 tons of supplies distributed. Urgent funding of $23 million is sought to aid more than 146,000 people in Ituri over three months, addressing health, food, and logistical needs. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. Cross-border cases include Uganda’s two imported RDC cases in Kampala (one death); South Sudan is testing a suspected case near the Congo border.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：国連は、より大きな人道的大惨事の可能性があると述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、国際越境例あり、死亡率30-50%で重症。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain、CFR 30-50%。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダへの越境事例（カンパラで2例、1例死亡）あり。南スーダンでも疑い例検査中と記載されているが、これらは輸入例であり、記事の主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ県（ブニア）。資金要求$23百万、対象人口146,000人以上。

article.articleHeadline: "걸리면 둘 중 하나 죽는다"...생존해도 시력·청력 손실 위험 '바이러스' 정체는 - 매일경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "If you contract it, half of those infected die... Even if you survive, risk of vision and hearing loss—the identity of the 'virus'."
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo’s northeastern Ituri Province and neighboring Uganda has caused at least 139 deaths and over 600 suspected cases as of May 21, 2026. The World Health Organization has declared this situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Bundibugyo virus is a rare Ebola lineage (identified in 2007) with four of six Ebola species known to infect humans; transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids, not airborne, with healthcare settings often implicated. Early symptoms mimic flu or malaria (high fever, severe headache, fatigue, myalgia, sore throat), followed by severe diarrhea, vomiting, possible gum or nasal bleeding, and potential CNS changes. Incubation ranges 2–21 days (median about one week). Historical case fatality for Bundibugyo outbreaks is estimated at 30–50%. No vaccine or specific treatment exists; care is supportive (fluids, oxygen, symptom relief). Survivors may face long-term sequelae such as vision/hearing loss and chronic pain.

triage.headline_ja: 「かかると半数が死ぬ...」生き残っても視力・聴力喪失の危険性がある『ウイルス』の正体は
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreakは139死亡、600以上の疑い症例を報告、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国メディア（매일경제）による報道であり、アフリカでの発生状況が国際的に注目されている。UgandaはBluedot APIで付与されているが、サマリーではDRC northeastern Ituri Province and neighboring Ugandaと記述されており、主要な発生地はDRCである。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行い、国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 联合国拨款加速应对刚果等地伊波拉疫情 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN funding accelerates the response to Ebola outbreaks in the Congo and other areas - International - Instant International
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the United Nations allocated $60 million (2.38 billion ringgit) to accelerate Ebola outbreak responses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and surrounding regions. UN Deputy Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator Fletcher stated that rapid, coordinated action is essential to curb spread before it escalates. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapeutics. WHO leads the international response, but the epidemiological situation remains challenging amid conflict and high population movement. Access to areas controlled by armed groups is a critical hurdle; effective community engagement, early warning, and robust surveillance are required. The UN and partners have deployed additional personnel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan to bolster response and protect humanitarian workers.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴなど地域のエボラ流行への対応を加速するため資金配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高致命率と医療対応なしの異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、国連による国際的対応と渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの懸念疾患であり、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC を主要な発生地として記述。Uganda と Sudan も言及されているが、対象国リスト内にはなく、記事の焦点は DRC に集中しているため、verified_locations は DRC のみとした。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスで承認ワクチン・治療薬なし、武装勢力支配地域でのアクセス困難、高い人口移動など複数の増幅要因あり。国連による6,000万ドル資金配分と国際的対応の展開から社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला प्रभावित अफ्रीकी देशों के यात्रियों के लिए अमेरिका ने वीज़ा जारी करना रोका द्वारा Investing.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Investing.com: United States stops issuing visas for travelers from Ebola-affected African countries
article.articleSummary: United States suspends visa issuance for travelers who visited South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), or Uganda within 21 days of planned U.S. travel, including lawful permanent residents. This comes as a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or treatment, has 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths (reported by WHO as of May 23, following identification on May 15). In response, the U.S. has allocated $23 million to establish 50 local treatment clinics. The CDC is deploying staff in Uganda for surveillance, lab testing, and contact tracing, and is coordinating with Kenya’s health ministry to curb cross-border transmission. Critics argue foreign aid cuts weakened health networks, but the State Department cites a $1.2 billion, five-year public health agreement with the DRC signed in February as ongoing support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の影響を受けたアフリカ諸国からの旅行者に対して米国がビザ発行を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（750疑い例、177疑い死亡、ワクチン・治療法なし）は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、複数国への拡大リスクと国際的な渡航制限を伴う異常事態である。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ東部イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱拡大を主題とし、DRCが実際の感染流行地である。南スーダン・ウガンダは米国の渡航制限の対象国として言及されているが、記事サマリーの主な流行地はDRCのみ。米国はAPIが付与した発生地域に含まれているが、感染発生地ではなく対応国（渡航制限実施国）であるため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: США запретили въезд владельцам грин-карт, побывавшим в зоне эпидемии Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States banned entry for green-card holders who had been in the Ebola outbreak zone.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the United States imposed a temporary entry ban on green-card holders who traveled to Ebola-affected areas — Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan — within the prior 21 days, to prevent importation of Ebola. The order, signed by Health and Human Services Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr., cites limited quarantine resources and argues that localizing quarantinable diseases in the United States requires substantial capacity, including specialized, isolated facilities. Previously, entry restrictions applied to foreigners only; U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents were exempt. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, preliminary counts as of May 22, 2026 show 177 deaths and 750 infections. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the outbreak is spreading rapidly and poses a very high national threat. In eastern Congo, locals burned a medical center treating Ebola patients in protest over a body-handling dispute.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱流行地域への渡航歴のあるグリーンカード保持者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（米国への持ち込み防止措置）と深刻な公衆衛生影響（DRCで750感染、177死亡、急速蔓延警告）が明確に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と流行しやすさが該当し、国際的な管理対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ出血熱の実際の発生地としてDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンに言及しているが、確認された具体的な患者数（750感染、177死亡）はDRCのみ記載。米国は流行地域からの入国制限を実施する側であり、発生国ではない。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOからの警告と医療施設の焼却事件により、紛争と感染制御の複雑性が示唆されている。

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ感染症の流行に影響を受けたアフリカ諸国へのビザ発給を停止 - WSJ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な懸念による渡航制限）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度、流行易感染性、管理可能性）。国際的な対応と支援が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは南スーダン、コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダへのビザ発給停止と記載されているが、実際のエボラ流行の報告はDRC東部のイトゥリ州に限定されている。サマリーの記述上、主たる発生地はDRCで、南スーダン・ウガンダは懸念国として言及されているが、確認症例の報告はDRCのみ。ウガンダはCDC派遣によるサーベイランス対象国だが、流行確認地ではない。米国の対応は広範だが、実際の流行はDRCに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia Bisa Tiru Amerika Serikat Melindungi Warganya dari Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia Could Follow the United States' Lead in Protecting Its Citizens from Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 51 laboratory-confirmed cases in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths, and WHO warns that cases are likely to rise. On 18 May 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), and related units launched proactive measures to protect Americans for an initial 30 days. Four core policies: strengthen screening and monitoring of travelers from affected areas; restrict entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have been in Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan within the last 21 days; coordinate with airlines, international partners, and entry officials to identify potentially exposed visitors; and bolster port-of-entry response, contact tracing, laboratory testing capacity, and hospital readiness. Indonesian experts, including Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama, say Indonesia could mirror this approach.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアは米国に倣いエボラからの国民保護を実施できる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率を伴う致命的な感染症であり、複数国での確認例と疑い例が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンでの発生を述べているが、ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めていない。インドネシアは対象国であり、記事の主題（インドネシアが米国の対策を導入すべきか）に直接関連しているため含める。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、発生地域として明示されているため含める。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の確認例51件、疑い例600件、疑い死亡者139件という報告は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。

article.articleHeadline: 美国将埃博拉疫情相关旅行禁令扩大至绿卡持有者 看点
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US Expands Ebola Outbreak-Related Travel Ban to Green Card Holders — Highlights
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention announced a temporary expansion of the Ebola-related entry ban to include lawful permanent residents (green card holders) who in the past 21 days had visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan. Previously, U.S. citizens, nationals and green card holders were exempt from the 30-day Ebola travel ban, but the CDC said expanding the ban to green card holders is a necessary measure to prevent the virus entering the United States. The policy reflects ongoing concern about Ebola outbreaks in the affected countries. The announcement tightens travel controls for individuals with recent exposure, even for permanent residents.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ感染症関連の渡航禁止令をグリーンカード保有者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの複数国での同時発生と米国による渡航制限措置拡大は公衆衛生上の深刻な対応を示唆しており、スクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が言及されている。対象国リスト内では DRC のみが該当。米国の渡航禁止令拡大は制度的対応の進展を示すが、流行地域は対象国外に集中している（ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象外）。ただし DRC での持続的発生と米国による強化対応の実施がIHR・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: हाथी पांव बीमारी क्या है? जानिए फाइलेरिया के लक्षण, कारण और बचाव के तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is elephantiasis? Learn the symptoms, causes, and ways to prevent filariasis.
article.articleSummary: Filariasis, or elephantiasis, is a mosquito-borne infection causing marked swelling of limbs, especially legs; men may develop scrotal swelling and women breast swelling, with progressive edema leading to disability. In India, Bihar, Assam, and Nagaland have historically reported the highest caseloads, with thousands affected. Transmission is via female Culex mosquitoes and can affect all ages; symptoms emerge gradually. Prevention emphasizes mosquito avoidance, nets, and timely medications to prevent complications. Treatments range from wound care and daily washing to antibiotics and antifungal creams; avoid prolonged leg hanging and engage in light exercise. Ayurveda prescriptions (as per Dr. Jitendra Verma) include Panchakarma with sesame oil massage and certain rasas; dietary guidance excludes refined flour, fried foods, pickles, and bananas, while favoring green vegetables, milk, and pure cow ghee. Diethylcarbamazine citrate (Hetarajan, Banocide) is noted as effective. Ambala Cantonment Civil Hospital OPD offers treatment with a nominal 5-rupee prescription.

triage.headline_ja: 象皮病とは何か？フィラリア症の症状、原因、予防方法について学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: リンパフィラリア症に関する一般的な健康教育・啓発記事であり、新規の集団発生や緊急事態を報告するものではない。歴史的なリスク地域の言及のみで、現在の流行状況や異常な増加は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド国内で報告された既知のリンパフィラリア症の流行地域（ビハール州、アッサム州、ナーガランド州）について言及していますが、新規の集団発生や疾病負荷の増加ではなく、既存疾患に関する一般的な予防・治療情報をまとめた教育的コンテンツです。アンバラ市民病院のOPD実施記載がありますが、新たな臨床的懸念は示唆されていません。

article.articleHeadline: OMS eleva a muy alto el riesgo de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the Ebola risk in the DRC to a very high level.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization raised the Ebola national risk level in the Democratic Republic of Congo to very high due to rapid spread in conflict-affected areas. Confirmed cases total 82 with 7 deaths; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are under investigation. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has spread across North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri, the outbreak’s focus. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain; control centers on rapid case detection, isolation, and contact tracing. Security constraints limit humanitarian access, with funeral bans and capped public gatherings in Ituri and transport restrictions in North Kivu. Uganda reports two cases and one death; Rwanda restricting entry for travelers from DRC. Additionally, a U.S. patient is in Germany and a high-risk contact in the Czech Republic. Monoclonal antibodies Regeneron 3479 and MBP134 are prioritized for trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国家での確認、急速な感染拡大、国際的な渡航制限が実施されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の多地域同時発生。確定82例・死亡7例、疑い症例750例・疑い死亡177例。ウガンダ（対象国外）で2例1死亡、ルワンダ（対象国外）が入国制限、米国・ドイツ・チェコ（対象国外）でも輸入症例。紛争地域での感染拡大により人道支援アクセス制限。ライセンス化されたワクチンなし。WHOが国家リスク評価を「非常に高い」に引き上げた時点での公式声明。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるが、世界的公衆衛生脅威として重要度極高。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo: OMS eleva el riesgo a "muy alto"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: WHO raises the risk to "very high".
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus has prompted the World Health Organization to raise the level of health risk to 'very high' and declare the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), while not yet a global pandemic. As of May 22, 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths have been reported in DRC, with an estimated 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths under investigation. In Uganda, two epidemiologically linked cases and one death have occurred, with no new transmission among monitored contacts. No vaccines or approved therapies exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; control relies on strengthened surveillance, comprehensive contact tracing, patient isolation, and rapid diagnostics, including 21-day follow-up and updated case registries. Trials are being explored for two monoclonal antibodies and the antiviral obeldesivir. International Health Regulations measures emphasize risk communication, community engagement, laboratory capacity, and entry-point controls, with no broad border closures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行：WHOがリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの重大事象。DRCで82確定患者・7死亡、ウガンダでも波及確認。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として即座のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での波及も報告されているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみ記載。記事サマリーにおいて、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ボンディブギオエボラウイルス）の主要な流行地はDRCであり、ウガンダは限定的な波及。WHOがすでにPHEIC宣言・リスク『非常に高い』評価済みであり、緊急度は最高レベル。ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、支援的治療と接触者追跡に依存する脆弱な状況も懸念。

article.articleHeadline: UN releases $60m from central fund to tackle lethal Ebola outbreak - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, the United Nations authorized the immediate release of $60 million from its Central Emergency Response Fund to combat a deadly Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and affecting neighboring central and eastern African nations. The funds will flow directly into high-priority, ground-level interventions, not administrative overhead, with a heavy emphasis on contact tracing using digital tools and PPE to map transmission in dense cities and remote forests. Rapid establishment of specialized treatment centres and mobile isolation units accompanies accelerated airlifted medical supplies, including experimental therapeutics, rehydration fluids, and bio-secure containment gear. The plan prioritizes community engagement via local leaders and youth groups to curb distrust, encourage early symptom recognition, and voluntary reporting. Officials warn cross-border transmission remains a risk, underscoring the need for sustained regional surveillance and cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 国連が致命的なエボラアウトブレークに対処するため中央基金から6000万ドルを放出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染リスク、複数国への影響、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念が明らかであり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。国連による大規模な緊急資金配分により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月23日のシミュレーション日付を示唆しているが、エボラアウトブレークの国際的拡大（中央・東アフリカの複数国への影響）と国連による大規模な緊急対応が述べられている。DRC中心の発生であることが確認される。接触追跡、移動制限の必要性、国境を越えた感染リスクが明記されており、国際的拡大の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO nâng mức báo động: Nguy cơ lây lan Ebola tại CHDC Congo ở mức "rất cao"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the alert level: The risk of Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is at a 'very high' level.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the World Health Organization has raised the risk assessment for Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to very high, while global risk remains low, announced by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at a Geneva briefing. The agency reports more than 750 suspected Ebola cases with 177 deaths in the DRC. On the same weekend, WHO officially declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and neighbouring Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The decision highlights international attention and the need for enhanced measures to contain transmission, given the Bundibugyo strain’s cross-border spread between DRC and Uganda. The report provides no further details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources, but the PHEIC designation indicates potential international public health impact.

triage.headline_ja: WHO raises the alert level: The risk of Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is at a 'very high' level.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が正式宣言され、DRCとウガンダの越境感染、750例以上の疑い患者と177人の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言により国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が正式に認識されている。Bundibugyo Ebola株の越境感染（DRC-ウガンダ間）が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。WHO事務局長による高レベルの警告発表で社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola recuerda las grietas de la salud global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak highlights the cracks in global health.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo show that Ebola control hinges on fragile health systems and the local context. Unlike Zaire ebolavirus, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; monoclonal therapies and vaccines target mainly Zaire. Control thus relies on rapid detection, isolation, contact tracing, and strong protection for health workers. The ground reality includes near-impenetrable roads, limited laboratories, and hospitals stretched to the limit, delaying diagnosis by days. Early symptoms are nonspecific—fever, fatigue, muscle pain, diarrhea, vomiting—often mimicking malaria or typhoid, delaying suspicion. Transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids of living or deceased patients, concentrating outbreaks around family care, insufficient PPE, and funeral rites. Outside affected areas, population risk remains low; the broader lesson is that outbreaks depend as much on where they begin as on the virus itself.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は世界保健制度の亀裂を浮き彫りにする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。治療法やワクチンが限定的なBundibugyo ebolavirus、脆弱な保健システムにおける制御困難性は国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC northeastern regionでのBundibugyo ebolavirus発生。ウガンダでの確認は言及されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus特有の課題（ワクチン・特異的治療なし、検査・隔離・接触追跡の困難性、脆弱な医療インフラ）が強調されており、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: The risk of ebola in the Congo, has been upgraded to very high, but remains low for the rest of the world
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has caused more than 170 deaths and nearly 750 suspected cases as of 23 May 2026. Oxford University scientists have begun developing a vaccine, but are three months away from clinical trials. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the outbreak is spreading rapidly, with risk classified as very high at national and regional levels, while global risk remains low. The Congo-specific risk is upgraded to very high, with the rest of the world at low risk. The report provides no details on the infection source or imported/exported cases. Ongoing international concern accompanies the local outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラリスク、非常に高いと格上げされるが、世界の他地域ではリスクは低いままとなる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラアウトブレイクは深刻な公衆衛生への影響を示しており、WHOが地域・国家レベルでの高リスク判定と国際的懸念を表明している。
triage.notes: 英国が発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上では輸入例の有無が不明で、主要な発生地はコンゴ（DRC）のみ。DRCは対象国ではないが、エボラアウトブレイク情報としてのシグナルとしての重要性は高い。170人以上の死亡、750近い疑い例が報告されており、WHOが国家・地域レベルでの非常に高いリスク判定を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ausbruch in Zentralafrika: Ebola: Wenn Rebellen das Gesundheitswesen kontrollieren
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in Central Africa: Ebola: When rebels control the health care system.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in mining-rich Ituri with cases in North Kivu and South Kivu amid decades of fighting and rebel governance. Ituri hosts the majority of cases in a region with four armed groups, including ADF; Codeco attacks last month killed about 70 people. In Goma, the North Kivu provincial capital, two Ebola cases have been reported, with another confirmed in South Kivu. The M23 militia runs some health services in areas under its control, while formal government–rebel cooperation is absent. Displacement is massive: Ituri alone hosts over 920,000 internally displaced people; more than 100,000 fled in the first three months of renewed clashes; East Congo may hold up to 4 million IDPs. MSF notes access is difficult; aid teams reach remote areas with motorcycles to spot new clusters, as security endangers responders. The article emphasizes the need to prioritize health above politics.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカの感染拡大：エボラ：反政府勢力が医療制度を支配する場合
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（異常、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラ出血熱のDRC東部での発生は国際的な重要シグナルであり、セキュリティ課題による対応困難性が加わる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）での明確なエボラ発生を記述。複数州での症例報告、920,000人超の国内避難民、M23など複数の武装勢力によるヘルスケア支配、MSFのアクセス困難性が確認される。セキュリティ情勢と公衆衛生危機の同時発生により、対応能力が著しく制約されている。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ypê alerta consumidores sobre produtos contaminados e orienta cuidados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ypê Warns Consumers About Contaminated Products and Advises Precautions.
article.articleSummary: On the 7th, ANVISA suspended the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of Ypê products ending in batch 1 due to contamination with Pseudomonas aeruginosa in Brazil. Affected items include Ypê Clear Care dishwashing liquid; Ypê dishwashing liquids with active enzymes; Ypê Dishwashing Liquid; Ypê Dishwashing Liquid Soft Touch; Tixan Ypê Combate Mau Odor liquid laundry detergent; Tixan Ypê Cuida das Roupas liquid laundry detergent; Bak Ypê disinfectant; and Atol general-use disinfectant. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is a bacterium with antibiotic resistance that can cause serious illness in immunocompromised and chronically ill patients. Consumers should avoid using the products and store them separately until new guidance from Anvisa; disposal guidance will follow. Ypê offers refunds via official channels or a website form. The company has instructed its distribution and retailers to segregate affected products and continues cooperating with authorities with technical analyses, reaffirming its commitment to safety and quality.

triage.headline_ja: Ypêが汚染された製品について消費者に警告し、注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは製品汚染に関する消費者警告であり、感染症の流行・集団発生ではない。公衆衛生上の急性的な脅威を示さず、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: このイベントは製品汚染に関する単発的な消費者警告であり、感染症の公衆衛生危機ではない。Pseudomonas aeruginosaの存在は記載されているが、実際の患者発生例や集団感染の報告がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。また記事サマリーから、ブラジルで実際に感染症イベントが発生しているという証拠がないため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 100 muertos, sin control ni vacuna: ¿debería preocuparnos el nuevo brote de ébola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More Than 100 Dead, Out of Control and Without a Vaccine: Should We Be Worried About the New Ebola Outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, with more than 100 deaths and about 600 suspected cases reported. Lab-confirmed cases total 33 in DRC across Ituri, North Kivu, Bunia, and Goma, plus 2 cases and 1 death in Uganda. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; regional risk is high, while global risk remains low. Early symptoms are nonspecific (fever, malaise, muscle pains, diarrhea) with a 2–21 day incubation, complicating contact tracing. Transmission occurs via body fluids and contaminated objects; frontline exposure includes families and health workers. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; the Zaire Ebola vaccine exists but is not protective against Bundibugyo. Two vaccine candidates are in development, potentially 6–9 months to readiness, with distribution challenges amid conflict in eastern DRC. Care focuses on supportive treatment, nutrition, and psychological support, as displacement and cross-border movement to South Sudan and Uganda hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: 100人以上の死亡、制御不能でワクチンもない：新たなエボラ流行について懸念すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）による国際的懸念事項として、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: ウガンダは検出地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認事例は2件・死亡1件に留まり、流行の主体はDRCである。そのため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo strain は既存のZaire Ebola ワクチンで防護不可能であり、新規候補ワクチンは6-9ヶ月の開発期間が必要。東部DRCの紛争と南スーダン・ウガンダへの人口移動が封じ込めを複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ausbruch in Zentralafrika: Ebola: Wenn Rebellen das Gesundheitswesen kontrollieren - Wissenschaft - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in Central Africa: Ebola: When rebels control the health care system.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s eastern provinces has majorly hit Ituri, with Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu affected. In Goma two cases have been reported and a third in Sud-Kivu; the first death in Goma generated 189 contacts. The outbreak clusters in a mining belt with dense populations and high mobility. In Ituri, over 920,000 internally displaced people are recorded, and up to four million IDPs exist in the east overall. Ongoing fighting, including ADF attacks and Codeco violence, plus M23 rebels who control parts of Goma and Bukavu, hinder outbreak response and health-care delivery; no formal government-rebel coordination. MSF notes that traveling to care facilities can be life-threatening, and roads turn to mud in the rainy season. Response relies on motorcycle teams to reach remote clusters and identify transmission foci to stop spread.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカにおける流行：エボラ：反政府勢力が医療制度を支配する場合
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多地域流行（イツリ、ノルドキブ、スキブ州）で920万人超の国内避難民が影響を受け、反政府勢力による医療制度妨害により管理が困難な状況。IHR基準3つ該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当し、国際的な懸念の対象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の複数州同時流行。イツリ州での920万人超のIDP、ノルドキブ州のゴマで死者・接触者189名、スキブ州での複数患者報告。採鉱地帯での高い人口密度と移動性が懸念。M23反政府勢力によるゴマ・ブカブの支配、ADF/Codeco勢力による戦闘が医療対応を大幅に阻害。MSFによる懸念報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Jateng Perlu Waspada Brucellosis Penyakit Hewan Menular Manusia Jelang Iduladha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Java Must Be On Guard Against Brucellosis, a Zoonotic Disease Ahead of Eid al-Adha.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis in Central Java poses a zoonotic threat ahead of Eid al-Adha. The disease, caused by Brucella, harms livestock reproductive health—causing abortions and infertility—and can infect humans. Authorities led by Nur Saptahidhayat (BBV Wates) say Central Java has not recorded brucellosis cases yet, but vigilance is essential, with fast response to any report. Although cases on Java are still rare, the potential economic impact is highlighted: infected cattle must be culled to prevent spread; leaving infections unchecked forces isolation and higher costs. Farmers may resist slaughter absent compensation (about Rp20–30 million per animal), while unmanaged outbreaks could cost Rp100–200 million. Distannak plans a compensation scheme and a roaming veterinary-health team. As of 2026, Central Java cattle number 1,393,159; sheep 1,421,246; goats 3,598,605.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ジャワはブルセラ症に警戒が必要 — イード・アル＝アドハー前の人獣共通感染症
triage.triage_reason: ブルセラ症は人獣共通感染症として重要だが、中部ジャワではまだ確認症例がなく、予防的警戒段階である。情報が限定的であり、実際の流行の兆候がないため、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はイード・アル＝アドハー前のブルセラ症への警戒を促すもので、現時点で中部ジャワでの確認症例なし。畜産業の経済的影響と家畜への曝露リスクが強調されている。ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく、動物接触による感染リスクが主体。情報がまだ予防段階であり、実症例の報告待ちが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kochi airport intensifies vigil over Ebola scare
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Kochi airport in Kerala intensified Ebola preparedness amid Africa-driven outbreak concerns. Cochin International Airport Ltd (CIAL) and the Airport Health Organisation (APHO) held an emergency meeting to bolster passenger monitoring and public health response. A 24x7 monitoring system has been activated, with thermal screening and 21-day travel history verification for international passengers. Passengers arriving from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan will be placed under special health surveillance due to global alert. Isolation wards have been established at Ernakulam General Hospital, Government Medical College Hospital in Kalamassery, and District Hospital in Aluva to manage potential cases. The measures focus on early detection of Ebola symptoms and coordinated response, leveraging existing hospital capacity to isolate and treat suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コーチン空港、エボラ熱懸念に対する警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。対象国インドにおけるエボラ熱の警戒体制強化は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケーララ州のコーチン空港でのエボラ熱対策強化について述べている。コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの到着者に対する特別な健康監視体制が実施されており、隔離病棟も準備されている。アフリカの複数国で発生しているとされるアウトブレイク状況への対応であり、国際的拡大リスクが明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: UK Scientists Race To Develop Ebola Vaccine That Could Enter Trials Within Months
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare Ebola virus species, causes severe hemorrhagic fever with fever, fatigue, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, internal bleeding and organ failure. It can kill about one-third of infected patients (case fatality ~33%). Unlike Zaire Ebola, which has vaccines, there is currently no proven vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. The current outbreak is particularly concerning due to the virus’s rarity, with only two prior outbreaks on record: Uganda in 2007 and Congo in 2012. UK scientists are racing to develop a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine that could enter human trials within months, aiming to provide protection against Bundibugyo strains rather than the more common Zaire strain. The article emphasizes accelerated development against Bundibugyo. It provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: イギリスの科学者がエボラワクチン開発を急速に進める、数ヶ月以内に臨床試験開始の可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの稀な種による感染症で、IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスクが認められるが、現段階では確認された患者数や具体的な流行状況が記事に記載されていない。ワクチン開発の報道であり、アクティブな患者集団の管理状況が不明であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にイギリスでのワクチン開発イニシアティブを扱っており、DRコンゴでの2012年アウトブレイク履歴に言及されている。ウガンダは2007年の過去のアウトブレイク参照であり、現在の活動中心地ではない。イギリスはワクチン開発の研究拠点であり、発生地ではないため除外。現在のアクティブな患者数、感染源、確認例の詳細が記事から得られていないため、情報不足が多い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Congo World Cup squad must isolate before entry to US
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, prompts U.S. restrictions on Congo’s World Cup squad. The 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths are accompanied by around 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. Congo’s team must isolate for 21 days in a bubble in Belgium before entry to the United States, with plans to travel to Houston on June 11 and play their first Group K match on June 17 against Portugal. The World Cup will be hosted in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The squad is exempt from a temporary U.S. travel ban affecting entrants who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. Authorities emphasize safety of Americans, participants, and fans; Kinshasa government referenced in communications.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行：コンゴのワールドカップチームは米国入国前に隔離が必須
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラの国際的拡大懸念と米国を含む多国間のイベント関連リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴのエボラ感染症流行が主題。DRC内での発生（キンシャサ）が確認され、米国等への国際的波及リスクが顕在化。ベルギーでの隔離措置、ワールドカップ関連の国際移動が関わるため国際的関心が極めて高い。発生地域にHouston等が記載されているが、サマリーはコンゴでの流行と米国への入国制限が主題であり、米国内での実際の感染症発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: US extends Ebola travel ban to Green Card holders
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda triggers US travel controls as green card holders face entry ban. The United States extended a public health restriction at the border to lawful permanent residents who have been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, broadening an existing 30-day ban that previously exempted US citizens and green card holders. The CDC issued the order under Title 42 to prevent importation of the virus while the outbreak is under international concern. The World Health Organization has raised the risk of a national outbreak from the Bundibugyo strain to 'very high' in the DRC and has declared the outbreak in the DRC and Uganda an emergency of international concern. The measure is temporary and intended to balance public health protection with emergency response resources.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、グリーンカード保有者にもエボラ渡航禁止を拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の発生に伴い、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡リスク）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が全て該当。WHO が国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）での同時流行を確認。米国の渡航禁止措置も実施済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでの Bundibugyo エボラ流行、スーダン（南スーダン）への拡大リスクが言及されている。ただし対象国リストでは DRC のみが該当。米国の渡航禁止措置は対象国外であるため verified_locations には含めない。WHO が PHEIC を宣言済みの確認がある（国際的懸念の宣言は IHR 第 12 条に基づく正式通知）。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Raises Alarm as Ebola Risk Peaks in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces Ebola at the highest WHO risk level. The Bundibugyo strain has 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; WHO is prioritizing existing tools, including Regeneron 3479 and MBP134 monoclonal antibodies and obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis. Ervebo offers little cross-protection against Bundibugyo, and a strain-specific vaccine would take six to nine months to develop. Uganda reports two cases linked to DRC with one death; the situation is described as stable. A US national working in DRC tested positive and was moved to Germany; another high-risk contact was sent to the Czech Republic. Rwanda restricts entry for foreigners who travelled via DRC, with quarantine for residents; the Netherlands reports a low-suspicion Ebola case in isolation. Transmission is via direct bodily fluids; 21-day contact tracing is essential.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRコンゴのエボラリスク上昇に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株という異常事態、既に国際的拡大確認、複数国で渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。国際的なエボラウイルス拡大イベントとして、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は既存ワクチン（Ervebo）で十分な交差防御がなく、株特異的ワクチン開発に6～9ヶ月要する重大な懸念事項。米国市民がDRコンゴで感染し独国に移送、ウガンダで2例（1死亡）、オランダでも低疑陽性例確認され、既に国境を越えた拡大が発生している。ルワンダが渡航制限を実施するなど地域的対応が開始されている。対象国ではDRコンゴのみが該当するが、国際的な感染症危機として最高優先度でのトリアージが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 受埃博拉疫情影响 卢旺达加强入境管控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rwanda Tightens Entry Controls Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Rwanda tightened entry controls on May 22, 2026, amid an Ebola outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Foreign nationals who have visited or transited through DRC in the past 30 days will be denied entry; Rwandan citizens and foreign residents with valid residence permits may enter but must undergo isolation if they traveled through DRC in the last 30 days. The border screening at land points adjoining DRC and at Kigali International Airport has been intensified. Rwanda states there are currently no Ebola cases within its territory, and ordinary activities such as meetings, travel and business continue. The WHO on May 22 raised the DRC’s national risk level from high to very high, with regional risk high and global risk low. As of May 22, 2026, DRC has 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の影響を受け、ルワンダが入国管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則（IHR）上の指定疾患であり、DRCでの確認症例と死亡、ルワンダの隣国での流行拡大リスク、及びWHOのリスク評価上昇（「非常に高い」）により、複数のIHR基準を満たす。地域的な国際拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行とルワンダの対応を主題としている。Kigaliはルワンダの首都であり対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCでの確認症例82例、死亡7例、疑い例約750例という規模は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示す。WHOが5月22日にDRCの国家リスクレベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げたことが報告されており、国際的な関心も高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: എബോള: പുതിയ വാക്‌സിൻ ഒരുങ്ങുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A new vaccine is in the works.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Uganda face Ebola spread concerns as Britain's Oxford University reports a vaccine in development. The vaccine candidate, developed by Oxford, could enter human clinical trials within three months. If successful, it would be the world's first vaccine against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant. Currently, there are no vaccines, treatments, or rapid tests for Bundibugyo Ebola; however, therapies and vaccines exist for the Zaire ebolavirus variant. Reported cases total around 750, with 177 deaths. The report warns the virus could spread to more parts of Africa, underscoring ongoing outbreak risk and the urgent push for vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：新しいワクチンが開発中
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus のアウトブレイク（750症例、177死亡）がDRC・ウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が懸念される。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（対象国外）とUK（対象国外）が含まれるが、サマリーでは明確にDRCが主要な発生地点。Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant は治療法・ワクチンがない新規脅威。ワクチン開発の進展は肯定的だが、現在のアウトブレイクは継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans rue link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus type named after a district of cocoa farmers
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola virus type named after Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, is driving the Congo eastern outbreak with about 160 suspected deaths across two provinces as of May 23, 2026. No Ebola cases are confirmed in Uganda; two Congolese nationals who traveled to Uganda before Congo declared the outbreak on May 15 are being treated in Kampala—one 59-year-old man admitted May 11 and died three days later; a second woman is under care. The outbreak is centered in Congo; Ugandan authorities warn against stigma and emphasize cross-border risk, suspending public transport and flights between Congo and Uganda, and delaying a large religious gathering near Kampala. Bundibugyo virus outbreaks previously occurred in 2007 (killing at least 37) and 2012. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids; fruit bats are suspected natural hosts. Vaccines/treatments for Bundibugyo are not effective; contact tracing and isolation are crucial.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが懸念するブンディブギョ：ココア農民の地域にちなんで名付けられたエボラウイルスタイプ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、および渡航制限の実施が確認された。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスはコンゴ東部で約160人の疑い死亡数で発生中。ウガンダでは確定患者なし（2人の患者はコンゴ国籍で治療中）。ウガンダは患者治療により国際的に関与しているが、サマリーの主要な発生地はDRCであるため verified_locations に含めない。過去の事例（2007年37人以上死亡）があり、ワクチン/治療が未有効であることが懸念材料。ウガンダが公共交通・航空便を停止するなど対応を開始している。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans rue link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus type named after a district of cocoa farmers - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Congo continues to raise regional concerns, while Uganda reports two imported cases from Congo. Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, home to about 200,000 cocoa farmers, lent its name to a rare Ebola virus strain; there is no Ebola in Bundibugyo itself. Congo has seen about 160 suspected deaths across two provinces linked to the ongoing eastern Congo outbreak; Bundibugyo virus previously caused 2007 and 2012 outbreaks. In Uganda, two Congolese nationals traveled into the country before the Congo outbreak; a 59-year-old man was admitted to a Kampala hospital on May 11 and died May 14; a second female patient remains hospitalized in Kampala. Authorities have postponed a major religious event near Kampala by June 3, and suspended cross-border transport and flights with Congo. Vaccines and treatments do not work for Bundibugyo; control relies on contact tracing, isolation, and PPE.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ココア農民地域にちなんで命名されたエボラウイルス種ブンディブギョとの関連を懸念
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで進行中のブンディブギョエボラウイルス集団発生（160人の疑い死亡）に加え、ウガンダへの輸入症例2件（うち1件死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）に該当し、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴでの集団発生が主題であり、ウガンダは輸入症例の報告国（二次的な危機）である。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダに対象国が含まれていないため、実際の地域検証ではDRCのみを記載しているが、地域的影響（東アフリカ地域全体）の観点から高度の警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế khẩn trương ứng phó dịch Ebola chủng Bundibugyo năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health urgently responds to Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda intensifies. On May 5, four health workers in Ituri, DRC, died; by May 15, cases were confirmed as Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease, and by May 18 Congo reported 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths. On May 17, WHO declared the Bundibugyo outbreak a PHEIC. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, and the outbreak shows concerning features, including nosocomial transmission and unclear epidemiological links, with potentially larger true counts. Global risk is high in affected regions but low overall. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health says risk is low and tightens border surveillance for travelers from affected areas. Vietnam’s Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City and National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology are prepared with BSL-III labs to perform Real-time PCR and sequencing; diagnostic reagents ordered to arrive in 7–10 days.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ブンディブギョエボラウイルス流行に厚生省が緊急対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）によるPHEIC宣言済みの多国籍アウトブレイク。DRC・ウガンダでの深刻な死亡例、ベトナムへの国際的な波及リスク、国境監視強化による渡航・貿易制限リスク有。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo Ebola はワクチン・特異的治療なし。DRC Ituri州で医療従事者死亡、院内感染。ベトナムはホーチミン市のパスツール研究所などで検査体制整備。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに未掲載のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo province bans funeral wakes to contain Ebola's spread
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Ituri province (Rwampara town) bans funeral wakes to curb Ebola spread linked to the Bundibugyo strain. An official order restricts burials to specialized teams, bans transport of corpses by non-medical vehicles, and limits gatherings to 50 people after clashes at a victim’s body. WHO declares the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. In eastern DRC, about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported; two cases are confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Response is hampered by late detection, absence of a vaccine or virus-specific therapeutics, ongoing violence, and high population mobility. WHO risk assessment: very high nationally, high regionally, low globally. The situation is aggravated by the M23 insurgency in the region, with an M23-appointed North Kivu governor suspending transport between Goma and Butembo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ州がエボラ感染拡大抑制のため葬儀の夜通し式を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生でIHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される緊急事態を宣言。国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認例）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、渡航制限が現在進行形で実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東コンゴのイトゥリ州が中心的な発生地で、ウガンダで2例確認。ルワンダはKigali Provinceが記載されているが、サマリー本文ではルワンダでの発生は言及されていない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。M23勢力による政情不安、ワクチン欠如、医療対応の遅延など、管理可能性の課題が多く報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'hôpital CBCA Virunga de Goma tente d'adapter ses structures sanitaires à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the CBCA Virunga Hospital in Goma is trying to adapt its health facilities to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, in Goma, the CBCA Virunga Hospital in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is adapting its facilities to Ebola response with support from International Medical Corps (IMC) after an Ebola case was recorded in the city. A new triage and isolation pathway has been established: at entry, all patients wash hands and undergo temperature screening; those with fever are directed to triage, and Ebola-suspected patients are immediately placed in isolation rooms supervised by IMC, with beds in each room to minimize contact. Since IMC’s arrival, eleven patients have been referred to the center, but there have been no suspected Ebola cases identified so far. Despite progress, the fight remains constrained by resources, with an urgent need for personal protective equipment and concerns about stock shortages despite receiving an initial delivery.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：ゴマのCBCA Virunga病院が流行に対応するため保健施設の適応に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認例がDRCのゴマで報告され、国際的に拡大するリスク（IHR基準：異常性、国際的拡大リスク）と重症度の懸念（IHR基準：重篤な公衆衛生への影響）を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、流行可能性、管理可能性（資源不足）が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、DRCのゴマで確認例が報告されている。記事には現在のところ疑い例は確認されていないとあるが、感染症危機管理の観点からは非常に重大なイベントである。国際医療軍団（IMC）による支援が開始されており、資源不足（個人防護具の緊急な必要性）が報告されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: IAH is one of three airports where certain passengers will receive Ebola health screenings, CBP says
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 — CBP announces enhanced Ebola health screenings at Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) in Houston, one of three U.S. entry points, for travelers who have recently been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior three weeks. Dulles International Airport near Washington, D.C., and Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport are also implementing the measures. Airlines are asked to identify travelers who have recently visited those countries and notify authorities. The CDC notes Ebola is a severe, often deadly disease that spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; the current variant has no vaccine or treatment. The largest Ebola outbreak occurred about a decade ago in West Africa, with more than 11,000 deaths. The new restrictions begin Tuesday night; duration has not been specified and do not apply to crew or cargo-only flights.

triage.headline_ja: IAH（ヒューストン・ブッシュインターコンチネンタル空港）は、CBPが述べるように、特定の乗客がエボラ出血熱の健康スクリーニングを受ける3つの空港の1つである
triage.triage_reason: 複数国からのエボラ出血熱関連の輸入リスク（コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダン）に対応した米国の公衆衛生措置であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限、深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ、南スーダンが患者発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations には除外。米国での適用はスクリーニング措置の範囲であり、実際の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: US announces stricter Ebola-related airport checks for passengers from 3 African countries
article.articleSummary: US imposes enhanced Ebola screening and updated travel restrictions for passengers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, as of May 23, 2026. In a public health alert, travelers who have been in these countries within the preceding 21 days must enter the United States only through designated airports equipped for enhanced Ebola screening. The measures apply to all travelers, including U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents, and could entail flight disruptions or rerouting. The enhanced screening will be conducted by CDC and U.S. Customs and Border Protection. The CDC reports no Ebola cases linked to this outbreak in the United States and little risk to the general public. WHO on May 22 warned the DRC outbreak is spreading rapidly with a national risk level of very high, while global risk remains low. Travelers should verify routes and guidance and enroll in STEP for updates.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアフリカ3カ国からの乗客に対するエボラ関連の空港検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。スクリーニング基準では異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。エボラ出血熱で対象国（DRC）での発生確認とともに、米国が公式な強化措置を実施している点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が主題であるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国での検査強化はこれらの国からの乗客に対する防御措置であり、米国での実際の発生は報告されていない（CDC報告で0例）。DRCにおける感染源国としての重要性、および国際的渡航制限措置の実施という点でシグナルの要件を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Ebola di Piala Dunia 2026, Pemain Kongo Harus Diisolasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola at the 2026 FIFA World Cup: Congolese players must be isolated.
article.articleSummary: United States will implement mandatory isolation for the Congo national team ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, citing an Ebola outbreak in the Congo. The World Cup 2026 Task Force states that the isolation must be completed by all members of the Congo squad before entering United States territory. The policy is non-negotiable and applies to the entire team and possibly accompanying staff. This precaution aims to mitigate imported Ebola transmission during the international tournament hosted in part by the United States. The article provides no specific case counts or dates beyond noting the ongoing outbreak in the Congo. The measure reflects heightened biosecurity for major events with international travel, balancing competition with public health protection.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年FIFAワールドカップでのエボラ熱防止：コンゴ選手団の隔離が必須
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱は深刻な感染症であり、コンゴでの発生は確認されているが、記事は主にワールドカップ開催国の予防措置に焦点があり、実際の現在の流行情報が不足している。具体的な症例数や流行規模が明記されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のワールドカップ開催時点での予防措置に関するもので、現在のエボラ熱流行状況についての具体的な流行規模・症例数が記載されていない。発生地域にはUSAも含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴでの発生が主題であり、USAでの発生は言及されていないため除外。続報でコンゴの現在の流行状況の詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Russia to help DRC, Uganda contain Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues, with WHO declaring a global emergency on May 17, 2026. As of now, over 80 confirmed cases in the DRC and one confirmed case in Uganda. Russia will assist with containment efforts, including sending a team of Rospotrebnadzor specialists to Uganda on May 25 to conduct epidemiological investigations and support local partners using Russian-developed diagnostic tests. In Uganda, Russia notes substantial support since 2023, including two mobile laboratories donated in 2024–2025 and training for more than 80 Ugandan specialists in pathogen monitoring, disinfection, laboratory diagnostics, and biosafety; in February 2025, Russian experts aided Uganda against this fever. For the DRC, two mobile laboratories were donated in 2020 to boost testing. Russia states there is no risk of Ebola spreading to Russia; suspected imported cases have been reported but none confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、DRCおよびウガンダのエボラ流行抑制を支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱はWHOが5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)として宣言しており、DRCで80例以上、ウガンダで1例以上の確定症例、複数国への拡大、国際的支援の実施が明確。フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ロシアは対象国外のため除外。発生地域に含まれるウガンダ（226074）は対象国リスト外。DRCは確実に該当。記事には「Myanmar」への言及はなく、verified_locationsは[DRC]のみが正確ですが、記事内容とマッピングを厳密に再確認すると、本記事ではウガンダが主要な発生国として扱われており、対象国リストに該当国がDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとなります。訂正：verified_locationsから不正確なMyammarを削除し、DRCのみの記載が正確です。

article.sourceUrl: https://vietnam.vnanet.vn/japanese/tin-van/ベトナム　エボラ出血熱の流入に備え監視強化-447497.html
article.articleHeadline: ベトナム　エボラ出血熱の流入に備え監視強化
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam strengthens surveillance in preparation for the influx of Ebola hemorrhagic fever.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, Vietnam's Ministry of Health held an online conference on Ebola surveillance and infection control. WHO Vietnam Office notes ongoing Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. WHO assesses high risk of regional spread but low global risk; Vietnam's current risk is not high. Countries are urged to strengthen infection-control measures proactively. The National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology states no domestic Ebola infections have been confirmed. However, virus introduction via travelers from affected areas cannot be ruled out, so authorities have ordered stronger entry screening and surveillance at points of entry. The Department of Disease Control continues to monitor Congo and Uganda with WHO. The National Institute and Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute are procuring Ebola-specific testing kits per WHO guidelines, expected to arrive in roughly one week.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム　エボラ出血熱の流入に備え監視強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ継続流行に対応したベトナムの予防的監視強化の報道。WHO も地域リスク評価中だが、現時点でベトナムでの確定患者はなく、WHO グローバルリスク評価は低い。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事主題はベトナムにおける予防的監視強化。DRC・ウガンダでの流行は背景情報。ベトナムでは確定患者なし。WHO 地域リスク評価は高いが、グローバルリスク・ベトナムのリスクは低いと明記。検査体制整備中（1週間で試薬到着予定）。フルRRA 開始の基準に達しないが、今後の展開（患者確認など）を注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: US to keep out green-card holders returning from Ebola-hit regions
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, the United States issued an interim final rule expanding entry restrictions for Ebola-affected areas. The rule, effective immediately for six months (or until Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. determines it's no longer needed), bars lawful permanent residents (green-card holders) from reentry if they have traveled to Ebola-affected regions. The prior measure barred non-citizens who had been in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, and did not apply to U.S. citizens or green-card holders. The CDC says the rule balances resource allocation with import risk, noting green-card holders are more likely to have ties outside the U.S. The action follows the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in central Africa, described as having hundreds of cases and about 177 suspected deaths. A separate rule change requires permanent residents to depart the U.S. to apply for green cards.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ出血熱流行地域からの帰国グリーンカード保有者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の複数国での流行と米国による入国制限措置が実施された重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株エボラの流行は数百例と約177例の死亡が報告されており、米国による直接的な入国制限措置が実施された。エボラは高い致死率を持つClass A感染症として認識されており、この措置は国際的な関心を集めている。

article.articleHeadline: Rwanda kuarantin pengembara dari DR Congo susulan wabak Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rwanda quarantines travelers from DR Congo following the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centered in Ituri, with spread to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. WHO reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with at least 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths in DRC; the outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri. Two Congolese nationals have been reported as imported cases in Uganda, which has suspended flights to/from Congo. Rwanda reports no cases yet but imposes strict entry controls: quarantine for Rwandan citizens and residents arriving from DRC within 30 days, and entry bans for foreign nationals who traveled through Congo in the prior 30 days. Rwanda has enhanced land-border screening and strengthened Kigali Airport measures. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the DRC president has urged intensified multi-sectoral response.

triage.headline_ja: ルワンダ、エボラ出血熱の流行を受けてコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者を隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、確認症例・死亡および国境を越えた患者輸入があり、複数国での対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーおよび発生地域から、エボラ出血熱の流行は主にコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）で発生しており、ウガンダへの患者輸入例が報告されている。ルワンダは患者の報告なく予防的措置を講じている。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月15日）、750疑い例・177疑い死亡、82確認例・7確認死亡という公開データにより、重大な公衆衛生脅威が確認されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.sourceUrl: https://vietnam.vnanet.vn/japanese/tin-van/エボラ熱、ハンタウイルスは「危険な時代」の兆候-ｗｈｏ事務局長-447496.html
article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、ハンタウイルスは「危険な時代」の兆候 ＷＨＯ事務局長
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever and hantavirus are signs of a 'dangerous era,' says WHO Director-General.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, two infectious-disease signals underscore a 'dangerous era' warned by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at the start of the WHO General Assembly in Geneva. Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo were declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, signaling a protracted crisis. Separately, a suspected hantavirus cluster was linked to the cruise ship M/V Hondius that docked at Tenerife in the Canary Islands, Spain, with Tedros visiting the island to coordinate on-site support.
