Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez urged international solidarity, saying no country can protect itself alone. The assembly also debated Taiwan’s observer status, which was rejected by several nations citing the One China principle. These events illustrate ongoing challenges amid conflict, economic strain, climate change, and aid reductions, with continued outbreak responses underway.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、ハンタウイルスは「危険な時代」の兆候 ＷＨＯ事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。DRCのエボラ感染症の国際的懸念事項化およびスペインでのハンタウイルス疑い事例により、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのエボラ感染症が公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項として2026年5月17日に宣言されたと明記。スペイン・カナリア諸島でのハンタウイルス疑い事例は記載されているが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのエボラアウトブレイクが主要なシグナルとして機能。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Notlage: US-Reiseverbot aus DRC, Uganda und SÃ¼dsudan stÃ¶ÃŸt auf Kritik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola emergency: US travel ban on people from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan draws criticism.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak spanning the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda and South Sudan prompted the United States to impose a travel ban on anyone who has been in those countries in the prior 21 days. The measure drew growing criticism from international health experts who warn that blanket border closures hinder outbreak response, fuel fear, and disrupt humanitarian and medical missions. New Ebola cases have been reported in South Kivu, with North Kivu under monitoring, and calls in Goma to reopen the airport to speed medical deliveries. Africa CDC and WHO caution that generalized bans misaddress transmission dynamics, advocating data-driven, targeted interventions and rapid reporting. The Bundibugyo strain lacks licensed vaccines or therapies, underscoring persistent gaps in global health research and equitable countermeasures. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ緊急事態：DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの米国渡航禁止が批判を招く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国にまたがるエボラ流行であり、国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）とスーダン（366755）も列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCがエボラ流行の主たる発生地であり、ウガンダと南スーダンは「隣国」として言及されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行で、複数国での患者報告と国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRAへの進行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: face à l'aggravation de l'épidémie, les pays frontaliers décrètent des restrictions de voyage
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Facing the worsening outbreak, neighboring countries impose travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, prompting neighboring nations to tighten travel amid WHO elevating the public health alert to 'very high' as the outbreak spreads. Uganda reports no active cases as of May 21 and ends air and land links with the DRC within 48 hours; direct flights previously linked Entebbe to Bunia, the epicenter, and Kinshasa, which has had no confirmed cases. Ground crossings remain but with strengthened health checks. Rwanda, not closing its border, bans entry for foreigners who travelled through or transited the DRC in the prior 30 days and imposes a 40-day quarantine on affected residents or foreign nationals, with heightened checks at Kigali airport. Rwanda indicates no Ebola cases yet and maintains normal activities, while surveillance and travel restrictions aim to curb cross-border spread, with Tedros noting rapid transmission.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：感染拡大に直面し、隣国が渡航制限を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大を示す明確なシグナルであり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCにおけるエボラの激化を主題としており、ウガンダとルワンダは隣国として言及されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダとルワンダは能動的な感染事例を報告していない。DRCのみが実際の発生地域として検証される。WHOが公衆衛生上の警告を『非常に高い』に引き上げており、急速な感染拡大が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ausbruch in Zentralafrika: Ebola: Wenn Rebellen das Gesundheitswesen kontrollieren
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in Central Africa: Ebola: When Rebels Control the Healthcare System.
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is centered in Ituri, with most cases, and extends into Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu provinces, including Goma and Bukavu. In Goma, two Ebola cases have been reported and a further case confirmed in Sud-Kivu; the first death in Goma prompted 189 contacts to be traced. Official government reporting does not always align with rebel communications, as M23 forces have established control in parts of Goma and publicize case counts. Ituri hosts several armed groups, including ADF; CODECO attacks have caused civilian killings while Ebola response proceeds. More than 920,000 internally displaced people live in Ituri, and up to about 4 million IDPs are in eastern DRC. The outbreak lies in a mining region with high mobility, challenging surveillance and response; MSF notes access barriers and difficult travel, especially during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでの感染爆発：エボラ：反政府勢力が保健医療システムを支配する場合
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多地域同時発生（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）、死亡例と複数の確定症例、武装勢力による保健システムの支配、大規模な国内避難民、対応困難な環境が複合的に該当。IHR基準3項目以上、WPRスクリーニング基準全5項目に該当し、国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）の複数州でのエボラ発生を明記。武装勢力（M23、ADF、CODECO）による保健システムの混乱、920,000人以上の国内避難民、採鉱地域での高流動性、MSFによるアクセス困難性の報告など、対応環境の悪化が顕著。現地での政府報告と反政府勢力の情報が一致していない点も注視すべき。

article.sourceUrl: https://vietnam.vnanet.vn/japanese/tin-van/世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行警戒レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ-447501.html
article.articleHeadline: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行警戒レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization raises the Ebola outbreak alert level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'Very High'.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 82 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 7 deaths, with roughly 750 suspected infections and about 177 additional deaths potentially linked to Ebola under investigation. On May 22, the World Health Organization raised the outbreak risk from high to very high as transmission accelerates, noting official counts likely underestimate spread. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the situation exceeds initial figures. Regional risk is assessed as high, while global risk remains low. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are currently no licensed vaccines or approved therapeutics. Uganda has recorded 2 imported cases connected to movement from the DRC, with 1 death. The update emphasizes the urgent need for enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and cross-border coordination to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行警戒レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの流入確認）、予想外の感染数増加が認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、ウガンダで2例の輸入症例（1死亡）が報告されているが、サマリーの主要焦点はDRC内での流行状況であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）の拡大が懸念される。WHOが警戒レベルを高から非常に高に引き上げた重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Gesloten klinieken, nauwelijks middelen: bezuinigingen op hulp wreken zich nu bij ebola-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Closed clinics, scarce resources: budget cuts to aid are now taking their toll amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province (Bunia) involves the Bundibugyo variant, with a case-fatality rate of about 30–40% and no vaccine. As of this week, at least 160 deaths and roughly 670 suspected infections have been reported, with neighboring countries at risk. Since the WHO declared an international health emergency, a Bunia laboratory has been established to test Bundibugyo, and international teams are rushing to help, though containment is criticized as late. Health facilities are scarce: protective equipment is in short supply, and no functional Ebola treatment centers operate in parts of eastern Congo. Aid budgets are being slashed—the Great Lakes region received 25 million in 2025, projected to fall to 500,000 by 2028. Malaria-like symptoms delay recognition; testing requires special assays beyond routine malaria diagnostics. The 2018 outbreak in the region killed over 2,000 people, underscoring the need for sustained, funded public-health responses.

triage.headline_ja: 閉鎖されたクリニック、乏しい資源：支援予算削減がエボラ流行対応で今その影響を示している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCのイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo型、致死率30-40%、ワクチンなし）で少なくとも160死亡・約670疑い例が報告されており、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。隣国へのリスク、渡航制限の可能性も高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCのイトゥリ州・ブニアでのエボラ流行が主題。発生地域にオーストラリア（NSW州）も含まれているが、記事サマリーに具体的な該当国での事例記載なし。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済みの現在進行中の流行であり、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: اقتحام مستشفى في الكونغو بسبب جثة "الإيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital raid in Congo over Ebola corpse
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensified after a violent incident at Roamabara Hospital in Ituri Province. A mob stormed the facility, set ablaze isolation and treatment tents, and protested the refusal to transport a young man’s body for traditional burial, prompting security to fire warning shots and the army to protect staff. Health authorities emphasize that handling Ebola corpses requires strict procedures and safe burials to prevent transmission; one health worker was injured during the riot. Locals dispute the medical assessment that the deceased had Ebola, with relatives accusing authorities of misdiagnosis. Misinformation and rumors about Ebola being fabricated persist in remote areas, hindering containment. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs says awareness campaigns are intensifying, while the WHO reports Ebola-related deaths exceeding 130, with concerns about spread toward Uganda and other eastern regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ遺体をめぐる病院襲撃事件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の活動的な流行、既に130人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの拡大懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイツリ州での流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの拡大リスクが言及されているが、ウガンダでの実際の発生報告ではなく懸念段階のため verified_locations には含めない。危機管理上、院内の集団感染リスク、公衆衛生対策への社会的反発、偽情報による対応阻害など複合的リスク要因を含む。WHO報告の死亡数130人以上は重大な指標。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo spreading rapidly amid treatment gaps, warns WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo strain, is spreading rapidly across three provinces; Uganda reports two cases (one death) traced to travel from the DRC. Roughly 750 suspected cases have been recorded with 177 deaths; mortality can reach 50%. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. The outbreak appears to have circulated for about two months in Ituri province's conflict-affected mining regions before detection. WHO has raised the risk to very high, noting fighting, displacement and miners' mobility hinder containment and fuel distrust toward authorities. Border controls and screening have intensified; DRC contact tracing covers about 1,400 people, with cases likely to rise. Experimental options include Regeneron and Mapp antibody therapies and antivirals obeldesivir and remdesivir for high-risk contacts. Vaccines (Merck's Ervebo, Janssen) are not prioritized for Bundibugyo; a strain-specific rVSV candidate lacks available doses and could take 6-9 months to prepare. Bundibugyo virus was identified in Uganda in 2007.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、治療ギャップの中で急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による国際的な急速拡大、高い死亡率、既知の治療法・ワクチンの不在、地域不安定性による管理困難性が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2症例が報告されているが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダが含まれているものの、記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダの症例はDRCからの渡航に関連している。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本案件はエボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体、未治療ウイルス、急速な拡大、国際的波及の全要素を満たす最優先シグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Στις φλόγες νοσοκομείο στο Κονγκό - Εμπρησμός από συγγενείς θύματος του ιού
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Congo hospital in flames — arson by relatives of the virus victim.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 177 deaths and 750 suspected cases. Violence linked to the response intensified as demonstrators set fire to Ruwa Bara Hospital after authorities refused access to a victim’s body. WHO warned that communities are not adequately informed, and some remote populations view Ebola as a Western invention, hampering containment. The first suspected case was a health-care worker whose symptoms began on 24 April and who died at a medical facility in Bunia. By 5 May, officials reported an unknown high-fatality illness. A rapid-response investigation on 13 May confirmed the outbreak as Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain). This marks the specific Ebola lineage involved in the DR Congo outbreak; no details on additional transmission or control measures are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴの病院が炎上―ウイルス被害者の親族による放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目全て満たす。エボラ出血熱の確認された大規模流行（177人の死亡、750人の疑い患者）であり、公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが全て認識される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ株）が確認されている。死亡率の高さ（177/927≈19%）と社会的混乱（病院への放火、コミュニティの不信感）が顕著。WHOの警告により情報不足と予防対策への抵抗が報告されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans rue link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus type named after a district of cocoa farmers
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus, named for Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, looms in focus as Congo’s eastern provinces report an ongoing outbreak with about 160 suspected deaths. The Bundibugyo virus was first identified in a 2007 Ugandan outbreak, which killed at least 37 and was contained by year end; a second Bundibugyo outbreak occurred in Congo’s northeast in 2012. In the current episode, two Congolese nationals who traveled to Uganda before Congo declared the outbreak on May 15 have been identified in Uganda; a 59-year-old man died in Kampala on May 14 and a woman is hospitalized there. Ugandan authorities insist there is no Ebola in Uganda. Measures include enhanced cross-border surveillance, suspending Congo–Uganda transport and flights, and urging people to avoid handshakes. All available vaccines and treatments do not work for Bundibugyo; contact tracing and isolation remain key. Fruit bats are the suspected natural hosts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが言及するブンディブギョ：ココア農民地区の名前が付いたエボラウイルス型
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目中3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ東部州での進行中のアウトブレイク（約160の疑い死亡）が主題。ウガンダは発生地域として記事に含まれているが、記事の述べるイベント（「現在のエピソード」）はコンゴで発生している。ウガンダで確認された2例はコンゴからの旅行者であり、ウガンダでの流行ではなく、越境事例。したがって verified_locations はコンゴのみ。エボラ（Bundibugyo型）は極めて高い懸念度を持つシグナル。すべてのワクチン・治療が無効という情報は深刻性を加重。

article.articleHeadline: 28 Minuten - Géraldine Nakaches Film "Si tu penses bien" / Im Kampf gegen Ebola und das Hantavirus (19.05.2026) - Komplette Sendung | ARTE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 28 Minutes - Géraldine Nakaches' film "Si tu penses bien" / In the Fight Against Ebola and Hantavirus (19 May 2026) - Full Show | ARTE
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan, led the World Health Organization on May 17 to declare an international health emergency. First cases were confirmed on May 15 in Ituri, and the outbreak has since caused over 130 deaths. Separately, hantavirus infections aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius have drawn international attention, with 11 detected cases and 3 deaths. The report notes the WHO summit in Geneva beginning May 19 and mentions that a pandemic treaty agreed last year to regulate pathogen data sharing has not yet entered into force due to ongoing tensions.

triage.headline_ja: 28分 - ジェラルディーヌ・ナカッシュのフィルム「Si tu penses bien」/ エボラとハンタウイルスに対する闘い（2026年5月19日）- 完全版 | ARTE
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラアウトブレイク（DRC、イトゥリ州）はWHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。死亡130例以上、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクはDRC（イトゥリ州）で確認され、WHOが2026年5月17日に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。ハンタウイルスは cruise ship MV Hondius での発生だが、対象国リストに該当する国での陸上発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。スイス（ジュネーブでのWHO会議）は報告の舞台であり、直接的な発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, il rischio ebola è al massimo. Scontri e ospedali dati alle fiamme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, the Ebola risk is at its peak. Clashes and hospitals set on fire.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, with the virus first isolated in 1976. Official counts show at least 600 cases and 139 deaths, though the true scale may be larger amid denialist attitudes. The crisis features widespread attacks on medical centers by denialist groups, and the WHO has raised the pandemic alert to the highest level as the local health system struggles to respond. US aid cuts to foreign health programs are cited as hampering field responses, though Washington has announced $13 million to bolster immediate efforts, supplementing €15 million from the EU. WHO Director-General Tedros notes rapid spread, with risk rated as very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally. Violence also escalates: protesters burned tents isolating patients at Rwampara Hospital after families were barred from burying a youth.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラのリスクが最高潮。衝突と病院が炎上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当し、WHO最高警戒レベルが発動されている急速拡大するエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: DRC保健当局が少なくとも600症例139死亡を確認。WHO事務局長がWHO最高パンデミック警戒レベルを発動。医療施設への暴力的攻撃、患者隔離テント焼却などの混乱により対応が著しく困難。米国13百万ドル、EU15百万ユーロの支援が発表されている。国家レベルでは非常に高リスク、地域レベルでは高リスク、グローバルレベルでは低リスクとWHOが評価。

article.articleHeadline: Толпа сожгла изоляторы для больных Эболой в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mob burned Ebola isolation wards in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, a mob attacked and set fire to Ebola isolation wards at Rwampary Hospital near Bunia, one of the outbreak centers. The unrest followed relatives of a deceased man being denied permission to retrieve his body for burial. Police fired warning shots to disperse the crowd, and medical staff were placed under military protection. One hospital worker was injured. The deceased, a young man, was reportedly a local footballer; relatives suspect typhoid, but doctors emphasize that bodies of Ebola victims remain highly contagious and must be buried with strict safety measures. The incident underscores tensions around burial practices amid ongoing Ebola transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: モブがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ隔離病棟を燃やした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の継続的流行地での隔離施設破壊は、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクを示す。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した地域（Bunia、DRC）は記事サマリーと一致。エボラ流行中のイトゥリ州での隔離施設破壊は、感染制御の著しい悪化を示す。社会不安と医学的信頼の喪失が同時に存在し、公衆衛生上の脅威が増加している。タイフォイドの言及は、確認対象疾患ではなく、埋葬習慣をめぐる信仰の対立を示す背景情報。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜美國CDC前主任：恐演變為嚴重全球流行病 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus | Former U.S. CDC director: fears it could evolve into a severe global pandemic | am730
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, former US CDC director Robert Redfield warns Ebola could become a severe global pandemic amid an outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Authorities report 575 suspected cases and 148 suspected deaths; Redfield notes counts have surged beyond 500 and that the true number may exceed 1,000, per the London-based MRC Global Infectious Disease Analysis Centre. The strain is rare, and officials fear potential spread to Tanzania, South Sudan, and possibly Rwanda. There is no cure, and vaccines may take six to nine months to become available. The United States has tightened border controls, including enhanced travel screening and entry restrictions. Non-U.S. passport holders who have visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days will be barred from entering the United States to prevent importation of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス | 米国CDC前主任：深刻な世界的流行病への進化を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの稀な株による大規模アウトブレイク、高い死亡率、地域間の拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限、および公開・政府レベルの高い関心が確認される。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダで確認されたBundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模アウトブレイク。公式報告は575疑似症例と148疑似死亡だが、専門機関はさらに多くの非報告症例があると推定。米国を含む複数国が渡航制限を実施。ワクチン可用性に6〜9か月必要とされている。タンザニアとスーダンへの拡大リスク有。verified_locationsはDRC（対象国リストに含まれる）のみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜剛果增至177人死　美國對非洲三國封關 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus | Democratic Republic of the Congo death toll rises to 177; United States closes borders to three African countries | am730
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak concentrates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of the latest WHO update, the DRC reports 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with suspected cases near 750 and suspected deaths at 177, suggesting the true burden may be higher. Uganda has 2 confirmed cases and 1 death, with no new cases. Violence and security problems hinder surveillance and contact tracing, and the source of the initial case remains unconfirmed. The Bundibugyo strain circulating currently has no approved vaccine. WHO has deployed field experts; two Americans who had contact with cases were treated in Germany and the Czech Republic. Public health measures include education and countering misinformation, given post-mortem infectivity and traditional funeral transmission. The outbreak is designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The United States has barred entry for non-U.S. passport holders who recently visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス | コンゴ民主共和国の死亡者が177人に増加；米国がアフリカ3国への国境を封鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上極めて深刻な影響を与える疾患であり、多数の死亡が報告されている。DRC・ウガンダでの流行は異常・予想外であり、国際的拡大リスク（米国での感染者発生、米国による国境封鎖）が存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSA、Sudan、Uganda、Germany、Czechiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行」であり、実際の流行地はDRCとウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として指定している。暴力と治安問題が疫学調査を阻害している点も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫：伊波拉疫情在刚果（金）风险水平"非常高"|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak risk level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is "Very High" | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the World Health Organization raised the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola risk level from High to Very High, with regional risk high and global risk low. The outbreak comprises 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 7 deaths; however, WHO says the scale is far larger, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. In Uganda, 2 confirmed cases and 1 death have been reported, with both patients having travelled from the DRC. Uganda has implemented contact tracing and canceled Martyrs’ Day gatherings. WHO and partners are deploying personnel and funds for contact tracing, treatment centers, risk communication, and community engagement. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no licensed virus-specific therapies or vaccines exist. Two prior Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in 2007 (Uganda) and 2012 (DRC). WHO has convened leaders to review vaccines, therapies and diagnostics, and prioritized two monoclonal antibodies for clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情のリスク水準は「非常に高い」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は高い重症度と死亡率を持ち、既に隣国ウガンダへの国境越え感染が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情を主題としており、ウガンダでの確認例も記載されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。疑い例750件、疑い死亡177件という広範な患者数が報告されている。WHOがリスク水準を「高い」から「非常に高い」に引き上げたことは重大な懸念を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital Regional de Taguatinga agiliza cirurgias para tratamento da doença de Chagas  --  Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taguatinga Regional Hospital speeds up surgeries for the treatment of Chagas disease  --  District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the DF.
article.articleSummary: Two Poem procedures were performed on May 21 at Taguatinga Regional Hospital (HRT) to treat achalasia, a condition associated with Chagas disease. Peroral endoscopic myotomy is a minimally invasive endoscopic technique done through the mouth, creating a tunnel in the esophageal wall to cut obstructing muscle fibers. Patients often leave the hospital the same day or within 24 hours, and up to 79% can ingest liquids within 24 hours post-procedure, reducing hospital stays and costs. HRT has become one of Brazil’s leading public centers offering Poem; the first case was in 2025, and 12 surgeries were performed in 2026. The Hospital de Base (HBDF) in the DF also offers Poem. The service addresses high Chagas-related esophageal dysfunction in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: タグアティンガ地域病院がシャーガス病治療のための手術を加速化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医療技術（POEM）の進歩とシャーガス病関連合併症の治療サービス提供に関する報道であり、新規感染症の発生や流行を示唆するシグナルではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は既知のシャーガス病患者に対する新規医療技術（POEM手術）の臨床応用であり、新規感染症の発生・流行ではない。確立された医療サービス提供に関する業務報告と見なされる。シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: UN allocates $60m to combat growing Ebola virus outbreak in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: UN allocates $60 million to combat growing Ebola virus outbreak in Central Africa. As of 2026-05-23, the United Nations pledges sixty million dollars to intensify response to an Ebola outbreak unfolding across Central Africa, including Congo. UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom Fletcher warns the outbreak is expanding in some of the world's most difficult humanitarian settings, where armed conflict and mass civilian displacement threaten containment efforts. The World Health Organization has raised the public health risk from high to very high in Congo, signaling an escalation in threat level and need for urgent coordination. The briefing notes limited access, insecurity, and logistical challenges complicating surveillance, vaccination, and case management. No case counts, transmission details, or laboratory confirmation are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 国連が中央アフリカのエボラウイルスの拡大する流行に対抗するため6000万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが脅威レベルを「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げ、国連が6000万ドルの支援を表明する重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中央アフリカ全域における流行を述べているが、具体的に名指しされている対象国はDRCのみ。DRCはWPRO対象国として該当。武力紛争、民間人の大量移動、限定的なアクセス、不安定な治安、ロジスティクス上の課題が対応を複雑化させており、管理可能性の問題が深刻。ただし具体的な症例数や検査確認情報が記事に記載されていない点は注意。

article.articleHeadline: US restricts arrivals from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026: Enhanced Ebola screening and restricted entry protocols target travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan. U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents who were in any of these countries within the 21 days before U.S. arrival must enter through designated airports for expanded health screening. Phase-implemented at: Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) for flights arriving after 11:59 pm on May 21, 2026; Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) for flights arriving after 11:59 pm on May 22, 2026; George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) in Houston for flights departing after 11:59 pm on May 26, 2026. CDC and CBP will conduct enhanced screening at these airports as part of efforts amid ongoing Ebola outbreak concerns in East and Central Africa. Airlines may reroute or cancel flights. Travelers should monitor updates, review CDC guidance, and enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行を理由にDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大懸念（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの流行）、米国による渡航制限措置実施、社会的・政治的関心の高まりが認められ、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行を背景にした米国の入国制限措置について報じている。verified_locationsはサマリーで実際に感染症イベント発生地として言及されている対象国のみを列挙。ウガンダ（GeoNamesに該当国ID検索不可）とスーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。US側の対応地（Houston, Washington, Georgia等）は感染症発生地ではなく対応地のため含めない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Cercetătorii de la Oxford dezvoltă un nou vaccin împotriva Ebola, pe fondul focarului care se răspândește rapid în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers at Oxford develop a new Ebola vaccine amid the outbreak spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo strain; WHO warns risk is very high and virus spreading rapidly. As of the report, 82 cases confirmed and about 750 suspected. Oxford University researchers are developing a new Ebola vaccine using technology similar to their COVID-19 vaccine to target Bundibugyo, for which there is currently no effective vaccine. The group notes mortality for Bundibugyo Ebola ranges from 30% to 50%. Historically, Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012). Teresa Lambe, director of immunology and vaccines at the Oxford Vaccine Group, emphasizes rapid responsiveness could eventually reduce vaccine need, while continuing to keep vaccine options available. The UN allocated $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to accelerate intervention in the region. The West Africa Ebola vaccine development experience informed later EMA-approved vaccines (by EMA in 2020).

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォードの研究者がコンゴで急速に拡大している流行を受けてエボラの新しいワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）のDRCでの急速な流行であり、死亡率30～50%、確認患者82名、疑似患者約750名。国際的な対応（UN資金配分）が既に開始されており、公衆衛生上の重大な影響と国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明らかにDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。Bundibugyo株は過去にウガンダ（2007年）とDRC（2012年）で報告されているが、サマリーに「現在の流行はコンゴ」と記載。Ugandaは過去の事例参照のため除外。UK/Oxfordは研究開発機関として言及されているが、感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。Angloaは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーに言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans rue link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus type named after a district of cocoa farmers
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Bundibugyo virus, a distinct Ebola type first identified in western Uganda in 2007, underpins the outbreak in eastern Congo, with hundreds infected and 160 suspected deaths across two provinces; Congo declared the outbreak on May 15. Uganda reports two imported cases, both Congolese nationals who crossed into Uganda before the outbreak: a 59-year-old man in Kampala (admitted May 11, died May 14) and a woman treated at another Kampala hospital. Uganda’s government warns against stigmatization, halts cross-border transport and flights with Congo, postpones a June religious gathering near Kampala, and urges people to stop handshakes. Vaccines/treatments for Bundibugyo currently do not work; containment relies on contact tracing and isolation. The virus is believed to reside in fruit bats; transmission occurs via bodily fluids or contaminated materials, with the outbreak primarily Congo-side.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ人がBundibugyo（ココア農民地区にちなんで名付けられたエボラウイルスの種類）との関連性を悔やむ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス(Bundibugyo型)の大規模な国際的流行を示唆する情報であり、IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。既に国際的な症例報告と複数国への拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: DRCが発生地で、ウガンダに輸入症例2件報告されている。記事主題はDRCでの流行であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。症状管理困難性（ワクチン/治療法なし）と動物媒介の可能性があり、持続的な脅威として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Đội tuyển CHDC Congo phải cách ly trước khi nhập cảnh Mỹ do dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC national team must quarantine before entering the United States due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak forces the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team to quarantine 21 days before entering the United States for the 2026 World Cup. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths in DRC as of May 22, 2026, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths linked to the virus. DR Congo began a vaccination program after 28 deaths and 81 confirmed infections since the first case on August 20. The White House World Cup Task Force says the team will maintain a quarantine zone in Belgium where players train, and must arrive in Houston on June 11. The team is exempt from the general temporary entry ban for non-US citizens who have visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, provided they maintain quarantine. World Cup matches will be staged in Houston (USA), Guadalajara (Mexico), and Atlanta (USA); a second-place finish in Group K could trigger a knockout in Toronto on July 2.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）代表チームはエボラ出血熱の流行のため米国入国前に21日間の隔離が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。アフリカの感染症危機が複数国を跨ぎ、国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に影響を与えており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの中心はDRCのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の流行。82例の確認症例、7名の死亡、約750例の疑い例が報告されており、2026年ワールドカップ参加国への国際的影響が懸念される。米国、メキシコ、カナダなど他国が記事内で言及されているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダとスーダンは引用情報内で言及されているが、サマリー中での流行との直接的な関連は不明。

article.articleHeadline: El nuevo brote de ébola se expandió sin frenos durante tres semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak spread without letup for three weeks.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates after a Bunia hospital patient develops fever and vomiting blood on April 24 and dies three days later. Three weeks of negative tests delayed recognition because the strain is Bundibugyo, not Zaire, and current diagnostics were tuned for Zaire. By May 2026, authorities report 134 deaths, over 500 suspected cases, and 30 laboratory-confirmed infections; testing capacity and sample routing issues hindered confirmation. On May 14 Kinshasa laboratories finally identified Bundibugyo. The World Health Organization declared an international health emergency and later raised national/regional risk to the highest level. A Congo-to-Uganda imported case was confirmed May 15 in Kampala, where the traveler died; the first Ebola case in Goma was confirmed May 17. Goma—North Kivu’s capital with well over a million residents—faces border closure with Rwanda and is under M23 control, complicating surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラウイルス病の流行が3週間にわたって制御不能な拡大を見せる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→ゴマ確認）、死亡例134件超、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数のIHR基準・スクリーニング基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダ（Kampala）およびルワンダ国境地域への拡大が明記されているが、これらの国は対象リスト（CEPR WPROのEBS対象国）に含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。ただし国際的な公衆衛生脅威として極めて重大。Bundibugyo株の初期検査遅延（Zaire株向け診断キット）、ゴマ市のM23支配下での管理困難性、検査能力不足等が増幅要因として報告されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola strain vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola strain vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, Oxford University researchers are developing a vaccine against a new Ebola strain, Beondi Bugio, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak persists. Officially seven deaths have been confirmed, with a further 177 deaths linked to this strain. There is currently no approved vaccine or effective treatment for Beondi Bugio. The team is advancing the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine, based on viral-vector technology used previously for emerging outbreaks, including COVID-19. The vaccine uses a harmless modified virus as a delivery system to introduce genetic instructions to human cells, eliciting immunity. The researchers say the emergency-use vaccine could enter clinical trials within months if the outbreak worsens.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ株ワクチン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の新規株、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ新規株アウトブレイク（死亡者確認）は重大シグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける新規エボラ株（Beondi Bugio）のアウトブレイク対応としてのワクチン開発を報告。公式7死亡、関連死亡177件が確認されており、既承認治療法がない点が懸念。Oxford大学による緊急臨床試験計画も示唆されている。Bluedot APIはUK/Englandも抽出しているが、これはワクチン開発機関の所在地であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 'Every health facility said they were full': fear that spread of Ebola in DRC is gathering pace - AOL
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) expands as the country reports its 17th outbreak. Since the first victim died in Bunia, Ituri province, on 24 April, nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been recorded; mortality is cited as 25–90%. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. Hospitals and other facilities are overwhelmed; MSF notes no isolation wards available and repeatedly full facilities. Transmission began when mourners touched the first victim at a funeral in Mongbwalu, and authorities fear broader spread. The security situation hampers response, with an ADF attack killing at least 17 near Mambasa, while a crowd set fire to a treatment centre in Rwampara over burial practices. To curb spread, the province banned funeral wakes, mandated burials by specialist teams, and limited gatherings to 50. ActionAid reports a third of schools in Bunia, Nizi and Nyankunde with suspected Ebola cases or contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 「すべての医療施設が満杯だと言われた」：DRCのエボラ感染の拡大が加速しているという懸念 - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な健康被害、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、越境移動リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準全て該当。エボラウイルス病はRSP対象疾患で、現地医療体制の崩壊と地域的不安定性により国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラ流行。4月24日以降、疑い例750件、疑い死亡177件（致命率25-90%）。医療施設の過飽和、セキュリティ上の課題（ADF攻撃、施設への放火）により対応が著しく困難。ルワンダ国境近接地域での発生であり、越境感染のリスクも存在。

article.articleHeadline: Risiko Ebola di RD Kongo Naik ke Level Tertinggi, WHO Sebut Penularan Belum Terkendali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola risk in DR Congo rises to the highest level, WHO says transmission is not yet under control.
article.articleSummary: On 22 May 2026, WHO raised the Ebola risk warning for the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to the highest level as cases and deaths continue to rise. The DRC has 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 confirmed deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths under investigation. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rarer form with no approved vaccine or treatment; WHO is prioritizing existing therapies to test against it. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the situation highly challenging due to unsafe areas hindering contact tracing. Uganda reported two confirmed cases linked to travel from DRC and one death, with intensified tracing limiting spread. An American working in the DRC tested positive and was moved to Germany; another high-risk contact was relocated to the Czech Republic. Rwanda said entry would be denied to travelers who transited through the DRC; foreign residents must quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラリスク、最高レベルに上昇、WHO は感染がまだ制御されていないと述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、また WPRO スクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する。新興の Bundibugyo 株による急速な症例増加、複数国への国際拡大、国際支援の必要性が高く、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC でのエボラ病の確認された症例（82例、7死亡）と疑い例（750例、177死亡）を詳述しており、DRC が主たる発生地域である。Uganda の症例も DRC との渡航リンクとして言及されているが、記事の主題は DRC の状況である。Germany と Czechia は移送患者の医療受け入れ国であり、新規発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。Rwanda は入国制限を実施しているが新規症例は報告されていないため除外。対象国リストの観点から、DRC（203312）のみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا توسع نطاق حظر السفر المتعلق بإيبولا ليشمل حاملي البطاقة الخضراء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States expands the Ebola-related travel ban to include green-card holders.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the United States temporarily barred lawful permanent residents who had been in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days from entering the U.S., citing concerns about Ebola. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said applying this Section 42 authority to permanent residents for a limited period balances public health protection with emergency-response resources. The World Health Organization raised the risk level of the rare Ebola Bundibugyo strain to a local outbreak in the DRC as 'very high' and declared that the outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda constitute a public health emergency of international concern. This order marks the first use of Section 42 of the Public Health Service Act to restrict entry of migrants to prevent spread of infectious diseases. Green-card holders had previously been exempt from such entry restrictions, unlike during COVID-19 or the Trump-era travel ban.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ関連の渡航禁止措置を拡大し、グリーンカード保有者を含める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO によるPHEIC宣言、複数国での多重爆発、及び国際的な渡航禁止措置に至る政治的決定により、シグナルピックアップの閾値を超える。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の感染症イベントはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで発生していることが確認される。ただし、提供された対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ含まれているため、verified_locations はDRCのみとなる。WHOによるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言及びEbola Bundibugyo株の記録的な多国拡大は、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya heightens Ebola preparedness amid regional outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: Kenya heightens Ebola preparedness amid regional Bundibugyo strain outbreak concerns in Uganda and Democratic Republic of Congo. The Ministry of Health, led by Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale, outlined intensified surveillance, testing, border health services, case management, logistics, and public awareness under KNPHI and the National Incident Management System. WHO declared the Uganda-DRC Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC classified it as a Public Health Event of Continental Security. Kenya has enhanced traveler screening at high-risk entry points, activated emergency response structures nationwide, and scheduled a cross-border simulation in Busia. Four national reference laboratories operate around the clock; isolation and holding facilities are established at key referral hospitals and border sites. Public sensitization targets healthcare workers, border communities, and transport operators. Duale urged emergency financing for PPE, diagnostics, border screening, specimen transport, risk communication, and frontline training, with strengthened cross-border coordination with Uganda and DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、地域内のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク懸念の中で準備態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO/Africa CDCによる公式な緊急宣言、対象国（DRC、ウガンダ周辺）でのアウトブレイク発生に伴うケニアの積極的対応。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はケニアの準備態勢であるが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はウガンダとDRCである。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。WHO/Africa CDCの公式な緊急宣言があり、Bundibugyo株の確認による高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Hrozí Európe šírenie eboly? Infektológ Smejkal v ta3 vysvetlil, prečo je Česko v strehu a aké sú riziká
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Europe at risk of Ebola spreading? Infectious-disease specialist Smejkal on TA3 explained why the Czech Republic is on alert and what the risks are.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is framed as a regional threat rather than a Europe-wide pandemic. An American missionary who had contact with an Ebola patient in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) was admitted to Prague’s Bulovka Hospital in a specialized biobox, signaling international trust in Czech health care. The outbreak is centered near the DRC–Uganda border; globalization and travel raise spillover risk, but Ebola transmits via direct contact, not by air. Case fatality is high, roughly 20%–90% depending on quality of care and speed of diagnosis. Infectious-disease expert Petr Smejkal stresses preparedness through rigorous triage, prompt isolation of patients with travel history to Ebola-endemic areas, and effective first-contact procedures. If managed correctly, the European risk of secondary transmission remains minimal; the contact had been hospitalized previously in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパにおけるエボラ感染拡大のリスク？チェコの感染症専門家スメイカル氏がTA3で、チェコが警戒態勢にある理由とそのリスクを説明
triage.triage_reason: エボラの記事であり国際的な関心があるが、記事サマリーでは「ヨーロッパでの二次感染リスクは最小限」と述べられており、実際の発生はDRCとウガンダの国境地域に限定。対象国内での本格的な流行の兆候がないため、現段階では経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ患者との接触歴のある米国人宣教師がプラハの専門施設に入院しているが、実際の発生地はDRC–ウガンダ国境。ドイツ・チェコ・オーストリアでの患者検出ではなく、輸入症例への対応と警戒態勢の整備が主題。対象国（WPRO地域）ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, Ebola... Le monde reste "largement mal préparé" face à une nouvelle épidémie, "le nouvel ordre mondial sanitaire" peine à émerger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, Ebola... The world remains "largely unprepared" in the face of a new epidemic, "the new global health order" struggles to emerge.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the MS Hondius and a deadly Ebola surge in Central Africa underscore persistent pandemic risk as the WHO World Health Assembly meets in Geneva (May 18–23, 2026). The global pandemic treaty, adopted in May 2025, remains blocked due to disputes over Annex 12 of the PABS, which would govern global sharing of pathogen samples and access to vaccines, treatments, and diagnostics. Delegates extended negotiations by a year. Without Annex 12, critics warn the WHO could be ill‑prepared for a worst‑case scenario; MSF calls for concrete measures now, arguing voluntary arrangements have failed and binding texts are needed for equitable access and funding. Annex 12 would require laboratories to provide 20% of real‑time production to the WHO during a pandemic, with at least 10% donated and the remainder priced affordably. India and China back continued talks; a WHO‑mandated working group will resume to finalize Annex 12.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス、エボラ... 世界は新たな感染症に「大きく準備不足」で、「新しいグローバルヘルスオーダー」は発展に苦しんでいる
triage.triage_reason: 複数の深刻な感染症イベント（ハンタウイルス集団発生とエボラ大流行）が報告されており、IHR基準で2項目該当の可能性があるが、記事の主要焦点は政策・条約交渉であり、実際の感染症拡大の詳細情報が不足している。続報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にWHO世界保健総会でのパンデミック条約交渉を論じており、ハンタウイルス（MS Hondius船舶での集団発生）とエボラ（中央アフリカでの「致命的な急増」）の具体的な患者数・死亡数・感染状況が記載されていない。Central Africaは対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めない。スイスのジュネーブはWHO会議開催地であり、感染症発生地ではないため除外。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、実際の感染症動向の詳細情報不足のため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 九族、清境都去過　外籍女麻疹確診旅遊足跡讓南投繃緊神經 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Both Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village and Cingjing Farm Have Been Visited — Foreign Woman Diagnosed with Measles, Travel History Puts Nantou on Edge | United News Network
article.articleSummary: A foreign woman in her 30s diagnosed with measles after arriving from Thailand visited Nantou’s popular sites, including Puli, Sun Moon Lake Xiangshan Visitor Center, Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village, and Cingjing Farm. The Nantou County Health Bureau has activated an emergency response, preliminarily identifying 38 close contacts; none are symptomatic at present. Authorities published the case’s footprints and urge individuals who visited the same venues during the same period to self-monitor through June 3. The patient’s infectious period was May 14–16, and measles is highly contagious around rash onset. Venues have been cleaned and disinfected, with health education provided. Exposed individuals should self-manage through June 3, watch for fever, rash, cough, runny nose, photophobia, tearing, or red eyes, and seek prompt medical care with travel and exposure history. An 18‑day observation period is crucial to prevent community transmission. Travelers are advised to consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before international trips; consult travel clinics or health authorities (1922).

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で麻疹患者発生、タイから渡航した外国人女性が確認―南投県の観光地を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は国際的に懸念される疾患であり、タイからの渡航者による台湾での確認、高い感染性、接触者38名の特定、公衆衛生上の対応が発動されており、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行可能性、長期曝露リスク）を満たす。
triage.notes: 患者はタイから台湾に渡航した外国人女性。記事の主題は台湾での麻疹確認であるが、発生地（感染源）はタイとして特定。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはタイのみ。麻疹は高い伝染性と国際的懸念を持つ疾患であり、接触者追跡も実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO nâng cảnh báo dịch Ebola lên mức 'rất cao'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the Ebola outbreak alert to the 'very high' level.
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 — The World Health Organization raises the national risk level for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo to very high, regional risk to high, and global risk to low, after declaring the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Congo has 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 7 confirmed deaths, with 177 suspected deaths and about 750 suspected cases under surveillance; numbers are expected to rise with expanded monitoring. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infectious body fluids or contaminated objects; there is no vaccine or specific treatment, and case fatality ranges 25-40%. Uganda reports two imported infections from returnees from Congo, including one death. An American working in Congo was infected and transferred to Germany; another exposed American is being monitored in the Czech Republic. Obeldesivir, an oral antiviral under Gilead trials, is being evaluated for post-exposure prophylaxis under strict controls. Vietnam cautions readiness; no Ebola cases have been reported domestically.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の警戒レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ）、PHEIC宣言、国際的なヒト-ヒト感染リスクが確認されており、緊急のRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCが主要な発生国であり、ウガンダ・ドイツ・チェコは輸入症例の報告国。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとベトナムのみ。ベトナムは国内患者なしだが警戒態勢を整備中として言及されている。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、WPRO地域外の欧米への拡大も確認されているため社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in Congo: Government Enforces New Restrictions on Funeral Wakes - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Congo prompts government to ban funeral wakes and cap gatherings at 50 as authorities try to curb transmission amid resource shortages and community resistance. The World Health Organization upgrades the outbreak risk in Congo to very high, though international spread remains unlikely. Response efforts are hindered by ongoing armed conflict, with aid groups facing security threats that complicate travel from Bunia to Mongbwalu. Restrictions aim to reduce high-risk funeral practices, but implementation is challenged by local acceptance and logistics. Despite the elevated risk, WHO notes a low probability of cross-border spread for now. The piece highlights the intersecting challenges of public health response, conflict, and humanitarian access in northeastern Congo as of 2026-05-23.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：政府が葬儀の夜間集会に新たな制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡リスク）、異常性、国際的拡大可能性の3項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と流行しやすさに該当。WHO が発生リスクを「very high」と評価しており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク疾患。記事はコンゴ北東部（Mangbwalu、Bunia周辺）での発生を明確に述べており、DRCが検証対象地域。武装紛争による医療対応の困難さと国際支援ニーズが明記されている。WHOが発生リスク評価を「very high」に引き上げている点は重要。国際的拡大のリスク評価は「unlikely」とされているが、不確実性が存在するため Yes と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Atlanta airport to start screening travelers from some countries amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport begins screening travelers who have traveled to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the last three weeks, effective at midnight. Atlanta becomes the second U.S. airport to screen for Ebola, joining Washington Dulles; George Bush Intercontinental in Houston will start screening next week. The three-week exposure window applies to inbound travelers from those countries. The effort aims to prevent Ebola spread amid an outbreak that has sickened more than 700 people and killed over 170. Atlanta previously conducted Ebola screening in 2022, and Emory treated Ebola patients in 2014. The heightened precautions occur as the DRC is set to play a FIFA World Cup match against Uzbekistan in Atlanta, with officials noting the DRC team must isolate for 21 days in Belgium before entering the U.S.

triage.headline_ja: アトランタ空港、エボラ流行を受けて一部の国からの旅行者のスクリーニングを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。アフリカでの活動的なエボラ流行による国際的スクリーニング実施であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに複数国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRCで700人以上が感染し170人以上が死亡したエボラ流行を受けた米国の空港スクリーニング』であり、実際の流行発生地はDRC（およびウガンダ、南スーダン）。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Verdachtsfall auf US-Flug: Umleitung nach Kanada wegen falscher Einreiseannahme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected case on a US flight: diverted to Canada due to incorrect entry assumption.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-related incident occurred on a US-bound flight from Paris to Detroit, diverted to Montreal after a passenger from an Ebola-affected region, the Democratic Republic of Congo, reportedly boarded in error. The traveler was asymptomatic at screening and, after assessment by a Canadian quarantine officer, was sent back to France. CDC and WHO say Ebola transmission requires symptoms, and U.S. risk is considered relatively low at present. The event underscores how gaps in passenger data, cross-border screening, and health communications can ripple through airline operations and public health responses. Canada conducted a risk assessment and allowed onward travel for the passenger. No confirmed infection or onward transmission was reported; symptoms were not observed during screening, illustrating ongoing defense-in-depth measures and data-sharing challenges in travel networks.

triage.headline_ja: US便でのエボラ疑い事例：カナダへ迂回、入国認識の誤りによる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスに関連した国際的な航空旅客スクリーニング事例で、複数国（DRC、カナダ、米国、フランス）が関与し、異常・予想外の側面がある。ただし確認感染者なく、現在のリスクは低いと当局が評価していることから、経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: イベントは2026年5月23日配信（未来日付、データの一貫性に注意が必要）。DRCからの旅客が関与しているが、確認感染者なし、症状なし、当局が低リスクと評価。スクリーニング基準1つ（異常・予想外）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心はあるが、感染の具体的な危機性が認められないため、WATCH判定が適切。カナダ・米国・フランスはスクリーニング対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Eпидемията от ебола в Конго се разпространява бързо, предупреди СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Congo is spreading rapidly, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, is spreading rapidly with ~750 probable cases and 177 deaths across three eastern provinces; the first case was in South Kivu. Two Ugandan cases, including one death, were confirmed after travel from DRC. The outbreak appears to involve Ituri province and has challenged response amid conflict and mining-displacement, with contact tracing expanded to about 1,400 people. WHO raised risk to very high and declared a global public health emergency earlier this month. No approved treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo (roughly 50% case fatality). Trials are being considered for therapies (Regeneron and Mapp monoclonal antibodies) and antivirals (obeldesivir, remdesivir) for post-exposure use; a vaccine candidate (rVSV-based for Bundibugyo) is prioritized, while Ervebo (Zaire strain) is not due to limited cross-protection. No doses are available yet; stock could take 6–9 months if prioritized. Uganda has tightened borders and transport.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。レアなBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で約750例の疑い例と177例の死亡、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ確認）、非常に高いリスク評価と公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA進行の対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例（1例死亡）が確認されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC流行であり、ウガンダは二次的な国際拡大として記述されている。発生地域フィールドにはUgandaが含まれているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株は治療法・ワクチンが限定的で致命率約50%と非常に危険。WHOが全球的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Naukowcy ostrzegają przed "niszczycielem grilla". Ukąszenie przez tego komara jest niezwykle bolesne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists warn about the 'grill destroyer'. A bite from this mosquito is extremely painful.
article.articleSummary: Aedes albopictus, the tiger mosquito nicknamed the 'grill destroyer' for its extremely painful bite, has been officially detected in Bamaga, Queensland, Australia, with six individuals confirmed and additional unconfirmed reports online. This marks an inland appearance after decades of sightings near Torres Strait ports. Authorities say it is too early to declare a widespread alarm; risk would rise if large numbers are found in open country. The likely introduction is linked to Indonesian fishers near Flores, Rote, and Kupang working around the Torres Strait, possibly transporting the species inadvertently. A. albopictus can carry dengue virus and Japanese encephalitis virus. Dengue causes high fever, severe muscle and joint pain, headache and rash; there is no specific antiviral, only symptomatic treatment. Japanese encephalitis can cause encephalitis, seizures, paralysis, and lasting neurological damage; a vaccine exists, but no cure.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が「グリル破壊者」に対する警告を発出。この蚊による刺咬は極めて痛い
triage.triage_reason: ヒトガ族蚊（Aedes albopictus）がオーストラリア内陸部で初めて検出され、デング熱及び日本脳炎の媒介蚊として公衆衛生上の潜在的リスクがある。IHR基準2項目（unusual_unexpected、international_spread potential）に該当し、また新興感染症媒介蚊の地理的拡大として異常かつ予想外の事象である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではオーストラリア（Queensland, Bamaga, Torres Strait）での検出が主な報道対象だが、オーストラリアは指定対象国に含まれない。対象国リスト内では、媒介蚊の導入元として記述されているインドネシア（Flores, Rote, Kupang）のみが verified_locations に含まれる。オーストラリアでの公衆衛生上の懸念は高いが、本トリアージの対象地域判定上はインドネシアのみを抽出。デング熱およびJEウイルス媒介の地域的リスク拡大として PICKUP 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: هشدار سازمان جهانی بهداشت درباره شیوع ابولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns about Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has intensified, with about 750 suspected cases, a threefold rise from one week earlier, according to the World Health Organization. The emergence is linked to a novel Ebola strain for which there is currently no vaccine or approved treatment. Most cases are concentrated in one province, with additional infections reported in other parts of the DRC and two cases in neighboring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the situation deeply concerning and described the outbreak as a very high risk to the country. The rapid expansion and lack of medical countermeasures underscore the urgent need for surveillance, infection control, and containment efforts. As of 23 May 2026, authorities are monitoring transmission dynamics and coordinating international assistance to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）がエボラウイルス流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。新規エボラ株による大規模流行、医療対策の欠如、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの既発症例）、および重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCにおけるエボラ流行が主題であり、ウガンダでの症例はDRCからの波及として言及されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。新規株の出現、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、急速な拡大、WHOの警告レベル（「非常に高いリスク」）、国際援助の必要性といった複数の深刻要因が識別された。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns of rising Ebola threat as Kenya tightens response efforts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak escalates as Kenya tightens response. WHO reports 82 deaths; suspected deaths could be as high as 17 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with about 750 cases unconfirmed. Kenya has identified 22 high‑risk counties (including Busia, Bungoma, Trans Nzoia, Mombasa and Turkana) and activated public health emergency centers at national and county levels. Border screening has intensified, with 42,437 travellers screened. Diagnostics are strengthened with four national laboratories designated for testing, including a mobile lab; over 880 health workers trained. Isolation and treatment facilities are identified; no case confirmed yet; Kenyans urged to avoid non‑essential travel to affected areas. Kenya activated the incident management system and engaged Africa CDC for regional coordination. WHO warns risk of rapid spread is very high; two million displaced in Ituri and North Kivu. UN CERF $60M, US $23M; 50 treatment clinics planned; Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine protocols discussed.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが対応を強化する中、WHOがエボラ脅威の増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスは極めて高い致死率と国際的脅威を持つ。DRコンゴとウガンダでの発生確認、ケニアでの高リスク地域認定と対応強化、WHOの「急速拡大リスクは非常に高い」との警告により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダやケニアでの対応強化を述べているが、実際の確定発生地は、DRコンゴ（イトゥリ州及び北キブ州）に限定されている。ウガンダ・ケニアは「疑い死亡」「高リスク地域認定」「対応準備」段階であり、確定症例は記述されていない。対象国リストに含まれないウガンダ・ケニアは verified_locations から除外した。WHOの警告と地域連携の記述から、シグナルレベルはPICKUPの高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Bikin Kongo Terancam Gagal Tampil pada Piala Dunia 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak puts Congo's 2026 World Cup hopes at risk
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak with over 130 deaths and about 600 suspected cases; the WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The DR Congo Leopards risk missing the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States unless players observe a 21-day travel bubble before entering the U.S., with arrival in Houston planned for 11 June. The squad, based mainly in France and Belgium for training, must keep outsiders out of the bubble to prevent transmission. The CDC has barred foreigners who recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan for 30 days. Upcoming friendlies: Denmark (Liege, 3 June) and Chile (Spain, 9 June); DR Congo is in Group K with Portugal, Colombia, Uzbekistan. Andrew Giuliani leads the White House World Cup task force.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がコンゴの2026ワールドカップ出場を危機に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行。対象国DRCにおける現在進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus型による流行で、130以上の死亡と約600の疑い症例報告。複数国の渡航制限措置(CDC 30日間)が既に発令。社会政治的に国際的スポーツイベント(2026 FIFA World Cup)に直結する影響あり。記事サマリーに基づき、実際の発生地はDRC単独であるため verified_locations は DRC のみ。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : multiples facteurs conjugués pèsent sur la lutte (REPORTAGE)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: multiple factors at play weigh heavily on the fight (Special Report)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, has spread from Ituri (east) to North Kivu and South Kivu, with Uganda reporting confirmed cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, while suggesting the broader reach may be about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths as surveillance and testing improve, though violence and insecurity hamper the response. Community resistance complicates isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials; in one instance families blocked a Red Cross burial team. Rwampara, Ituri, is the epicenter, with roughly 50 suspected admissions and 2–4 daily deaths. Insecurity, including armed conflict around Goma and Mongwalu, threatens tracing and outreach. Goma’s international airport remains closed to humanitarian flights, raising concerns about delivering supplies, equipment, and personnel for the response as of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：対策に重くのしかかる複数の要因（特別報告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目中5項目全て該当。複数国にまたがる確認済みエボラ発生事例として緊急RRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCが主要な発生国である。ウガンダとルワンダも言及されているが、DRCから国境を越えた拡大事例との記述であり、DRCを対象国の primary location とする。Goma国際空港の人道支援便閉鎖、武装紛争による対応への妨害、コミュニティ抵抗など複数の管理上の課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia khuyến cáo cảnh giác với virus Ebola trước thềm giải đấu World cup
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn to stay vigilant against the Ebola virus ahead of the World Cup tournament.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) triggers vigilance as World Cup 2026 venues in Toronto and Vancouver approach. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after more than 130 deaths and nearly 600 suspected cases; transmission occurs through direct contact with infectious bodily fluids and is currently confined to the DRC, with no confirmed cases in Canada. The 21-day incubation period means monitoring in the two weeks before the tournament is critical for surveillance, testing, screening, and entry management. The risk is greatest from fans traveling from outbreak areas and from crowded stadiums. The DRC will participate in World Cup Group K, with matches in Houston, Guadalajara, and Atlanta; second place could trigger a knockout in Toronto on July 2. Canada has not imposed travel restrictions yet; the United States has tightened entry for travelers from affected countries, including the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が2026年ワールドカップの開催を前にエボラウイルスに対する警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、国際的なスポーツイベント開催地での流行リスク監視が急務。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCでのエボラ流行とワールドカップ2026開催地（トロント、バンクーバー）の関連性を扱っており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。一方、米国・カナダ・メキシコはサマリー上で対象国でなく、フォーカスはDRCの流行が国際的スポーツイベント開催地へのリスク。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、130人以上の死亡と約600件の疑い例があり、21日間の潜伏期間による監視体制の強化が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: США призупинили видачу віз громадянам із країн, охоплених Еболою - ЗМІ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States has suspended visa issuance to citizens of Ebola-affected countries, according to the media.
article.articleSummary: US has suspended visa issuance for travelers who visited South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or Uganda within 21 days before planned entry, and barred recent permanent residents from returning. The move targets a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak with no approved vaccine or treatment. The outbreak began in Ituri province, eastern Congo, and spread before WHO identified it on May 15. WHO reports 177 probable deaths and 750 suspected cases. The US has allocated $23 million in emergency funding for 50 local clinics. CDC teams are being sent to Uganda for surveillance, lab testing, and contact tracing, coordinating with Kenya’s health ministry to prevent cross-border spread. WHO has declared the Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a PHEIC. In DRC, at least 100 deaths and over 390 cases. Critics say dismantling USAID weakened health networks; State Department cites a five-year, $1.2B health deal with DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラに見舞われた国の国民へのビザ発給を停止した、とメディアが報じている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国家流行で、DRC・ウガンダで確認され、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。米国ビザ停止等の国際的対応が開始され、強い社会政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言済み。DRC（Ituri州）が主要発生地で対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。スーダン、ウガンダ、ケニアも関連地域として記事に述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。記事は2026年5月配信だが、サマリー内容から2024年または2025年の実際のBundibugyo株エボラ流行を参照している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Nueva epidemia de ébola: ¿por qué ha declarado la OMS una emergencia internacional?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak: Why has the WHO declared an international emergency?
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province in northeast RDC; initially alerted May 5, 2026, and later confirmed May 15 as Ebola caused by Orthoebolavirus bundibyoense. The epicenter Ituri has over 370 suspected cases and at least 100 deaths, including health workers. The outbreak has spread to Kinshasa and Goma; two imported cases in Kampala, Uganda, with one death. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to cross-border spread to Uganda, high population mobility amid conflict, lack of vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo, and probable active community transmission with unclear origin. No pandemic or generalized border closures are recommended. Ebola affects humans and non-human primates; six species described, with Bundibugyo around 40% mortality, Sudan ~50%, Zaire up to 90%. This is RDC’s 17th Ebola outbreak; animal reservoirs include fruit bats and other wildlife.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラアウトブレイク：WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規株、国際的な越境拡大、国際支援の必要性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。WHO緊急宣言により社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い。
triage.notes: 新規Ebola株（Orthoebolavirus bundibyoense/Bundibugyo種）による大規模アウトブレイク。370疑似症例、100死亡以上。Ituri州から越境してKinshasa、Goma、ウガンダKampalaへ拡大。既存ワクチン・治療薬が対応していない新株の出現により管理難度が高い。WHO公式緊急宣言済み（PHEIC）。対象国のDRC及びUgandaで確認された事例あり。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け サッカーＷ杯で米当局:サッカー:福島民友新聞社
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. authorities impose Ebola quarantine on the Congo national team at the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: 21-day quarantine before entering the United States will be imposed on the Congo national team by U.S. authorities involved in organizing the World Cup event, in response to an Ebola outbreak in Congo. The measure was disclosed to ESPN and applies as the squad prepares for the World Cup North/Central American tournament, with their first match slated for June 17 in Houston, Texas against Portugal. Most Congo players are based outside Central Africa; the team canceled a planned pre-camp in Kinshasa and is adjusting training arrangements in Belgium. The action underscores heightened biosecurity for the tournament, with Reuters confirming the report. The Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in Congo prompted the quarantine policy, affecting international travel and competition logistics for the Congo squad.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け サッカーＷ杯で米当局
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生に伴う国際的な公衆衛生対応（隔離措置）であり、IHR基準で「国際的拡大リスク」「異常・予想外」に該当。米当局による公式な隔離政策であり社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にHouston・Texas・USAが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは実際の疾病発生はコンゴ(DRC)であり、米国・ベルギー・ポルトガルは対応地域(隔離政策実施地)である。verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。この記事は感染症イベント（エボラ発生）とそれに伴う国際的なバイオセキュリティ措置の両面を報道しており、シグナル性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: كمبالا تعلن حالة استعداد قصوى بسبب فيروس الايبولا... وسفارة السودان تصدر إرشادات عاجلة - اخبار السودان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kampala declares a state of maximum readiness due to the Ebola virus... and the Sudanese embassy issues urgent guidance - Sudan News
article.articleSummary: Uganda declares maximum readiness for Ebola after confirming two imported cases from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and one death. Ongoing DRC transmission has surpassed 528 suspected cases and over 130 deaths. Health authorities say Uganda can detect a new outbreak within 24 hours, with rapid-response teams and border surveillance along the DRC frontier. Measures target schools: handwashing facilities, temperature checks, isolation rooms, dormitory crowding reduction, and tracking of visitors and returning students. Restrictions extend to churches, mosques, markets, and public transport, with event organizers required to notify authorities and provide hygiene stations and temporary isolation spaces. Vehicle inspections at bus parks, taxis, and motorcycles include disinfection and denying transport to symptomatic individuals. The Sudanese embassy in Kampala urged nationals to follow precautions and avoid gatherings; key symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and weakness. The Ugandan Health Ministry published an emergency contact for reporting suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: カンパラがエボラウイルスにより最高度の警戒態勢を宣言...スーダン大使館が緊急ガイダンスを発行 - スーダンニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認済み死亡例と高い死亡率を伴う既知の流行地からの越境症例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダ（対象国外）におけるエボラ対応であるが、実際の感染事例の発生地はDRC（対象国）であり、越境した確認症例が文脈。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Sudan（対象国外）はスーダン大使館の注意喚起のみで、感染発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا توسع نطاق حظر السفر المتعلق بفيروس إيبولا ليشمل حاملي البطاقة الخضراء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States expands the scope of its Ebola travel ban to include green card holders.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the United States has temporarily barred entry of lawful permanent residents who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days, due to Ebola concerns. The CDC invoked Section 42 of the Public Health Service Act, stating the measure protects public health while preserving emergency-response resources. The move expands a travel ban to LPRs for a limited time, a shift from earlier policies during COVID-19 and Trump-era bans that exempted green-card holders. The World Health Organization has raised the Bundibugyo Ebola strain risk to 'very high' in the DRC and declared outbreaks there and in Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The order marks the first use of this authority to restrict migrants to prevent spread of a communicable disease.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルスに関連する渡航禁止の対象をグリーンカード保有者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の措置、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の発動）。WHO緊急事態宣言により国際的な懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクはWHOにより国際懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言されており、Bundibugyo株のリスク評価は『非常に高い』。米国による渡航禁止拡大は初めてのグリーンカード保有者への適用であり、国際的に重大な公衆衛生政策転換を示している。

article.articleHeadline: US doctor with Ebola in Berlin hospital not critically ill, family tests negative
article.articleSummary: A U.S. medical missionary, Dr. Peter Stafford, infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is being treated in Berlin’s Charité hospital in a high-security isolation unit. The DRC outbreak is described as a rare Ebola strain with over 130 fatalities. Stafford is not in critical condition and remains under close observation. His wife and four children, who are asymptomatic, tested negative for Ebola by initial PCR and are quarantined in a separate area of the isolation unit. Stafford contracted Ebola while treating patients in DRC, where he had lived with his family. The White House said the family was brought to Germany because it is about 12 hours closer to DRC than the United States. The room is child-friendly; the children can see their father through a glass partition, with communication via intercom.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の医師がベルリンの病院でエボラ感染、重体ではなく、家族は陰性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。希少なエボラ株の大規模アウトブレイク（130人以上の死亡）に加え、国際的な患者転送が発生している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は DRC でのエボラアウトブレイク（130人以上の死亡）及び DRC で感染した米国医師のドイツへの国際転送である。ベルリン・ドイツ・米国は治療地および患者の国籍に関する情報であり、発生地は DRC のみ。DRC は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。WPRO スクリーニング基準 5 つすべて該当し、かつ IHR 基準も 4 つ該当、社会政治的関心も高い。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Συγγενείς θύματος του ιού Έμπολα έβαλαν φωτιά σε νοσοκομείο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Relatives of an Ebola virus victim set fire to a hospital.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that violence is impeding Ebola control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where deaths have reached 177 and suspected cases total 750. Relatives of a victim set fire to Ruabara Hospital while demanding the body’s return. The first suspected case involved a healthcare worker with symptoms appearing on 24 April, who died at a medical facility in Bunia. By 5 May, authorities reported an unknown, highly fatal illness. A rapid-response investigation on 13 May identified the outbreak as Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain). As of 23 May 2026, transmission persists under this strain, with 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths. The report highlights public misinformation, including beliefs that Ebola is a ‘white man’s invention,’ underscoring challenges in outreach and containment in remote communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルスの犠牲者の親族が病院に放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：177名死亡・750疑似患者、予想外の大規模ウイルス出血熱、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も全て該当し、高度な社会的関心あり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain)による継続的な伝播。社会不安（病院放火、公衆の誤情報）により対応が複雑化。WHOが暴力によるエボラ制御阻害を警告。2026年5月23日時点で750疑似患者、177名死亡。緊急の対応支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka on high alert over Ebola scare; 21-day quarantine mandated for travellers from affected nations
article.articleSummary: Karnataka on statewide high alert over Ebola as of 23 May 2026; no cases in India to date, but surveillance is heightened at airports and hospitals. Passengers arriving in Bengaluru from Ebola-affected countries—especially the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda—must undergo 21-day quarantine and health monitoring, reporting symptoms promptly. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rashes, and red eyes; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, organs, bodily fluids, or contaminated items. Designated facilities: Bengaluru's Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Chest Diseases as primary isolation centre; Epidemic Diseases Hospital as quarantine facility. In Mangaluru, Srinivas Port Hospital and Wenlock District Hospital are prepared for suspected cases. Suspected samples are sent to the National Institute of Virology network for testing. Rapid Response Teams are activated; PPE, medicines, ambulances, and equipment stocks secured. Officials urge reliance on official information and warn against panic.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州がエボラ熱警戒態勢 感染国からの渡航者に21日間の隔離を指示
triage.triage_reason: インドでの確認患者はなく、予防的警戒対応の段階であるため。ただしエボラ熱は高い重症度と国際的リスクを持つため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインド（カルナタカ州ベンガルール）での予防的警戒対応。DRCとウガンダはエボラ流行地の参照として記載されているが、イベント発生国はインドであると判定。現在インド国内での患者報告はなく、サーベイランス強化と隔離措置の段階。エボラ熱の病原体特性上、今後の情報更新を監視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: США приостановили выдачу виз гражданам стран, охваченных Эболой - СМИ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States suspended visa issuance to citizens of Ebola-affected countries, according to the media.
article.articleSummary: U.S. authorities suspend visa issuance for travelers who visited South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), or Uganda within 21 days before planned entry, a policy also blocking recent lawful permanent residents from returning to the United States. The move targets the Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. The outbreak began in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, and has spread with WHO confirming 177 probable deaths and 750 suspected cases as of May 22, 2026. The United States has earmarked $23 million for 50 local clinics in affected countries. CDC sends specialists to Uganda for epidemiologic surveillance, lab testing, and contact tracing, and coordinates with Kenya's Ministry of Health to curb cross-border spread. Critics argue USAID restructuring weakened local health networks; WHO declared the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はエボラ出血熱の流行地の市民へのビザ発給を停止 - メディア報道
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン、ケニアでの確認）、米国による渡航制限措置、WHO PHEIC宣言により、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される実際の発生国はDRC（イトゥリ州を含む）。スーダン、ウガンダ、ケニアは影響国として言及されているが、記事の主題は「DRC発祥のエボラ流行」。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株による流行で、177名の確定死亡、750名の疑い例を記録（2026年5月22日現在）。国際的な対応（米国ビザ停止、CDC派遣、$23M支援、国境越え感染対策）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie de Ebola: Infectare automată la atingerea corpurilor neînsuflețite. Localnicii au dat foc unui centru de tratament - Știrile ProTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: automatic infection upon touching lifeless bodies. Locals set fire to a treatment center - ProTV News.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, with the World Health Organization raising national and regional risk levels. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or treatments; Oxford researchers are developing a vaccine, but deployment will take months. Cumulative data report 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths, about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; Uganda reports 2 confirmed cases. The epicenter is in eastern DRC, including Ituri province, where a case was detected hundreds of kilometers from the core outbreak. Civil conflict and public mistrust hamper response; some treatment and isolation centers are nearly empty as suspected patients circulate in hospitals. Transmission is via body fluids and is higher from contact with deceased bodies, prompting bans on funeral rites and strict corpse handling. An incident: youths burned a treatment center after doctors refused to release the body of a friend suspected of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行: 遺体との接触による自動感染。地元住民が治療センターに放火 - ProTV News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、管理困難性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）でのエボラ出血熱の流行であり、Ugandaの2確定例は二次的言及。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ワクチン未承認の稀な株、低い病院隔離率、葬儀ルール厳格化への社会的反発による治療センターへの放火事件など、複合的な管理上の課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola vakalarının sayısı arttı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo has risen.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo are rising. The Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths, with laboratory confirmation for 64 cases and 6 deaths.
