The World Health Organization cites around 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths, noting underreporting may mean the true burden is higher. The outbreak began in the northeastern Ituri province near the Uganda and South Sudan borders. According to Asharq Al-Awsat, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, making containment exceptionally difficult. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or body fluids of an infected person. In the 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak, more than 11,000 people died. Ongoing surveillance and public health measures remain critical as of 23 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ症例数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を持つ厳重な公衆衛生脅威であり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ国境近隣）と渡航制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR指定疾患。Bundibugyo株でワクチンなし。671疑い例・160死亡。ウガンダ国境近隣での発生のため国際的リスク極めて高い。WHO報告と各国保健省報告に不一致あるが両方高い死亡率を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Холандска болница прими пациент со сомнеж за ебола - Trn.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch hospital admitted a patient with a suspected case of Ebola - Trn.mk
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Nijmegen's Radboud University Medical Center in the eastern Netherlands admitted a patient with a slight suspicion of Ebola virus infection, placing them under observation in a specialized isolation unit; test results are expected over the weekend. The hospital has not disclosed patient details or recent travel. The development coincides with a World Health Organization warning that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo now presents a very high risk to public health in the country, with Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reporting about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths likely linked to the virus. Separately, on May 11 the same hospital quarantined 12 staff after treating a patient positive for hantavirus evacuated from the cruise ship MV Hondius, with reports that some blood/urine collection procedures were not fully followed, triggering precautionary measures.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの病院がエボラ疑い患者を受け入れ - Trn.mk
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染の疑い患者がオランダで検出され、DRCにおける活動的なエボラ流行との国際的連関が報告されている。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、国際的な拡大リスク、異常性、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: オランダ（対象国リスト外）での疑い患者報告はコンテキストとして重要だが、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCのエボラ流行が主要な懸念。ハンタウイルス事例も報告されているが、本シグナルの主要懸念はエボラ。記事の日付が2026年となっており、未来日付の仮想シナリオであることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Ebola: Uganda and development partners discuss unifi
article.articleSummary: Uganda urges a unified international response framework to bolster Ebola containment, discussed at a May 22 Kampala meeting with ambassadors, UN agencies and development partners after an outbreak linked to eastern DRC. Uganda has confirmed imported Ebola cases caused by the Bundibugyo strain among Congolese nationals seeking treatment; no local transmission to date. The government intensified contact tracing, border screening, laboratory surveillance and public health sensitisation across high-risk districts. Permanent Secretary Dr Diana Atwine called for a single national plan, budget, monitoring and evaluation framework, and communications strategy to avoid duplication and ensure transparency and accountability. Uganda pledges not to export Ebola and offers to share technical expertise with the DRC to reduce transmission. Cross-border collaboration remains crucial; the WHO praised Uganda’s leadership while vigilance continues until containment in both countries.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：エボラ：ウガンダと開発パートナーが統一的対応枠組みについて協議
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例とDRC由来のアウトブレイク関連が報告されており、国境を越えた協力が必要な状況。
triage.notes: DRCでのアウトブレイク関連の記事だが、記事の主題はウガンダの対応と国際協力枠組みの協議であり、実際の確認症例はウガンダ領内（Kampala）で発生している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の実質的な発生地は検証済みとしてウガンダを記載。DRC（203312）は対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCは「東部地域のアウトブレイク関連」の言及に留まり、主題となる発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outruns Containment in Eastern Congo as Contact Tracing Falters | Today News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo driven by Bundibugyo strain, with 83 confirmed infections, 746 suspected, and 1,603 identified contacts as of May 21; only 342 contacts were traced that day (≈21%). The outbreak spans three provinces, including South Kivu near Bukavu, with a case in that area; two cases have been detected in Uganda. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or antibody treatments, and testing gaps persist as GeneXpert cannot detect Bundibugyo and virus-specific PCR kits are limited. Over 11 metric tons of emergency supplies have been airlifted to Bunia. Mongbwalu remains a large suspected cluster; Nyankunde reports 11 confirmed cases and 340 contacts. Reported 46% positivity suggests under-detection. Security tensions—burial disputes, hospital unrest, and patient flight—complicate response efforts. Calls for expanded lab testing, contact tracing, community outreach, and negotiated security corridors; Uganda and Rwanda tightened cross-border measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ東部での封じ込めを上回り、接触者追跡が失敗
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限実施）。WHO PheIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・抗体治療なし、検査能力ギャップあり、セキュリティ上の課題で対応が複雑化。フルRRA実施が急務。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラアウトブレイクの主な発生地はDRC（South Kivu Province、Bunia、Nyankunde、Mongbwalu等）。ウガンダとルワンダでも検出されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRC東部での流行制御困難にある。DRCが対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国に含まれていないため除外。WHO PHeIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・治療薬なし）、接触者追跡の著しい不足（21%）、セキュリティ課題による対応阻害が主要懸念。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け　サッカーＷ杯で米当局｜秋田魁新報電子版
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. authorities impose Ebola quarantine on the Congolese national team at the FIFA World Cup
article.articleSummary: A 21-day pre-entry quarantine for the Congo national football team is mandated by U.S. tournament officials ahead of the FIFA World Cup North America three-nation event, in response to an Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. On May 22, Ebola testing was expanded at Washington Dulles International Airport. The Congolese squad, whose players largely operate outside Central Africa, canceled their planned pre-tournament camp in Kinshasa and are adjusting training arrangements in Belgium. Their first match is set for June 17 against Portugal in Houston, Texas. The policy, disclosed to ESPN by the event organizers, seeks to prevent imported infections amid ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Congo. The article does not provide specific case counts or laboratory-confirmed figures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け　サッカーＷ杯で米当局
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準において国際的に拡大するリスク（人の移動に伴う）、渡航制限実施、および異常/予想外な対応（スポーツイベントでの隔離措置）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）と管理可能性（国際支援・調整の必要性）に該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、米国での検疫措置や国際スポーツイベントでの対応が二次的な内容。具体的な患者数の記載がないため重症度は不明だが、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際保健上の懸念が高い。Bluedot APIが米国やベルギーなどを列挙しているが、サマリーではこれらは検疫・調整の場所であり、エボラ発生地としてはDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا توسع نطاق حظر السفر المتعلق بإيبولا ليشمل حاملي البطاقة الخضراء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States expands the Ebola-related travel ban to include green card holders.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the United States temporarily expands its Ebola-related entry ban to include lawful permanent residents who have traveled in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days. The CDC says applying Section 42 of the Public Health Service Act aims to balance protecting public health with emergency-response resource management. The expansion follows WHO raising the Bundibugyo Ebola strain’s risk in the DRC to 'very high,' with outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Previously, green-card holders were exempt from the 42 order; this is the first time the restriction applies to LPRs under this framework, expanding a tool not used during COVID-19 or earlier bans.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ関連の渡航禁止令をグリーンカード保有者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）がPHEIC宣言されており、米国が渡航制限を強化する国際的対応が発動されている。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでエボラアウトブレイク発生中。Bundibugyo株のリスク評価が『very high』に引き上げられ、WHOがPHEIC宣言。米国の渡航禁止措置拡大は国際的対応の重大化を示唆。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。スーダン（South Sudan）も同様。

article.articleHeadline: خطر ابتلا به ابولا در کنگو به بالاترین سطح رسید
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of contracting Ebola in Congo has reached the highest level.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the World Health Organization warns that Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 'very high'. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. There are 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, with roughly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; the true scale may be larger due to undetected circulation. Contact tracing is underway in insecure areas of Ituri province, with over 1,400 people under surveillance. Two cases have been confirmed in Uganda linked to travelers from Congo. An American citizen with Ebola was transported to Germany, while a second person is in the Czech Republic. WHO still classifies global risk as low and regional risk as high; 21-day contact monitoring remains the key control measure.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染リスクが最高レベルに達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疾患、複数国への国際的拡大、国際的関心の高さ）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる稀有な種による大規模アウトブレークで、ワクチン・治療法なし。複数国への既知の拡大あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国（ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ）への輸入症例を述べるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo型エボラは稀有で、既知のワクチン・治療法がない点が特に懸念される。WHO評価は地域リスク『高い』、全球リスク『低い』だが、実際の流行規模は報告より大きい可能性あり。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: WHO nâng cảnh báo dịch Ebola, nhiều nước tăng cường giám sát y tế tại biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO upgrades Ebola outbreak alert as many countries step up border health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization elevated the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to a national risk level of very high and a regional risk level of high, with global risk still considered low. DRC has 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, while about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected Ebola-related deaths are under surveillance. The epicenter is Ituri province near the Uganda and South Sudan borders, a conflict-affected area with high population movement. Uganda reports two cases linked to travelers from the DRC, including one death. Access limitations in insecure zones may mask the true burden. WHO and partners have delivered roughly 25 tons of medical supplies; the UN has released $60 million from the CERF to accelerate regional response. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with up to 40% mortality and no licensed vaccine or treatment yet, though several vaccines are in development. Several countries have tightened border health surveillance (US, EU, Thailand, Singapore).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の警告レベルを引き上げ、複数国が国境での保健監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的拡大リスク、死亡者を含む重症事例、複数国での監視強化など、フルRRA実施の優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されている発生国はDRCおよびウガンダ。対象国リストのうち、実際に事例が報告されているのはDRC（確定82例、死亡7例、疑い例750例）。タイは監視強化国として言及されているため、域内対象国として含める。米国、シンガポール、EUも監視強化しているが、対象国リストに米国は含まれないため除外。ウガンダからの旅行者由来の事例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストにないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola virusの稀な株による発生、紛争地域での高い人口移動、ワクチン・治療法の不在が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outruns Containment in Eastern Congo as Contact Tracing Falters
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, Ebola is spreading faster than responders can track it in eastern Congo, where health workers grapple with the outbreak. The World Health Organization warns that weak surveillance and laboratory capacity are hampering the response, noting the outbreak is unfolding in one of the most challenging operational environments possible. Contact tracing is faltering, undermining efforts to identify and monitor exposed individuals and to interrupt transmission chains. The report emphasizes the critical background challenges faced by responders in eastern Congo, rather than providing case counts or specific containment milestones, highlighting why rapid improvements in surveillance and lab support are needed to slow Ebola spread in this region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラが封じ込め対策を上回るペースで拡大、接触者追跡が機能不全
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を伴う異常事態であり、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性が複数該当し、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率と感染力を有する。記事は接触者追跡の失敗と監視体制の不備を強調しており、制御不能な拡大傾向を示唆している。WHO警告の存在も社会的・政治的関心の高さを証明している。フルRRA実施時には最新の感染者数、死亡数、地理的拡大範囲、国境地域への拡散状況を確認すること。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outruns containment in eastern Congo as contact tracing falters - The Boston Globe
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo driven by Bundibugyo strain, with confirmed cases in Ituri's Bunia and Nyankunde and spillover into South Kivu near Bukavu; two cases confirmed in Uganda this week. The WHO notes this is one of the most challenging operational environments as security incidents and population movements hinder containment. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or antibody therapies, and the virus appears to have circulated undetected for months in Ituri. Testing gaps persist: GeneXpert cannot detect Bundibugyo; virus-specific PCR kits are in short supply. More than 11 metric tons of emergency supplies have been airlifted to Bunia. Nyankunde reports 11 confirmed cases and 340 contacts under follow-up amid expanding clusters; Congo’s positivity rate ~46% suggests under-detection. Cross-border risk to Uganda and Rwanda; border controls and screening tightened.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ東部の封じ込めを上回る、接触者追跡が機能不全 - ボストングローブ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、ワクチン・治療法なし、複数国への越境リスク、検査能力の制限が深刻。
triage.notes: エボラ新株（Bundibugyo株）による急速な拡大、検査能力の著しい制限（GeneXpertが検出不可、ウイルス特異的PCR試薬不足）、数ヶ月間の未検出流行、セキュリティ上の課題により封じ込め困難。ウガンダへの越境確認、ルワンダへのリスク。WHOが「最も運用困難な環境の一つ」と指摘。国際的な支援と緊急対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities beef up Ebola response as WHO confirms 82 cases in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak, centered in Ituri and now extending to North Kivu and South Kivu; a Bukavu case traveled from Kisangani and died before confirmation. Ituri authorities have restricted gatherings to 50 people, suspended funeral wakes, and imposed strict burial rules; body transport is limited to Ebola-response ambulances. Rwanda reports no cases but has enhanced border and airport screening; Uganda has two confirmed cases and suspended most cross-border transport. No vaccine or licensed therapies exist for Bundibugyo; prior outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012). WHO R&D Blueprint prioritizes two monoclonal antibodies; Obeldesivir may be used for contacts; Ervebo is not a primary option due to limited cross-protection. Community distrust and displacement complicate responses.

triage.headline_ja: 当局がエボラ対応を強化、WHO がコンゴ民主共和国での 82 件の患者確認を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR 基準 4 つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO スクリーニング基準も全て該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルリスク評価（RRA）に進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo 株）による多発事例。確定患者 82 名、死亡 7 名、疑い患者 750 名。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu に分散。ウガンダでも確定患者 2 名報告。ルワンダは患者なしだが境界措置を強化。既存の認可済みワクチン（Ervebo）は効果が限定的であり、治療選択肢も限定的。地域社会の信頼不足と住民移動が対応を複雑化。複数国境接近地域での流行であり国際拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: क्या कोरोनावायरस से भी ज्यादा घातक है इबोला वायरस? दिखते हैं ये 12 लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Ebola virus even more deadly than the coronavirus? Here are its 12 symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO as cases rise in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. India has issued alerts; Karnataka state has established rapid-response facilities in Bengaluru and Mangaluru, with the Rajiv Gandhi Chest Disease Institute prepared as an isolation center. Suspected cases in Bengaluru are tested first at NIV Bengaluru, with confirmation sent to NIV Pune. There are currently no Ebola cases in India. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, body fluids, contaminated objects, or contact with infected animals. Incubation is typically 2–21 days. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, and sore throat; it can progress to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, red eyes, bleeding, and respiratory distress. Prevention includes maintaining distance, washing hands, using masks and gloves. Seek medical care promptly for fever, weakness, vomiting/diarrhea, or bleeding. Ongoing outbreaks in DRC and Uganda warrant vigilance for international travel and trade.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスよりも致命的なエボラウイルス？その12の症状を紹介
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラウイルスを国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言し、DRCとウガンダでの発生に伴いインドが警戒態勢を強化している。IHR基準（国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）も満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの症状教育記事だが、DRCとウガンダでの実際の発生を背景としており、WHOのPHEIC宣言とインドの警戒態勢強化により緊急性が高い。インド国内ではまだ確定症例はないが、検査体制整備と警戒継続中。Bluedotが挙げたウガンダは記事サマリーに明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Voiko ebola levitä Suomeen? Asiantuntijalta huojentava tieto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can Ebola spread to Finland? Reassuring information from an expert.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected hundreds with at least 130–160 confirmed deaths, centered near Bunia. Diagnosis is challenging because Bundibugyo virus is hard to detect with standard tests, allowing delays that fuel transmission; once identified, patients are isolated and contacts traced. There is no licensed vaccine for this strain; two promising vaccines are under development and could take up to nine months to deploy. Transmission is mainly human-to-human during symptomatic illness, aiding containment, though cross-border movement and border controls complicate efforts. The outbreak has led to flight cancellations and halted cross-border transport at the Congo–Uganda border, including the Semliki crossing. One American doctor has contracted Ebola; six exposed individuals were treated in Germany. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; resources such as tests and hygiene supplies are urgently needed. Risk of global spread remains low according to experts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはフィンランドに広がる可能性があるか？専門家からの安心情報
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in DRCが公開衛生上深刻（130-160名の確認死亡）で異常/予想外、国際的な影響（ウガンダとの国境移動の複雑化、アメリカ人医師感染、ドイツでの曝露事例）があり、WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言している。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、かつスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreakはDRCのBunia周辺で確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツは記事内で曝露事例（6名の曝露者が治療を受けた）が述べられているが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではなく、曝露管理の対象国であるため verified_locations に含めない。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、ワクチン開発中、国際的なリソース支援が急務とされており、高度の国際的懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け｜埼玉新聞｜埼玉の最新ニュース・スポーツ・地域の話題
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola quarantine imposed on the Congo national team.
article.articleSummary: U.S. authorities announced on May 22 that the Congo national football team, set to participate in a World Cup‑related event in North America, must undergo a 21‑day quarantine before entry into the United States due to an Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The measure, disclosed to ESPN, applies ahead of the team's scheduled first match against Portugal in Houston, Texas, on June 17. No clinical details or case counts are provided in the report. The quarantine underscores stringent border health measures tied to Ebola concerns during international sports competition. The Congo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is identified as the infection source prompting pre‑arrival isolation, highlighting the intersection of global health and major sporting events with entry requirements enforced by the United States.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け
triage.triage_reason: DRC（対象国）でのエボラ発生は確認されるが、記事の主要テーマは国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ関連）での検疫措置であり、感染症自体の詳細情報が全く提供されていない。症例数、重症度、進行状況など公衆衛生関連の基本情報が欠落しているため、情報充実を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは国際スポーツイベントにおける検疫措置の報道に重点があり、DRCでのエボラ発生それ自体の公衆衛生情報（症例数、死亡者、感染率、流行規模など）を全く含んでいない。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高いが、疾病の実態に関する具体的情報の不足が判定をWATCHとした理由。続報でDRCでの感染症の詳細情報が追加されれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US Physician Peter Stafford Hospitalized with Ebola in Berlin; Family Tests Negative for Virus - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: US physician Peter Stafford, who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is hospitalized in Berlin's Charité hospital in a high-security isolation unit and is showing signs of recovery. The case involves a rare Ebola strain linked to over 130 deaths in the DRC. Stafford’s wife and four children, all symptom-free, have been isolated in a separate section; initial PCR tests were negative, with ongoing monitoring for potential symptoms. The family was relocated from the DRC-area due to Germany’s closer proximity to Congo, reducing travel time by about 12 hours, per the White House. The mission organization Serge Christian identified Stafford, a medical missionary. The hospital stated care is ongoing and that the room has been made child-friendly, with family members able to communicate via glass partition and intercom in the isolation setting.

triage.headline_ja: 米国医師ピーター・スタッフォード、ベルリンでエボラウイルスで入院。家族は陰性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス感染で複数国に関連し、医療危機対応が進行中。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、感染源はDRC（130人以上の死亡関連の稀なエボラ株）であり、患者がベルリンで治療されている。ベルリンはドイツにある都市だが、対象国リストにドイツは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。白宮の言及やセルジ・クリスチャン機関の関与は政府・社会的関心の裏付けとなる。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け | 岩手日報ONLINE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola quarantine mandated for the Congo national team
article.articleSummary: U.S. tournament authorities require the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team to undergo a 21-day quarantine before entering the United States due to an Ebola outbreak in Congo. The rule applies as the team prepares for World Cup qualifiers in North and Central America, with their opening match against Portugal scheduled for June 17 in Houston, Texas. Most Congo players are based outside Central Africa—in Europe and elsewhere—and the squad canceled a planned pre-camp in Kinshasa, instead training in Belgium. The measure reflects heightened public health precautions for Ebola hemorrhagic fever linked to the Congo outbreak, and was reported by ESPN as cited by Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表にエボラ隔離義務付け
triage.triage_reason: DRC（対象国）でのエボラ発生自体は深刻だが、本記事の主題はスポーツチームの入国制限措置であり、疫学的なシグナル内容は限定的。DRCのエボラ流行に関する詳細な疫学情報が不足しており、発生規模・進行状況が不明のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生を前提としているが、詳細な疫学データ（症例数、死亡数、発生期間、ジェノタイプなど）が記載されていない。本記事の焦点はスポーツイベントにおける入国制限措置であり、感染症の疫学的評価のためにはDRCでの流行に関する別途情報が必要。IHR基準は2つ該当するが、記事の性質上フルRRAへの優先度は相対的に低い。

article.articleHeadline: 宰牲節需求暴增！馬來西亞進口逾2.7萬頭牛 隔離14天防疫 | 四方報 | 全球 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in Eid al-Adha demand! Malaysia imports more than 27,000 head of cattle; 14-day quarantine to prevent disease spread | Sifang News | Global | NOWnews Today's News
article.articleSummary: Malaysia imported over 27,000 cattle and about 1,000 water buffalo to meet Eid al-Adha demand. All animals underwent strict MAQIS (Malaysia Quarantine and Inspection Service) screening and a 14-day isolation, with close monitoring for foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and lumpy skin disease (LSD). Most cattle originate from Thailand, with Padang Besar serving as the quarantine site. MAQIS confirms livestock are disease-free after screening prior to slaughter. If government quarantine facilities are full, imports may be placed in private quarantine sites or at importers’ locations, subject to MAQIS approval, though there have been past noncompliance incidents of cattle moved before completing the 14-day isolation. Eid al-Adha 2026 begins on the evening of May 26, highlighting ongoing public-health safeguards to prevent animal-disease spread during the festival.

triage.headline_ja: 宰牲節需求暴増！マレーシアが2万7000頭以上の牛を輸入 14日間の隔離で防疫
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（口蹄疫、ルンピースキン病）の輸入リスク管理イベントだが、現在のところ疾病発生は報告されていない。タイからの輸入時の検疫体制の確認報告であり、予防的対応段階。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはマレーシアが含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。記事サマリーから実際の疾病発生は報告されておらず、輸入時の検疫措置と過去のコンプライアンス不遵守の可能性が指摘されている。タイからの輸入畜産品に関連したFMD/LSDのリスク管理イベント。引き続き発生状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'hôpital CBCA Virunga de Goma tente d'adapter ses structures sanitaires à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the CBCA Virunga Hospital in Goma is trying to adapt its health facilities to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: In Goma, the North Kivu capital controlled by AFC/M23, a case of Ebola has been recorded. The CBCA Virunga Hospital is adapting its facilities with support from International Medical Corps (IMC). A new triage and isolation circuit screens all arrivals: handwashing, temperature checks, and a formal screening at entry. Patients with fever are directed to triage, and those with Ebola-like symptoms are moved to isolation rooms supervised by IMC. They classify cases by presenting complaints; those not meeting Ebola criteria are redirected to the clean zone. Since IMC's involvement, eleven patients have been referred, but there have been no suspected Ebola cases so far. Isolation wards place beds in each room to prevent contact. Ongoing challenges include insufficient resources; PPE is urgently needed; a first batch has arrived, but stockpiles may run short.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ゴマのCBCA Virunga病院が流行への保健施設の適応を試みている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が確認され、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当する可能性が高い。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)の懸念疾患として指定されている。記事ではゴマ（North Kivu州の首都）での1例が確認されたと述べられており、IMC（International Medical Corps）が支援する感染対策が展開されている。現在のところ疑い例は報告されていないが、資源不足（PPE不足）と流行の可能性が課題として挙げられている。流行可能性の高さと国際的な懸念から、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ik overleefde ebola. Dit is wat me het meest angst inboezemt bij deze nieuwe uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: I survived Ebola. This is what frightens me the most about this new outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo virus. Congo reported 246 suspected infections last Friday, with a death in Kampala, Uganda, signaling cross-border spread and marking it among the largest outbreaks in history. The author, a survivor from 2014, notes that vaccines exist for the Zaire strain but there are no effective treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo. Capacity to respond is dwindling amid policy cuts: USAID funding reductions, disbanding of outbreak teams, CDC staff losses, and reduced cooperation with WHO. In 2014, CDC–WHO collaboration helped map spread; now it is hampered. The piece calls for steadfast global leadership, renewed funding, accelerated development of therapies, PPE, broader testing, and safer burial practices to curb transmission, anchored by the author’s memory of two young brothers who died in 2014.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ生き残り者の証言：この新しい流行で最も恐れていること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の出現、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5つ該当。対象国のDRC内で発生が確認され、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株に対する既存ワクチンの有効性が限定的であり、対応能力の低下（USAID削減、CDC人員削減、WHO連携低下）が報告されており、国際的な懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola  Virus को लेकर बढ़ी चिंता, WHO ने की ग्लोबल हेल्थ इमरजेंसी,जानें कैसे फैलता है यह संक्रमण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising concern over the Ebola virus; WHO declares a global health emergency; learn how this infection spreads.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreaks have prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with cases rising in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, triggering global alarm. India has issued heightened vigilance; Karnataka has strengthened surveillance, establishing isolation centers in Bengaluru and Mangaluru. Bengaluru’s Rajiv Gandhi Chest Diseases Institute is designated for isolation, with suspected samples sent to NIV Bengaluru and for confirmation to NIV Pune. The virus spreads mainly via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated materials from infected humans or animals, placing health workers at high risk. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever and weakness, evolving to headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, red eyes, and potentially internal and external bleeding in severe cases. Emphasize hand hygiene, masks, gloves, safe caregiving, and prompt isolation. No confirmed cases in India as of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスへの懸念の高まり、WHO が世界的健康緊急事態を宣言、この感染症がどのように広がるかを学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク高、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、対象国インドでの準備段階での対応確認、WHO による国際的宣言により社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC とウガンダでのエボラ発生を主に報告し、インドの対応準備状況を記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。インドでの確認症例はなし（2026年5月23日現在）が、監視体制強化と隔離施設設置により公式な関心が高まっている。Nipah も疾患として列挙されているが記事本文では言及がなく、エボラが主題。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan siết chặt kiểm soát y tế với hành khách đến từ vùng dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand tightens health checks for passengers arriving from Ebola-affected regions.
article.articleSummary: Thailand tightens health checks for travelers from Ebola-affected regions, adding Congo and Uganda to its high-risk list. The Thai Public Health Ministry notes the current outbreak involves Bundibugyo Ebola, with no vaccine or specific treatment. As of May 21, more than 650 suspected cases and about 160 deaths have been reported in the Congo-Uganda outbreak. Travelers from high-risk areas must declare health status via an electronic entry card; asymptomatic entrants may travel but require daily temperature checks and 21 days of medical monitoring, while symptomatic or high-risk individuals are isolated. Thailand is monitoring 126 passengers who entered from Congo and Uganda between April 29 and May 18, broadening surveillance to travelers with recent travel histories to high-risk regions. WHO has raised the Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo to 'very high' and is considering Obeldesivir for exposed individuals. Officials urge calm and information from government channels.

triage.headline_ja: タイがエボラ出血熱流行地域からの到着旅客に対する健康管理を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当、かつ国際的な公衆衛生懸念が高い。アクティブな多国間疫学調査と対策実施が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo型）が2026年5月21日現在650疑い例・160死亡と報告されており、タイは4月29日～5月18日に該当地域からの旅客126名の監視を実施中。ウガンダはGeoNamesリストに非該当のため除外。WHOがDRCのリスクを『very high』に引き上げており、国際的関心と対策の実施が確認された重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперты оценили риск завоза Эболы в Россию
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts assessed the risk of Ebola importation into Russia
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Russian experts say Ebola will not establish itself in Russia due to an unsuitable climate and absence of a natural reservoir (fruit bats). The virus could theoretically be imported by travelers, but infection requires direct contact with contaminated bodily fluids. Ebola virus is highly contagious and causes severe hemorrhagic fever, presenting with fever, headache, muscle pain, and potentially rapid breathing and low blood pressure, with a high mortality rate. The virus was first identified in 1976 in Zaire near the Ebola River. Experts caution that global Ebola pandemics remain a concern, driven by international mobility, environmental changes, and public mistrust in institutions. Russia’s epidemic-surveillance system is described as capable of rapidly responding to imported cases; sustained transmission within Russia is considered unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がロシアへのエボラ持ち込みリスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: 記事は理論的なリスク評価であり、ロシアでの実際の発生報告ではない。DRC での流行の詳細情報がなく、ロシアでの感染可能性は低いと専門家により判断されている。IHR基準は該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの専門家による仮説的なリスク評価であり、DRC でのエボラ流行の具体的情報は含まれていない。ロシアでの実際の感染事例や発生報告ではなく、理論的には輸入例の可能性は認められるが、確立される可能性は低いと評価されている。DRC が対象国であることから verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Британски учени разработват ваксина срещу ебола - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: British scientists are developing a vaccine against Ebola - News from Dnes.bg.
article.articleSummary: Oxford University researchers are developing a new Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine that could be ready for clinical trials in two to three months to help address the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, which has around 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths. The rare Bundibugyo strain has no proven vaccine and kills about one third of those infected. While efficacy is not guaranteed, animal and human studies are planned if the outbreak expands. The WHO has raised the outbreak risk in the DRC from high to very high, with regional risk also high and international risk still considered low, and has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A separate experimental Bundibugyo vaccine is also in development, expected to take six to nine months to ready for testing. Both vaccines use the ChAdOx1 platform—an engineered chimpanzee adenovirus delivering Bundibugyo genetic material to cells, training the immune system without causing disease.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の科学者がエボラウイルスのワクチンを開発中 - Dnes.bgのニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。DRC発生地域は対象国であり、PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行に関する重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス。患者750名疑い例、死亡177名（致死率約33%）。WHO既に PHEIC 宣言。DRCでの活動的な流行中に英国がワクチン開発。regional risk が high に設定されているため、東アフリカ周辺国への拡大リスクは高い。ただし英国での発生例は記事中に見当たらず、記事主題はDRCの流行と英国でのワクチン開発であるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱のリスク、WHOが「非常に高い」に引き上げ　コンゴ民主共和国について - BBCニュース
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk of Ebola hemorrhagic fever to "Very High" for the Democratic Republic of the Congo - BBC News
article.articleSummary: On May 22, the World Health Organization raised the public-health risk from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) from high to very high, with regional risk high and global risk low. In the DRC, 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 7 deaths have been reported; neighboring Uganda has 2 infections and 1 death, both linked to cross-border movement from the DRC, with the situation described as stable. The current Bundibugyo strain shows a mortality around one-third and has no vaccine proven effective. Since the outbreak centered in the DRC, 177 deaths and about 750 suspected infections have been reported. New vaccines are under development using Oxford University technology for rapid testing in 2–3 months; Serum Institute of India could scale production. Another vaccine for Bundibugyo is in development, with 6–9 months for trials. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のリスク、WHOが「非常に高い」に引き上げ　コンゴ民主共和国について - BBCニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外のリスク上昇、地域・国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。またWHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言済みで既に国際的認識が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてDRCがエボラの主要発生地で、Ugandaは隣国からの越境感染例（2例、1死亡）が報告されている。Indiaはセラム・インスティチュート（ワクチン製造スケーリング可能性）の文脈でのみ言及され、感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。PHEC既宣言で国際的には既知のイベントだが、リスク評価の引き上げ（高から「非常に高い」）は新しい重要な発展。

article.articleHeadline: 방역도 수출 경쟁력...제주 구제역 청정지위 지켰다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Biosecurity is also a competitive edge for exports... Jeju maintains its foot-and-mouth disease-free status.
article.articleSummary: South Korea secured designation as a One Health antimicrobial resistance (AMR) collaboration center for terrestrial animals by the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) at the 93rd WOAH General Session in Paris, 18–22 May 2026. Concurrently, Korea’s quarantine agency reaffirmed disease-free status for African swine fever (ASF), bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE), and Peste des petits ruminants (PPR); Jeju Island’s foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccination-free region was also re-certified. Jeju’s FMD-free status supports export negotiations for regional animal products, though broader export gains depend on import negotiations, facility approvals, and market demand. Korea also became a core member of WOAH’s Asia-Pacific regional group, expanding its role in setting cross-border disease control priorities. Planned 2027 East Asia Chief Veterinary Officers Forum and China–Japan–Korea meetings aim to bolster shared surveillance and One Health collaboration to address AI, FMD, ASF and related policies.

triage.headline_ja: 防疫も輸出競争力に...済州口蹄疫清浄地位を守った
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国の動物疾病清浄地認定維持と国際的な防疫協力枠組みの拡大に関するポジティブなニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。対象国内での実際の疾病発生イベントではないため、シグナルとして識別せず。
triage.notes: 記事はASF、BSE、PPR、FMDの清浄地認定維持と国際的な防疫体制強化に関する公式ニュースである。発生地域にはJeju-do、Paris、Republic of Korea、Japan、France、Chinaが含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の疾病発生イベントは報告されていない。むしろ清浄地維持の確認とWOAH等における韓国のポジション向上を述べている。対象国中でChina（東アジアの会議参加国として言及）のみが関連するが、Chinaでの具体的な疾病発生報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-country Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak situation report no. 1
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda was declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) by WHO on 17 May 2026 after cross-border transmission confirmation, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. WHO's 18 May weekly risk assessment provides epidemiological context. The outbreak unfolds amid insecurity and displacement, with cross-border mobility raising transmission risk. IOM's Displacement Tracking Matrix reports 3,591,162 IDPs in eastern DRC, including 921,947 in Ituri and 1,168,413 in North Kivu; Ituri borders South Sudan and Uganda, North Kivu borders Uganda and Rwanda. WHO designates Priority 1 readiness for DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Burundi, Rwanda; Priority 2 for Angola, CAR, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of Congo, Tanzania, Zambia. IOM is strengthening readiness at points of entry and along mobility corridors; U.S. State Department funding activates rapid response in Priority 1 countries.

triage.headline_ja: 多国間エボラ・ブンディブギョ発生状況報告書第1号
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間発生であり、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み（IHR基準4項目全て該当）。国際的拡大・渡航制限リスク・重症性・ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには12カ国が含まれるが、記事サマリーで実際に発生が確認されているのはDRC（確定）とウガンダ（国境を越えた感染確認）。対象国リストではDRCとザンビアのみ該当。ザンビアは優先度2の備態国として言及されているが、実際の症例発生は記載されていないため、DRCが主要発生地。高いスクリーニング必要度あり。

article.articleHeadline: Заради ебола САЩ разшириха обхвата на временната забрана за достъп и за пристигащи от ДР Конго, Южен Судан и Уганда със зелена карта
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Because of Ebola, the United States expanded the scope of the temporary travel ban to include arrivals from DR Congo, South Sudan and Uganda with a green card
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the United States has expanded its temporary entry ban to include travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, extending to holders of green cards. The measure targets Ebola transmission amid an outbreak in the DRC, with confirmed Ebola cases also reported in Uganda and South Sudan. Under the expanded policy, green card holders who have been in any of the three countries within the previous 21 days are barred from entering the United States. The ban is currently in effect for 30 days. Reuters reported the development, reflecting heightened travel screening and public health measures in response to the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラのため、米国はDR コンゴ、南スーダン、ウガンダからの到着者に対する一時的な入国禁止措置の対象を拡大し、グリーンカード保持者も含める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の多国間での発生と国際的な渡航制限措置が講じられている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDR Congo、Uganda、South Sudanでのエボラ発生が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダとスーダンは対象外。米国の渡航禁止措置は対象国のリストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラ出血熱は高致死率で国際的懸念が高く、IHR基準全4項目に該当する明確なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Congo avança; unidades de saúde relatam lotação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo Advances; Health Facilities Report Overcrowding.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, with the current sequence beginning April 24 in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, and spreading to North and South Kivu. Nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported to date. Health facilities are overwhelmed; isolation beds scarce; response teams face logistical challenges amid ongoing conflict and cultural practices around funerals. International organizations like Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) and ALIMA warn that coordination and funding are insufficient to mount an effective response to a virus with no approved treatment and no specific vaccine for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Control measures include case isolation, contact tracing, and mobile treatment units; but safe burial practices are challenged by traditions of washing and touching the deceased. Innovative tools, such as ALIMA’s Cube, aim to reduce exposure. Militia attacks (e.g., ADF) threaten surveillance, compounding delays in containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが進行；保健施設が収容限界に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。活動中の大規模エボラ outbreak（750疑い例、177死亡）が複数州に拡大し、国際的対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 2026年5月23日配信。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ outbreak（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）。4月24日にイトゥリ州ブニアで開始、北・南キブに拡大。MSFおよびALIMAが国際的調整と資金不足を警告。紛争下での対応困難（民兵攻撃ADF等）。治療法・ワクチン不在のリスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu se širi opasan soj ebole za kojeg ne postoji vakcina: WHO upozorio da je epidemija mnogo veća od zvaničnih podataka - Zenit.ba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a dangerous strain of Ebola for which there is no vaccine is spreading: WHO warned that the outbreak is much larger than official data - Zenit.ba.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain spreading in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, Bunia) with no available vaccine. WHO raised Congo's outbreak risk to very high; global risk remains low. Official counts report 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, but field estimates suggest up to 750 cases and 177 deaths. Initial testing for standard Ebola variants was negative, allowing hidden spread; the outbreak has reached South Kivu and North Kivu, areas controlled by the M23 rebel group. Public health measures include bans on vigils and large gatherings, while frontline health workers face severe PPE shortages and communities' mistrust; unsafe burials and funeral practices amplify transmission. Clinics have burned; misinformation from some churches worsens fears. International response includes $60 million from the UN and $23 million from the US for up to 50 treatment centers in Congo and neighboring Uganda. Ongoing armed conflict hinders aid delivery and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで予防接種がない危険なエボラ株が流行：WHO当局の発表より流行規模が大きいと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体の出現、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高い重症度（死亡事例あり）と感染拡大リスクが示唆されている。フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain（ワクチン未利用可能）で、公式報告82確認例・7死亡に対し現地推定750例・177死亡と乖離大きい。武装勢力M23支配地域への拡大、医療従事者のPPE不足、安全でない埋葬慣行等により制御困難。ウガンダへの拡大リスク言及されているが、ウガンダでの実際の確認事例の記載がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: '백신 없는' 희귀 변종 에볼라 비상... 미국, 영주권자까지 입국 차단
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No-vaccine Ebola: rare-strain emergency... U.S. bans entry even for permanent residents.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, a rare Ebola variant, Bundibugyo virus, is circulating in sub-Saharan Africa, with cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and spillover into Uganda and South Sudan. The virus, hosted by fruit bats, transmits via contact with infected bodily fluids; there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy, so care is supportive. Incubation can reach 21 days; early symptoms mimic influenza or malaria, delaying diagnosis. Historical case fatality is estimated at 30–50%, though data are limited. The WHO has declared an International Public Health Emergency, raising the national risk in the DRC to very high and urging global outbreak response coordination. In the United States, visa issuance is suspended for foreign nationals who have stayed in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days under CDC authority, and a DRC national passenger was denied U.S. entry and diverted to Canada.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなき希少変種エボラ緊急事態...米国、永住権者まで入国禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の希少変種、複数国への国際拡大、渡航制限実施）。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法なし。
triage.notes: 記事は南スーダン・ウガンダでの二次感染にも言及しているが、対象国リストに該当せず。DRCが主発生地として記事の中心。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、米国による入国禁止措置、ワクチン・特異的治療法不在により重大リスク。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少変種）の流行は高い優先度を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Powrót najgroźniejszego wirusa świata. Co trzeba wiedzieć o eboli?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The return of the world's most dangerous virus. What you need to know about Ebola?
article.articleSummary: The article recounts Ebola’s early outbreak in Yambuku, a small town in Zaire (now the Democratic Republic of the Congo). On August 26, 1976, Mabalo Lokela, director of a school in Yambuku, returned from the Ebola River with fever. Local medical staff misdiagnosed the illness as malaria and treated him with quinine, which provided no relief. He soon developed bleeding from the nose, ears, and gums and died shortly after. Nurses at a mission hospital operated by Belgian nuns also fell ill, followed by other patients, signaling nosocomial transmission within a healthcare setting. The description highlights acute fever and hemorrhagic symptoms as hallmark features of the outbreak and documents the earliest observed cluster that would come to be known as Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 世界で最も危険なウイルスの再来。エボラについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 記事内容は1976年のヤンブク初期発症事例の歴史的回顧であり、現在の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は1976年のヤンブク初期発症事例（50年前のイベント）の歴史的解説であり、現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイク報告ではない。現在の感染症動向に関する新規シグナルではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: കോവിഡിന് പിന്നാലെ പുതിയ ഭീതി ; എബോളയെക്കുറിച്ച് അറിയേണ്ടതെല്ലാം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New fear after COVID; everything you need to know about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD), or Ebola haemorrhagic fever, is a deadly illness transmitted from animal reservoirs—primarily fruit bats—to humans and between people via contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated items. Incubation is 2 days to 3 weeks; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, and headache, progressing to internal and external bleeding and organ failure. Diagnosis relies on ELISA and RT-PCR. First identified in 1976 in Congo (then Zaire) and in Sudan; Congo outbreaks: 318 cases, 280 deaths (CFR 88%); Sudan: 284 cases, 151 deaths (CFR 53%). Major 2014-16 outbreaks hit Sierra Leone, Liberia, Guinea: Sierra Leone 14,124 cases, 3,956 deaths (CFR 28%); Liberia 10,675 cases, 4,809 deaths (CFR 45%); Guinea 3,811 cases, 2,543 deaths (CFR 67%). 2018-20 Congo outbreak: 3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths (CFR 66%). Isolated cases reported in Congo and Guinea in February 2021. More than 130 deaths reported; Kerala expresses concern; past spillovers reached Gabon and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: COVID後の新たな恐怖；エボラについて知るべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病についての教育的・情報提供記事であり、具体的な現在進行中の新規事例報告ではない。ただしエボラの高リスク病原体特性と過去の大規模流行歴から、疾患そのものの懸念は高い。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的なエボラ流行や疾患特性に関する一般向け情報記事であり、現在のアウトブレイク報告ではない。2021年2月の孤発例言及は過去の記録。しかし発生地域リストに多数のアフリカ諸国が含まれており、APIの自動抽出に誤りがある可能性がある。実際の検証対象国はインドのみ（ケーララ州からの懸念報告）。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫上调刚果（金）埃博拉疫情风险等级至"非常高"，当地抗议者焚烧医疗物资
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises Ebola outbreak risk level in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'Very High'; local protesters burn medical supplies.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization on May 22, 2026, raised the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s country-level risk for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak to Very High, with regional risk High and global risk Low. As of the briefing, 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths have been reported, but nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths suggest a much larger outbreak. Most transmission is in Ituri Province, with a few cases elsewhere; neighboring Uganda has two related cases. Community distrust of external responders is hindering control efforts. An Ebola treatment center tent outside a hospital in Ituri was set ablaze during protests, with a death reported; authorities aim to have the center back in operation within 24 hours. WHO and Congo representatives warned such attacks jeopardize containment, while international NGOs flag resource shortages and funding cuts. A drug called Obedexivir is being piloted to protect close contacts during trials in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情リスク等級を「非常に高い」に引き上げ、現地の抗議者が医療物資を焼却
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。WHOが国レベルのリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げた重篤なエボラ出血熱イベントであり、ただちにフルRRAを進める必要がある。
triage.notes: WHOが国レベルのリスク評価を『非常に高い』に引き上げた確認症例82例、疑い例750例、死亡7例（疑い例177例）を報告。イトゥリ州での主要感染と隣国ウガンダでの2例の関連症例が確認されている。地域の信頼喪失と医療物資への攻撃がコントロール努力を阻害している重大な段階。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi Wabah Ebola, Rwanda Terapkan Karantina Wajib bagi Pelancong asal Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating the Ebola Outbreak, Rwanda Imposes Mandatory Quarantine for Travelers from the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Rwanda tightens entry controls as Ebola risk crosses the border, imposing a mandatory 30-day quarantine for travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo. In a Friday statement, Rwanda's Ministry of Health requires all citizens and foreign residents arriving from Congo in the past 30 days to complete quarantine per health protocols. Non-resident foreign nationals with Congo travel history in the last 30 days will be refused entry. The policy follows the Ebola outbreak first declared in Ituri Province on May 15 and reportedly spreading to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. WHO data show about 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths linked to the outbreak, with at least 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The measures aim to reduce cross-border transmission as regional authorities monitor evolving spillover.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症アウトブレイク対策として、ルワンダがコンゴからの旅行者に強制隔離を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3基準に該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を持つVHFであり、コンゴでの発生がルワンダの隔離措置を引き起こす国際的脅威となっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生が主題であり、ルワンダの措置はその対応。Ituri Province、North Kivu、South Kivu各州での発生が確認されている。患者数750名（疑い例）、死亡者177名（WHO報告）、確定例82名・死亡7名。ルワンダは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: بسبب الفيروس القاتل.. إجراءات استثنائية بحق زوار كأس العالم عام 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to the deadly virus, extraordinary measures against visitors to the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo with about 600 suspected cases and 139 probable deaths; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. For the expanded 2026 World Cup (June 11–July 19) in the United States, Canada and Mexico, spectator risk is low, but intensified screening and travel restrictions could complicate logistics. DRC training was canceled in Kinshasa and moved to Belgium; the team opens vs Portugal in Houston, then Colombia in Valley of Stones and Uzbekistan in Atlanta. U.S. authorities bar entry for non-U.S. passport holders who were in DRC, Uganda or South Sudan in the past 21 days; Congo staff may depart early; the team arrives in the United States around June 10–11. Dr. Oliver Johnson of King’s College London notes Ebola is not airborne and spreads by close contact with a very ill patient; rapid contact tracing is essential. Americans who were in those countries in the past three weeks must undergo testing at Washington Dulles as agencies coordinate with FIFA.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスのため...2026 FIFAワールドカップの観客に対する特別措置
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（疑い例約600件、死亡139件）がWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。2026ワールドカップなど大規模国際イベントへの影響とともに、複数国での入国制限・検査強化が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域にはアメリカ、カナダ、メキシコ、イギリス、ウガンダ、スーダン、ベルギーなどが含まれているが、記事サマリーの分析では実際のエボラ感染の発生はDRC（約600疑い例、139死亡）に限定されている。他の国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。アメリカなどでの検査・入国制限はDRCからの流入防止対策であり、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 미국, 에볼라 확산 지역 체류자에게 비자 발급 중단
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. suspends visa issuance for residents in Ebola outbreak areas.
article.articleSummary: U.S. visa issuance is suspended for foreign nationals who have stayed in Ebola outbreak areas within 21 days prior to planned U.S. travel, targeting the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The policy, reported May 22, 2026 by the Wall Street Journal citing the U.S. State Department, aims to reduce Ebola importation risk amid ongoing African outbreaks. In a related incident, a passenger from the Democratic Republic of the Congo aboard a French flight was denied U.S. entry on May 20 and diverted to Montreal, Canada. Montreal screening found no symptoms. U.S. Customs and Border Protection noted the boarding error was due to airline oversight, and the individual should not have boarded under the risk-reduction measures.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行地域の滞在者へのビザ発給を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス病は高致死性で国際的脅威であり、複数国での流行と米国への侵入事例が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはカナダ・米国・フランス・スーダン・ウガンダなども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はアフリカのエボラ流行（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）と米国の対応である。対象国リストのうち、実際に流行が発生している国はDRCのみであり、カナダはスクリーニング中継地点、米国は防疫措置実施国として機能している。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Заради ебола САЩ забраниха влизането в страната от ДР Конго, Уганда и Южен Судан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to Ebola, the United States banned entry into the country from DR Congo, Uganda and South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: U.S. bans entry of travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to the Ebola outbreak, expanding the ban to include green card holders who in the past 21 days visited any of the three countries. The measure, in effect for 30 days, follows Ebola cases detected in Uganda and South Sudan in addition to the ongoing outbreak in DR Congo. WHO officials express concern about the rapid spread and scale, noting that past outbreaks in the DR Congo region took years to bring fully under control. There is no proven Ebola treatment, and the average case fatality rate is about 50%. This underscores international concern about potential further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策：米国がコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（致死率50%）、異常・予想外の急速な地域拡大、複数国への国際的拡大、米国による渡航制限措置の発令。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）でのエボラ事例に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。米国の渡航制限は国際的関心を示す証拠だが、米国は対象国ではないため除外。WHO懸念、歴史的な制御困難性、致死率50%などが深刻な公衆衛生影響を裏付けている。

article.articleHeadline: Ada Warga Sempat Suspek, Dinkes Sleman Perketat Kewaspadaan Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Resident Was Briefly Suspected, Sleman Health Office Tightens Hantavirus Vigilance.
article.articleSummary: In Sleman Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia, the Health Office tightened vigilance for hantavirus and leptospirosis after a resident was briefly suspected in early 2026. Although symptoms prompted concern, laboratory tests later returned negative, and the individual is considered safe. No confirmed cases have been reported. Preventive measures include circulating an official hantavirus prevention circular, outreach to health workers, and public guidance on the Sleman Health Office website. Promotional and preventive efforts emphasize Hygiene Behavior (PHBS) and handwashing with soap and running water. Rodent-control campaigns (gropyokan) are planned to reduce rat habitats, reflecting the shared rodent transmission pathways for hantavirus and leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: 住民が一時的に疑い患者となった、スレマン保健所がハンタウイルスに対する警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 疑い患者の検査結果は陰性で確定患者なし。予防措置が実施されているが、実際の感染症発生ではなく予防的警戒段階であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がない。
triage.notes: 記事は疑い患者の陰性確定と予防的措置の強化を報告しており、実際の感染症発生イベントではない。ハンタウイルスとレプトスピラ症は齧歯動物媒介であり流行しやすい可能性があるが、現在のところ確定患者はなく、予防段階の措置に過ぎない。地域検証：記事はインドネシア・ヨグヤカルタ州スレマンで発生しており、Indonesia (1643084) に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials activate enhanced screening as WHO issues Ebola advisory
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompted Cayman Islands to activate enhanced screening at Owen Roberts International Airport from 21 May, with targeted health questionnaires, increased traveler monitoring, and coordination with border agencies. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May, noting the Bundibugyo Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or treatments; the strain historically shows about 30% mortality. The Caribbean region, via CARPHA, reactivated electronic travel screening at borders; CARPHA says primary regional risk comes from infected travellers. Cayman’s overall risk remains low, though vigilance is warranted as infection can appear 2–21 days after exposure. Uganda cases involved travelers from Congo, underscoring import risk. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, and unexplained bleeding. Measures aim at early detection and public safety without broad travel warnings, focusing on outbreaks concentrated in specific areas of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラ警告を発令する中、保健当局が強化スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認される。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、シグナル識別が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ感染は DRC とウガンダで発生しており、ケイマン諸島はこの流行への対応として強化スクリーニングを実施している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHO が PHEIC を宣言（2026年5月17日）し、Bundibugyo エボラ株（ワクチン・治療法なし、致死率約30%）が確認されている。国際的な感染リスクとしてトラベラーを通じた伝播が懸念されており、複数地域での強化スクリーニング実施が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Crowd Torches Ebola Isolation Tents in Eastern DR Congo During Burial Dispute - South Africa Today
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern Ituri region, a crowd in Rwampara torched Ebola isolation tents and attacked a hospital amid a burial dispute for a man believed to have died from the virus. A family burying their son watched villagers demand the body of another man named Ellie; stones were thrown, tents burned, and an ambulance attacked. Son’s body was left burned. Health officials urged safe burial practices to prevent transmission through contact with infected bodies. WHO reports over 600 suspected cases and at least 139 suspected deaths in DRC and Uganda; confirmed figures likely undercounted. In South Kivu, M23-aligned officials said May 20, 2026 one confirmed case and one death. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine; testing capacity is six per hour; two vaccines under consideration, 3–9 months to develop. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Health workers continue containment amid conflict.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴでエボラ隔離テントが焼かれる 埋葬紛争中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式な国際的懸念事項の宣言済みで、複数国での患者報告あり。
triage.notes: WHOが既に公式な国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言している。複数地域（Ituri、South Kivu）での発生報告あり。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はコンゴであり、ウガンダは WHO統計での参照のみのため verified_locations には含めない。社会不安（隔離施設への攻撃）が病原体管理を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Wirus Ebola szaleje w DRK. Rośnie liczba przypadków, WHO bije na alarm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is raging in DR Congo. The number of cases is rising; WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Ebola is raging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with nearly 750 cases and rising. WHO has raised the alarm to the highest level, citing very high transmission risk and an unstable epidemiological situation. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, a rarer strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, unlike Zaire. Priorities include testing experimental therapies and rapid isolation of cases, with WHO stressing 21-day isolation. Delayed detection means case counts likely underestimate true spread, since early symptoms resemble malaria or typhoid. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death; Rwanda has border restrictions and quarantines for travelers via DR Congo. In Europe, a Netherlands patient is isolated, with US citizens treated or monitored in Germany and the Czech Republic. Experimental monoclonal antibody therapies and an oral antiviral are under investigation for treatment and post-exposure use.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で猛威。症例数が増加、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数の症例（約750件）、WHOが最高レベルの警告、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、欧州での確認例）が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域に米国、オランダ、ドイツ、チェコが含まれているが、サマリーではこれらは患者の治療・監視地であり、ウイルス発生地ではない。したがず verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。ウガンダとルワンダも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo variant、ワクチン非承認、高い伝播リスク、WHO最高警告レベルなど、複数の重篤な懸念要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Football. Avec Ebola, la sélection congolaise devra s'isoler
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Football. With Ebola, the Congolese national team will have to isolate.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s national football team, training in Belgium, must enter isolation from Friday to guard against Ebola exposure amid a 17th outbreak in eastern DRC. If others join the squad, they must form a separate bubble; any symptomatic person could jeopardize World Cup participation. The team bases in Houston, Texas, in Group K, facing Portugal on June 17 in Houston, Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara, Mexico, and Uzbekistan on June 27 in Atlanta. In a statement to AFP, Giuliani said the White House encouraged protecting players to preserve the bubble and the team’s readiness. The WHO has triggered an international health alert for the outbreak, which has 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with national risk rated "very high" as the outbreak spreads. Ebola virus disease is a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever; the virus has caused more than 15,000 African deaths in the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ代表チームは隔離しなければならない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健警報を発令した17回目のアウトブレイク。確認症例82件、死亡7件。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCの17番目のエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。DRC代表サッカーチームが国際試合（ワールドカップ予選）のためにベルギムから米国に移動する際の隔離措置が焦点。WHOが国際保健警報を発令済み。米国テキサス州やメキシコでの試合開催予定であるが、記事は実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCであり、米国やメキシコへの懸念は二次的なリスク。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا توسع نطاق حظر السفر المتعلق بـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. expands Ebola-related travel ban
article.articleSummary: AS OF 23 MAY 2026, the United States has temporarily barred entry of lawful permanent residents who were in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days due to Ebola concerns. The policy, enacted under Section 42 of the Public Health Service Act, aims to balance protecting public health with ongoing emergency-response resource management, per the CDC. The World Health Organization has raised the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC to a very high risk level and declared that the concurrent outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The action reflects intensified international attention to Ebola amid local transmission in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ関連の渡航禁止措置を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での局所伝播、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、米国による渡航制限実施により、フルRRA進行の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラの局所伝播が確認される国はDRCとウガンダ（対象国外）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。米国の渡航禁止措置は23日以内の滞在者を対象。南スーダンはサマリーではSouth Sudanとされており対象国外。verified_locationsはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго от лихорадки Эбола погибло больше 150 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 150 people have died from Ebola fever in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has risen to 160 deaths, with 671 suspected cases, according to local authorities cited by the Associated Press. The epicenter is Ituri Province, where the first warning signals appeared on May 5. In response to the worsening situation, Uganda has suspended all direct flights to the DRC. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, underscoring its cross-border risk. The report, dated May 23, 2026, highlights the global public health emphasis on this event and the need for coordinated surveillance and containment measures in neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱により150人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した高リスクイベント。
triage.notes: ウガンダはDRCへの直行便を停止するなど国際的対応が始まっている。Ituri州が震源地で5月5日に最初の警告信号が出現。WHOによる公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項宣言により、国際調整と周辺地域での監視・抑制対策の必要性が強調されている。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーではDRCでのイベント説明が主題であり、ウガンダは対応国として言及されているのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola crisis in Congo raises fears ahead of 2026 World Cup
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 139 people. With less than a month before the opening whistle of the 2026 World Cup, the DR Congo Leopards face a health crisis overshadowing the tournament, as fear grips streets in the east. Riots and medical workers operate under military protection as authorities try to contain the outbreak. The episode threatens to become the tournament’s biggest health headache, just as the country pursues a historic first World Cup appearance in decades. The report underscores the spillover risk to an international event amid significant social and security strain around the World Cup. Published May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機が2026年ワールドカップ前に懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。死亡139人以上のエボラ出血熱流行で、国際的なスポーツイベントへの脅威と国際支援の必要性を示唆。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の流行により139人以上の死亡が報告。東部DRコンゴでの暴動、医療従事者が軍の保護下で活動中。2026年ワールドカップ（1か月以内開幕予定）への国際的スポーツイベントに対する脅威。社会不安と治安上の問題が並行して発生。WPROスクリーニング全基準該当。

article.articleHeadline: "Im Kongo sterben wegen Ebola mehr Kinder an Malaria"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, more children die of malaria because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kongo-Kinshasa), marking the region’s 17th outbreak. Save the Children reports bolstered field teams supporting health centers across the province, with emphasis on protecting overburdened healthcare workers amid PPE shortages. Facilities use chlorine disinfection and temperature screening; many residents avoid hospitals for fear of Ebola, risking death from other illnesses. Children face dual threats: Ebola can be fatal, but malaria remains the leading cause of child deaths, compounded by malnutrition and displacement as hundreds of schools have closed due to ongoing conflict. Early Ebola symptoms (fever, malaise, pain) mirror malaria, hindering diagnosis. The WHO is on site, and officials appeal for renewed international financial support to end the outbreak, arguing that containment is possible with adequate resources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴではエボラのため、より多くの子どもたちがマラリアで死亡している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラアウトブレイク（17回目）、子どもの死亡増加、医療施設への信頼喪失、マラリア併発による複合的脅威が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラの17回目のアウトブレイク継続中。マラリアなどの他疾患による死亡が増加している点が重要。医療施設への信頼喪失（エボラへの恐怖心）により、本来予防可能な疾患での死亡が増加。紛争による学校閉鎖、栄養不良、住民移動により脆弱性が増加している。WHO現地配置、国際支援への強い訴え。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Impfstoff für diesen Virus-Stamm fehlt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: vaccine for this virus strain is missing.
article.articleSummary: In the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda, the Ebola outbreak has 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths as of May 23, 2026. Doctors Without Borders warns the situation is dramatic, but controlled care is possible in a proper setting despite war, attacks on healthcare facilities, and shortages of staff and PPE. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving this outbreak currently lacks an vaccine that has been tested in humans; vaccines exist for other strains, highlighting long-standing gaps since the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic. Global response teams are being mobilized to regional efforts. An imported case involves a U.S. physician who contracted Ebola and was treated at Berlin’s Charité hospital; his wife and four children were brought to Charité, with the CDC reporting the patient in stable condition.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：このウイルス株用のワクチンが不足
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。活動的な流行、死亡症例、ワクチン未整備のBundibugyo株、複数国への拡大、国際支援体制の既に存在するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC東部とウガンダでの流行を主眼としているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙。米国医師のベルリン搬送はインポートケースで、独仏での二次発症リスクは現在のところ記事では言及されていない。Bundibugyo株用のヒト試験済みワクチンが欠如しており、感染制御上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ повысила уровень риска Эболы до "очень высокого" в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raised the Ebola risk level to 'very high' in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompted WHO to raise the public-health risk to 'very high' while global risk remains low. As of 2026-05-23, 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC with 7 deaths; investigators estimate about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which no proven effective vaccine exists. The virus has spread to neighboring Uganda, with 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. An American citizen who contracted Ebola in the DRC is treated at a Berlin Charité hospital; his condition is described as strongly weakened but not critical, under high-containment isolation. Another American high-risk contact has been moved to the Czech Republic. A patient with low suspicion of Ebola is isolated in the Netherlands at Radboud University Medical Center awaiting test results. Symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラウイルスのリスクレベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（82確定例、750疑い例、177疑い死亡）は深刻な公衆衛生への影響を呈し、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されており、ドイツおよびチェコでの輸入症例が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo virus）が主な発生地。ウガンダ（対象国外）への越境事例も報告されているが、ウガンダは評価対象外国のため verified_locations から除外。ドイツ、チェコ、オランダでの輸入症例は対象国外であるため、評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ, KDC'de Ebola riskini 'çok yüksek' seviyesine çıkardı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has raised the Ebola risk in the DRC to a 'very high' level
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 – WHO raises Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high. The outbreak reports 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, indicating a much larger spread. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is the causative agent; no proven vaccine exists. Uganda reports cross-border transmission with two confirmed cases and one death. Global risk remains low. A U.S. citizen in DRC contracted Ebola and was transferred to Charité Hospital in Berlin, where he is severely weakened but not in critical condition, held in a high-security isolation unit. Another U.S. high-risk contact has been moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center has admitted a patient with suspected Ebola and awaits test results. Common symptoms include fever, fatigue, diarrhea, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラリスクを「極めて高い」レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確定患者82名・7名の死亡、疑い患者750名以上が報告され、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、米国市民の感染により複数国で患者受け入れ中。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC での最初の発生を主眼としている。ウガンダの越境感染、ドイツ・チェコ・オランダへの患者移送は記載されているが、これらの国での地域感染発生ではなく、DRC からの患者輸送ケースであるため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストに DRC（203312）のみが該当。WHO による「極めて高い」リスク評価の引き上げは、既知の高リスク状況からの段階的上昇を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS eleva el riesgo por el ébola a 'muy alto' en la R. D. del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk of Ebola to 'Very High' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO has raised the public-health risk from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high, while the global risk remains low as of May 23, 2026. The DRC outbreak shows 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and seven deaths, with approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no proven vaccine. The virus has spilled over into Uganda, with two confirmed cases and one death. An American worker who had been in the DRC contracted Ebola and was transferred to Charité hospital in Berlin, where he is gravely weakened but not critically ill and remains under high-security isolation. Another American high-risk contact has been moved to the Czech Republic. Common symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting. Ebola was first identified in 1976; CDC cites mortality up to about 90%.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスのリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未開発の希少株）による確定例と死亡、複数国への拡大、高リスク症例の国際移送が確認されている。WHOが「Very High」に評価を引き上げたシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及されているウガンダの症例（確定例2、死亡1）はWPRO対象国外であるため除外。ベルリン・ドイツ・チェコの言及は輸入症例の扱いで、発生地はDRCが主体。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は希少株でワクチン不在、致命率最大90%。DRC国内リスク『Very High』、グローバルリスク『Low』の評価が注記されている。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية ترفع خطر إيبولا إلى مرتفع جدا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization Raises Ebola Risk to Very High in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization raises Ebola risk to Very High in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 2026-05-23, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said global risk remains low, even as the public health risk assessment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus moved from High to Very High. In the DRC, 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths have been reported, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda, with two confirmed cases and one death. An American citizen infected in the DRC was treated at Berlin’s Charité hospital; described as severely ill but not in critical condition, and in high-containment isolation. Reports also note another American contact moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center has admitted a patient under low-suspicion for Ebola. Symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, vomiting; mortality can reach up to 90% in some outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に高リスクの感染症であり、DRC内での確認症例82例および死亡7例、隣国ウガンダへの拡大、欧州での患者治療報告により、公衆衛生影響は深刻かつ国際的拡大が既に進行中。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の確認ケースはDRC内が主体。ウガンダへの拡大は記事に明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ドイツ、チェコ、オランダでの患者報告は、DRCでの感染後の国際移動・治療であり、これらの国での発生ではないため除外した。WHOが公式にリスク評価を「Very High」に引き上げた重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Oms alza a 'molto alto' il rischio Ebola nella Rdc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk of Ebola in the DRC to 'very high'.
article.articleSummary: WHO has raised the public health risk of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high, while global risk remains low according to Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In the DRC, 82 cases have been laboratory-confirmed with 7 deaths; approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths indicate broader transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain for which no proven vaccine exists. The flare-up has also reached Uganda, with two confirmed cases and one death. A U.S. citizen working in the DRC has been infected and transferred to Berlin's Charité hospital; the patient is gravely debilitated but not in critical condition and remains under high-security isolation. Another U.S. citizen, deemed a high-risk contact, has been moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center reported a patient with low Ebola suspicion awaiting diagnostic results. Ebola is severe and often fatal; symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認症例82件、疑い症例750件、死亡7件で著しい公衆衛生への影響があり、国際的な患者移動と複数国への拡大が既に発生している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCの同族報告が主題であり、ウガンダの2例は言及されるが、DRCが主要な発生地であることが明確。ドイツ・米国市民患者の転送はDRC発生源の国際的関心を示すが、転送先国は二次的。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実質的な発生地として該当。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus株という稀なタイプで有効ワクチンなし。WHOがリスク評価を引き上げた事実から社会的・政治的関心が著しく高い。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان جهانی بهداشت خطر ابولا را در کنگو بسیار بالا اعلام کرد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola risk in Congo to be very high.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the World Health Organization raised the DRC Ebola outbreak’s public health risk from high to very high, though global risk remains low. The Democratic Republic of Congo has 82 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 7 deaths, with roughly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccine exists. The virus has crossed into neighboring Uganda, with 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. An American working in DRC was confirmed infected and, after transfer, is severely weakened but not in critical condition at Berlin’s Charité hospital, under strict isolation in a high-security unit. A second American contact and a case in the Czech Republic are being tracked. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center is quarantining a patient with low probability of Ebola until tests confirm. Ebola presents with fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting; mortality can reach 90%.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴでのエボラ熱リスクを極めて高いと宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認例、死亡例あり、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事に記載されているドイツ、ウガンダ、チェコ共和国、オランダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC での活動中に感染したアメリカ人がベルリンで隔離されているが、実際の発生地はDRC。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による致命率の高い流行であり、WHOが「極めて高い」リスク判定を下している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: World Bank says responding to Ebola outbreak, plans to increase funding
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 82 confirmed cases, 7 confirmed deaths, and 177 suspected deaths among about 750 suspected cases; two confirmed cases reported in Uganda. On May 17, 2026, WHO declared the outbreak an emergency; by May 22 its risk in DRC was raised to very high. Symptoms include fever, body aches, vomiting and diarrhea; early signs resemble malaria or typhoid. There is no licensed vaccine or therapeutic for BDBV, though vaccine development is being accelerated with Gavi. Ituri region has three Ebola treatment centres; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated materials or deceased patients. The World Bank has mobilized staff and a financing package to rapidly scale funding, drawing from a $250 million health project (2024) with about $200 million undisbursed.
