UN released about $60 million; the U.S. is funding 50 emergency clinics. Bank coordinating with WHO and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 世界銀行がエボラウイルス病の発生に対応し、資金増加を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4/4該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な出来事、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。BDBV感染症の確認症例と死亡が報告され、WHO緊急事態宣言も発出されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでの2確認症例が言及されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのイトゥリ地域での発生が主たるイベント。WHO緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）、リスクレベル「very high」への引き上げ（2026年5月22日）により、国際的な支援・調整が急速に展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO nâng cảnh báo dịch Ebola ở CHDC Congo lên mức cao nhất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the Ebola outbreak alert in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the highest level.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak with 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths may indicate a larger burden. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or specific treatment; Ervebo (Zaire strain) offers no proven cross-protection, and Bundibugyo-specific vaccines could take 6–9 months. Transmission appears to have occurred weeks before detection, with early symptoms resembling malaria or typhoid, hindering rapid identification. Control relies on 21-day contact tracing and isolation amid insecurity. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tanganyika provinces face severe hunger affecting around 10 million people. WHO and partners are delivering aid and medical supplies to hard-to-reach areas. Trials are evaluating Regeneron 3479, MBP134 monoclonal antibodies, and obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが民主共和国コンゴのエボラアウトブレイクの警戒レベルを最高段階に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予期しない新種株の出現、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で全5項目該当。致死的な新規エボラ株の大規模アウトブレイク（82確認例、750疑い例、死亡7例以上）は最優先のシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの出現は極めて異常。既存ワクチン（Ervebo：ザイール株）での交差防御効果がなく、株特異的ワクチン開発に6-9ヶ月要する。マラリア/チフス様初期症状により検出遅延が発生。周辺4県で1000万人規模の飢饉が複合危機を形成。国際支援・ワクチン開発の緊急体制が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo: WHO stuft Ebola-Risiko als sehr hoch ein
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: WHO deems Ebola risk to be very high
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization elevated the Ebola public-health risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'very high'. In the DRC, 82 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported with 7 deaths; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths indicate a larger outbreak. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible; no proven vaccine exists. The virus has crossed into Uganda, with 2 cases and 1 death. A U.S. citizen working in DRC was infected and treated at Charité in Berlin, described as severely weakened but not in critical condition, under high-security isolation. A second U.S. citizen at high-risk contact has been moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center admitted a patient with low Ebola suspicion in isolation. Symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea and vomiting; CDC notes up to 90% fatality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：WHOがエボラ出血熱のリスクを非常に高いと判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（確定82例、死亡7例、疑い例750例以上）がDRCで発生し、既にウガンダへの越境、複数国への患者輸送が確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの82確定例・750疑い例の大規模アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダへの越境（2例、死亡1）、米国市民のベルリン搬送、チェコ共和国への接触者移動、オランダでの疑い例入院など国際的な拡大が既に進行中。ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo型で、致命率最大90%とされている。Bluedot APIの発生地域には複数国が列挙されているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCが中心であり、他国は患者輸送先または疑い例の報告地点である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперты предупредили об участившихся нашествиях опасных инфекций: от хантавируса до Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts Warned of Increasing Outbreaks of Dangerous Infections: From Hantavirus to Ebola
article.articleSummary: Rises in infections such as hantavirus and Ebola are becoming more frequent, straining health systems in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as they fight an Ebola outbreak. A Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) report warns pandemics outpace readiness investments, eroding global health security. The DRC Ebola outbreak has claimed at least 87 lives; WHO has depleted stockpiles in Kinshasa and is arranging supplies from Kenya, with MSF and the International Rescue Committee deploying response teams. Experts cite early misidentification of the Ebola strain, yielding false negatives and delaying action, allowing spread across major transport routes. Despite rapid biotech advances, including mRNA vaccine platforms, access to vaccines, tests, and treatments remains uneven, and Ebola vaccine deployment took nearly two years to reach Africa, longer than for COVID-19. GPMB calls for a permanent independent risk-monitoring mechanism, a pandemic accord for equitable access, and sustained funding.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、ハンタウイルスからエボラまで危険感染症の発生増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。複数の重症病原体（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）における同時多発的な感染増加パターンが報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行易さ、管理可能性）。検証済み発生地域はDRCでコンファーム。
triage.notes: 複数の危険病原体（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）の同時増加を報告。DRCのエボラアウトブレイクで87人以上の死亡確認。WHO備蓄枯渇、ケニアからの供給調整中。MSF・国際救援委員会が対応チーム展開。早期診断失敗（偽陰性）による感染拡大が主要な懸念。社会的・政治的関心が高い。ウガンダとケニアも言及されているが、記事サマリーの主軸はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク対応であり、他国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: UN intensifying efforts to counter fast-spreading Ebola in eastern DR Congo - Official
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts WHO to raise the DRC’s national risk assessment to very high, while risk remains low globally. In DRC, 82 cases and seven deaths are confirmed, with authorities warning the true scale is likely larger; nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported. The UN allocated $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to bolster the response in DRC and neighboring countries. The outbreak unfolds amid intensified fighting, displacement, and mistrust, with a hospital in Ituri reportedly set on fire after authorities refused to release a body due to contamination fears. Two travel-linked cases have been confirmed in Uganda with one death; two nationals, including a doctor, have been moved to Europe for treatment or monitoring. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccines or therapeutics; only two prior outbreaks (Uganda 2007, DRC 2012).

triage.headline_ja: UN intensifying efforts to counter fast-spreading Ebola in eastern DR Congo - Official
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例と死亡が報告され、ウガンダへの国際的な広がり、WHO危険評価の引き上げ、および複数国への対応資源配分が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも旅行関連症例2例が報告されているが、主要な発生地はDRCの東部（Ituri州）であり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルス株は既認可ワクチン・治療薬がなく、流行拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: ABD'den Kongo'ya Ebola resti: Karantinaya uymazsanız Dünya Kupası'na almayız! - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ban from the United States to Congo: If you don't comply with the quarantine, you won't be allowed into the World Cup!
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), prompting U.S. entry restrictions for the Leopards ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted by the United States. Due to health risks, the DRC national team canceled its planned domestic training camp and will continue preparations abroad, with Belgium hosting a camp and two warm-up matches. White House Ebola Task Force Director Andrew Giuliani stated that the Leopards must maintain a 21-day quarantine before entering U.S. soil, or they will be denied entry to the World Cup. The message was delivered to FIFA, the DRC Football Federation, and the DRC government. The United States seeks strict isolation to prevent cross-border transmission of the outbreak and to protect the tournament’s integrity. Arrival in Houston is targeted for June 11, according to the report; no clinical case counts are provided. Keywords: Ebola, DRC, United States, Belgium, World Cup, quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: 米国からコンゴへのエボラ警告：隔離に従わなければワールドカップ出場を認めない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病はハイインパクト感染症であり、DRCでの再出現と米国への拡大リスク、国際的なスポーツイベント関連の制限措置が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラの再出現を主題としている。発生地域リストにはテキサス州・ヒューストン・米国・ベルギーが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれず、また記事上では2026年ワールドカップに向けた制限措置の文脈であり、これらの国での実際の発生は示されていない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみ。臨床患者数が記載されていないため詳細な重症度は不明だが、エボラウイルス病という病原体の特性と国際的な対応措置の規模から、スクリーニング基準は全て該当と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا توسع نطاق حظر السفر المتعلق بإيبولا ليشمل حاملي البطاقة الخضراء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States expands Ebola-related travel ban to include green card holders.
article.articleSummary: The United States expands Ebola-related travel restrictions to include lawful permanent residents (green card holders) who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. The temporary order, announced by the CDC under Section 42 of the Public Health Service Act, bars entry to protect public health and conserve emergency-response resources during ongoing Ebola responses. Green card holders had previously been exempt from such bans, including during the COVID-19 era, making this a notable policy shift. The move follows the World Health Organization’s elevation of the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain in the DRC to a very high risk and the outbreak in the DRC and Uganda being designated a public health emergency of international concern. The policy underscores intensified cross-border Ebola containment as outbreaks continue in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ、エボラ関連の渡航禁止令をグリーンカード保有者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際渡航制限の実施により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。WHOによるPHEIC指定とも相互参照される重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行を言及していますが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。CDCによる公式な渡航禁止令拡大、WHOのPHEIC指定、クロスボーダー感染リスク、複数国での同時流行が確認され、エボラのような高リスク感染症としての要素すべてが合致。フルRRA優先度は最高段階。

article.articleHeadline: Smitteudbrud: Nu reagerer DBU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of infection: DBU responds now.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the epicenter in the eastern region far from Kinshasa. The WHO has warned of a global risk. Denmark’s DBU (Danish Football Association) is monitoring developments as a national team match against DR Congo is arranged in Belgium. The Congolese federation is in contact with the Belgian federation and Denmark’s authorities. None of the Danish players have recently been in DR Congo; a few staff have been closer, but not near Kinshasa. Congo canceled a Kinshasa training camp and moved preparations to Belgium. DBU says there is no immediate cause for alarm and will follow authorities’ guidance if the situation worsens. Upcoming fixtures: DR Congo on June 3, and Ukraine on June 7 in Odense.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の流行: DBUが対応を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がDRCで流行しており、国際的なスポーツイベント（サッカー国際試合）を通じた国際的拡大リスクが存在する。WHOが世界的リスクを警告しており、IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行ですが、デンマーク・ベルギーはイベント開催国・国際的接触の文脈で登場するため、実際の感染症発生地はDRCのみと判定。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。国際スポーツイベント関連の接触を通じた二次的な国際リスク有。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo manifestanti danno fuoco a centro di cura per l'Ebola | Messaggero Veneto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Ebola activity in rural Democratic Republic of the Congo involves the Bundibugyo strain, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported. Protesters at the Rwampara hospital set fire to tents used to isolate patients after families of a young man were barred from taking his body for burial. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced these figures during a press briefing at the 79th World Health Assembly, stating the epidemic risk from Bundibugyo Ebola has risen from high to very high. The incident highlights community tension and ongoing infection-control challenges amid transmission in affected rural areas of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対応センターが抗議者により放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による750件の疑い例、177件の死亡報告があり、WHO事務局長が記者会見で「非常に高いリスク」と宣言。コミュニティの対応困難性と感染制御の課題が続いており、フルRRA進行必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月23日時点でのコンゴのエボラ流行を報告。Bundibugyo株は稀な株であり、WHO事務局長による「非常に高いリスク」の公式宣言がある。病院施設への放火はエボラ対応インフラの脆弱性を示唆。社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い（79次世界保健総会での言及）。

article.articleHeadline: ಎಬೋಲಾ ಭೀತಿ: WHO ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಬೆನ್ನಲ್ಲೇ ಎಚ್ಚೆತ್ತ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರ; ವಿಮಾನ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೀವ್ರ ನಿಗಾ ಇಡುವಂತೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಸೂಚನೆ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threat: Amid WHO warning, the state government on high alert; Health Department directs strict surveillance at airports.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, following WHO's May 17 declaration of Ebola as an international public health emergency (PHEIC), Karnataka has heightened alert and issued precautionary guidelines. India currently reports no Ebola cases. Surveillance under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP) has been intensified for suspected cases. Airports and other points of entry are coordinating to identify travellers from affected countries—the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda—for health monitoring. Rapid-response teams across the state are on high alert; hospitals have reinforced infection prevention and control measures. Health personnel receive specialized training, and stocks of PPE kits, essential medicines, and laboratory capacity are being secured to enable rapid diagnosis and containment. The approach emphasizes vigilant border screening, rapid case management, and readiness for imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの脅威：WHO警告を受けインド・カルナータカ州政府が厳戒態勢へ、空港での厳格な監視を指示
triage.triage_reason: エボラは重大な懸念疾患であり、WHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的イベントではあるが、インドでは現在症例報告がなく、発生国（DRC、ウガンダ）での局限的事象への準備対応である。情報不足のため詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・カルナータカ州のエボラ準備対応に関するもの。DRCとウガンダで発生しているエボラのWHO PHEIC宣言に対応する準備段階。インドでは現在症例なし。WHO宣言済み事象のため社会的・政治的関心は高い。ただし対象国内での実際の発生ではなく準備対応であるため、DISMISS基準には満たず、WATCH段階で続報監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo manifestanti danno fuoco a centro di cura per l'Ebola | Il Mattino di Padova
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in rural Democratic Republic of the Congo; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. Protests erupted at Rwampara hospital, where tents isolating Ebola patients were set on fire after families were blocked from removing a body for burial. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced at a press briefing during the 79th World Health Assembly that the epidemic risk from Bundibugyo Ebola has risen from high to very high. The article notes ongoing transmission and public unrest; no confirmed case counts or transmission chains are provided beyond the suspected figures. The piece situates the outbreak as a significant concern within the DRC's rural areas as of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターに抗議者が火をつける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。また、WHO事務局長による「リスク上昇」宣言と公衆衛生上の社会的関心の高まりから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のBundibugyo地域でのエボラアウトブレイクに焦点を当てており、約750件の疑い患者と177件の疑い死亡を報告。WHO事務局長がリスク評価を「高」から「非常に高い」に引き上げたことが記載されている。Bundibugyo郡はウガンダとの国境に近い地域であり、ウガンダでの二次感染の可能性もあるが、記事サマリー内では明示されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。医療施設での抗議行動と患者隔離の崩壊は、感染対策措置の有効性の低下を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo manifestanti danno fuoco a centro di cura per l'Ebola | Il Piccolo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center | Il Piccolo
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, rural Democratic Republic of the Congo areas report an Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Protests in the vicinity of the Rwampara hospital set fire to tents used to isolate patients after relatives of a young person were barred from taking the body for burial. The situation includes about 750 suspected Bundibugyo Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the figures at a press briefing during the 79th World Health Assembly, warning that the epidemic risk from Bundibugy o ebolavirus has risen from high to very high. The report underscores ongoing transmission and social tensions complicating containment in rural areas of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで抗議者がエボラ出血熱治療センターに火をつける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。750例以上の疑い例・177死亡、WHOが流行リスクを「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げ、社会的対立による制御困難性が存在。
triage.notes: ルワンダ(Kigali Province, Republic of Rwanda)はBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ東部での発生が主題。ルワンダ国内での実際の患者発生は記述されていないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統によるアウトブレイクで、社会的対立(治療センター焼却)が制御困難性を増長している点が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola s-a extins în mai multe provincii din RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has spread to several provinces in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to eastern provinces after the World Health Organization raised the risk to very high. Authorities report active foci in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with conflict-affected areas complicating response. In Goma, the regional capital, no official outbreak declaration has been made, though a laboratory test returned positive. As of 2026-05-23, more than 700 people have been exposed to the virus and over 170 deaths are suspected. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. Ongoing transmission across multiple provinces indicates a multi-provincial escalation, with surveillance and response efforts scaled up under the elevated risk level. The report does not specify infection sources or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の感染は DRC の複数の州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。大規模な死亡者（170名超の疑い例）、複数州への拡大、紛争地域での制御困難性により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での同時発生、WHOによるリスク評価の引き上げ、紛争地域での対応困難、Bundibugyo株による流行など、すべての基準で高リスク評価。即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland intensifies ASF containment measures; pork sale banned in several districts
article.articleSummary: Nagaland tightens African Swine Fever (ASF) containment with bans on pork sale and pig movement across districts. Mon district imposes a temporary pork sale ban and restricts import/export/transport of live pigs. Dimapur identifies infected zones after ASF-positive pigs at Signal Angami village, with movement, slaughter, and transport of pigs/pork restricted in affected areas. In Medziphema subdivision, Chumoukedima district regulates slaughter and sale of pigs/pork, requiring prior permission for commercial activities. Mokokchung district warns residents to avoid pork in Tuli subdivision, where outbreaks are confirmed in Chungtia and Kangtsungyimsen villages and Shitikolak ward of Tuli town. Peren and Niuland districts impose pig import/transport restrictions. Kohima pork shops are closed in multiple areas. ASF is a highly contagious pig disease, not affecting humans, but with severe economic losses; officials urge reporting of sick/dead pigs, strict biosecurity, and avoidance of unauthorized movement and disposal in rivers or open spaces.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド州、ASF(アフリカ豚熱)封じ込め対策を強化；複数地区で豚肉販売禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は家畜に対する異常かつ予想外の発生であり、重症度が高く（複数地区での発生確認）、複数の管轄区域で移動制限や販売禁止などの対策が実施されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性が高い。インドにおける動物疾病の重大な国内事象であり、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Philippines (1694008) を含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はインドのナガランド州におけるASF発生であり、フィリピンは記事本体に言及されていない。したがって verified_locations はインドのみとした。複数の行政区（Mon、Dimapur、Mokokchung、Peren、Niuland、Kohima）で同時発生しており、地理的な拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: สหรัฐระงับวีซ่า 3 ชาติแอฟริกา สกัดอีโบลาระบาดลามเข้าประเทศ - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. suspends visas for three African countries to prevent the Ebola outbreak from spreading into the country.
article.articleSummary: U.S. suspends visas for travelers who have been to South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of Congo, or Uganda within 21 days prior to U.S. entry, including permanent residents, to curb the Ebola outbreak. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form with no approved vaccine or treatment, and began in Ituri province in eastern DR Congo; WHO officially declared the outbreak on May 15. As of May 22, there are 177 deaths among about 750 suspected cases. The United States has allocated $23 million in emergency funding to support up to 50 high-priority treatment centers in affected regions. CDC teams are deploying to Uganda for surveillance, laboratory testing, and contact tracing, with coordination with Kenya’s Health Ministry to prevent cross-border spread. The measures follow debates over foreign aid restructuring, with the U.S. citing a five-year, $1.2 billion health agreement with DR Congo signed in February as ongoing support.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行拡大を防ぐため3つのアフリカ国へのビザを一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo strain）による重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置の実施がみられ、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strainは認可されたワクチンや治療法がない稀な亜種。WHO公式宣言（5月15日）。死亡者177人、約750例の疑い患者。米国が2,300万ドルの緊急資金援助を提供。ウガンダおよびケニアとの国境を越えた感染拡大防止のため、CDCチームが配置されている。サマリーではUganda、South Sudan、Kenyaへの言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: USA fÃ¼hren verschÃ¤rfte Ebola-Screenings ein â€" Dulles bleibt Fokus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US to introduce tightened Ebola screenings — Dulles remains the focus.
article.articleSummary: US tightens Ebola entry screening at Washington Dulles for travelers who visited the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, or Uganda in the past 21 days; foreign nationals face temporary 30-day entry restrictions. US citizens and green-card holders are subject to enhanced screening; risk in the United States is considered low. The CDC frames the measure as part of a layered public-health surveillance approach, not a sole shield, incorporating documentation checks, travel-route review, risk-based questioning, and targeted medical referrals. The move accompanies an ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the DRC, with transmission footprints likely recognized weeks before international alerts; WHO flagged the outbreak on May 15. The report notes transmission links to handling of corpses and burial practices, highlighting risk communication and community engagement. Data privacy and proportionality at border screening are emphasized as well.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、強化されたエボラ検査を導入—ダレス空港が焦点
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）、かつ政府・国際的関心が高い。進行中のDRCエボラアウトブレイクと米国の対応が主題。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（WHO5月15日通知）と米国の水際対応（ダレス空港での強化検査）を主題としている。South Sudan（対象国外）とUgandaへの言及もあるが、実際の発生地はDRCが主体。Virginiaおよび米国は対応国であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans rue link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus type named after a district of cocoa farmers
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports no Ebola in its territory despite Bundibugyo’s association with the current outbreak. The Congo outbreak, now of global concern, has infected hundreds in eastern Congo with about 160 suspected deaths across two provinces. Two cases in Uganda are Congolese nationals who traveled to Uganda before Congo declared an outbreak on May 15: a 59-year-old man admitted in Kampala May 11 and who died May 14, and a woman treated at a separate Kampala hospital. Ugandan President Museveni urged caution, postponed a June 3 religious gathering, and ordered suspension of cross-border transport and flights between Congo and Uganda. The Bundibugyo virus was first identified in a 2007 Ugandan outbreak that killed at least 37; a second outbreak occurred in Congo in 2012. No vaccine or treatment exists specific to Bundibugyo; control hinges on contact tracing, isolation, PPE, and enhanced border surveillance. WHO maintains taxonomy naming, mindful of stigma concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ココア農民地区にちなんで名付けられたエボラウイルス型ブンディブギョとの関連を悔やむ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（疑い死亡160人以上）と国境を接する重要な懸念国ウガンダで症例報告あり。高い社会政治的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（疑い死亡160人以上、東部2州で数百人の感染者）が世界的な懸念事項。ウガンダではコンゴ国籍者の症例2例（1人死亡、5月14日）が確認。ウガンダ大統領は国境管理強化、越境輸送・航空便の停止を命じており、高度な政治的対応が実施されている。Bundibugyo型エボラは特異的なワクチン・治療法がないため、接触追跡と隔離に依存する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola diễn biến khó lường, Sở Y tế Hà Nội yêu cầu kiểm soát chặt chẽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak unfolds unpredictably; Hanoi Department of Health calls for strict control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo (BDBV) strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompts Hanoi public health actions. From 24 April to 19 May, over 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths have been reported; WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 16 May. There is no specific treatment or vaccine for this Ebola strain; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids, with spillover from fruit bats in animals. In Hanoi, the Department of Health orders enhanced border screening at Noi Bai International Airport for arrivals and transit passengers from DRC and Uganda, with rapid detection, isolation, and contact tracing. Hospitals must prep isolation areas, stock supplies, and reinforce infection control; local authorities should boost surveillance, conduct epidemiologic investigations, collect samples, and transport suspected cases to treatment facilities, following a four-on-site approach and public communication to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が予測困難に展開、ハノイ保健局が厳格な管理を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの進行中の大規模エボラ流行事例。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株(BDBV)によるエボラ流行はDRC及びウガンダで発生、既にWHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月16日）。ベトナムは流行国からの旅客に対する検査体制強化対応を実施中。Hanoi発生地域フィールドに記載されているが、サマリーはハノイでの検査体制強化対応に関する記事であり、実際の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ。

article.articleHeadline: Fire destroys makeshift Ebola hospital in Congo after family dispute
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, a makeshift Ebola hospital was set ablaze by relatives who believed the virus is a lie after being refused the body of a victim. The fire destroyed two treatment tents with six patients inside; at least one hospital worker was injured, prompting military protection. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo Ebola; there is no vaccine or approved treatment. As of May 23, 2026, authorities report at least 130 deaths and about 600 suspected cases, with the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimating as many as 671 people could be sickened. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Uganda has reported two cases and one death in Kampala; border controls between Uganda and the DRC have been suspended. The first known case was a healthcare worker whose symptoms began April 24 in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: 家族争いの後、コンゴでエボラ病院が火災で破壊される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な拡大（DRC-ウガンダ跨境）、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、死亡者130名以上・患者数600名超との深刻な流行状況により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus, ワクチン・承認済み治療法なし。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。記事では医療施設の破壊とウイルス陰謀説による社会的不安が報告されている。国家間での境界管制停止は国際的な流行拡大リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo and the Ebola virus: Uganda's district name tied to past outbreak amid Congo crisis
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, about 160 suspected Ebola deaths have occurred in two eastern Congo provinces amid an ongoing outbreak. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo virus, named after Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, though Uganda reports no active Ebola cases. Uganda has two imported cases: Congolese nationals who crossed into Uganda before Congo declared the outbreak on May 15. A 59-year-old man was admitted to a Kampala hospital on May 11 and died three days later; a second woman is hospitalized in Kampala. Authorities stress that Bundibugyo is not Uganda’s epicenter. Public-health measures include suspending all Congo–Uganda transit and flights, postponing a major religious gathering, and enhancing entry-point surveillance. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids; fruit bats are natural hosts. All available vaccines and treatments do not work for Bundibugyo, making contact tracing and isolation essential.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョとエボラウイルス：ウガンダの地区名がコンゴ危機の中で過去の発生と結びつく
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：160人の死亡、異常・予想外：新しいウイルス種、国際拡大リスク：ウガンダへの流入確認）。WPRO基準4つ該当（重症度あり、接触感染リスク、ワクチン無効、管理課題あり）。対象国DRC・ウガンダでの確認事例あり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による発生。DRCで160人の疑い死亡、ウガンダで2人の輸入症例（1人死亡）を確認。現在利用可能なワクチン・治療薬が無効であることが重大な懸念。国境閉鎖、フライト停止など厳しい対策が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: People in the United States with Ebola pose little risk to the public, experts say - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has grown to about 750 suspected cases and over 170 deaths, per the WHO. U.S. experts say the risk to the public in the United States is very low because Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and is not airborne; transmission requires close, symptomatic contact, with contagion increasing in advanced disease. Incubation is two to 21 days. Background from 2014 West Africa shows how an imported case (Thomas Eric Duncan) traveled from Liberia to Dallas; his family remained unharmed, but two hospital nurses treating him in Dallas were infected, illustrating healthcare-worker risk and PPE importance. Dead bodies can remain contagious during burial practices. The Trump administration issued travel restrictions for people who have traveled to the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国内のエボラ患者は公衆衛生にほぼリスクなし、専門家らが見解
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。DRCの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（750件の疑い患者、170件以上の死亡）を主題とし、国際的な公衆衛生上の危機を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事は米国内での風評リスク低下を論じているが、主題はDRCの進行中アウトブレイク。Bluedot APIが米国、スーダン、アンゴラ、リベリア、ウガンダを列挙しているが、サマリーから実際の現在の主要発生地はDRCであると検証。スーダン（South Sudan混合の可能性）は歴史的背景としてのみ言及。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Reporta OMS aumento de muertes por brote de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports an increase in deaths from Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: as of 23 May 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) reports 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. WHO has raised risk to very high, with regional risk high and global risk low. The outbreak, likely circulating undetected, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. WHO prioritizes existing therapies to test against this strain, including monoclonal antibodies Regeneron 3479 and MBP134, and considers obeldesivir as post-exposure prophylaxis. Ervebo vaccine protects Zaire but shows limited cross-protection for Bundibugyo; no strain-specific vaccine exists yet, with development 6–9 months. Ituri is the epicenter, with more than 1,400 contacts being traced. Uganda reports two cases from travelers and one death; a US worker infected in DRC was evacuated to Germany, and a high-risk US contact moved to Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ出血熱流行による死亡増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤で異常/予想外、国際的拡大と渡航制限の両方のリスクがある。複数国での確認事例と高い死亡率、WHOが地域リスク「高」に評価。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統エボラは既知のワクチンがなく治療法も限定的。1,400以上の接触者追跡、複数国への流出（ウガンダ2例+1死亡、米国労働者がドイツに避難）が報告されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが検証可能。ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコは対象国外。WHOが地域リスク「高」、世界リスク「低」と評価している時点での報告。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS relève à 'très élevé' le risque Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk of Ebola in the DRC to 'very high'.
article.articleSummary: WHO raised the Ebola public health risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high. In DRC, 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths have been reported; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are under investigation, indicating a larger outbreak. The global risk remains low. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which no proven vaccine exists. It has spread to Uganda, with 2 cases and 1 death confirmed. An American who worked in DRC was diagnosed and transported to Berlin's Charité hospital, where he is weakened but not in critical condition, in high-security isolation. Reports also include an American contact transferred to the Czech Republic, and in the Netherlands, a patient under Ebola suspicion is isolated awaiting test results. Ebola is a severe, often fatal illness; symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting; CDC cites up to 90% fatality.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国への伝播、死亡例、及びWHOによるリスク評価引き上げにより、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョウウイルス）は稀なエボラ株。複数国での事例報告（ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ共和国、オランダ）があるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での発生。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOがリスクを高から非常に高に引き上げたことは重要なシグナル。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises DR Congo Ebola outbreak risk to 'very high'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo: 82 confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths, with higher suspected figures. WHO raises national risk from high to very high, regional risk high, global risk low as infections rise. This rare Bundibugyo species has no approved vaccine and kills about a third of those infected. Violence and insecurity hamper containment efforts. Oxford University is developing a potential vaccine based on the AstraZeneca Covid jab technology; animal testing is underway and clinical trials could begin within months. Building public trust is vital as fear spreads. An incident illustrates impact: angry relatives attacked a hospital after staff refused to release a body due to contamination concerns, with tents used for isolation set on fire.

triage.headline_ja: WHO raises DR Congo Ebola outbreak risk to 'very high'
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準で4つ以上該当。稀なBundibugyo種による高い致死率と急速な感染拡大がシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola種は認可ワクチンなく致死率約33%。暴力・不安定情勢が対策を阻害。記事にはウガンダとUKの地名が含まれるが、イベントの主題はDRC東部Bundibugyo地域での発生であり、これら2国では実際の発生は記載されていないため除外。Oxford Universityのワクチン開発が進行中だが、臨床試験はまだ開始前。

article.articleHeadline: Врач перечислил симптомы смертельной лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor listed the symptoms of the deadly Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Ugandan doctor Elijah Kiiza, with direct experience treating Bundibugyo ebolavirus infections causing Ebola fever, lists key manifestations: dizziness, intense headache, joint pains, high fever, diarrhea, nausea episodes, reddening of the eyes, and bleeding. He notes the tempo of symptom onset varies with health status: elderly and those with weakened immune systems and diabetics experience faster progression; in children, the incubation period can be about one and a half weeks. Kiiza warns that the clinical picture of Ebola can be easily mistaken for malaria, hindering timely diagnosis. The discussion references earlier Ebola deaths in Congo, where more than 150 people have died. The report underscores the need for careful recognition of the symptom cluster to prompt appropriate clinical management and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がエボラ出血熱の症状を列挙
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの医師がエボラ症状について医学的解説を行う記事。DRCでの過去の死亡例（150人以上）に言及されているが、記事の主題は現在の新規イベントの報告というより症状認識の啓発であり、信号強度は中程度。情報不足の部分が多く、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は主としてウガンダの医師による医学的解説であり、DRCの過去事例（150人以上死亡）に言及。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUgandaが含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ列挙。現在進行中の新規アウトブレイク情報としては不充分で、続報により状況が明確化されるまで経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo manifestanti danno fuoco a centro di cura per l'Ebola | La Nuova Venezia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026 in rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, protesters set fire to tents used to isolate patients at Rwampara hospital after relatives of a young person were blocked from removing the body for burial. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported. World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced these figures at a press conference during the 79th World Health Assembly, noting the epidemic risk from Bundibugyo Ebola has risen from high to very high. The report highlights ongoing transmission risks in rural areas and tensions around patient care and burial practices as authorities pursue containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで抗議活動者がエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。WHO事務局長による公式発表で750疑似症例と177疑似死亡が報告されており、リスク評価が「高」から「極めて高」に上昇している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）の流行で、WHOがWHA79で正式に発表した重要な公衆衛生イベント。地域住民による治療施設への放火という社会的緊張が報告されており、感染管理と文化的慣行の衝突が課題。DRCで確認された発生のため、ルワンダはサマリーに明示的に該当イベント発生地として記載されていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO เตือนความเสี่ยงจากโรค "อีโบลา" ใน "คองโก" อยู่ระดับสูงสุด หลังผู้เสียชีวิตพุ่งแตะ 177 รายแล้ว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the risk of Ebola in Congo is at its highest level after the death toll rose to 177.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached its highest level as 177 deaths are reported among more than 750 suspected cases; 82 laboratory-confirmed infections, with 2 confirmed in neighboring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the risk is at its maximum due to ongoing fatalities, calling the situation extremely challenging as health workers scale up response and contact tracing. Mohamed Yakub Janabi, WHO Africa region director, cautions against underestimating the outbreak, noting Bundibugyo ebolavirus for which there is no vaccine, and that a single case could spread beyond DRC and Uganda. Authorities are increasing testing, infection prevention, and community engagement. Public trust issues are evident after relatives burned tents of deceased Ebola patients; experts are still assessing the outbreak’s timeline and scope, with rapid human movement complicating assessment.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ熱リスクが最高レベルにあると警告 死亡者数が177人に上った後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認されている国際的拡散（ウガンダ）、高い死亡率（177人の死亡）、ワクチン無効なBundibugyo ebolavirus、WHO最高警告レベル。フルRRA推進対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただしサマリーにおいて「2 confirmed in neighboring Uganda」と国際的拡散が既に発生していることが明記されており、IHR international_spread基準の重要な根拠。ワクチン無効なBundibugyo ebolavirus株、公開での体液処理（テント焼却）による感染リスク、地域内での急速な人的移動が相まり、管理困難性が高い。WHO事務局長による「最大リスク」明言は外部支援必要性を強く示唆。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola que crecía en África mientras mirábamos hacia un barco en el Atlántico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak that was growing in Africa as we looked toward a ship in the Atlantic.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, the Ebola outbreak has grown, with more than 170 suspected deaths and about 750 cases, and authorities fear the true scale is much larger. The epicenter sits in a mining region (gold and coltan) where bats, the virus reservoir, live, and where conflict, displacement, and a fragile health system delay care, allowing transmission to persist. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, previously linked to only two prior crises (Uganda 2007, DRC 2012). There is no effective treatment or vaccine yet. The World Health Organization is evaluating options; a vaccine shows promise but no doses exist yet, and production would take 6–9 months. An experimental antiviral is being considered for exposed individuals. There is concern about spread beyond DRC; cases have appeared in Uganda, and Rwanda restricts entry for people who have been in Congo in the last 30 days.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで成長していたエボラ出血熱の流行—大西洋の船に目を向けている間に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。コンゴ民主共和国での170以上の死亡を含む750件のエボラ確定症例と、ウガンダ・ルワンダへの越境事例が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行。採鉱地域での発生、ヒト-ヒト感染の持続、治療法・ワクチン不在、ウガンダ・ルワンダでの越境事例確認により国際的懸念が極めて高い。ルワンダによる入国制限措置が既に実施されている。WHOによるワクチン及び実験的抗ウイルス薬の評価が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: ESPN: сборную Конго могут не допустить до ЧМ по футболу из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ESPN: Congo national team could be barred from the FIFA World Cup due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province has killed over 80 people. As of May 23, 2026, ESPN reports the Congo national football team could be barred from the 2026 FIFA World Cup if players do not complete a 21-day isolation in Belgium before entering the United States. The U.S. has informed FIFA, the team, and the Congolese government of the requirement, with the squad training in Belgium and planning friendlies there. The 2026 World Cup will be staged in Canada, the United States, and Mexico from June 11 to July 19. The Ebola outbreak is driving travel and participation concerns for Congo ahead of the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: ESPN：エボラ流行のためコンゴ代表がFIFAワールドカップから出場禁止となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。80人以上の死亡を伴うエボラ流行であり、国際的なスポーツイベント参加制限により渡航制限リスクも顕現化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行を主題としており、アメリカ、メキシコ、ベルギー、カナダはワールドカップの開催地・準備地として言及されているが、実際の感染発生地ではない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみに限定。2026年ワールドカップという国際的イベントへの影響が社会的・政治的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: أستاذ علم جراثيم: تأخر اكتشاف سلالة "بونديبوجيو" وراء ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو  - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor of Microbiology: Delayed discovery of the Bundibugyo strain behind the rise in Ebola infections in Congo - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: Dr. Mahmoud Halablab, professor of microbiology, says the WHO's Ebola emergency declaration expands intervention options as cases rise in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO has raised Congo's risk to very high, while global risk remains low. The first death occurred April 20 in Ituri, but the alert came about 25 days later due to diagnostic delays, with samples sent to Kinshasa, about 1,600 kilometers away, to identify the rare Bundibugyo strain. Halablab notes this is the third emergence of Bundibugyo, and that delayed detection facilitated transmission. The outbreak has sharply increased in cases and is expected to persist for months unless containment and early detection improve. He calls for strengthened surveillance and rapid diagnostics in affected Congo regions to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 微生物学教授：「ブンディブギョ株」の検出遅延がコンゴのエボラ感染増加の原因 - アルワタン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の多剤耐性株との関連報告、DRCにおける確認死亡例、地域のリスク評価が「very high」に引き上げられており、PICKUP対象となる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの稀なブンディブギョ株の出現であり、2026年4月20日に初死亡が報告されている。診断遅延（25日間）により伝播が促進された可能性があり、検査体制の強化が求められている状況。WHOが地域リスクを『very high』に設定していることから、国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Lángba borították az ebolaközpontot Kongóban: pánik és káosz tört ki a járvány sújtotta térségben
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment center in Congo set on fire: panic and chaos erupted in the outbreak-affected region.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri and North Kivu with new cases in South Kivu, spurred deadly riots after protesters torched an Ebola treatment center in Rwamparai, Ituri, when authorities blocked transporting a suspected patient’s body for a traditional funeral. Six patients who had vanished during the disturbance were later found and are being treated at a nearby hospital. Officially announced in mid-May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, with over 670 suspected cases and at least 160 deaths reported. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo virus strain currently circulating has no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. Ongoing challenges include security instability and local distrust hindering outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療センターが放火される：流行地域でパニックと混乱が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な死亡例、および治安不安定性による管理上の課題が確認される。
triage.notes: 2026年5月中旬に公式発表されたDRC第17次エボラ流行。Bundibugyo株は予防ワクチン・標的治療なし。治安不安定性と地域住民の不信がアウトブレイク対応を阻害。WHOが国際的公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言。670例以上の疑い例と160例以上の死亡が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升級！剛果民主共和國列「非常高」風險 台暫維持第2級警示 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak escalates! Democratic Republic of the Congo is listed as 'Very High' risk; Taiwan temporarily maintains Level 2 alert - Freedom Health Net.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak escalates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) as WHO raises risk from High to Very High; Taiwan maintains Level 2 travel advisory. Local cases have surged from about 246 to nearly 750 with suspected/confirmed deaths rising to 177, indicating rapid spread, though global risk remains Low. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is currently no approved vaccine or virus‑specific treatment. Transmission remains via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects; airborne spread is not evident. Cross-border transmission and limited healthcare resources complicate control. The DRC and Uganda outbreaks have been designated as Public Health Emergencies of International Concern. Taiwan will continue monitoring with no immediate plans to upgrade travel advice. Travelers should avoid contact with patients’ blood/fluids and wildlife, practice hand hygiene, and seek prompt medical care if fever or bleeding after travel, reporting travel history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が悪化！コンゴ民主共和国が「非常に高い」リスクに指定、台湾は暫定的にレベル2警告を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) として認定し、複数国での患者発生と死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダも言及されているが、発生地域には含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Taiwan はイベント発生地ではなく、対応国（渡航警告）であるため除外。患者数が約246から750近くに急増し、死亡者は177名に達している。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行であり、ワクチンと特異的治療法がない。国境を越えた伝播と限定的な医療資源が制御を複雑にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Pakistan issues Ebola alert with tightening screening at airports, borders
article.articleSummary: Pakistan issues Ebola alert as the WHO declares Ebola a global public health emergency, prompting tightened screening at airports and borders. The Ministry of Health instructed the National Institute of Health (NIH) to ensure preparedness and maintain laboratory testing kits for early detection. Border health authorities are on high alert with enhanced passenger screening for arrivals from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Officials warn early Ebola symptoms can mimic dengue fever, urging heightened vigilance among medical staff. The health ministry reassures the public that the situation is under control with no immediate cause for concern; NIH is continuously monitoring the situation and airport surveillance has been intensified per international regulations. Travelers to African countries are advised to seek medical advice, and all provinces and border services should remain ready for emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: パキスタンがエボラ出血熱警報を発令、空港と国境での検査をより厳しく
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）が該当し、WHO による世界的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言の文脈においてシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはパキスタンとウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーを読むとエボラの実際の発生地はDRC（民主コンゴ）とウガンダであり、パキスタンはあくまで国境検査強化の対応国である。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（ID:226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOが世界的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している文脈から、国際的な関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC, dette du Sénégal, Mali sous tension... Les 5 infos qu'il ne fallait pas rater
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC, Senegal's debt, Mali under pressure... The five stories you shouldn't miss.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: a new strain in eastern Congo causes 513 suspected cases and over 130 deaths; WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as the virus crosses into Uganda; no vaccine or treatment exists; a $30 million response is needed; the U.S. pledges $13 million in emergency aid. Senegal: IMF talks continue after 18 months; BOAD financing remains; Zeine Ould Zeidane’s IMF appointment could ease negotiations amid Gulf uncertainties. Mali: on April 25, JNIM and FLA attacks kill Sadio Camara and wound Modibo Koné; Assimi Goïta consolidates power, reclaims the Defense Ministry, and pursues a counter-offensive toward Kidal with closer Russia ties. France–Algeria: Macron’s “new method” resumes high-level talks; ambassador Romatet returns; discussions cover politics, security and judiciary; Algeria seeks restitution, extraditions, Amir DZ case progress; separation of powers invoked. Guinea: disappearances persist against journalists and opponents; authorities deny involvement, while the opposition accuses a state repression apparatus.

triage.headline_ja: RDCでのエボラ、セネガルの債務、マリの緊張...見逃せない5つのニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスがDRCの東部で513例の患者と130人以上の死亡を引き起こし、WHOが国際的懸念となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。ウイルスがウガンダに拡大し、国際的拡大のリスクが高く、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: エボラの新系統がDRC東部で新規検出され、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認。WHO PHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)宣言済み。サマリーではマリ、セネガル、ギニア、仏領圏での言及もあるが、感染症イベントの主題はDRCのエボラ事例。対象国リスト内ではDRC(203312)のみが実際の感染症発生地として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в Конго выходит из-под контроля: вспышка охватывает новые регионы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo is out of control: the outbreak is spreading to new regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalates, with 83 confirmed cases and 746 suspected as of May 21. Over 1,600 contacts have been identified, but only 342 (about 21%) have been traced. WHO warns that response measures lag behind the outbreak’s pace. The virus has spread to three provinces, notably South Kivu near the Rwanda border, with separate cases confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Ongoing violence, population displacement, and distrust hinder control; in Ituri province, clashes over quarantine occurred, a death led relatives to demand the body, doctors refused due to infection risk, tents were burned, and some patients escaped, including confirmed cases. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Weak diagnostic capacity and test shortages complicate efforts. Neighboring countries tighten measures: Uganda restricts passenger transport from Congo, Rwanda imposes enhanced screening and quarantine for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラが制御不能に：感染拡大が新たな地域に広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（ウガンダで確認）、深刻な公衆衛生影響（83確定例、746疑い例、死亡あり）、ワクチン・治療法なし、対応遅延、多地域への拡大が認められ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダで隣接県での事例確認も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での South Kivu、Ituri 各州での急速拡大、暴力・人口移動・信頼の欠如による対応困難、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）の使用、隣国の制限措置など複数の重大な懸念要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: DRC officials warn chains of Ebola transmission still active as they race to contain outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with transmission chains still active as of 2026-05-23. The surge affects Ituri province, notably Bunia, where about 160 deaths have been reported among roughly 670 suspected cases. Funeral wakes and large gatherings have been temporarily banned to curb spread. New screening measures at checkpoints include temperature checks and mandatory hand washing; arriving passengers displaying Ebola symptoms are not allowed to board. The World Health Organization has declared the situation an international emergency, though response efforts are hampered by insecurity and limited access to affected zones. There is no vaccine for this Ebola strain, complicating containment. Health workers in protective suits continue burials, while some relatives push back against restrictions and measures.

triage.headline_ja: DRC officials warn chains of Ebola transmission still active as they race to contain outbreak（DRC当局者がエボラ感染チェーンがまだ活動中と警告、流行封じ込めに奔走）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて致命的で公衆衛生への影響が深刻、WHOが国際的公衆衛生の緊急事態を宣言、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスク両立。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行は高度に懸念される事象。約670疑い例中160死亡（致死率24%程度）と報告。Ituri州Bunia地域での発生が確認。WHOが国際的公衆衛生の緊急事態宣言済み。ワクチン非利用、セキュリティ制限、限定的アクセスなど封じ込め困難性も指摘。社会文化的要因（葬儀の集会）による続行リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تحظر دخول حاملي "الغرين كارد" بسبب مخاوف تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bans entry of Green Card holders due to fears of an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the United States temporarily barred entry of certain lawful permanent residents (Green Card holders) who traveled to or were present in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days, amid fears of an Ebola outbreak. Previously, US citizens and permanent residents were exempt from 30-day travel restrictions, but the government extended precautions to Green Card holders. The CDC stated the move aims to prevent Ebola transmission while balancing health protection and emergency-response resources, based on health and security risk assessments. Separately, WHO raised the risk of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in DRC to very high and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to increasing cases in DRC and spillover concerns to Uganda, prompting tightening travel and surveillance measures worldwide. The policy leverages US Public Health Service Act Section 42 to bar entry during the threat.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行の懸念からグリーンカード保有者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施があり、WHO PHEICも宣言されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、スーダンが記載されているが、記事サマリーで実際のエボラ発生事象はDRCが主体である。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、米国がグリーンカード保有者への入国禁止を実施した極めて重大なシグナル。対象国ではウガンダも影響を受けているが、サマリー上の主要な発生地域はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo manifestanti danno fuoco a centro di cura per l'Ebola | Corriere delle Alpi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center
article.articleSummary: Protesters in rural Democratic Republic of the Congo set fire to tents used to isolate Ebola patients at Rwampara hospital after relatives of a young person were blocked from burying the body. As of May 23, 2026, the outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus has about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the figures at a press conference during the 79th World Health Assembly, noting the epidemic risk from Bundibugyo Ebola has risen from high to very high. The incident highlights tensions around burial practices and healthcare access amid ongoing transmission in affected rural zones of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターに抗議者が放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with 750 suspected cases, 177 deaths, WHO risk assessment elevated to very high, and international public health emergency implications.
triage.notes: Active Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak with significant case burden (750 suspected cases). WHO has escalated risk assessment to very high. Security incident (arson at treatment center) indicates breakdown in community trust and control measures. Regional transmission risk in rural DRC zones remains high. Requires immediate full RRA and enhanced surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Cebu City rabies vaccine stock falls below herd immunity target
article.articleSummary: Cebu City, Philippines faces a critical rabies-control crisis as anti-rabies vaccine stock falls to 1,400 vials, far below the 11,000–12,000 needed to vaccinate about 70% of the dog population. City veterinary authorities warn that updated estimates tied to population growth could require as many as 20,000 vials to reach herd immunity, with the dog population possibly larger than the 2016 baseline of 166,000 (DVMF/HSI). Each vial vaccinates roughly 10 dogs, so the current supply is insufficient to interrupt transmission. The shortage intensified after only 900 usable vials remained in January 2026 due to late-2025 deliveries, and ongoing budget cuts to medicines and biologics worsen the situation. Cebu City recorded 31 rabies cases last year, underscoring rising risk and the improbability of achieving herd immunity this year.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市の狂犬病ワクチン在庫が集団免疫目標を下回る
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は重篤な感染症で、フィリピンにおいて31件の症例が記録されており、ワクチン供給不足により制御困難な状況。IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の危機）。
triage.notes: セブ市は2026年に31件の狂犬病症例を記録し、ワクチン在庫が1,400バイアルまで低下（必要量11,000～12,000、または20,000バイアル）。予算削減とワクチン配送遅延により、地域での狂犬病制御に重大な危機が生じている。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当し、シグナル特性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Brucellosis, Penyakit Menular dari Hewan yang Bisa Menginfeksi Manusia Jelang Iduladha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Getting to Know Brucellosis, a Zoonotic Disease That Can Infect Humans Ahead of Eid al-Adha.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis, a zoonotic disease caused by Brucella bacteria, is highlighted in Indonesia ahead of Eid al-Adha. It primarily affects livestock—cattle, goats, sheep, and pigs—and threatens consumers of raw or unpasteurized dairy products. In humans, brucellosis usually presents with flu-like symptoms: intermittent high fever, severe muscle and joint pain, fatigue, night sweats, headache, and weight loss. Without treatment, illness can be prolonged and disruptive. Transmission occurs mainly through drinking unpasteurized milk or dairy products, direct contact with infected animals or their birth fluids, and sometimes exposure to contaminated aerosols in animal settings. The article notes economic losses in farming due to reproductive issues in animals and identifies farm workers and veterinarians, as well as raw-dairy consumers, as higher-risk groups. No case counts or laboratory confirmation details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症を知る：イード・アル=アドハー前夜、動物から人間に感染する可能性のある人獣共通感染症
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるブルセラ症の啓発記事。具体的な患者数や流行の確認がなく、主に教育的な内容だが、Eid al-Adhaを控えた時期における人獣共通感染症リスクの警告として、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は確認患者数やアウトブレイク規模を報告していない教育的コンテンツであり、具体的なイベント確認（confirmed outbreak）ではない。ただし、Eid al-Adhaを控えた時期における動物接触と非加熱乳製品摂取の増加により、ブルセラ症リスクが相対的に高まる可能性がある。継続的な情報収集による確認患者報告の有無に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: US temporarily bars entry of Green Card holders from three African nations amid Ebola fears: What we know - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: US CDC expands Ebola-entry restrictions to lawful permanent residents who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days, barring entry to the United States amid the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The temporary measure tightens a prior 30-day rule for non-citizens, as authorities seek to prevent importation of the virus. WHO raised Bundibugyo’s national risk to very high and declared an international concern; the outbreak began with the May 15 declaration, with Uganda reporting its first Ebola-related death on May 14 and the DRC recording over 500 suspected cases and more than 130 deaths, spreading from Ituri’s Mongwalu to Bunia and North Kivu (including Goma). MSF warns of late detection, fragile health systems, and the lack of a vaccine or targeted treatment for Bundibugyo; existing Zaire-strain vaccines and monoclonal antibodies are not applicable. PCR testing remains in short supply, slowing confirmation and response. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the third involving Bundibugyo. As of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱の懸念から3つのアフリカ諸国からのグリーンカード保有者の入国を一時的に禁止：わかっていることは何か - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WHOが国際的懸念を宣言、複数国での死亡者と感染拡大があるため、フルRRAへ進む必要がある。
triage.notes: サマリーでは、エボラ熱の発生地域としてDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsに含める。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。本シグナルは、Bundibugyo株による大規模な多国間での流行であり、WHOが国際的懸念を宣言し、米国が渡航制限を実施している重大な事象である。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : enterrement des victimes du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola virus victims buried
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused about 160 deaths among roughly 670 suspected cases, with urgent burials ongoing in Rwampara. In Bunia, authorities have intensified screening at checkpoints and transport hubs to curb transmission, including temperature checks and mandatory handwashing; officials warn arriving passengers with Ebola symptoms must not board planes. Healthcare workers report mounting pressure as transmission chains remain active and the outbreak intensifies, disrupting daily life. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though response is hampered by insecurity and limited access to affected areas. There is no vaccine for this Ebola strain, complicating containment; authorities have been on high alert since the 15th.»

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラウイルス感染者の埋葬が行われている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の流行は最高リスク疾患であり、WHOによるPHEIC宣言もあり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Kigali Province（ルワンダ）は記事サマリーに明示的に言及されていないため、発生地域リストから除外。記事の主たる焦点はDRCの東部エボラ流行（Bunia等）である。約670疑い例・約160死亡、PHIC宣言済み、伝播チェーン活性、ワクチン欠如、治安悪化による対応困難等、極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo manifestanti danno fuoco a centro di cura per l'Ebola | Tribuna di Treviso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Rural Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with an ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, reporting about 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at the 79th World Health Assembly. In Rwampara hospital, protesters set fire to tents used to isolate patients after families and friends of a young person were prevented from taking the body away for burial. The figures refer to suspected cases and deaths pending laboratory confirmation. The epidemic risk from Bundibugyo ebolavirus was raised from high to very high. The incident highlights community tensions and operational challenges amid outbreak response in one of the regions most affected by Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで抗議者がエボラ治療センターに火をつける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。進行中のBundibugyo ebolavirus流行で750件の疑い患例と177件の疑い死亡が報告されており、リスク分類が「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げられた。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行を主題としており、ルワンダはKigali Provinceを示しているが、サマリー本文ではDRCの農村部での発生に焦点が当たっている。WHO事務局長による79回世界保健総会での発言に基づいた報告。社会不安（治療センターへの放火）が対応活動の課題として記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Χαμηλός ο κίνδυνος για τον ιό Έμπολα στην ΕΕ - Αλλά χρειάζεται ετοιμότητα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Low risk of the Ebola virus in the EU – but preparedness is needed.
article.articleSummary: EU/EEA risk from the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda is very low, per ECDC as of 20 May 2026. In DRC, about 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths; confirmed cases occur in Ituri and North Kivu. Uganda reports two imported cases in travelers from DRC. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus Bundibugyo, with no vaccines or specific therapies approved. Transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. Travelers returning from red zones who develop symptoms within 21 days should self-isolate and seek care; overall European risk remains very low. Exit screening of travelers from affected areas and post-arrival monitoring are prioritized; entry screening is not deemed essential. ECDC will continue surveillance and provide updates.

triage.headline_ja: EU内でのエボラウイルスのリスクは低い - しかし備えが必要である
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な広がり（DRCでの大規模な疑い例・確認例、ウガンダへの輸入例）が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に合致し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでの疑い例約600件・死亡139件、ウガンダへの輸入例2件が確認されている。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、ワクチン・特異的治療法が承認されていない。記事はECDCによるEU/EEAリスク評価（低リスク）を報告しているが、アウトブレイク自体は進行中であり、国際的な拡大リスクが存在する。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Συγγενείς θύματος του ιού Έμπολα έβαλαν φωτιά σε νοσοκομείο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Relatives of an Ebola virus victim set fire to a hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 177 deaths and about 750 suspected cases. Violence hampered containment after relatives of a victim set fire to Ruabara Hospital when access to the body was denied, prompting WHO warnings that unrest undermines response efforts. The first suspected case was a health-care worker whose symptoms began April 24 and who died at a medical facility in Bunia. By May 5, authorities were alerted to an unknown, highly fatal illness. Investigations by a rapid-response team on May 13 confirmed the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain). The outbreak is spreading rapidly, with no further transmission details provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルスの犠牲者の親族が病院に放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された流行で177人の死亡と約750人の疑い患者があり、急速に拡大中。暴力による対応阻害も報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain)による確認された流行。医療施設での暴力が発生しており、対応の課題となっている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: WFP: Krisis pangan perburuk risiko penyebaran Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WFP: Food crisis exacerbates the risk of Ebola transmission in Kongo
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the World Food Programme warns that political instability and a food crisis in the Democratic Republic of Congo are heightening Ebola transmission risk. The WHO has raised outbreak risk to 'very high' and declared the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the DRC and neighboring Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. So far, more than 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths have been reported. WFP, the DRC government, WHO, and partners are expanding emergency response, with hundreds of humanitarian workers and dozens of tonnes of emergency medical supplies deployed. Bunia serves as the main logistics hub, delivering more than 46 tonnes to at least 14 regions for Ebola response. Some 26.5 million people in the DRC face acute food insecurity, including 10 million in severe hunger across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tanganyika.

triage.headline_ja: WFP：食糧危機がコンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の伝播リスクを悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WHOが公開衛生上の国際的に懸念される事象（PHEIC）を宣言。既に750例以上の疑い例と177人の死亡が報告され、重症度が高く、隣国ウガンダへの国際的な拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは明確にDRCでの発生が主題。ウガンダへの国際的な拡大リスクについても言及されているが、サマリー上でウガンダでの確定的な症例発生は記述されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、Bundibugyo株の検出、食糧危機による伝播リスク増加、隣国への拡大可能性など、複数の重大なリスク要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉警報！民主剛果風險「非常高」已177死 疾管署1原因維持2級警示 | 國際 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert! Democratic Republic of the Congo risk 'very high' with 177 deaths; Taiwan CDC maintains Level 2 alert for one reason | International | SETN.com
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization upgrades Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high, with Uganda also affected. Current data show about 750 confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and 177 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of five Ebolavirus species; Bundibugyo’s case fatality rate is estimated at 30–40%, lower than the ~90% seen with Zaire ebolavirus. WHO notes the true infection burden may be larger, given rapid, cross-border spread, strained health resources, difficult contact tracing, and security challenges in the region. No evidence of airborne transmission; international export cases remain limited, keeping global risk at low. The outbreak has prompted a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Taiwan’s CDC raised travel advisories for DRC and Uganda to Level 2; Taiwan reports no confirmed or suspected cases and continues monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報！民主共和国のコンゴのリスク「非常に高い」177人が死亡。台湾疾管署が1つの理由でレベル2警告を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高リスク評価、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当、WHOがPHEIC宣言、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国でエボラ発生が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。Taiwanは記事発信地であり、確認症例なし。WHOがPHEIC宣言、リスク評価を「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げ、死亡者177名、推定750症例。国際的な疫学的および公衆衛生的懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ο ΠΟΥ: ο κίνδυνος Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό είναι πλέον πολύ υψηλός Πηγή: Euronews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is now very high. Source: Euronews.
article.articleSummary: WHO raised the Ebola risk level for the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high. As of Friday, 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths have been reported in the DRC, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, indicating a larger outbreak than confirmed figures. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no proven vaccine. The disease has spread to Uganda, with 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. An American worker infected in the DRC was transported to Charité hospital in Berlin; he is highly debilitated but not in critical condition and remains in high-containment isolation. Another American high-risk contact has been moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center admitted a patient with low suspicion of Ebola, isolated pending test results. Symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting. Global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラリスクは現在非常に高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の確定患者および疑い患者が増加中、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ、オランダ）が確認されており、国際的感染症危機管理上の重要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virusはワクチン未開発。国際的な患者輸送が発生しており、感染症危機管理上の優先度は極めて高い。WPRO対象国外での発生（ドイツ、チェコ、オランダ）も含まれているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする（対象国リストに基づく）。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: OMS eleva risco de Ébola para 'muito elevado'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO raises Ebola risk to 'very high'.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization raised the Ebola public health risk for the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high, while global risk remains low. In the DRC, 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 confirmed deaths have been reported; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are under investigation. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no proven vaccine exists. The virus has spread to Uganda, with 2 cases and 1 death confirmed. A US citizen who worked in the DRC is hospitalized in Berlin’s Charité in a very debilitated but non-critical state, under high-security isolation. Another US contact was reportedly moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center admitted a patient with low Ebola suspicion, placed in isolation awaiting results. Ebola, identified in 1976, can be fatal in up to about 90% of cases.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: WHO raises Ebola risk to 'very high'.
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ一類感染症で、DRCでの確認症例と死亡例、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、複数国での患者搬送・入院、ワクチン未開発など、複合的な公衆衛生上の危機である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ出血熱の主要発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダにも国際的拡大が確認されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ベルリン（ドイツ）、オランダ、チェコでの患者搬送はあるが、これらは対象国ではなく、新規発生地ではなく患者受け入れ地であるため除外。WHO公式声明でリスク評価が「非常に高い」に引き上げられたことが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ο ΠΟΥ ανεβάζει τον κίνδυνο Έμπολα σε "πολύ υψηλό" στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises Ebola risk to "very high" in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the WHO has raised the public-health risk level for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) from high to very high, while noting global risk remains low. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are under investigation. The epidemic has crossed into Uganda, with 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. An American worker infected in DRC has been transported to Charité Berlin for treatment; he is severely debilitated but not in critical condition, under high-security isolation. Reports indicate another American contact has moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center admitted a patient with low Ebola suspicion, isolating pending tests. Ebola, first identified in 1976, can cause fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting; CDC cites high fatality rates in many cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ、複数先進国への患者輸送）、重症度の高さ、IHR基準3つ該当、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはオランダ、ドイツ、チェコが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは患者輸送先・接触者の移動先として言及されているのみで、これらの国での実際の発生報告ではない。ウガンダについても感染例があるとされているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが主要な発生地として確実に該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола у Конго виходить з-під контролю: спалах охоплює нові регіони
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo is out of control: the outbreak is spreading to new regions.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating and spreading to new regions. As of May 21, 2026, DRC reports 83 confirmed Ebola cases and 746 suspected, with over 1,600 contacts identified but only 342 (about 21%) traced. World Health Organization notes response efforts lag behind transmission. The virus has reached three provinces, including South Kivu near the Rwanda border, with some cases confirmed in neighboring Uganda. Violence, mass displacement, and public mistrust hinder containment; in Ituri Province, quarantine-related clashes erupted, and authorities refused to release a body due to infection risk. During unrest, unknown assailants burned Ebola treatment tents and several confirmed patients escaped. No licensed vaccines or specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; weak laboratory capacity and test shortages further complicate control. Neighbors are tightening controls: Uganda temporarily restricts passenger transport from Congo, while Rwanda imposes enhanced screening and quarantine for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が制御不能に：新たな地域へ感染が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolasの大規模発生で複数国への越境感染、国際的な移動・貿易制限実施中。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC以外の越境症例（Uganda、Rwanda）も記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebolaは希少であり（通常はZaire型）、ワクチン・特異的治療がない点が重要。接触追跡率21%で制御困難。複数国の国境制限実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Pakistan tightens airport screening after WHO declares Ebola outbreak global emergency
article.articleSummary: Pakistan tightened airport screening on May 23, 2026, after the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda a global emergency. The WHO PHEIC designation prompted the Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination to bolster border health measures, with Federal Health Minister Mustafa Kamal directing authorities to implement strict precautionary screening protocols at all airports and to pursue other precautionary steps across the country. The response targets prevent potential cross-border transmission amid the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak. The article underscores heightened vigilance at international and domestic points of entry as part of Pakistan's readiness to respond to this global health alert.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の大流行を世界的緊急事態と宣言した後、パキスタンが空港のスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の大流行がWHOにより国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言され、複数国への拡大リスクと国際的な対応が発動されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱大流行がWHOのPHEIC宣言の対象であることを明確に述べている。パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ウガンダ（対象国外）も同様に除外。コンゴ（DRC）のみが対象国リストに該当するため、これをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: International Contact Group urges warring parties in DR Congo to facilitate Ebola response
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the International Contact Group for the Great Lakes urged all parties to the Congo conflict to facilitate the Ebola response amid an outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths. Two Congolese nationals with imported cases were reported in neighboring Uganda. The Congolese government warns the virus may pose a greater risk in areas held by the M23, which the UN and partners say lacks epidemic handling experience. The ICG calls for unimpeded humanitarian access, sustained opening of Goma and Kavumu airports, safe corridors in North and South Kivu, and simplified procedures, stressing regional cooperation and respect for the October ceasefire.

triage.headline_ja: 国際接触グループ、コンゴ民主共和国の交戦当事者にエボラ対応の円滑化を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの輸入症例）、重篤な公衆衛生影響（177死亡例、複数州への拡大）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク（5月15日宣言）はDRC内の複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で発生。ウガンダへの輸入症例2件が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。紛争地域での感染症対応という複合的リスク要因により、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Rebellen erschweren Hilfe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: Rebels hinder aid.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, an Ebola outbreak is unfolding in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with two cases in Goma, the capital of North Kivu, and one additional case confirmed in South Kivu. The first Ebola death in Goma has led to 189 contacts being traced, a figure reported by the M23 faction and not listed in government briefings, highlighting tensions over cooperation between the government and rebel-held authorities that run limited services in parts of the region. Humanitarian groups, including Doctors Without Borders, report severe access challenges to remote areas, exacerbated before the rainy season when roads become mud tracks; they deploy motorcycles to reach communities and detect new transmission clusters. The parties acknowledge health needs but lack formal collaboration, underscoring that outbreaks transcend political divisions and demand coordinated prevention and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ発生：反政府勢力が援助を妨害
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生で死亡例あり、国際的な人道支援関心が高く、政治的緊張が対応能力に影響。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月23日時点のデータ。ゴマでの死亡例、189人の接触者追跡、人道団体の報告により重症度が確認。反政府勢力による政府との非協調が対応能力を低下させており、管理可能性の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛再調升剛果伊波拉風險至「非常高」　台灣維持二級警戒 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Raises Ebola Risk in Congo to 'Very High'; Taiwan Maintains Level 2 Alert
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts WHO to raise regional risk to Very High, while global risk remains Low and regional risk High. The outbreak, linked to DRC and Uganda, has seen suspected or confirmed cases surge from about 246 to nearly 750, with deaths rising to 177, indicating rapid spread. Transmission is mainly through close contact with infected body fluids; no airborne transmission detected, though cross-border spread and weak health resources hinder containment, with some areas affected by security issues. Animal reservoirs include fruit bats, primates, forest antelope, and porcupines. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are fever, fatigue, myalgia, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding; severe cases involve liver and kidney failure, CNS damage, shock, and multi-organ failure.
