Taiwan maintains Level 2 Alert with strengthened border monitoring; advisories for DRC and Uganda moved from Watch to Alert; international export cases remain limited.

triage.headline_ja: WHO コンゴのエボラウイルス病リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ、台湾は警戒レベル2を維持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の地域的リスク上昇、急速な感染拡大（246→750例）、死亡例増加（177例）、国際的懸念の高まりが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ発生が述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。台湾の記載は国家レベルの対応（警戒レベル2維持）であり、実際の発症地ではない。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはTaiwanも含まれているが、サマリーから実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみと判断。全般的に重症度が高く、急速な患者数・死亡数増加、国境越えリスク、弱い保健リソース、セキュリティ問題による対応困難がRRA進出の根拠。

article.articleHeadline: La Une de la presse cette semaine à Kinshasa - À la Une: l'Opposition lance C-64 pour neutraliser un troisième mandat de Tshisekedi, Ebola progresse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This week's front page of the Kinshasa press - On the front page: the Opposition launches C-64 to thwart Tshisekedi's bid for a third term, Ebola progresses.
article.articleSummary: 17th Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved vaccine for this variant. The outbreak is advancing in the east amid persistent insecurity and a fragile health system that hinders case detection and medical response. The Congolese government has convened a multisectoral crisis meeting led by the head of state, with Health, Defense, Interior, Transport, and Finance ministries coordinating containment and aiming to prevent regional spread. No case counts are provided in the report. The situation raises concerns about cross-border transmission and regional escalation, though specific transmission links are not detailed. Separately, US travel restrictions on travelers who recently stayed in DRC could affect Congolese supporters, journalists, and delegations ahead of the 2026 World Cup, complicating the Leopards' international preparation.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサの今週のプレスの一面 - 一面：野党がツィセケディの3期目阻止にC-64を立ち上げ、エボラが進行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の17番目の流行として社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルのリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの東部でのエボラ流行に焦点。Bundibugyo株は実用的なワクチンがなく、保健システムが脆弱。米国の渡航制限も報告されているが、DRCからの渡航者への制限であり、米国内の発症例報告ではない。米国は発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは実際の流行地はDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Américain contaminé en RDC est désormais dans un état stable en Allemagne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The American infected in the DRC is now in a stable condition in Germany.
article.articleSummary: An American citizen infected with Ebola while working in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now in stable condition in Germany, where he is hospitalized. CDC official Satish K. Pillai reported on May 20, 2026 that U.S. partners continue the Ebola response, coordinating with field partners and protecting Americans. The patient arrived in Germany for care, with transport facilitated by German authorities and support from the DRC and Uganda health ministries. U.S. authorities are evaluating restrictions for exposed individuals as the situation evolves, emphasizing risk assessments and travel/surveillance procedures. The State Department evacuated Americans and issued Level 4 travel advisories for the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and enforces Title 42 restrictions for travelers who have been in those countries. The outbreak persists in eastern DRC amid violence by ADF rebels and other militias; funding to support up to 50 treatment centers in DRC and Uganda was announced, with NGO collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：DRCで感染したアメリカ人はドイツで安定状態に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での患者発生と米国による渡航警告・制限措置が実施されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な事象と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSA、Sudan、Germany、Ugandaも含まれているが、記事の主題は『DRCで感染したアメリカ人患者』に焦点が当たっており、実際のエボラ流行発生地はDRCである。Sudanは言及がなく、UgandaはDRC支援国として登場するのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。DRC東部での継続的な流行、武装勢力による暴力の影響、複数国での患者発生と国際的な公衆衛生対応が実施されており、シグナルとして高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: Kongatják a vészharangot: továbbterjedhet a halálos járvány
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm Bells Are Ringing: The Deadly Epidemic Could Spread Further.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts a global response. The DRC reports 82 confirmed cases, 7 confirmed deaths, 177 suspected deaths, and about 750 suspected infections. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and Friday raised the national risk to very high. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or targeted therapy; early symptoms include fever, muscle pains, vomiting and diarrhea, hindering diagnosis. Transmission occurs via body fluids, contaminated objects, and contact with the deceased. Rapid case finding, contact tracing, safe burial practices, and community engagement are crucial. The World Bank’s $250 million health program (approved March 2024) has about $200 million undisbursed. UN released ~$60 million; the US funded ~50 clinics. Uganda reports two Ebola cases; South Sudan and Burundi face heightened risk due to weak health systems. The Bank is coordinating with Gavi to accelerate vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: アラーム鐘が鳴っている：致命的な流行がさらに拡大する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの大規模発生で82確認例、177疑い死亡、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダで2症例確認）、ワクチン・治療薬なし。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはDRC、ウガンダ、ブルンジ、スーダンが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは東部DRC（Bundibugyo）での発生が主題。ウガンダで2症例確認されているが、primary outbreak はDRC。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。PHEIC宣言済み、WHO risk level「very high」、ワクチン・治療薬なし、国際的支援体制構築中。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള അതിവേഗം പടരുന്നു, സ്ഥിതി ആശങ്കപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതെന്ന് WHO; മരണം 177, രോഗികൾ 750
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly; WHO says the situation is alarming; 177 deaths, 750 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of six Ebola species; others are Zaire, Sudan, Tai Forest, Reston, and Bombali. WHO Director-General warns the situation is alarmingly challenging, as several African countries, including the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, intensify surveillance and response. A global public health emergency has been declared. The India-Africa summit scheduled for May was postponed. This Congo outbreak is its 17th; last year Congo reported 34 deaths in August, and the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak infected over 28,600 people. Transmission occurs via blood and body fluids; animals such as monkeys, apes, wild boar and pigs can harbor the virus. Symptoms appear 2-21 days after exposure; management is largely supportive, with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; prevention focuses on isolation, avoiding contact, and safe handling of animal meat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが急速に拡大、WHOが状況は悲劇的と警告；177人の死亡、750人の患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数国での異常な発生拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められる。WHOが公式に世界公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの発生を記述。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはスーダン、アンゴラ、ウガンダも含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ拡大。インドについてはアフリカ・インド首脳会議の延期言及のためAPIに含まれたが、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない可能性が高い。ただし、対象国リストに含まれるため検証済みロケーションに含めた。WHOが公式に世界公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したことが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Coupe du monde 2026 : la compétition menacée par une épidémie ? Face au risque Ebola, les États-Unis imposent une "bulle" de 21 jours à l'équipe congolaise pour participer au tournoi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup 2026: Is the competition threatened by an epidemic? Facing the Ebola risk, the United States imposes a 21-day 'bubble' on the Congolese team to participate in the tournament.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has prompted U.S. health and security measures ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026. The WHO has declared an international health emergency; in the DRC, 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths have been recorded, with about 750 suspected cases nationwide, and the national risk judged as 'very high.' Ebola, a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, is driving the flare‑up in the region. To participate in the World Cup, the Congolese national team must isolate in a 21‑day biosecure bubble starting May 22 and aim to reach Houston by June 11 for Group K matches (Portugal in Houston June 17; Colombia in Guadalajara June 23; Uzbekistan in Atlanta June 27). The United States has tightened border screening for travelers from affected areas; officials note the squad is reportedly in Europe and may not be subject to the travel ban. The CDC is coordinating to ensure a safe tournament.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年FIFAワールドカップ：エボラ流行による脅威か？エボラのリスクに直面し、米国がコンゴチームの参加条件として21日間の『バブル』隔離を課す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済みのエボラ出血熱で、確定症例82名・死亡7名、疑い症例750名。国際スポーツイベント関連による渡航・入国管理措置実施中。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での活発なエボラ出血熱流行を主題としており、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には米国・メキシコ・ポルトガル・コロンビア・ウズベキスタンなど国際的な場所が含まれているが、これらは2026年ワールドカップ開催地または参加国を示しており、実際のウイルス発生地はコンゴ東部のみ。サマリーでは米国での国境スクリーニング強化と隔離措置が述べられているが、米国で新規症例発生の報告はなく、リスク管理措置の予防的実施である。

article.articleHeadline: Hanoi steps up Ebola surveillance at airport, local health facilities
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Hanoi Department of Health issued Official Dispatch No. 4612/SYT-NVY (May 21) to strengthen Ebola surveillance amid a Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. WHO notes 500+ suspected cases and 130 deaths from Apr 24–May 19; a May 16 Public Health Emergency of International Concern under IHR-2005. Hanoi centers will tighten border checks at Noi Bai Airport for passengers from DRC and Uganda, collect flight-contact data for tracing, and train border staff on PPE. Local authorities must boost surveillance, contact tracing, and epidemiological investigations; hospitals to maintain isolation capacity and supplies. Ebola transmission: animal-to-human via fruit bats; human-to-human through blood and bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days. There is no specific treatment or approved vaccine for this strain; public communications will be coordinated to prevent panic.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、空港および地域の医療施設でエボラ監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダでBundibugyo virus（BDBV）のアウトブレイクが進行中（500+疑い症例、130死亡）で、WHOがPHEICを宣言。ベトナム（ハノイ）が対象国からの入国者監視を強化する予防的対応をとっており、国際的拡大リスクと管理体制の整備が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはHanoi（ベトナム）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRC・ウガンダでのBDBVアウトブレイク』であり、ベトナムはあくまで予防的監視強化の実施国。対象国リストに基づき、実際の感染事例が発生している DRC と、対象国である Vietnam を verified_locations に含める。ウガンダはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Претседателот на Светското првенство им нареди на фудбалските репрезентативци на Конго да се изолираат поради епидемијата од ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The President of the World Cup ordered the Congolese national football team players to isolate themselves because of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Andru Giuliani, named by Donald Trump as a leading figure for the World Cup, announced a dramatic decision: the Democratic Republic of Congo’s men's national football team must be placed in isolation ahead of the World Cup due to the risk of Ebola spread. The move sparked fear and anger within the football community. The World Health Organization warned of a 'very high risk' of Ebola in Congo as authorities grapple with transmission ahead of the tournament, with concerns about implications for players, fans, and international travel. The report highlights the tension between sport preparations and global health precautions amid an Ebola threat in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 世界選手権大会会長がエボラ感染症流行に対してコンゴのサッカー代表チームの隔離を命令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行が確認されており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響（死亡率の高さ）、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが複数該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の複数基準に該当し、国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）との関連で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行に伴う国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）への影響という社会政治的重要性が高い。WHO により『非常に高いリスク』と評価されている。ただし記事は2026年5月配信であり、将来の仮想シナリオである可能性も考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീഷണി; വിമാനത്താവളങ്ങളിലും അതിർത്തി കവാടങ്ങളിലും നിരീക്ഷണം ശക്തമാക്കി കുവൈത്ത്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threat; Kuwait strengthens monitoring at airports and border checkpoints.
article.articleSummary: Kuwait tightens health screening at all airports and border checkpoints in response to an Ebola threat. All entry points now feature passenger health checks, temperature screening, and medical examinations. Authorities also advise avoiding unnecessary travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda and urge anyone with symptoms to seek prompt treatment. Kuwait has not reported any Ebola cases. The measures are part of ongoing global surveillance to counter health threats. Ebola outbreaks have been reported in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The DRC health ministry reports 160 deaths, about 670 suspected cases, and 61 confirmed infections; Uganda has two confirmed cases. A health ministry spokesperson emphasized strict monitoring to prevent importation and safeguard public health. Asianetnews is listed as a preferred source.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ脅威により、クウェートが空港と国境検問所での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱はリスク種疾患であり、DRC及びウガンダでの確認事例、国際的な監視・制限措置の開始、複数国への拡大リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: Kuwaiti当局による監視強化は、DRCとウガンダでの活動的なエボラ流行への対応。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーに記載されるKuwaitの措置は対象国外のため含めない。DRCでの160死亡、約670疑い事例、61確定症例は重大な懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: إجراءات استثنائية لزوار كأس العالم 2026 بسبب فيروس خطير " وكالة بغداد اليوم الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extraordinary measures for visitors to the 2026 World Cup due to a dangerous virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) concerns shadow the expanded 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico (June 11–July 19). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, approximately 600 suspected EVD cases and 139 probable deaths have been reported, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and disrupting the DRC team’s preparations, which were moved from Kinshasa to Belgium. The United States has barred entry for non-US passport holders who traveled to the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, forcing Congolese staff to depart early; the team is set to arrive in the US around June 10–11 and base in Houston. Expert Oliver Johnson of King’s College London says the risk to ordinary fans is very low; Ebola is not airborne and spreads via close contact, with strong contact tracing helping prevent spread in high-income countries.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ訪問者への特別措置が危険なウイルスのため実施される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い国際的イベント。DRCにおけるエボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言と複数国への影響による。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国・カナダ・メキシコでのワールドカップ開催について言及しているが、これらはスクリーニング対象外国であり、verified_locationsには含めない。実際のEVD発生地域はDRCのみ。複数国が言及されている理由は、米国入国制限やDRCチームのベルギー移動など、DRC発生イベントへの各国の対応であるため。WHOによるPHEIC宣言は記事で明示されており、深刻性と国際的関心を確認。フルRRAへの進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: إجراءات استثنائية لزوار كأس العالم 2026 بسبب فيروس خطير | هذا اليوم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extraordinary measures for visitors to the 2026 World Cup due to a dangerous virus | This Day
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) risk linked to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico remains low for ordinary visitors, says Oliver Johnson of King’s College London. The expanded tournament runs June 11–July 19, 2026, across three host countries. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, roughly 600 suspected EVD cases and 139 deaths have prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Congo preparations for the World Cup were disrupted, with training moved from Kinshasa to Belgium. The United States has barred entry for non-U.S. passport holders who were in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days, affecting the Congolese team’s arrival plans for June 10–11 in Houston. Transmission of EVD is not airborne; infection occurs via direct contact with a severely ill patient, with effective contact tracing and containment measures highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップ来場者向けの特別措置 危険なウイルスのため | This Day
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がIHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）に該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。対象国DRCで進行中の実イベント。
triage.notes: Bluedot API が Houston/Texas/US/Canada/Mexico/Sudan/Belgium/Uganda を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラ患者発生は DRC (Kinshasa) のみであることが明確。これらは World Cup 2026 開催地または入国制限措置が講じられた国として言及されているが、患者発生地ではない。DRC での約600人の疑い患者と139人の死亡により WHO が PHEIC を宣言しており、対象国リストに含まれる DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: WK 2026: Amerikaanse overheid zet Congolese nationale ploeg onder streng isolatieregime en dreigt met uitsluiting na ebola-uitbraak in eigen land
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: The U.S. government imposes a strict isolation regime on the Congolese national team and threatens to exclude them after an Ebola outbreak in their own country.
article.articleSummary: The United States imposes a 21-day full isolation on the DR Congo national team to participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, to prevent Ebola spread during the tournament. Congo must maintain a bubble until arriving in Houston on June 11; the squad is training in Belgium and has begun isolation to meet U.S. conditions. Any late arrivals would require separate isolation, and any symptoms could jeopardize the entire team’s participation. Congo is in Group K: June 17 vs Portugal in Houston, June 23 vs Colombia in Guadalajara, and June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. An Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo prompted a WHO international health alert; 82 confirmed infections and 7 deaths, with a very high risk of further spread. Ebola is a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, with over 15,000 lives lost in Africa over the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026: エボラ流行により米国政府がコンゴ民主共和国代表チームに厳格な隔離体制を課し、除外を脅迫
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（82確定例、7死亡）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4項目全て該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と長期曝露リスク、流行性、管理可能性の複数項目が合致し、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRC東部での進行中のエボラ流行が主題。WHOが国際的保健警告を発令。2026 FIFAワールドカップという国際的スポーツイベントにおける感染管理措置として、米国政府がDRC代表チームに対して21日間の完全隔離を課している。複数国での国際的関心が高い。Bluedot APIが出力した米国、カナダ、メキシコ、ポルトガル、ウズベキスタン、ベルギー、コロンビアなどは、本イベントの主題である感染症流行の発生地ではなく、影響を受ける対象地点であるため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch 2026: Warum die neue Variante ohne Impfstoff so gefährlich ist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak 2026: Why the new variant without a vaccine is so dangerous.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri region escalates in 2026 with hundreds infected and over 130 deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. First infection detected on April 24; outbreak declared May 15; WHO declared an international health emergency. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects; bats and apes are natural reservoirs. The Bundibugyo variant has about 37% mortality; without treatment higher. Symptoms begin as flu-like—fever, headaches, myalgia—with progression to vomiting, diarrhea (often bloody), internal bleeding, kidney and liver failure. Treatments focus on supportive care; Regn-Eb3 and mAb114 antibodies are not effective against Bundibugyo. Challenges include isolation difficulties in Ituri, distrust of authorities, and attacks on health workers; EU risk deemed very low, but travel restrictions and quarantines implemented. A U.S. physician infected in Congo is treated in Berlin's Charité.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 2026年：ワクチンのない新変異株がなぜそんなに危険なのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の新変異株（Bundibugyo）による大規模アウトブレイク。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みでありシグナル確度が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「ドイツ・ベルリン」を発生地域として抽出しているが、これは感染症イベントの「事象発生地」ではなく、感染した米国医師の「治療地」。実際のアウトブレイク発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ地域。記事サマリーから明確に DRC Ituri region が主要発生地。対象国リストの DRC（203312）のみを verified_locations に含める。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、140名以上の死亡、治療法が限定的であるため確度の高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: UPDATED: WHO raises Ebola risk to highest level in DR Congo as death toll climbs, hospital riot erupts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, prompts WHO to raise risk level from high to very high as of 23 May 2026. Nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported nationwide; 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths. Uganda reports two imported cases, including one death. Insecurity and violence in eastern Congo hinder emergency response, with contact tracing and containment efforts slowed. In Ituri Province, residents stormed and burned Ebola isolation tents at Rwampara hospital over burial procedures, reflecting persistent distrust of health protocols. The WHO collaborates with partners to test treatments and develop vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain, while additional foreign medical experts are deployed to support overwhelmed local teams. Regional risk remains high; global threat is considered low.

triage.headline_ja: 更新：DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱リスクをWHOが最高レベルに引き上げ、死亡者数増加、病院での暴動発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染確認、高い重症度、国際拡大リスク、WHO最高警戒レベル指定により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。WHO最高リスクレベル指定、ウガンダへの越境確認例、医療施設の機能障害、住民の保健プロトコル不信による暴動など複合的な懸念要因が存在。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれていますが、記事の主要焦点はDRコンゴであり、ウガンダは輸入症例（2例）の報告国のため、verified_locationsはDRコンゴのみとしています。

article.articleHeadline: Congo province bans funeral wakes to contain Ebola's spread
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ituri province banned funeral wakes amid Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with burials restricted to specialized teams and transport of corpses by non-medical vehicles forbidden. Clashes in Rwampara underscored resistance to outbreak controls. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo strain a public health emergency of international concern, citing late detection, no vaccine or virus-specific therapeutics, armed violence, and high mobility as complicating factors. Nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been recorded in eastern DRC; two cases have been confirmed in Uganda. WHO raised its outbreak risk to very high globally, with high regional risk. In eastern DRC, armed groups operate, including M23, which has influenced governance; an M23-appointed North Kivu governor suspended public transport between Goma and Butembo. Ituri limited public gatherings to 50 people and suspended football. Ebola symptoms include fever, body aches, vomiting and diarrhoea.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部州、エボラ拡散を抑制するため葬式での夜間の集いを禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラの新規アウトブレイク、WHO緊急事態宣言済み、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例あり）、高い死亡率と国際的懸念。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラ株の新規アウトブレイク。WHO緊急事態宣言済み（国際的懸念事項）。ウガンダでも2例確認されているため国際的拡大の実績あり。武装勢力による統治混乱がアウトブレイク対応を複雑化。ワクチン・治療薬なし。記事はDRC主体だが、ウガンダでの確認例により国境地域での感染リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la República Democrática del Congo: riesgo muy alto por rápida propagación - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Very High Risk Due to Rapid Spread - Notiulti.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is being described as very high risk due to rapid spread across zones already destabilized by conflict. The World Health Organization has convened its Emergency Committee under the International Health Regulations to coordinate response; authorities report widespread transmission challenging containment as health facilities become overwhelmed. The outbreak involves a Bundibugyo variant, with cases crossing multiple affected areas, complicating access and logistics. International mobilization is underway, but experts warn that a safe and effective vaccine remains months away, underscoring reliance on traditional control measures. The WHO recommends temporary guidance focusing on enhanced epidemiological surveillance, rapid isolation of confirmed cases, and stringent infection prevention and control protocols to halt transmission chains and prevent spread to new regions. International observers maintain close surveillance given high contagion and regional instability affecting public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：急速な拡大による極めて高いリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。Bundibugyo variant Ebolaの急速拡大による高リスク評価とWHO緊急委員会の招集により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant Ebolaの急速な地域間拡大、複数ゾーンでのヒト-ヒト感染、保健施設の過負荷、紛争地域における感染制御の課題が報告されている。WHO緊急委員会の招集により対応が協調化されている一方、ワクチン利用まで数ヶ月を要する状況にあり、従来の制御措置への依存が強調されている。国境を越える拡大リスクおよび地域的不安定性が国際的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS eleva risco de ebola na RDC a 'muito alto', nível máximo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises Ebola risk in the DRC to 'very high', the maximum level.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the WHO raised the Ebola virus disease risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo to very high at national level, high regionally, and low globally. The outbreak spans North and South Kivu near the front with the M23 group; Ituri reports a strained response with funerals banned and gatherings limited to 50. Confirmed cases total 82 with 7 deaths; there are about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. Uganda has two cases and one death. An American with Ebola in the DRC is hospitalized in Germany; another high‑risk contact was moved to the Czech Republic. In North Kivu, some passenger transport is suspended. Vaccines remain effective only against the Zaire strain; there is no licensed treatment for Bundibugyo, which can cause a fatal hemorrhagic fever. WHO’s R&D Blueprint urges two monoclonal antibodies, Regeneron 3479 and Mapp MBP134, for trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱リスクを『非常に高い』（最大レベル）に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外/異常な高リスク評価、国際的拡大リスク、国境を越えた移動と貿易制限のリスク）。さらにWPRO基準5つすべてに該当し、WHOが国家レベルでリスク引き上げを実施した高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの事例言及があるが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCで発生した主要なエボラウイルス病の流行であり、ドイツとチェコへの渡航関連事例は確認されているが、それらの国での実質的な流行発生は記載されていない。DRCはIHR通知対象として該当すべき重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة توسع قيود السفر إليها بسبب فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States expands its travel restrictions due to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the United States expanded Ebola-related travel restrictions to include lawful permanent residents (green card holders) arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The measure, described as temporary, bars entry for anyone who has been in those countries in the previous 21 days and aims to balance public health protection with emergency-response resources, under Section 42 of the Public Health Service Act. This marks a precedent for green-card holders who were not restricted during COVID-19 or earlier Ebola actions. Separately, the State Department limited entry of 21 individuals from these countries to enter the United States only via Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced health screenings. The WHO raised the risk from the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain to very high, noting outbreaks in DRC and Uganda and declaring a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルスを理由に渡航制限を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。Bundibugyo Ebola株による国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が顕著であり、渡航制限を伴う国際的影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。WHOが稀有なBundibugyo Ebola株に対する国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念（PHEIC宣言）を表明している点が重要。米国による渡航制限拡大（グリーンカード保有者を含める前例のない措置）は国際的な政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ, Kongo'da Ebola riskini 'çok yüksek' seviyeye çıkardı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raised the Ebola risk in Congo to a 'very high' level.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, WHO raised the Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from high to very high. The country reports 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, indicating a larger outbreak. The illness is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola virus for which no licensed vaccine exists. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, where two cases and one death have been confirmed. An American working in DRC has tested positive and was transported to Berlin’s Charité Hospital for treatment, described as severely weakened but not in immediate danger, and kept in a high-security isolation unit. Another American with high-risk exposure has been moved to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center quarantined a patient with low-level Ebola suspicion awaiting test results. Global risk remains low, while local risk is very high; common symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ熱リスクを「非常に高い」レベルに引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なエボラウイルス種）による大規模流行で、DRC・ウガンダで複数死亡者、複数国への波及確認。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行が主題。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とウガンダ（226074）が該当。ドイツ・チェコ・オランダは治療受入国であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO公式リスク引き上げ、複数国波及、ワクチン未承認株という極めて重大な要素あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises Ebola outbreak risk level to 'very high' in eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths have been recorded in eastern DR Congo amid the BundiBujyo strain outbreak, with two confirmed infections detected in neighboring Uganda. In response, authorities in eastern DRC imposed strict measures: funeral ceremonies banned, football matches suspended, gatherings capped at 50 people; in Ituri Province, only trained medical teams may handle burials, and transport of bodies by non-medical vehicles is prohibited. Clashes in Rwampara city reflect community tensions amid the response. The World Health Organization has declared BundiBujyo a global public health emergency and raised the Ebola risk level in DR Congo from high to very high, while global risk remains lower. Security challenges continue to hamper surveillance, testing, and response efforts. The situation remains dynamic as surveillance and laboratory confirmation evolve.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、東部コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症の危険レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、高い社会的・政治的関心を示している。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはRwanda、Uganda、DRCが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東部DRCの感染症イベント。ウガンダでは2件の確定症例が報告されているが、記事の焦点はDRC内の流行。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。BundiBujyo株の新規エボラ流行、WHOによる緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大リスク、セキュリティ上の課題による対応困難など、複合的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: US suspends visas from three African countries over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 — The United States suspends visa issuance for people who have traveled to South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), or Uganda within 21 days of entering the United States, and bars recent visitors who are lawful permanent residents from returning. The measure is part of a bid to contain a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak described as potentially the worst in a decade. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. No specific case counts are provided in the report. International health officials have urged heightened vigilance as transmission monitoring continues; the policy targets travel-related import risk and does not detail laboratory confirmation or infection sources beyond the implicated countries.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱懸念からアフリカ3カ国へのビザ発行を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（Bundibugyo Ebola、10年来最悪の可能性）、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク（米国がビザ停止措置を講じるほどの懸念）が複数該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行可能性が該当し、国際的な政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: South Sudan（対象国リストに含まれていないため除外）はサマリー内で言及されているが、検証対象国に属さないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCとUgandaはいずれも対象国に含まれる。記事は米国のビザ停止措置という明確な国際的影響を示す公式政策対応を報じており、エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大と治療法・ワクチン欠如という重篤性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒病例暴增！風險等級提至「非常高」 旅遊警示維持2級 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus cases surge! Risk level raised to 'Very High'. Travel advisory remains at Level 2 | United News Network
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), raising the Congo outbreak risk to Very High, with regional risk High and global risk Low. Taiwan maintains a Level 2 travel advisory. Taiwan’s CDC told physicians to assess travel, occupation, contact history (TOCC) and reinforce infection control, though overall threat to Taiwan remains low. WHO reports Congo’s suspected/confirmed cases surged from about 246 to nearly 750, with deaths increasing to 177, signaling accelerated spread. Cross-border transmission signs, constrained healthcare resources, tracing difficulties, and security conflicts complicate containment. While local transmission is predominantly via close contact with infected body fluids and no airborne transmission is evident, international exportations are limited, sustaining low global risk despite the severe local threat.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病例が急増！リスクレベルが「非常に高い」に引き上げられ、旅行警告は2級を維持 | 聯合新聞網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な症例急増、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Taiwan は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーから DRC で症例246～750に急増、死者177、ウガンダでの越境感染の兆候が確認される。WHO が PHEIC 宣言済みであり、IHR基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準をすべて満たす高リスク事象。台湾での流行可能性は低いとの記載があるも、グローバルな懸念は存在。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo risk World Cup expulsion following Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo risks expulsion from the World Cup due to an ongoing Ebola outbreak. To travel to Houston for the June 11 arrival and June 17 opener against Portugal, the squad must isolate for 21 days before arrival, with their bubbles starting in Belgium, where the training camp is located, and kept intact until departure. US White House World Cup Task Force director Andrew Giuliani warned that breaking the bubble could bar the team from competition; any added personnel must have a separate bubble to shield the squad. The DR Congo squad, coached by Sebastien Desabre, is largely based abroad, with many players in France, including Premier League stars Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Noah Sadiki and Yoane Wissa. They will play warm-up games against Denmark and Chile before the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に伴いコンゴ民主共和国がワールドカップ出場停止のリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準に該当。エボラウイルス病の新規発生は重大な公衆衛生事象であり、国際スポーツイベント参加に伴う人的移動による国際的拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事は明示的に「DR Congo」でのエボラ発生を主題としており、DRC(203312)のみを verified_locations に含める。Bluedot APIが付与した他の地域（Houston、Texas、USA、France、Chile、Portugal、Denmark、Belgium）は、ワールドカップ関連の移動地や対戦国に関する文脈であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではない。国際的な関心（ホワイトハウス対策本部の警告、世界的スポーツイベントへの影響）が高く、公衆衛生上の深刻さと相まってシグナルとしてピックアップすべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: Egyre súlyosabb az ebolahelyzet, emelték a kockázati besorolást is
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola situation is getting worse, and the risk classification has also been raised.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. As of May 23, 2026, about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths are attributed to the virus in the region. WHO has raised the outbreak’s international risk to very high, citing late recognition, lack of licensed vaccines or therapies, ongoing armed violence, and high population mobility. Ituri province imposed restrictions: burials by trained teams only; prohibition on transporting corpses by non-health vehicles; public gatherings limited to 50 people; local football league suspended. Cross-border measures include Rwanda barring entry for foreigners who recently visited DRC and quarantining its citizens; Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. Notable imported/exported cases include an American infected in DRC treated in Germany, and another high-exposure individual moved to the Czech Republic. The UN is allocating about $60 million to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ状況が悪化、リスク分類も引き上げられた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるDRC東部でのエボラアウトブレイク、約750疑い例177死亡、複数国への国際的拡大、WHO最高リスク評価、ルワンダ・ウガンダ等での国境対策実施。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク。DRC（Ituri州）を中心に約750疑い例・177死亡。ルワンダ・ウガンダで確認例あり、ドイツ・チェコへの輸入例も報告。WHOが国際リスクを最高レベルに引き上げ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ルワンダ・ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めず。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير من الصحة العالمية بارتفاع معدلات الخطر في الكونغو بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of rising risk levels in Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns of rising risk levels in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as Ebola spreads in Ituri, the outbreak epicenter. The agency notes that declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern aims to reinforce international powers to intervene and help affected countries contain transmission. The risk inside the DRC has been raised to very high, regional risk remains high, while the global level is currently low, with ongoing close monitoring. The outbreak is described as potentially limited but could persist for months, aided by delays in initial diagnosis in Ituri. First death occurred on 20 April, and official acknowledgment followed about 25 days later. Diagnosis required sending samples to a Kinshasa laboratory roughly 1,600 kilometers away, delaying identification of the virus strain. The strain identified is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare lineage, the third recorded instance, and typing delays may have facilitated spread.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がコンゴでのエボラウイルス感染者数増加に伴う危険レベルの上昇を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的に重大な感染症であり、DRC国内でのリスク評価が「非常に高い」とされており、WHOによる国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が言及されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症の致死的な性質、DRC内のリスク評価が「非常に高い」に引き上げられたこと、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な系統）の確認、診断の遅延（約25日間）による伝播促進の可能性、国際的な支援体制の強化が必要とされていることなど、複合的にリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Σε "φούσκα" αυτοαπομόνωσης η εθνική ομάδα του Κονγκό λόγω... Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo national team in a "bubble" of self-isolation due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk drives the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team to implement a 21-day self-isolation bubble to enter the United States for the World Cup. The squad, training in Belgium, must begin isolation immediately to arrive in Houston by June 11. If additional personnel join, they must form a separate bubble to avoid cross-contamination; any symptomatic individual could prevent the team from participating. White House coordinator Andrew Giuliani told ESPN that authorities are urging protective measures to preserve bubble integrity and the team’s World Cup eligibility. No Ebola cases are reported in the article; the precautions are preventive to avoid importation of infection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ国家代表チーム、エボラ対策で自己隔離「バブル」に入る
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはエボラ発症者ではなく、予防的隔離措置についてのスポーツニュースであり、公衆衛生への直接的な影響がない。記事サマリーに確認されたエボラ症例はなく、実際の感染症クラスター発生ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行地域（DRC）の国家チームの予防的隔離措置についてのスポーツニュースである。実際の症例報告やアウトブレイクではなく、WorldCupへの参加保障のための行政的措置である。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては認識されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandeses lamentan vínculo con Bundibugyo, el tipo de ébola nombrado por un distrito de cacao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ugandans lament the link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus strain named after a cocoa-producing district.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus, named after Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, is a concern as eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports about 160 suspected Ebola deaths across two provinces. There is no Ebola in Uganda; two imported cases have been reported there, both Congolese nationals who entered Uganda before Congo declared the outbreak on May 15. A 59-year-old man was hospitalized in Kampala on May 11 and died May 14; a second woman is being treated in Kampala with limited information. Ugandan officials urge caution, as President Museveni ordered suspension of cross-border transport and a June 3 religious gathering near Kampala. Vaccines and treatments do not work against Bundibugyo; contact tracing and isolation are essential. The Bundibugyo designation traces to past outbreaks—2007 in western Uganda (at least 37 deaths) and 2012 in northeast Congo—identified by a U.S. CDC-led team.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ人がブンディブギョとの関連を嘆く。カカオ生産地区で名付けられたエボラウイルス株
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola（既知株）の再興事例で、DRCで約160人の疑い死亡、ウガンダへの流出が確認（2例の輸入症例）。ワクチン・治療が無効であり、国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生影響が深刻。IHR基準3つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: DRCの東部2州で約160人の疑い死亡が報告され、既知ワクチン・治療が無効なBundibugyo Ebola株が確認。ウガンダへの流出（2例の輸入症例）が発生しており、大統領が越境輸送の一時停止と宗教集会の禁止を命令。高リスク事象であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Here's How the US Is Handling Congo's World Cup Participation Amid Ebola Crisis
article.articleSummary: In response to an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo, the United States is imposing strict health and safety measures on Congo’s national team ahead of the FIFA World Cup. Congo’s participation now hinges on mandatory isolation, with a 21-day pre-travel isolation period required before the team can depart. To ensure safe preparation, U.S. officials have directed the Congo Football Federation and government to keep the squad in a controlled bubble environment in Belgium, where they will train and play two warm-up matches under close supervision. Andrew Giuliani, executive director of the White House task force for the World Cup, said the outbreak is serious and warrants extra precautions to prevent health risks at the event. The plan underscores international public health concerns associated with major sporting events and involves collaboration with medical experts and football bodies.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ危機の中でのコンゴのワールドカップ参加をどのように対応しているか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱の発生国からの国際的な移動制限が実施されており、公衆衛生上の国際的懸念が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのエボラ流行に対する国際的対応を取り上げており、米国とベルギーが言及されているが、発生地はDRC。WPROスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」はエボラの高い感染性と国際イベント参加による拡大リスクで該当。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれるため、verified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ultimátum z Bílého domu! Kvůli obavám z eboly zamíří DR Kongo do přísné bubliny
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ultimatum from the White House! Due to Ebola fears, DR Congo will enter a strict bubble.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fears prompt the United States to impose a strict isolation bubble on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) national team as it prepares for the FIFA World Cup. The squad, currently at a training camp in Belgium, must completely separate from the outside world for 21 days to maintain bubble integrity before a June 11 flight to Houston. White House assistant Andrew Giuliani told ESPN that any visits or arrivals will be tightly controlled, and new arrivals must have their own bubble; if anyone develops symptoms, the entire team could be barred from the tournament. A U.S. statement urges the Congolese federation to minimize contact and protect players. Congo’s World Cup matches: June 17 in Houston vs Portugal, then Guadalajara vs Colombia, and Atlanta vs Uzbekistan in Group K.

triage.headline_ja: ホワイトハウスからの最後通牒！エボラ懸念により、DRコンゴはドイツ厳格なバブルに入る
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はDRコンゴのサッカーチーム（FIFA ワールドカップ参加）に対する予防的な隔離措置であり、実際のエボラ感染イベントではない。疾患の発生や患者数の増加を示す疫学的証拠がなく、公衆衛生上の重大な影響は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ感染イベントではなく、DRコンゴのサッカーチーム（2026年FIFAワールドカップ参加）に対する予防的隔離措置に関するスポーツニュースである。エボラの実際の発生、感染者、死亡者の報告はなく、エボラへの懸念は行政的予防措置の根拠として言及されているのみ。感染症シグナルとしてはピックアップ不要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Airlines suspends Kinshasa flights over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda Airlines suspended flights to and from Kinshasa from May 23, 2026, as a precaution amid Ebola developments in the region, tied to the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak involving the Bundibugyo strain. Uganda confirmed two imported Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases linked to the DRC outbreak; one patient died, the other is recovering after testing negative on May 18 and May 20. Authorities placed 127 contacts under institutional quarantine and activated nationwide preparedness under the National Task Force chaired by the Vice President. Measures include intensified border screening, temporary suspension of select cross-border transport with the DRC, enhanced border patrols, suspension of weekly markets in border sub-counties, and restrictions on large gatherings near the border; schools will reopen with Health Ministry SOPs. WHO warns the Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern DRC remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern with no approved vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ航空がエボラを理由にキンシャサ便を運休
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。既に複数国での確認事例と公式な対応措置が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統エボラの東部DRC発生地域からの越境拡大を警告。ウガンダでの輸入症例確認(死亡1、回復中1)。WHOがPHEIC宣言。記事サマリーはウガンダでの対応措置を詳細に述べているが、感染症イベント自体の発生地はDRCが主である。発生地域に含まれるUgandaは二次的な拡大事例であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: La selección de fútbol de la República Democrática del Congo vendrá a Cádiz en pleno brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team will come to Cádiz amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team will play Chile on June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Cádiz, amid an Ebola outbreak affecting DRC and Uganda. Spanish health authorities are coordinating safety measures for the team’s stay, with Sanidad Exterior reviewing travel routes, duration in Cádiz, and medical screenings. The squad has altered World Cup preparations, canceling a training camp in Kinshasa but keeping friendlies in Belgium and Spain before traveling to the United States. Most players reside outside the DRC. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency on May 17 for the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda, with hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths reported, though officially confirmed cases are fewer. FIFA remains in direct contact with the Congolese Football Federation to align medical and prevention guidance ahead of the Cádiz match.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のサッカー代表チームがエボラ出血熱流行の真っ最中にカディスを訪問予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが5月17日に公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱が背景にあり、複数国での確認ケースと国際的なスポーツイベント開催による拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されるエボラ流行国はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。スペイン・ベルギー・チリ・米国は試合開催地・移動地であるが、流行発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。WHOによる公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）、複数国への移動に伴う国際的拡大リスク、スポーツイベント開催時の接触機会増加がコンサーン。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland intensifies ASF containment measures; pork sale banned in several districts
article.articleSummary: Nagaland reports African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak, with infected pigs identified in Signal Angami village, Dimapur district, prompting intensified surveillance and containment. As of May 18, 2026, authorities imposed a district-wide ban on pork sales and prohibited import, export, and transportation of live pigs until further notice. In Dimapur, movement, slaughter, and transport of pigs, pork, and related products are restricted in affected areas. In Medziphema subdivision of Chumoukedima district, pig slaughter and sale are regulated, with prior permission required for commercial activity. Mokokchung district areas under Tuli subdivision — Chungtia, Kangtsungyimsen villages and Shitikolak ward of Tuli town — report ASF outbreaks and advisories to avoid pork purchases. Additional restrictions on pig import/transport in Peren and Niuland; pork shops closed in Kohima. ASF is highly contagious among pigs, not a human infection, though causes severe economic losses; authorities urge reporting, strict biosecurity, and prevention; no panic.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランがASF封じ込め対策を強化、複数地区で豚肉販売禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり人獣共通感染症ではなく、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は限定的。ただしナガランでの確定的な多地域発生と継続的な感染リスク、経済的被害の大きさから経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病であり人間への感染はないため、IHR基準における「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」には該当しない。しかし記事によりナガランの複数地区（Dimapur、Mokokchung、Kohima、Peren、Chumoukedima）で確認されており、地域経済への深刻な影響、豚肉流通規制、バイオセキュリティ措置強化が報じられている。IHR2つ該当するが動物疾病のため国際的な人の健康リスクは低い。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度（経済的損失）、長期曝露（継続的制限措置）、流行しやすさ（豚間での高い感染力）の4基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk in DR Congo now 'very high' as cases surge -- WHO
article.articleSummary: By 23 May 2026, WHO raised DR Congo's Ebola outbreak national risk to very high as cases and deaths surge. Confirmed: 82 cases and 7 deaths; 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The Bundibugyo virus is implicated, with no approved vaccines or therapeutics, and the outbreak centers are Ituri and North Kivu. Insecurity has displaced over 100,000 people and left 4 million in humanitarian need; a hospital in Ituri was attacked. Uganda reports two confirmed cases linked to travellers from DRC, including one death. An American working in DRC tested positive and was evacuated to Germany; another high-risk contact moved to the Czech Republic. WHO deployed 22 international staff and released $3.9 million; the UN allocated $60 million. Monoclonal antibodies prioritized for trials; obeldesivir proposed as post-exposure prophylaxis. Separately, hantavirus linked to cruise ship MV Hondius: 12 cases and 3 deaths; 600+ contacts across 30 countries monitored.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱リスクが「非常に高い」に上昇――WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱（Bundibugyo virus）による大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高死亡率、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ共和国への確認例あり）、及び渡航制限リスクが明確。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州・北キヴ州）での大規模エボラ熱流行が主題。ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコへの事例は二次的な拡大だが、DRCの流行が主要イベント。ハンタウイルス（MV Hondius船関連）は別事象だが同時報告。WHO及び国際機関の高度な関与と迅速な対応実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola à Butembo : Le Parlement des jeunes monte en première ligne contre la désinformation et la propagation du virus | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in Butembo: The Youth Parliament takes the lead in the fight against misinformation and the spread of the virus | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Butembo's Youth Parliament in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, pledges to lead the fight against Ebola and misinformation, declaring at a 22 May 2026 press briefing at the Kimemi communal office that they will be at the frontline to defend against Ebola by enforcing preventive health measures and countering infodemic and manipulative rumors. President Boxfish'angi Barack emphasized sensitizing residents to strictly follow sanitary guidelines to prevent transmission and to empower youth in the response. The move follows a 21 May 2026 attempted sabotage at a hospital in the Bulengera commune, where unknown men allegedly tried to forcibly remove a patient suspected of Ebola after the family disputed test results; security forces intervened. The article highlights community-driven leadership addressing Ebola containment in Butembo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がブテンボで発生：青年議会が偽情報と感染症の拡大防止に最前線で対抗
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で最も重大な疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国での発生は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが高い。複数のIHR基準に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の疑い患者がButembo市内で確認されており、病院での患者奪取未遂事件も報告されている。青年議会による感染症対策と情報統制の取り組みが記述されているが、具体的な患者数や死亡者数は記事に明記されていない。Rwandaは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーにおいて主な発生地としては言及されていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : enterrement des victimes du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Burial of Ebola virus victims
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts urgent burials in Rwampara as health workers in protective suits bury victims while the virus spreads to neighboring provinces. Approximately 160 deaths have been reported among nearly 670 suspected cases. In Bunia, authorities have reinforced screening at checkpoints and transport hubs to curb spread; at each checkpoint, temperature checks and handwashing are performed, and travelers with Ebola symptoms are barred from boarding, according to Aimé Prospère, a Bunia control-point supervisor. Health workers report mounting pressure as the outbreak intensifies and disrupts daily life. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency, but response is hampered by insecurity and limited access to affected areas. Transmission chains remain active; the absence of a vaccine for this Ebola strain further complicates containment.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラウイルス犠牲者の埋葬
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認された流行で、WHOも国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国東部（Bunia含む）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は地理的に近接するが、サマリーの主要な焦点はDRCである。WHO による国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、160名の死亡、670名の疑い例、ワクチン欠如、アクセス制限による対応困難という複数の深刻な課題が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Африканская сборная может не сыграть на ЧМ-2026 по футболу из-за лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An African national team may miss the 2026 FIFA World Cup due to Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens the DR Congo national football team’s participation in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The team faces a 21-day mandatory isolation before the tournament and quarantine requirements in Belgium, where they are training, with potential disqualification for non-compliance. The 2026 World Cup runs June 11–July 19 across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, with DR Congo in Group H against Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency as Congo reports about 160 suspected deaths and 671 suspected cases across two provinces; neighboring Uganda has two cases, including one death, this week. The outbreak’s rapid spread and epidemiological risks threaten travel and competition.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのナショナルチームが2026年FIFAワールドカップをエボラ熱で欠場する可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のDRC及びウガンダでの発生で、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、国際的な拡大リスク及び渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ熱発生を主題としており、約160人の死亡疑い例と671人の患者が報告されている。ウガンダでの2症例も言及されているが、サマリーの主要な焦点はDRC。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、2026年ワールドカップという国際的なスポーツイベントへの脅威として高い社会的・政治的関心がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола виходить з-під контролю: в якій країні спалахнули бунти та масові втечі заражених
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is out of control: in which country did riots break out and mass escapes of the infected occur?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spiraling out of control amid armed conflict, panic, and resource shortages. As of May 23, 2026, health authorities report 83 confirmed Ebola cases with hundreds more under suspicion; only about 21% of roughly 1,600 potential contacts remain under surveillance. The World Health Organization says response efforts lag behind transmission. The virus has reached South Kivu near the Rwanda border, with additional cases reported in neighboring Uganda. Quarantine-related unrest includes in Ituri, where relatives attempted to retrieve a body, protests escalated, treatment tents were burned, and several infected escaped from a medical facility. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specialized treatment. Testing capacity is limited and laboratory infrastructure weak. Rwanda has heightened border controls; Uganda has restricted passenger transport from Congo. Experts warn of regional-scale epidemics if not localized.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能に：どの国で暴動が発生し、感染者の大量脱出が起きたのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクが制御不能な状況、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ルワンダ確認）、ワクチン未承認株、公衆衛生対応の崩壊、域内流行の懸念が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（South Kivu、Ituri州）に限定される。ウガンダとルワンダは確認地域として記載されているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。制御不能な状況（接触者監視21%、脱出事例、暴動）と医療体制崩壊（テント焼却、検査能力不足）が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Συγγενείς θύματος του ιού Έμπολα έβαλαν φωτιά σε νοσοκομείο επειδή τους αρνήθηκαν την πρόσβαση στη σορό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Relatives of an Ebola virus victim set fire to a hospital after being denied access to the body.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is ongoing, with 177 deaths and about 750 suspected cases reported as of May 23, 2026. Relatives of a victim burned a hospital after being denied access to the body, illustrating community violence hindering response. WHO warns that such violence undermines containment efforts. The first suspected case involved a healthcare worker whose symptoms began on April 24, who later died at a facility in Bunia. By May 5, authorities were alerted to an unknown high-mortality illness, and a rapid-response assessment on May 13 confirmed the outbreak as Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Officials note insufficient public awareness, with some remote communities viewing Ebola as a Western invention. The report does not specify vaccination, treatment details, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルスの犠牲者の親族が遺体へのアクセスを拒否されたため病院に放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な影響：177死亡、750疑い例；異常性：アウトブレイク確認；国際拡大リスク：エボラ出血熱；渡航・貿易制限リスク：可能性あり）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべて該当。フルRRA進行必須。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の現在進行中のアウトブレイク。2026年5月23日時点で177死亡、約750疑い例。4月24日に初発患者（医療従事者）、5月5日に当局への報告、5月13日に確認検査。コミュニティ暴力（遺体への接触制限に対する病院放火事件）により対応が阻害されている。不十分な公衆衛生意識（エボラを西洋の捏造と見なす一部地域）が記録されている。ワクチン接種、治療詳細、輸入・輸出事例は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Африканська збірна може не зіграти на ЧС-2026 з футболу через лихоманку Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African national team could miss the 2026 FIFA World Cup due to Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo could miss the 2026 FIFA World Cup due to an Ebola virus disease outbreak. ESPN reports a mandatory 21-day isolation before the tournament, and that the United States requires the team to quarantine in Belgium, where it is training and planning friendlies; non-compliance could lead to disqualification. DR Congo are scheduled to face Portugal, Colombia and Uzbekistan in the group stage. The 2026 World Cup runs June 11–July 19 in the United States, Canada and Mexico, features 48 teams and 104 matches. The Ebola outbreak has prompted the WHO to declare an emergency. Congolese authorities report about 160 suspected deaths and 671 suspected cases in two provinces; the UN notes two suspected Ugandan cases, including one death, highlighting broader cross-border spread. Earlier, the team reportedly parted ways with its second head coach in four months.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ代表がエボラ熱により2026年FIFAワールドカップを欠場する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが緊急事態宣言、複数国での患者確認、国境を越えた拡大があり、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ疫病流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの越境確認事例も言及されている。WHOが緊急事態を宣言し、約160の疑わしい死亡と671の疑わしい症例が報告されている。隔離・検疫措置は国際的な渡航・スポーツイベント参加に影響を与えている。米国・カナダ・メキシコはワールドカップ開催国だが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレイク自体であるため、これらの国は verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch 2026: Warum die neue Variante ohne Impfstoff so gefährlich ist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak 2026: Why the new variant without a vaccine is so dangerous.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, a new Ebola outbreak in the Congo involves the rare Bundibugyo variant, with hundreds infected and more than 130 deaths. First case detected April 24; outbreak declared May 15. No vaccine or targeted therapy exists for Bundibugyo; case fatality ~37%. The virus spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated objects; bats and primates are natural hosts. Mobility between the Congo and Uganda and a funeral aided spread. Ituri is hard to reach, with mistrust delaying detection and attacks on health workers. WHO has declared an international health emergency, and the African Union followed with a continental emergency. Treatments are supportive; Regn-Eb3 and mAb114 are ineffective for Bundibugyo. Precautionary measures in Europe include isolation units and travel quarantines; a US doctor infected in Congo is treated in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生2026：新しいワクチン未対応変異株が危険な理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。新規エボラBundibugyo変異株の国際的感染事例（DRC→Uganda→Germany→US）、130人以上の死亡、ワクチン/治療法なし、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはUganda、Germany、USでの症例言及あるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Berlin（Germany）での感染者治療は二次的対応。Bundibugyo変異株の特性（ワクチン/既知治療法なし、37%致命率）とWHO国際保健緊急事態宣言が重大なシグナル。Africa地域（WPRO外）であるが、グローバルな脅威として即座のRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: le risque Ebola désormais " très élevé " en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola risk now 'very high' in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO raises the Ebola public-health risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo from high to very high. As of 23 May 2026, 82 cases have been confirmed in DRC with 7 deaths, while about 750 cases and 177 suspected deaths are reported, indicating the outbreak is broader. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no proven vaccine. The outbreak has also spread to Uganda, with 2 cases and 1 death confirmed. An American national working in DRC tested positive and was transferred to Berlin's Charité hospital, where he is described as very weakened but not in critical condition and remains under high-security isolation. Tedros noted another American contact at high risk has been transferred to the Czech Republic. In the Netherlands, Radboud University Medical Center admitted a patient with Ebola suspicion judged as low and placed in isolation while awaiting tests. Ebola is severe and often deadly; the CDC cites up to 90% mortality. Global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱リスク、現在「非常に高い」と評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ熱の確認症例82例、死亡7例、推定750例のアウトブレイクが複数国に拡大しており、ワクチンなし。国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ熱アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo型）が主題。ウガンダへの拡大が確認されている。ドイツ・オランダ・チェコでの輸入症例の報告もあるが、これらの国々は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO公式リスク評価が「非常に高い」に引き上げられ、確認症例と推定症例数が大規模。ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo型という特殊性も含めフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: WFP Peringatkan Krisis Pangan Perburuk Wabah Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WFP Warns Hunger Crisis Is Worsening the Ebola Outbreak in the Congo
article.articleSummary: World Food Programme warns that ongoing political instability and a worsening hunger crisis are intensifying the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The World Health Organization has raised the outbreak risk to 'very high' as of May 22, 2026, noting that malnutrition and a fragile health system heighten transmission risk of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain. Across the country, 26.5 million people face acute food insecurity, including 10 million severely hungry in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tanganyika. Insecurity hampers access to affected areas, but the UN Humanitarian Air Service continues logistics and medical deliveries. Bunia is a key logistics hub, with over 46 tons of medical cargo distributed to at least 14 strategic areas. Since reports indicate more than 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths, responders are intensifying cross-border containment with Uganda to avert a regional humanitarian catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: WFP、飢饉危機がコンゴのエボラ流行を悪化させていると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国境規制リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebola株による750件以上の疑い例と177人の死亡、ウガンダとの越境対策、WHOが'very high'リスク評価を発表し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内の複数州（Ituri、South Kivu、Tanganyika）での発生が明記されており、ウガンダとの越境対策も言及されているが、ウガンダでの実際の発症例報告は記事に明記されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。Bundibugyo Ebola株（稀な株）による大規模流行、栄養不良と脆弱な保健システムが悪化要因として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Proč se ebolu nedaří zastavit? Na vině je hned několik faktorů | EuroZprávy.cz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why Isn't Ebola Being Stopped? Several Factors Are to Blame
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, with Bunia in Ituri Province as the initial hotspot. Since late April, about 750 suspected cases and nearly 180 deaths have been recorded, with official counts underrepresenting the true scale. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. The fragile health system is overwhelmed; MSF reports 100% hospital occupancy and no beds for new patients. Ongoing violence by Allied Democratic Forces further hinders response, damaging clinics and driving staff away. Traditional burial rites involving washing the dead conflict with hygiene rules; authorities have banned such rites, restricted funerals to specialized teams, and limited corpse transport and public gatherings to 50. Prevention focuses on intensive care, rigorous contact tracing, and timely hospitalization; new transparent plastic isolation units are being used. The outbreak has reached schools, with a third reporting suspected cases or contacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが阻止できない理由は何か？複数の要因が原因である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（750疑い例、180死亡）、予想外の爆発的流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクを有する。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRC17番目のエボラ流行。ブンディブギョ株で承認済み治療法なし。武装勢力による保健施設への攻撃、伝統的埋葬儀式との衛生対策の葛藤、医療体制の崩壊（院内占有率100%）など、複数の阻害要因が存在。学校への感染拡大の報告あり。国際的な支援と強化された対応が急務。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: International Contact Group urges warring parties in DR Congo to facilitate Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo declared May 15 in Ituri province has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; 82 cases and seven deaths have been laboratory-confirmed. Two Congolese nationals infected cases were imported to Uganda. The ongoing conflict in eastern DRC compounds the humanitarian crisis and hinders Ebola response. The International Contact Group for the Great Lakes, comprising Belgium, Denmark, the EU, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK, and the US, urges all parties to facilitate response efforts and regional cooperation. The group calls for safe, rapid humanitarian access, sustained opening of Goma and Kavumu airports, safe corridors in North and South Kivu, and streamlined administration. The M23 rebels—reportedly supported by Rwanda—control significant eastern territories, including Goma and Bukavu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の交戦当事者に対しエボラ対応を促進するよう求める国際接触グループ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（750疑似症例、177疑似死亡、82確認例、7確認死亡）がDRCで宣言され、国際的な懸念と動員を示唆する国際グループの公式声明が含まれている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダとルワンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダへの輸入症例が言及されているため、実際の流行地はDRCに限定される。ただし、地域的な拡大リスクが存在する。2026年5月15日にIturi州で宣言、その後North KivuおよびSouth Kivu州に拡大。東部DRCの武力紛争がアウトブレイク対応を複雑にしている。

article.articleHeadline: WFP: Krisis pangan perburuk risiko penyebaran Ebola di Kongo - ANTARA News Jawa Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WFP: Food crisis exacerbates the risk of Ebola transmission in the Congo - ANTARA News East Java
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, the World Food Programme warned that political instability and a worsening hunger crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are heightening Ebola transmission risk. The World Health Organization raised the outbreak's risk to 'very high' and declared the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The WFP notes 26.5 million people face acute food insecurity, including 10 million severely food insecure in four eastern provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tanganyika—conditions that amplify vulnerability to transmission. Hundreds of humanitarian workers and tens of tons of emergency medical supplies have been mobilized; Bunia serves as the main logistics hub with over 46 tons of cargo distributed to at least 14 districts. So far, there are over 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: WFP: コンゴの食糧危機がエボラ出血熱の拡散リスクを悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが「極めて高いリスク」と評価したPHEICの正式宣言がなされているため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHOがBundibugyo Ebolavirus outbreakをPHEIC宣言し、ウガンダにも患者波及が確認されているが、記事サマリーの主要な流行地はDRCの東部4州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tanganyika）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。750以上の疑い患者と177死亡報告、26.5百万人が急性食糧不安に直面している極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Fotbalisté Konga mají kvůli ebole strávit 21 dnů v izolaci, požadují USA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo footballers to spend 21 days in isolation due to Ebola, US demand.
article.articleSummary: Congolese footballers will spend 21 days in isolation due to an Ebola outbreak in their country to be eligible for the World Cup in the United States. In a closed 'bubble,' the team must stay 21 days before arriving in Houston, ESPN quoted Andrew Giuliani, head of the White House's tournament task force. If they fail to comply, the squad risks being unable to travel to the venue. The squad is currently training in Belgium and will play warm-up matches against Denmark and Chile. They are due to reach their Houston base on June 11. Giuliani said the strict 21-day bubble is to prevent any infection from entering the U.S. or near its borders, with safety of Americans, teams, and millions of fans as the top priority.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのサッカー選手たちはエボラのため21日間の隔離が必要、米国が要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ感染症発生は懸念されるが、本記事の主題はワールドカップ参加に伴う隔離措置であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、制度的な対応措置の報道である。公衆衛生危機の新規シグナルとしては評価されない。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を言及していますが、主な内容はワールドカップに向けたコンゴチームの隔離措置に関する行政的決定です。既知のアウトブレイクへの対応であり、新規シグナルではありません。Bluedot APIが抽出した米国やその他の地域への言及は、隔離地点やワールドカップの開催地に関連しており、実際の発生地ではありません。

article.articleHeadline: AS Larang Masuk Warga dari 3 Negara Afrika akibat Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US Bans Entry of Citizens from Three African Countries Due to Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: US bans entry for foreign nationals with travel history from Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan amid an Ebola outbreak. The CDC states the restriction applies to anyone who was in those countries within 21 days before planned arrival in the United States and will last 30 days, with a subsequent evaluation. Exemptions exist for certain groups, but all travelers with exposure history will face substantially stricter health checks; Homeland Security directs that they be routed through Washington Dulles International Airport for intensified screening. The WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda to be emergencies, with Congo reporting at least 131 deaths in the latest wave. Ebola’s incubation can reach 21 days, which underpins the travel-history monitoring period.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行の影響で3つのアフリカ諸国からの市民の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準を4つすべて満たし、WHOが両国で公式に緊急事態宣言を発出している国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象。複数国での死亡者報告及び国際渡航制限が発動されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC（131人以上の死亡報告）とウガンダとしており、南スーダンも言及されている。しかし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WPROスクリーニング基準を全て満たし、WHOが公式緊急事態宣言を発出済みであることが確認される。米国からの旅行禁止措置は国際渡航制限の典型例。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ZDA: Kongo zaradi ebole nujno v karanteno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA: Congo urgently quarantined due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Congo’s national football team must complete a 21-day quarantine before arriving for the FIFA World Cup in the United States. Preparations in Belgium will keep the squad in a quarantined environment, with travel to the USA scheduled for June 11, after authorities warned to prevent entry of dangerous diseases. A Kinshasa event to greet the team has been canceled. Ebola, highly contagious and deadly, spreads via close contact and bodily fluids; eastern Congo is reporting an outbreak. WHO estimates roughly 700 suspected infections and about 180 deaths, with dozens of laboratory-confirmed cases. The threat to players is considered minimal since most Congolese players compete abroad, mainly in French leagues. Congo qualified for the World Cup for the first time since 1974; they face Portugal on June 17 in Group K, followed by Colombia and Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: USA: コンゴはエボラのため緊急隔離が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生（DRC東部）が確認され、IHR基準で公衆衛生への影響が深刻（死亡確認）、異常且つ予想外、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への移動）が該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからDRC東部でのエボラ発生が確認される。Kinshasa地域の具体的言及あり。USA・Belgium・France等への移動・拡散リスクは記述されているが、それらの国での実際の感染発生は報告されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO推定値（疑い患者約700名、死亡約180名）に基づく深刻性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Coupe du monde 2026 : avec Ebola, la sélection congolaise doit s'isoler dans une "bulle" pour assurer sa venue, affirme la Maison Blanche
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: With Ebola, the Congolese national team must isolate in a "bubble" to ensure its participation, says the White House.
article.articleSummary: To participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, the Congolese national football team must isolate in a 'bubble' for 21 days to prevent Ebola contamination, the White House announced on Friday. The requirement applies to entry into the United States for the tournament, with the squad required to remain in isolation for three weeks to avert Ebola transmission and secure participation. The plan imposes a strict containment regime during travel and pre-tournament activities, framing the 21-day period as a precaution against Ebola linked to the Congolese team. The announcement highlights how travel-related public health safeguards can affect international competition.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ：エボラの脅威で、コンゴ代表チームは参加を確保するため「バブル」内での隔離が必要と、ホワイトハウスが表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がコンゴで発生していることが前提とされているが、記事の主内容はサッカー選手団の入国規制であり、実際の流行状況が不明。IHR基準の該当状況が判断できない。
triage.notes: 記事は政治的な旅行規制の発表であり、コンゴでの実際のエボラ流行の詳細（患者数、死亡数、流行規模など）が不明。感染症イベントの実質的な情報が不十分なため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。USA（対象国外）への言及は検証位置から除外。

article.articleHeadline: PH seeing 51 new HIV cases per day
article.articleSummary: Philippines reports 4,633 confirmed HIV cases in Q1 2026, via DOH January–March 2026 HIV-AIDS Surveillance. The quarter-average is 51 new cases per day. Monthly: January 1,690; February 1,407; March 1,536. Of these, 4,214 (91%) were newly reported infections acquired through sexual contact: 3,095 male-to-male, 567 male-to-male/female, 552 male-to-female. Sexual contact remains the leading transmission mode among newly diagnosed cases. Mother-to-child transmission accounted for 13 cases. Two cases were transmitted through reported sharing of infected needles. Laboratory-confirmed HIV-positive individuals were reported by the DOH. Location: Philippines; status: ongoing HIV surveillance through 2026.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンで1日51件の新規HIV感染報告
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで高い新規HIV感染率（1日51件）が継続報告されているが、流行性疾患ではなく既知の風土病の継続サーベイランスである。IHR基準は2つ以上該当せず、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の懸念も低い。情報が限定的なため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: フィリピンは既知のHIV風土病地域で、継続的なサーベイランスデータの報告。性的接触が主な感染経路（91%）であり、流行性感染症ではなく既存の公衆衛生課題。IHR基準では「異常性」が低く、WPRO基準で複数項目該当するが、重症度評価は限定的。情報不足（国外支援必要性など）のため、シグナル昇格には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Arab Saudi Siap Melindungi Jamaah Haji di Tengah Kekhawatiran Global Terhadap Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia Ready to Protect Hajj Pilgrims Amid Global Concerns About the Virus
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia says its epidemiological surveillance system is fully prepared to protect about 1.5 million Hajj pilgrims as global concerns rise over Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo and hantavirus warnings. The World Health Organization has declared the Ugandan and DRC Ebola outbreaks a public health emergency of international concern. Enhanced preventive measures have been implemented for travelers from neighboring countries, including Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and the DRC. Pilgrims from various nations, including Iran, have arrived ahead of the Hajj, which begins May 25, 2026. Saudi authorities have installed shade routes to cope with the heat and set up at least 34 medical units near the holy sites to safeguard travelers at Mecca's Masjid al-Haram and related sites such as Jabal al-Nour and the Safa-Marwa area.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、ハッジ中のエボラウイルスおよびハンタウイルスへの世界的懸念の中、巡礼者保護を準備
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスはWHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言しており、ハッジという大規模国際イベント（150万人）での感染リスクは国際的拡大のリスクが高く、IHR基準3項目該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはリストに含まれる対象国として verified_locations に含める。イランもリストに含まれていないため除外。サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれていないが、ハッジ開催国として中心的な地域である。記事はDRCでのエボラ感染が直接的な発生地であり、サウジアラビアはリスク低減対策を実施している状況。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den kırmızı alarm: Ebola salgınında risk seviyesi yükseltildi!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues red alert: Risk level raised in the Ebola outbreak!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts the WHO to raise national risk to very high; regional risk remains high, global risk is low as of 23 May 2026. Official confirmed cases are relatively low, but suspected cases and deaths are high, suggesting ongoing transmission and potential rapid confirmation of suspected deaths if contact tracing remains insufficient. Uganda has issued a red alert and canceled public events to curb spread. Internationally, a US citizen stationed in DRC with Ebola tested positive and was evacuated to Germany for treatment; another US national with high‑risk exposure has been sent to the Czech Republic for monitoring. Separately, hantavirus cases on the MV Hondius, a Netherlands-flagged vessel in the Atlantic, include 12 infections and 3 deaths. The WHO highlights broader regional and travel implications and a new response roadmap.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が赤色警報を発令：エボラ出血熱の流行でリスクレベルが引き上げられた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC でのエボラ流行に対し WHO がリスク評価を引き上げており、米国市民の国際的な疎開や複数国への監視体制構築が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRC でのエボラ流行が確認される。記事中に Uganda、USA（Iowa/Atlantic）、オランダ国旗船での接触者監視が記載されているが、これらは DRC からの二次的な国際的な影響である。ハンタウイルスは Atlantic 上の船舶での発生で、陸域での流行ではなく対象国を含まない。対象国リストの DRC のみを verified_locations に計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda como microscópio de baixo custo criado por brasileiro ajuda no diagnóstico da malária na Nigéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out how a low-cost microscope created by a Brazilian helps diagnose malaria in Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Malaria diagnosis in Nigeria is aided by a low-cost, open-hardware microscope developed by Brazilian researcher André Maia Chagas. The device uses a USB camera, online lenses, common screws, and a 3D-printed frame, powered by a smartphone, and costs about $85. Originating from a demand in Yobe state, northeast Nigeria, 30 units have been locally built and distributed to hospitals and primary care centers for blood-smear microscopy to identify Plasmodium parasites inside red blood cells. Validation against traditional microscopes is underway. The project, based on the OpenFlexure open-hardware concept, seeks to expand diagnostic access, accelerate treatment, and enable digital data collection and automated screening in the future. Beyond malaria, it could support other microscopy-based tests, such as Pap smears for cervical cancer screening.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル人が開発した低価格顕微鏡がナイジェリアでのマラリア診断を支援
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア診断技術の開発・展開についての報道であり、感染症の発生・流行を示すイベント情報ではない。疾患発生の異常性、重症度の懸念、または急速な拡大リスクは検出されない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は診断技術の開発・展開であり、感染症の新規発生や流行の報告ではない。ナイジェリアでマラリアが風土病として存在することは述べられているが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。対象国リストにはナイジェリアが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。ブラジル（3469034）は対象国だが、記事の主題はブラジルでの発生ではなく技術開発のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: БРОЈОТ НА МРТВИ И ЗАРАЗЕНИ ОД ЕБОЛА ВО КОНГО РАСТЕ: Нема одобрена вакцина или терапија за бесниот сој!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths and infections from Ebola in Congo is rising: There is no approved vaccine or therapy for the deadly strain!
