article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo with 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths; approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported. No approved vaccine or therapy exists; WHO raised national risk to very high, regional risk high, and global risk low, and declared an international health emergency last Sunday. In Uganda, two confirmed cases (imported from DRC) and one death have been reported; the situation is currently described as stable. Abdirahman Mahamud warns the potential for rapid spread is very high, with Uganda enforcing intensified contact tracing and mass gathering cancellations. An American worker infected in Congo has been evacuated to Germany; another high-risk American was moved to the Czech Republic. Sylvie Briand, WHO Chief Scientist, says the experimental oral antiviral Obeldesivir could be used for contacts to prevent disease. Congolese WHO representative An Ansiya says the outbreak likely began two months ago but was only officially confirmed last Friday.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染死者数が急増：致死的株に対する承認済みワクチンや治療法がない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的な二次感染（ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ）が確認されている。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済みで、重症度・拡大可能性・国際的影響が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴで発生が確認されており、ウガンダ・ドイツ・チェコへの二次感染があるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。Bundibugyo株で承認済み治療法がない危機的状況。ただし配信日時が2026年5月とあるため、日付の誤りの可能性がある（参考情報）。

article.articleHeadline: Résurgence d'Ebola: l' UE alloue une envelloppe supplémentaire de 15 millions d'euros pour la réponse - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola resurgence: the EU allocates an additional €15 million funding envelope for the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurgence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda triggers a renewed humanitarian response. On May 23, 2026, the European Union announced an additional €15 million to fund emergency operations, alongside WHO support to help the Congolese government rapidly implement measures to prevent spread in Ituri and North Kivu in eastern DRC. The outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. WHO has delivered 11.5 tonnes of medical supplies and essential equipment within 72 hours from Kinshasa and regional emergency centers in Dakar and Nairobi. President Félix Tshisekedi has mobilized the government to halt transmission, directing the Health Ministry to strengthen surveillance and barrier measures; the Communications Minister to intensify public awareness; and the Finance Ministry to ensure emergency funding. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, underscoring ongoing regional vulnerability.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の再発生：EU が対応のため 1500 万ユーロの追加資金を配分 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の再発生により深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR (2005) Annex2の指定疾患。DRC の Ituri 地域および North Kivu での発生が記事の主要な焦点。ウガンダは記事内で言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCであり、DRCのみを対象国として列挙。EU による 1500 万ユーロの追加資金配分と大統領による積極的な政府動員が報告されており、政治的関心が高い。これは DRC にとって 17 番目のエボラ発生であり、地域的脆弱性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: "Decimated" CDC could struggle in face of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has triggered a WHO public health emergency of international concern. As of May 22, 2026, DRC reports 575 suspected Ebola cases, 51 confirmed, and 148 suspected deaths; Uganda has two confirmed cases linked to travel from the DRC, with one death. American physician Dr. Peter Stafford, exposed in the DRC, tested positive on May 17 and was treated in Germany. The United States issued enhanced screening and entry restrictions under Title 42 for travelers from outbreak countries including the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The CDC is described as severely weakened: 10% staffing cut in February 2025, 80% of top director positions vacant, leadership turnover, and a reduction in expertise. The agency says it remains engaged with partners via country offices in the DRC and Uganda. Critics note U.S. withdrawal from WHO and other aid cuts have hampered global response.

triage.headline_ja: 「弱体化した」CDCはエボラ流行に直面して苦闘する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスのアウトブレイク、複数国への国際的拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な旅行制限実施により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはUSA、Germany、Uganda、South Sudanが言及されているが、対象国リスト内で実際にイベントが発生しているのはDRCのみ。Ugandaで2確定例が報告されているがサマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク。ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）。CDCの機能低下についての懸念が強調されているため、社会政治的関心は極めて高い。WHO緊急事態宣言が既に発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland intensifies ASF containment measures; pork sale banned in several districts
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in Nagaland triggers containment: Mon district bans sale of pork district-wide and prohibits import/export/transport of live pigs until further orders; in Dimapur district infected and surveillance zones established after ASF-positive pigs in Signal Angami village. In Medziphema subdivision (Chumoukedima district), slaughter and sale of pigs/pork regulated; prior permission required for commercial slaughter or sale. Mokokchung district advises public to avoid pork in affected Tuli subdivision (Chungtia, Kangtsungyimsen villages and Shitikolak ward of Tuli town). Additional import/transport restrictions in Peren and Niuland districts. As a result pork shops in Kohima remained closed. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease affecting pigs; it does not infect humans and is not a public health concern, but causes severe economic losses to pig farmers. Public urged to report sudden sickness/deaths, avoid unauthorised movement, and practice biosecurity; dispose carcasses properly.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランがASF封じ込め対策を強化、複数地区での豚肉販売禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は家畜感染症であり人間への感染はなく公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。ただしインドのナガラント州での多地区での発生拡大と経済的影響の可能性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは家畜感染症で人間への感染リスクなし。しかし記事はナガラント州内の複数地区（Mon、Dimapur、Chumoukedima、Mokokchung、Peren、Niuland）での発生と広がりを報告。豚肉販売禁止など地域経済への影響あり。スクリーニング基準3つ該当するが社会的関心は限定的で、フル評価前の続報確認が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Warum sich dieser Ebola-Ausbruch so schwer eindämmen lassen wird
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why this Ebola outbreak will be so hard to contain
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern Ituri region is experiencing a severe Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a strain for which there is no licensed vaccine. By May 19, 2026, the outbreak had more than 500 infections and 130 deaths, with Uganda reporting two confirmed cases. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warned of uncertainties about the true scale and geographic spread, including transmission among healthcare workers in urban areas and a highly mobile population in a politically unstable region. The outbreak’s dynamics are described as unusually rapid and widespread compared to prior episodes. A confirmed American patient was flown to Germany for treatment, and U.S. travel rules were tightened. The WHO emergency committee will be convened to consider next steps.

triage.headline_ja: このエボラ出血熱の流行がなぜそれほど抑制困難なのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行動向、国際的拡大とWHO PHEIC宣言、国際的な渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。国家間をまたぐ多国籍対応とWHO最高段階の警告により、フルRRA実施必須。
triage.notes: DRC東部イトゥリ地域でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス株）の大規模流行。2026年5月19日時点で500以上の感染例と130人の死亡が報告され、ウガンダでも確認例あり。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。米国患者がドイツに搬送され、米国も渡航規制を強化。記事では「異常に急速で広がりやすい」と指摘。政治的不安定性、医療従事者への感染、都市部での拡大リスク、高い流動人口などが制御困難性の理由として述べられている。Bundibugyo株にはライセンス済みワクチンが存在しない点も懸念要因。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみverified_locationsに追加。

article.articleHeadline: UN rushes emergency aid to eastern DRC to combat fast-growing Ebola wave
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or therapeutics exist. In the DRC, 82 cases and seven deaths have been confirmed, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths across affected areas. The UN is rushing emergency personnel, funding, and supplies, allocating $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to bolster responses in DRC and neighboring countries. WHO has raised the national risk to very high, while global risk remains low. Cross-border transmission has been recorded in Uganda (two cases, including one death) linked to travel from DRC; American nationals, a doctor and a high-risk contact, have been transferred to Europe for treatment or monitoring. The outbreak unfolds amid fighting, displacement, and distrust, with a hospital in Ituri province reportedly set on fire. Only two prior Bundibugyo outbreaks have been documented.

triage.headline_ja: UN rushes emergency aid to eastern DRC to combat fast-growing Ebola wave（国連が東部DRCの急速に拡大するエボラ波との戦いに緊急援助を急ぐ）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、高い重症度（死亡例・疑い例多数）、稀少なBundibugyo株による大規模流行、管理能力を超えた展開（UN資金投入、国際援助必要）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの越境感染（2症例、死亡1名）が確認されているが、発生地域フィールドにUgandaが含まれている一方、サマリーの主題はDRC東部のエボラ流行。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は稀少（過去2件のみ）で管理が困難であり、戦闘・国内避難民等による複雑な危機状況が対応を困難にしている。米国人の国外搬送は国際関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland intensifies ASF containment measures; pork sale restricted in several districts
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Nagaland faces African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreaks in districts. The Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services has intensified surveillance, sampling, awareness, and bio-security measures. Mon district bans sale, import/export, and transport of live pigs. In Dimapur, infected and surveillance zones have been declared after ASF-positive pigs were found at Signal Angami village; restrictions cover movement, slaughter, and transport of pigs and pork products in affected areas. Medziphema subdivision (Chumoukedima district) regulates slaughter and sale, requiring prior permission for commercial activity. Mokokchung district advises avoiding pork in Tuli subdivision (Chungtia, Kangtsungyimsen, Shitikolak ward). Peren and Niuland districts impose pig import/transport limits. Several pork shops are closed in Kohima. ASF does not infect humans but threatens livelihoods; farmers and traders are urged to cooperate, report sudden pig illness, maintain hygiene and biosecurity, and avoid dumping carcasses in rivers or forests. Interventions will continue to safeguard livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランがASF封じ込め対策を強化、複数地区で豚肉販売制限
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）がインドのナガラン州で複数地区で確認され、豚の移動制限・販売禁止などの公衆衛生的介入が実施されている。動物への影響は深刻で、地域社会経済に影響を与えており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露、管理可能性）に該当する。
triage.notes: ASFは人間には感染しないが、ナガラン州の農業・畜産経済に対する脅威が明らかである。インド国内でのASF発生は動物衛生上重要なシグナルであり、地域ごとの厳格な制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de Ebola salgınında ölü sayısı 160'a yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in KDC has risen to 160.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri and North Kivu near Goma, has reached 671 confirmed cases and 160 deaths, according to the government Ebola situation report published after the May 15 declaration. In the last 24 hours, 13 new confirmed cases were recorded (12 in Ituri, 1 in North Kivu); 1,261 contacts are being followed, totaling 1,441. Earlier government figures had put cases at 435 and deaths at 118. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization has described the DRC and Uganda outbreaks as being of international concern. In Goma, measures have been stepped up; health staff training and patient-care support are prioritized. Officials warn prevention remains crucial to protect healthcare workers, families, and communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行で死者数が160人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に記載されているが、サマリーではDRCの流行が主題であり、ウガンダは「WHO が DRC とウガンダの流行を国際的関心事として記述」という文脈のみ。確認されたケースと死亡はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu）のみであるため、verified_locations はDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo型エボラで承認済み治療/ワクチンなし、という重大な懸念も存在。

article.articleHeadline: La colaboración internacional es clave contra brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International collaboration is key to combating outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola species with no approved medicines or vaccines. It is centered in eastern DRC’s Ituri province, with initial cases in Bunia and the Mongbwalu area amid ongoing conflict and large-scale displacement. Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan, increasing cross-border risk; two cases have been reported in Uganda, including a death, in travelers from the Congo. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and sometimes internal and external bleeding. The response features an urgent high-level WHO/CDC Africa meeting with Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, and evaluation of vaccine candidates for a potential trial, though progress and funding are hampered by aid cuts from the United States and other wealthy nations.

triage.headline_ja: 国際協力は流行に対抗するための鍵
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準も5つ全て該当する。国際的な高度な関心と対応が必要な重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダとスーダンも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは主な流行地はDRC（Ituri州）であり、ウガンダは2例（1例死亡）の輸入症例が報告されている段階。対象国リストにウガンダ（1641171）とスーダンは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus感染による前例のない大規模流行、ワクチン・医薬品未整備、資金難による対応阻害が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, la variante Bundibugyo preoccupa ma per un vaccino potrebbero volerci fino a 9 mesi - Corriere Nazionale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the Bundibugyo variant worries but for a vaccine it could take up to 9 months - Corriere Nazionale
article.articleSummary: At least nine months are needed before a vaccine against the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola would be ready. Two vaccine candidates are in development but none has cleared clinical trials. Meanwhile the outbreak accelerates: about 600 suspected cases, 139 deaths, and 51 confirmed infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with two cases in Uganda; numbers are considered underestimates due to detection delays. The eastern Ituri province is the epicenter, with spillover toward Nord Kivu. The first known case was a nurse who died April 24 in Bunia; the body was repatriated to Mongwalu. Kampala reports two imported cases from the DRC, with one death. On Sunday the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting high national/regional risk but not a global pandemic; Doctors Without Borders warns hospitals are overwhelmed, PPE is arriving but protection remains insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ブンディブギョ変異体が懸念されるが、ワクチンには最大9ヶ月かかる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での確認症例、死亡例、病院の混雑、不十分な個人防護具など深刻な状況。ワクチン開発の遅れも懸念要因。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題。ウガンダへの越境事例（2例）も記載されているが、アプローチ上DRCが確認発生地として該当。発生地域にUgandaが含まれているものの、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月23日）しており、国際的な保健対応が既に開始されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／暫無疫苗！新一波伊波拉疫情爆發　WHO：民主剛果風險調至「最高」 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: No Vaccine Yet! A New Wave of Ebola Outbreak Erupts; WHO: Risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Raised to the Highest Level.
article.articleSummary: WHO raises the Ebola outbreak risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the highest level as deaths rise. As of May 23, 2026, the DRC reports 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is currently no vaccine or approved therapy for this strain. WHO cautions the true scale is larger than confirmed counts. Transmission is via direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated items. Taiwan’s CDC has raised international travel advisories for the DRC and Uganda from Level 1 to Level 2; no further upgrades planned. Travelers to affected areas should avoid contact with blood, body fluids, or wildlife, maintain hand hygiene, and seek medical care promptly if fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding occur after return.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：ワクチンなし！新たなエボラ出血熱の流行が勃発　WHO：民主共和国コンゴのリスクを「最高」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによるリスク評価の最高段階引き上げ、高い死亡率、有効なワクチン/治療法の欠如、国際的な関心の急上昇が認められるため、フルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要なイベント発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが確定事例の報告はない。台湾はこの情報を報道する国であり、発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ウガンダ型）は既知のエボラウイルス亜種だが、現在有効なワクチン・治療法がない点が極めて深刻。WHOの最高リスク評価引き上げは国際的警戒レベルの高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : risque désormais "très élevé", selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: risk now "very high", according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has been raised to the WHO's highest level of public health risk, 'very high,' as of May 23, 2026, with 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths suggest a far larger outbreak. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine. It has also spread to Uganda (2 cases, 1 death). An American national who worked in the DRC tested positive and was transferred to Berlin's Charité hospital in a very weak condition, under high-security isolation. Additional developments include a high‑risk contact transferred to the Czech Republic and a suspected Ebola patient admitted to the Netherlands’ Radboud University Medical Center, isolated pending tests. Common Ebola symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea, and vomiting; CDC notes case fatality can reach up to 90%. The WHO notes that global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: RDコンゴのエボラ：WHOによると現在「非常に高い」リスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生（82確定例・7死亡、疑い例750、疑い死亡177）、ワクチンなし株、複数国への国際拡大（ウガンダ、ドイツ、チェコ、オランダ）。WHO最高レベルのリスク評価。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（対象国）が主要な発生地であり明確。ウガンダも言及されているが、記事の焦点はDRCの大規模発生にあり、ウガンダは確定例2件の二次拡大として記載。ドイツ・チェコ・オランダはDRC/ウガンダからの輸入症例を記載しており、これら欧州国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発で致死率高く、医療管理の課題が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Why health officials are taking the latest Ebola outbreak seriously- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda triggers a WHO health emergency. Bundibugyo strain has caused 148 deaths in Congo with 51 confirmed cases; 575 suspected infections are under investigation and 800+ contacts monitored. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs via direct contact with fluids; early symptoms include fever, fatigue and vomiting, potentially progressing to severe bleeding and organ failure. A four-week detection gap delayed confirmation; the first confirmed patient arrived in Bunia in April after Zaire-strain tests were negative. Cases have crossed borders to Uganda, with two imported cases, one death. The United States tightened travel restrictions for travelers from affected areas; an American aid worker in Congo tested positive and was treated in Germany, with six high-risk contacts in Europe. Global risk is 'low,' but regional risk is high due to late detection and movement in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局が最新のエボラアウトブレイクを真摯に受け止めている理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規株、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限措置実施済み）。Bundibugyo株による確定症例51例、死亡148例、疑い症例575例の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株（Zaire株とは異なる）による初の大規模アウトブレイク。DRC東部Bunia発生、ウガンダへの越境確認。4週間の検出遅延が懸念。米国援助労働者の感染と欧州への移送事例あり。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ、米国、ドイツは対象外だが、DRCでの発生が主要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи виходить з-під контролю: ВООЗ попередила про критичну ситуацію у Конго | Головне в Україні
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spiraling out of control: WHO warns of a critical situation in Congo | Top stories in Ukraine
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than contact tracing can keep up, and the WHO has declared a health emergency. As of May 21, 2026, 83 confirmed cases and 746 suspected cases have been reported. Over 1,600 contacts have been identified, but only about 21% were traced in a day, signaling strain on the response. Three-province outbreak includes South Kivu near Bukavu on the Rwanda border; two cases have been detected in Uganda. WHO notes the epidemic is unfolding in one of the most challenging operational environments due to armed conflict, distrust, and movements. At Bunia hospital, relatives clashed with staff over body handling; tents were burned and six patients escaped, including three with confirmed infection. The outbreak is linked to a Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with no vaccines or therapies, and diagnostics may fail to detect it. Uganda tightened border controls; Rwanda increased checks and quarantines for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に：WHOはコンゴの危機的状況について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。複数国での確認、死亡・重症例の多数、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: サマリーではウガンダとルワンダでの接触確認が述べられているが、主要な流行地はDRCのみであり、ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain、ワクチン/治療法なし、診断困難という懸念要因が複数指摘されており、リスク評価の優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans Rue Link To Bundibugyo, The Ebola Virus Type Named After A District Of Cocoa Farmers
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus, named for Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, is a focal point as Uganda reports only two Ebola cases amid the Congo outbreak. Both cases are Congolese nationals who traveled to Uganda before Congo declared an outbreak on May 15. One, a 59-year-old man, was admitted in Kampala on May 11 and died May 14; the second, a woman, is hospitalized in Kampala with few details. Congo’s outbreak has infected hundreds, with about 160 suspected Ebola deaths in two provinces. Past Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in 2007 (western Uganda) and 2012 (northeast Congo); initial cases were identified early, enabling response. There is no Ebola in Bundibugyo currently, but the link risks stigmatization. Measures include suspending Congo-Uganda travel and flights, delaying a religious gathering, enhanced entry-point surveillance, PPE, and rigorous contact tracing; vaccines/treatments for Bundibugyo strains do not work. Natural hosts: fruit bats; transmission via bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ人はブンディブギョとの関連を悔しがっている。ココア農家地区にちなんで名付けられたエボラウイルスの種類
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴでの大規模エボラ流行（数百人感染、約160人の死亡疑い）とウガンダへの越境症例により、高い優先度でフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダで2症例（コンゴ国籍者）が確認されているが、記事の主題はコンゴでの活動中の大規模エボラ流行（数百人感染、約160人死亡疑い）であり、ウガンダは越境症例の報告国。DRC のみをverified_locationsに列挙。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスであることが特徴。ワクチン/治療法が限定的であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Penyediaan Vaksin Ebola untuk Wabah di Kongo Butuh Waktu Sembilan Bulan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Ebola Vaccine Provision for Outbreak in the Congo Requires Nine Months
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts WHO warnings that an effective vaccine for the specific strain may require up to nine months to become available. The nine-month timeline underscores logistical and technical challenges in production, testing, and distribution, necessitating continued conventional prevention measures to interrupt transmission. While global health advances persist, clinical validation must not be compromised. WHO is coordinating with vaccine manufacturers and international partners to shorten the timeline without sacrificing safety. Field teams rely on personal protective equipment and supportive care for those exposed. The DR Congo has faced repeated Ebola outbreaks, each with unique characteristics, underscoring the need for strong national surveillance and rapid response to prevent spread to densely populated areas. Officials and humanitarian groups are racing to curb transmission in affected districts before wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO コンゴのエボラ流行に対するエボラワクチン供給に9ヶ月を要する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準4項目全て（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当。WPRO基準も全5項目該当。国際的な疫学的重要性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い病原性（ヒト-ヒト感染、高い致命率）を有し、DRコンゴは反復的な流行の歴史あり。ワクチン供給に9ヶ月要するという供給チェーン課題、密集地域への拡大リスク、および国際的なWHO調整の事実が記載されている。フルRRA実施の優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola volta a se espalhar e lota hospitais no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads again and overwhelms hospitals in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading again in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-05-23, with health workers warning the outbreak could outpace confirmed cases and strain an already fragile health system. Humanitarian organizations report rapid transmission across multiple areas and no clear signs of containment. Mercy Corps country director Rose Tchwenko told The Guardian that the speed of this Ebola surge is deeply concerning and underscores the urgent need for regional and global support. Field coordinators, including Hama Amado of Alima, say the disease is gaining strength in various zones, with authorities not yet able to halt spread. Aid groups stress immediate mobilization and additional resources to prevent a broader outbreak. The Guardian and Associated Press are cited as sources for these assessments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが再び拡大、コンゴで病院が満員になる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当し、WPRO基準でも5項目すべてが該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、地域内の国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラは極めて高い致死率と強い感染性を持つ病原体。記事では健康記者団による警告、複数地域での急速な伝播、保健システムの逼迫が述べられており、地域的な拡大と国際的な懸念が明確。人道支援団体による地域からの直接的な評価があり信憑性が高い。DRC以外の対象国への既存の拡大報告はないが、地域的な波及リスクは懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Schools should abide by SOPs
article.articleSummary: Uganda faces an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak with two imported, unrelated cases confirmed in Kampala, tied to the Democratic Republic of Congo origin; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or targeted therapeutics, so containment relies on surveillance, contact tracing, and public compliance. In response, Uganda's Ministry of Health issued school SOPs for reopening next week: handwashing facilities with running water and soap at entrances, classrooms, dormitories, dining areas, toilets, and staff rooms; temperature screening at entry; restricted entry for anyone with Ebola symptoms; regular cleaning and disinfection; proper waste management; discourage handshakes, hugging, and sharing personal items; ensure ventilation; designate isolation area; stock soap, water, hand sanitizers, and thermometers. The government cancelled the June 3 Martyrs' Day celebrations to prevent spread, with COVID-19 closures and the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak cited as reminders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：学校は標準的な運用手順を遵守すべき
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の確認事例、WHO公開健康上の緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン/治療法なし。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはDRC、Angola、Ugandaが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はウガンダでのエボラ流行。DRCは原発地として言及されているが、実際の発生はウガンダで確認されている2例。対象国リストではDRC（203312）はウガンダ（非対象）と共に記載されているが、verified_locationsはウガンダのみに限定。Angola（対象国外）は除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dünya Kupası'nda salgın paniği: ABD karantina şartı getirdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup outbreak panic: U.S. imposes quarantine requirement
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers strict U.S. entry conditions for the DRC national football team ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026 (USA, Canada, Mexico). The White House World Cup Task Force requires a 21-day full isolation, or 'balloon' protocol, at the team's Belgium training camp before entering U.S. soil. Any breach could legally bar the squad from entering the United States for the tournament. FIFA, FECOFA, and the DRC government have been formally informed. The squad is slated to arrive in Houston on June 11, contingent on completing the isolation period. Executive Director Andrew Giuliani stated there is no tolerance for compromising the balloon's integrity, warning that entry rights could be revoked and participation at the World Cup could be affected.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップの感染症パニック：米国が隔離条件を導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の発生が報告されており、国際的なスポーツイベント（FIFA ワールドカップ2026）への参加に関連した公衆衛生上の対応が取られている。対象国DRCにおける異常な公衆衛生事象として該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱発生が主題である。発生地域にはHouston、Texas、USA、Canada、Belgium、Mexicoも含まれているが、これらは対応国（隔離プロトコルの実施地）であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当。社会政治的関心も極めて高い（国際的なスポーツイベント関連、ホワイトハウス公式タスクフォース関与）。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" بأفريقيا تحذر من الاستخفاف بخطر انتشار "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization in Africa Warns Against Underestimating the Risk of Ebola Transmission
article.articleSummary: WHO Africa Regional Director Dr. Mohamed Yaquob Janabi warned that Ebola's Bundibugyo strain poses a serious risk and that a single case could spark transmission beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Data from the DRC health ministry show 160 suspected deaths among 670 suspected cases and 61 confirmed cases; two cases have been identified in Uganda. The outbreak in DRC and neighboring Uganda prompted elevated international concern, with WHO raising the outbreak risk level to very high locally and declaring it an international concern. Ebola symptoms include fever, body aches, vomiting, and diarrhea, and transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials; there is currently no vaccine for Bundibugyo. The United States temporarily barred entry of eligible permanent residents who had recently been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days under CDC authority (Title 42).

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）アフリカ地域事務所がエボラ拡大リスクの過小評価に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認事例と急速な国際拡大リスク、WHO警告、米国による渡航制限実施により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（対象国）とウガンダ、スーダン、米国が地理的文脈で言及されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは2例の確認事例の言及あるが、発生地域として対象国リストに含まれていない。Bundibugyo株は極めて高い致死率と治療法不在が特徴で、シグナルの重要性は極めて高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ایبولا کے پھیلاؤ اور بڑھتی ہلاکتوں کے بعد ہنگامی بنیادوں پر نئی ویکسین تیار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New vaccine developed on an emergency basis after the spread of Ebola and rising deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, London-based Oxford University researchers have achieved a major advance in developing an emergency vaccine against a new, dangerous Ebola virus strain, Beondi Bugio, circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where 7 people have died and 177 additional deaths are attributed to this outbreak. The vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, uses a viral-vector platform previously employed in COVID-19. Clinical trials are expected to begin within months. There is currently no approved vaccine or effective treatment for this strain. If trials succeed, the vaccine could be deployed rapidly with World Health Organization support to curb spread. Global medical circles regard the development as crucial for outbreak preparedness against evolving Ebola variants, potentially preventing large-scale epidemics in future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの拡散と増加する死亡者数の後、緊急ベースで新しいワクチンが開発される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス新種株による流行で死亡者あり、ワクチン開発中の重要な展開。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラウイルス新種株（Beondi Bugio）がDRCで流行しており、7人の死亡と177人の追加死亡が報告されている。ワクチン開発はロンドン（英国）の大学で実施されているが、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。英国はワクチン開発拠点であり、感染流行地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan Schools Ramp Up Hygiene Facilities Amid Ebola Outbreak - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Wakiso District, near Kampala, has equipped more than 40 government primary schools with handwashing stations, running water, and soap as part of a government drive to curb the Bundibugyo Ebola strain resurgence linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Ministry of Health has issued strict sanitation protocols ahead of the 2026 academic term, turning schools into frontline defenses. New SOPs require mandatory, supervised handwashing at entry, temperature screening at all access points, and routine disinfection of high-touch surfaces. Physical contact is discouraged; assemblies and visiting days suspended; classrooms and dormitories must be well ventilated, reducing usable capacity. Suspected cases trigger immediate isolation with holding rooms and rapid mobilization of district epidemiological surveillance via emergency hotlines. Administrators and school nurses act as public health officers. The measures flag regional cross-border risk with DRC, Kenya, and neighboring states monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの学校がエボラ流行中に衛生施設を強化 - KMA Updates
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola strain の再発は高い公衆衛生影響を持ち、DRC との国境リスク、複数国での関心の高さから国際的な拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain の再発が DRC からウガンダに波及している状況。記事は学校での感染対策強化を述べており、政府による組織的対応が進行中。ケニアも監視対象として言及されているが、記事の主題はウガンダとDRCの境界地域でのイベント。フルRRAにおいて、DRCとの国境での患者移動の有無、感染者数、死亡者数の詳細を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland Bans Pork Sale In Some Dists To Check African Swine Flu Spread
article.articleSummary: Nagaland, India, tightens ASF containment: African Swine Fever outbreaks prompt restrictions across districts including Dimapur, Medziphema subdivision, and another district. The Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services conducts surveillance, sample collection, awareness drives, and bio-security enforcement. Dimapur declared a 1-km infected zone with prohibitions on movement of pigs, piglets, pork, pig feed, and related products into/out of the zone; slaughter and transport within the area banned. In a separate district, district-wide bans on import, export, and transport of live pigs, with pork sales halted district-wide pending control. Medziphema regulates slaughter and sale, requiring administration and veterinary inspection for commercial pig slaughter. Violations may incur legal action. Authorities urge village councils, ward authorities, traders, and the public to cooperate. ASF is a highly contagious pig virus; it does not infect humans but causes severe losses in the livestock sector.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド州がアフリカ豚熱の拡大を防ぐため一部地区での豚肉販売を禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病で人に感染しないため公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的だが、インドでの異常な発生と家畜セクターへの経済的影響、および複数地区での広がりが確認されており、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病であり人間への感染リスクはないため、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」はNoと評価。ただしインド（特にナガランド州）での確認は異常であり、複数地区への拡大、規制措置の実施が確認されている。動物衛生当局による積極的な対応が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola au Nord-Kivu : le trafic des passagers entre Goma et Butembo suspendu pour limiter la propagation du virus | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in North Kivu: passenger traffic between Goma and Butembo suspended to limit the spread of the virus | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, is prompting authorities in North Kivu to suspend passenger transport between Goma and Butembo to limit intercity spread. The AFC/M23 rebel administration announced that from this date, buses and Leo Leo taxis are halted until further notice. The measure does not apply to freight; vehicles carrying goods may circulate provided only two people are on board—the driver and assistant. The move forms part of an expanded outbreak response aimed at protecting at-risk communities by restricting movement between affected or exposed zones. Authorities urge public understanding, vigilance, and responsibility while maintaining the sanitary measures as part of the ongoing response to the Ebola threat in the province.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがキブ州北部で：ゴマとブテンボ間の乗客交通が停止され、ウイルスの拡散を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の発生により、当局が都市間交通を制限する措置を講じており、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。重症度・管理可能性の点でWPRO基準も満たし、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州のゴマおよびブテンボで確認されている。当局による交通制限措置は疾病対策の実施を示唆し、国際的な関心を引く可能性が高い。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका: इबोला हुआ और खतरनाक, डब्ल्यूएचओ ने जोखिम स्तर 'उच्चतम' श्रेणी में रखा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Ebola-stricken and dangerous, WHO has placed the risk level in the 'highest' category.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the WHO has raised Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to the highest Very High tier, while global risk remains low. An outbreak is also confirmed in Uganda, where the situation is stable and broad contact tracing is effective. In the DRC, 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths have been reported, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no effective vaccine yet, and WHO notes more time is needed before initiating human clinical trials. In response, airports have increased screening and surveillance. The outbreak prompted an International Public Health Emergency declaration, though not at pandemic level. The India-Africa Forum Summit IV in New Delhi, planned for May 28–31, has been postponed to reflect evolving health conditions.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：エボラが発生し危険、WHOがリスク水準を「最高」カテゴリーに設定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高リスク分類、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。Bundibugyo株による大規模発生でワクチン未整備、国際宣言発出、国際フォーラム延期など政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの発生を主に記述しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドは見出しの「New Delhi」ロケーション（India-Africa Forum Summitの延期言及）により verified_locations に含める。DRCでの82確定例、750疑い例、Bundibugyo株でワクチン未開発という深刻な状況が International Public Health Emergency 宣言につながっている。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking news; Uganda Confirms 3 New Ebola Cases, Total Rises to 5 - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases, raising total confirmed infections to five. The two Ugandan cases are a driver who transported the country’s first confirmed patient and a health worker exposed while caring for the initial case; both are under treatment. The third case involves a Congolese woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who traveled into Uganda with mild abdominal symptoms, entering via Arua, then flying to Entebbe and presenting to a Kampala private hospital on May 10. She was treated and discharged on May 14 before returning to the DRC after a positive test prompted by the pilot who airlifted her. All contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are being monitored. Uganda has activated a comprehensive Ebola response plan—surveillance, laboratory services, case management, infection prevention, public awareness, and continuity of essential health services—part of the Sudan strain outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 速報: ウガンダがエボラ新規感染3件を確認、確定感染者は合計5人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な越境拡大（DRC⇔ウガンダ）を示唆し、IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な事象、国際拡大リスク）。スーダン株アウトブレイク対応が進行中。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（スーダン株）の確定感染例が複数国に跨って確認されている。DRCからウガンダへの越境移動と現地での医療従事者への二次感染が特に懸念される。ウガンダの包括的対応計画が既に発動されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ｗ杯、エボラ出血熱が流行のコンゴ民主共和国代表に「隔離」義務付け...米入国前に
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak imposes quarantine on the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team before entering the United States.
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers a 21-day quarantine for the DRC national football team before entry to the United States for the June FIFA World Cup in North America. White House World Cup adviser Andrew Giuliani told ESPN that failure to quarantine while training in Belgium could result in entry denial. Congo will play two of its three group-stage matches in the United States; the article notes training in Belgium and U.S. entry restrictions but does not specify any laboratory confirmation or case counts. The measure reflects precautionary border controls amid the Congo Ebola outbreak; no further details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided. Affected locations include the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Belgium, and the United States.

triage.headline_ja: Ｗ杯、エボラ出血熱が流行のコンゴ民主共和国代表に「隔離」義務付け...米入国前に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では「異常/予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当（2/4）。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当（3/5）。DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行は重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、国際的なスポーツイベント（W杯）に伴う国際移動制限という前例なき社会的・政治的影響が伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行を主題としており、ベルギー・米国は隔離措置の実施地であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。具体的な患者数や確認事例は記事では提供されていない。大規模国際スポーツイベント（FIFA W杯）との関連性が社会的・政治的関心を高めている。フルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός στην Ισπανία για το φιλικό ματς της ΛΔ Κονγκό λόγω έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Spain over DR Congo's friendly match due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s national football team is set to play a June 9 friendly against Chile in Cádiz, Spain, as an Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province prompts heightened security. DR Congo reports over 670 suspected Ebola cases and about 160 deaths under investigation, with laboratory confirmation of 64 infections and 6 deaths. Spain’s health authorities are evaluating measures to ensure maximum safety during the match. Deputy Health Minister Javier Padilla said movement routes and screening protocols will depend on outbreak evolution, in the context of the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The DR Congo squad has paused training in Kinshasa and relocated to Belgium for European friendlies, including this Spain game. FIFA is coordinating with FECOFA to ensure medical protocols are communicated to the team.

triage.headline_ja: スペインのエボラ懸念：コンゴ民主共和国のスペイン親善試合開催に対する警戒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、国境を越えた感染症リスクが現実化している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にスペインとベルギームが含まれているが、これらは国が設定した親善試合の開催地であり、エボラの実際の流行地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri Province等）のみ。WHOのPHEIC宣言済み、疑い事例670名以上、検査確認症例64名、死亡6名。国際的なスポーツイベントを通じた感染症リスク拡大の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: İç çatışma ebola salgınına yaradı: Ölü sayısı 100'ü aştı - Sözcü Gazetesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Civil Strife Aided the Ebola Outbreak: Death Toll Surpassed 100 - Sözcü Gazetesi
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies as Bunia in Ituri Province notes the first death on April 24, with roughly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported to date. The country faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, with case fatality rates estimated between 25% and 90%. Transmission via body fluids leads to organ damage and severe internal bleeding. Containment is hindered by ongoing armed conflict, disrupted burial practices, and healthcare system strain: more than half of health facilities in the affected areas damaged and nearly half of health workers displaced since January 2025. Attacks in Ituri have killed at least 17 people, and a treatment center was burned in Rwampara. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists; international aid is urgently needed, with MSF and Mercy Corps among responders. Early care markedly improves survival.

triage.headline_ja: 市民紛争がエボラ流行を促進：死亡数が100人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で177人の疑い死亡、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、武力紛争による制御困難性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州ブニアを中心とするエボラ流行について報告。ルワンダは地理的に言及されているが、疾病イベントの主要発生地はDRCのみ。武力紛争、医療施設破壊、埋葬慣行の混乱など、制御困難な環境要因が存在。国際援助機関（MSF、Mercy Corps）の関与を確認。

article.articleHeadline: Los rebeldes congoleños crean una "célula sanitaria" para contener el brote del ébola en el noreste del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese rebels create a 'health cell' to contain the Ebola outbreak in the northeast of the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompts the M23 rebels to form a 'health crisis cell' to curb transmission in Ituri province, neighboring North and South Kivu. The region has reported almost 180 suspected Ebola deaths and about 750 probable cases amid ongoing conflict, humanitarian access challenges, and mass displacement. The outbreak was declared this month in Ituri. The new crisis cell will be led by epidemiologist Freddy R. Kaniki from Goma, the capital of North Kivu, under a revised 'response strategy' developed in collaboration with local authorities, community leaders, national and international health actors, and humanitarian organizations. The M23 stressed its willingness to cooperate across political lines to protect populations and accelerate a coordinated response. It also noted the broader security context, with Rwanda-backed M23 and Burundi-backed forces influencing the region and potentially aiding spread. Immediate, united action and vigilant community engagement are urged.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の反政府勢力が同国北東部のエボラ流行を封じ込めるため「保健危機対策班」を設立
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。約180人の死亡、750人の症例報告、紛争下での限定的な人道支援アクセス、大量住民移動という条件下でのエボラ流行は深刻な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北東部（イトゥリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、Bluedot APIで識別された発生地域のうち、DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる。ブルンジ、ルワンダは記事で地政学的背景として言及されているが、エボラ発生地ではないため除外。紛争下での限定的なアクセスと大量移動により管理可能性が懸念される点、複数州での流行・複数国への拡大リスク、死亡・症例数の多さが総合的に深刻な状況を示している。

article.articleHeadline: أستاذ علم جراثيم: تأخر اكتشاف سلالة "بونديبوجيو" وراء ارتفاع الإصابات بـ"إيبولا" بالكونغو - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor of Microbiology: Delay in identifying the Bundibugyo strain behind the surge in Ebola infections in Congo - The Week
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Dr. Mahmoud Halbalab, a microbiology professor, notes that the WHO’s declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern grants expanded powers to assist affected countries in containing Ebola. The WHO raised the risk level in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to Very High, while global risk remains Low. He said the first death in the Ituri region occurred on April 20, but the outbreak was announced about 25 days later due to diagnostic delays, with samples sent to a Kinshasa laboratory about 1,600 kilometers away, delaying identification of the rare Bundibugyo strain. This is the third documented emergence of Bundibugyo in Ebola. The delay contributed to wider spread and a sharp rise in cases; officials warn the outbreak could persist for months unless containment and early detection improve. Emphasis on enhanced surveillance and rapid diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: 微生物学教授：「ブンディブギオ」株の発見遅延がコンゴのエボラ感染急増の背景にある - ザ・ウィーク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の希少株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの確定的なエボラ流行。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC（国際懸念事項に該当する公衆衛生上の緊急事態）既に宣言済み。希少なブンディブギオ株（過去3例目）による流行。診断遅延（25日間）が症例急増の主要因。キナシャの実験室から1,600km離れた採取地での検体搬送による検査遅延が問題。流行は数ヶ月継続する可能性との警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Voetballers Congo moeten van regering-Trump eerst 21 dagen in quarantaine vanwege ebola-uitbraak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese footballers must undergo a 21-day quarantine first under the Trump administration due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts the national football team to undergo a 21-day quarantine before the World Cup to secure entry into the United States. If not quarantined, players risk entry denial, according to Andrew Giuliani, head of the White House World Cup task force. Congo previously canceled a planned three-day training camp and fan farewell event in Kinshasa due to the outbreak. Ebola is a contagious, life-threatening disease transmitted via direct contact and bodily fluids. The World Health Organization reports about 750 suspected cases and around 180 suspected deaths in Congo, with several dozen laboratory-confirmed cases. This would mark Congo’s first World Cup appearance since 1974.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのサッカー選手はエボラ流行により、米トランプ政権からの要請で21日間の隔離が必須
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な発生、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべて該当。エボラウイルスは高い致死性と国際的な懸念を生じさせる。
triage.notes: 東部DRCでのエボラ流行が記事の主題。約750人の疑い患者と約180人の死亡疑い例（複数十人は検査確定）が報告されている。米国へのワールドカップ出場に伴う隔離要件など、国際的な影響が直接的に記述されている。フルリスク評価（RRA）推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos amplía restricciones de viaje por el Ébola e incluye a residentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States expands travel restrictions due to Ebola and includes residents.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the United States expanded Ebola-related travel restrictions to include legal permanent residents (green card holders) from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan who have traveled to those countries within the previous 21 days. The temporary rule, announced by the CDC under Section 42 of the Ebola Travel Act, aims to balance public health protection with emergency-response resources. Earlier, the State Department barred entry of 21 individuals from DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan in the past three weeks, allowing entry only through Washington Dulles International for heightened health screening. The move follows the WHO raising the Bundibugyo Ebola strain risk in DR Congo to 'very high' and declaring the DR Congo–Uganda outbreak an international health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルスに関連する渡航制限を拡大し、居住者も対象に含める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施、異常事象）。また複数のWPRO基準にも該当し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク関連の米国政府措置である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生に関連する米国の渡航制限拡大を報じている。WPROスクリーニング対象国のうち、実際に記事主題として感染症イベントが発生している国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。南スーダンは「Sudan」ではなく「South Sudan」のため、対象国リストの「Republic of the Sudan」（366755）とは異なる国。WHOによる国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、Bundibugyo株の危険度が「very high」と評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: البنك الدولي يعلن إعداد حزمة تمويل جديدة لمواجهة تفشي فيروس الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Bank announces a new financing package to address the Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is battling an Ebola outbreak with 82 confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths, alongside hundreds of suspected infections, while neighboring Uganda has two confirmed cases. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and raised the Congo’s outbreak risk to Very High. The United Nations released about $60 million from its Emergency Fund, and the United States is deploying a rapid response team and funding for 50 emergency centers. The World Bank, directing a $250 million DRC health project approved in 2024 for outbreak detection and emergency response, is preparing a support financing package. For the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, there is no vaccine or proven treatment yet, with case fatality up to 40%; control hinges on case finding, contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement. The Bank is coordinating with Gavi to accelerate vaccine development for the current strain.

triage.headline_ja: 世界銀行がエボラウイルスの流行に対処するための新たな融資パッケージを発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱の確認患者数82名、死亡7名、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、複数国への拡大報告あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダと米国が含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダでの確認患者2名のみ記載され、米国での発症報告はない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言済みで、複数国間の連携とワクチン開発支援を含む国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола предизвикува тензии во Итури: Локалци запалија центар за лекување
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Triggers Tensions in Ituri: Locals Set Fire to a Treatment Center
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo’s Ituri province, centered on Rwampara, led locals to burn a treatment center after authorities refused to release the body of a man believed to have died from Ebola. The Thursday incident underlines mistrust and the challenge of safe burials in a fragile, displaced setting. A group of young men entered the facility and set fire to parts of the center; police intervened but failed. The body of at least one suspected Ebola patient was burned inside; six patients were transferred to a hospital. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, urging burials by trained teams in protective gear. Official counts: 148 suspected deaths and about 600 suspected cases, with one death reported in Uganda. ALIMA said calm was later restored.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがイトゥーリ州で緊張を引き起こす：地元民が治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）に拡大、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: ウガンダとルワンダも記事に言及されているが、主たる発生地はDRC東部イトゥーリ州（Rwampara中心）。ウガンダでの死亡は1例のみ報告。WHOが公式に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。治療センターへの放火など、社会的紛争が勃発している点が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch 2026: Warum die neue Variante ohne Impfstoff so gefährlich ist
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak 2026: Why the new variant without a vaccine is so dangerous.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri near the Uganda border, has infected hundreds and killed over 130 within weeks. It involves the rare Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine and no specific therapy; mortality is about 37% for Bundibugyo. First infection detected on 24 April; the outbreak was declared on 15 May. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; bats and primates are natural hosts. Mobility between Congo and Uganda and a traditional funeral facilitated spread. The region’s isolation, distrust of authorities, and attacks on health workers complicate containment. WHO has declared an international health emergency. Vaccines exist for other Ebola variants (e.g., Zaire type), but Bundibugyo currently cannot be vaccinated. EU risk is very low; a US doctor infected in Congo is treated in Berlin.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク2026：ワクチンのない新しい変異株がなぜそんなに危険なのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo変異株による大規模アウトブレイク（130人以上死亡、数百人感染）、ワクチンなし、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）を中心としたエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを報じている。ウガンダとの国境地域での発生であるが、記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイクであり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ベルリンに搬送された米国人医師の事例は輸出症例であり、ドイツでの発症ではない。WHOが既に国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola‑riasztás Kongóban: a WHO már nagyon magasnak minősíti a járványveszélyt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Congo: the WHO already deems the epidemic risk to be very high.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers a very high national risk and high regional risk, with the WHO declaring the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; global risk is considered low. DRC has 82 laboratory-confirmed cases, 7 confirmed deaths, 177 suspected deaths, and about 750 suspected cases. In Uganda, the situation is stable with two confirmed cases among arrivals from DRC, including one death. The WHO notes rapid spread is likely and could alter outbreak dynamics. Uganda has implemented intensive contact tracing and canceled a mass gathering. An American working in Congo has a confirmed infection and has been evacuated to Germany; another American with high-risk contacts has been evacuated to the Czech Republic. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ警報：WHOはすでに流行リスクを非常に高いと評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルス株による国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態として、WHOが宣言。国際的な症例拡大（米国感染者のドイツ・チェコへの搬送）と死亡が確認されており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaは特定の株。DRCで確認症例82例（死亡7例）、疑い症例約750例。ウガンダでも2例の確認症例がある。米国人2名が感染・疑い例として欧州に搬送されているが、ドイツ・チェコは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・承認治療法なし。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。早急なフルRRA実施を推奨。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford Scientists Develop New Ebola Vaccine Amid Rising Outbreak Concerns
article.articleSummary: Oxford researchers are racing to develop a ChAdOx1-based Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain during a Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The experimental vaccine could enter clinical trials within two to three months if testing proceeds favorably. The outbreak in the DRC has produced hundreds of suspected infections and many deaths; Bundibugyo is a rarer Ebola species for which no approved vaccine exists. The World Health Organization has raised the internal Congo risk level from high to very high, though global risk remains low and the outbreak is not yet a pandemic. Animal studies are underway at Oxford; human trials will be needed before wider use. Authorities are employing ring vaccination—vaccinating close contacts and frontline workers—to curb spread alongside contact tracing and quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学の科学者がエボラ発生懸念の高まりの中で新しいエボラワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでの確定的なエボラアウトブレイク報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ発生は民主主義共和国（DRC）で発生していることが明確に述べられている。オックスフォード（英国）はワクチン開発地であり、発生地ではない。DRC以外の対象国では発生報告がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。DRCはリスト外国だが、IHR基準3項目以上該当の重大シグナルであるため、標準判定ルールに従いPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 美国扩大埃博拉疫情入境限制范围至绿卡持有者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. expands Ebola outbreak-related entry restrictions to green-card holders
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the United States expands Ebola outbreak-related entry restrictions to lawful permanent residents (green-card holders). The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says a temporary rule bars green-card holders who have traveled to or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days from entering the United States. Earlier, on May 18, the agency announced a 30-day package of enhanced traveler screening and entry controls, including heightened public health screening and monitoring for entrants from Ebola-affected areas, while continuing to allow U.S. citizens and green-card holders to enter. The new rule is not permanent. The World Health Organization on May 22 raised the national risk level of the outbreak in the DRC to very high, regional risk high, global risk low. The United States has not reported confirmed cases; public risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の感染拡大に伴う入国制限範囲をグリーンカード保有者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国間での報告、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、WHOによる国家リスク評価の引き上げにより、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な影響と管理対応が明確に認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）、ウガンダ、南スーダンと記述されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。米国の記述は入国制限措置の実施国であり、疾患発生地ではないため除外した。WHOが5月22日にDRCの国家リスクレベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げており、地域リスク「高」、世界リスク「低」と評価。米国での確認症例はなし。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية ترفع مستوى خطر تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization raises the risk level of an Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization raised the national risk level of the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'very high,' noting there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. The DRC has reported 82 confirmed Ebola infections and 7 deaths, with 177 deaths among suspected cases. The organization says the outbreak remains contained in Uganda for now, despite linked cases associated with travelers from the DRC. WHO also announced the use of an experimental antiviral drug called Obildesvir for contacts of confirmed cases, aiming to curb transmission while vigilance remains high and authorities warn that the number of infections could rise in the near term.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がコンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行リスクレベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者82名、死亡7名（疑い例含む177名死亡）が報告され、WHOがリスク「非常に高い」に引き上げた。DRCで確認された症例に加えウガンダへの波及も報告され、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、また公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCからの旅行者に関連した症例としてのみ言及されており、ウガンダ国内での活発な流行報告ではない。したがって、実際の流行地域はDRCのみとして verified_locations に含める。ただし、ウガンダへの波及リスクは IHR基準「国際的拡大」に含めて評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Mundial 2026: Ébola obriga RD Congo a isolamento para participar na prova | MAISFUTEBOL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: Ebola Forces DR Congo Into Isolation to Participate in the Tournament
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo national football team must remain in a 21-day sanitary bubble to prevent Ebola transmission ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States. The isolation should begin this Friday, with the squad slated to reach Houston by 11 June. White House official Andrew Giuliani warns that any symptomatic player could jeopardize the entire delegation’s participation; if additional personnel join the team, they must stay in a separate bubble. DR Congo is in Group K alongside Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan, and will face Portugal in their tournament opener on 17 June. The plan underscores infection-control measures for Ebola during the event, though no confirmed cases within the team are reported.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026：エボラがコンゴ民主共和国をトーナメント参加のため隔離を余儀なくさせる
triage.triage_reason: 記事は仮想的なワールドカップシナリオ（2026年5月）に関するもので、実際の感染症イベントではなく、予防的な感染対策措置の報道である。DRC内での実際のエボラ確認症例は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す具体的証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のエボラ流行ではなく、2026年のワールドカップに向けたDRCチームの予防的な隔離措置に関するスポーツニュースである。DRC内でのエボラ確認症例は記載されていない。将来予測シナリオまたは仮想シナリオとして扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Voetballers Congo moeten voor WK 21 dagen in quarantaine vanwege ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese footballers must quarantine for 21 days ahead of the World Cup due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Congolese footballers must undergo a 21-day quarantine ahead of the World Cup due to an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Andrew Giuliani, head of the White House World Cup task force, told ESPN that measures aim to prevent disease entry at borders. The outbreak prompted the cancellation of Congo’s planned three‑day training camp and a fan farewell in Kinshasa, linked to the eastern DRC outbreak. The piece highlights preventive travel restrictions and event cancellations related to Ebola in the eastern region; it provides no case counts. Focus remains on safeguarding against cross-border spread ahead of international competition.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのサッカー選手はエボラの影響で，ワールドカップ前に21日間の隔離が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルスの国境外への拡大防止のための国家規模の渡航制限・イベント中止が実施されており、国際的公衆衛生上の懸念が顕著である。
triage.notes: 記事では東部DRC（東カサイ州等の推定）でのエボラアウトブレイクが言及されており、首都キンシャサでの対策（選手隔離、トレーニングキャンプ中止）が実施されている。米国は記事発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリーでは米国での発生ではなく米国による国際的防疫対応が述べられているため verified_locations から除外。症例数など具体的数値が記事に記載されていない点は注意。

article.articleHeadline: MS fotbal | USA požadují, aby fotbalisté Konga kvůli ebole strávili 21 dnů v izolaci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup football | USA demand that Congolese footballers spend 21 days in isolation due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has spread to Uganda; WHO reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths in the current outbreak. The United States has barred entry for people who have visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. Congolese national team, training in Belgium, must complete a 21-day isolation in a closed bubble before arriving in Houston on June 11 to prepare for friendlies with Denmark and Chile. The World Cup, hosted by Canada, the United States and Mexico, opens June 17 in Houston with Congo facing Portugal, then Uzbekistan and Colombia in the group stage. Congo canceled a planned three-day training camp in Kinshasa. Andrew Giuliani, head of the White House task force for the tournament, said the 21-day bubble must be strictly followed to protect Americans, teams and fans.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップサッカー | エボラ熱のため、コンゴ人選手は21日間の隔離を要求される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染拡大（東部コンゴからウガンダへの拡大）、750件の疑い症例と177人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）を複数満たす。国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）との関連で社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドには多くの国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東部コンゴでのエボラ発生である。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが対象国リストに未含。米国、ベルギー、カナダ等での報道や対応措置は記載されているものの、これらは発生地ではなく対応地点であるため verified_locations には含めない。DRC (203312) のみを該当対象国とする。現在の情報レベルでフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bloomberg: у Конго різко погіршується ситуація зі спалахом Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bloomberg: The Ebola outbreak situation in Congo has deteriorated sharply.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has worsened. As of May 21, 2026, 83 confirmed infections, 746 suspected cases, and 1,603 contacts under surveillance; 342 contacts traced. The outbreak spans at least three provinces, with a new case near Bukavu on the Rwanda border; earlier cases were reported in Uganda. WHO says the response is hampered by insecurity, displacement, and distrust, with challenges in contact tracing and laboratory diagnostics. About 46% of tests are positive, suggesting many undetected infections. Diagnostic platforms previously used do not consistently detect this Bundibugyo virus strain, and specific tests are scarce. Tensions during control measures include hospital clashes and burning of humanitarian tents. Armed conflict limits humanitarian access. WHO urges expansion of testing, stronger surveillance, and safe humanitarian corridors. Domestic risk: very high; neighboring countries: high; EU risk: very low but monitoring is rising. A Bundibugyo vaccine could be available in six to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: ブルームバーグ: コンゴのエボラアウトブレイク状況が急速に悪化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大（確定83例、疑似746例、接触者1,603名監視中）で、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。複数州での流行、国境を越えた症例、ワクチン開発中といった国際的に重要な感染症危機。
triage.notes: ウガンダとルワンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリー上で「earlier cases were reported in Uganda」との言及があり、他国への波及を示唆している。ただし主要な発生はDRC（南キブ州）であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株の診断困難性と異なるウイルス株であることが対応の複雑化要因として重要。

article.articleHeadline: നാഗാലാൻഡിൽ ആഫ്രിക്കൻ പന്നിപ്പനി പടരുന്നു; പ്രതിരോധ നടപടികൾ ശക്തമാക്കി, പല ജില്ലകളിലും പന്നിയിറച്ചി വില്പന നിരോധിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever spreading in Nagaland; preventive measures intensified, sale of pig feed banned in several districts.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks continue in Nagaland, India, with Dimapur reporting confirmed infection in Signal Angami village and Kohima noting sustained transmission. Preventive measures have been intensified across districts, including bans on pig imports/exports and strict controls on the movement, sale, and slaughter of pigs and pig products. Mon district has imposed a temporary ban on pork sales, while other districts such as Niuland, Peren, Mokokchung, and Dimapur have similar restrictions; Kohima and surrounding areas have seen pig shop closures on Saturdays. In Dimapur, the infected area and surrounding surveillance zone have been declared, with restrictions on killing and transport of pigs. In Medziphema Subdivision (Dimapur) and Mokokchung’s Tuli Subdivision (Chumgtiy, Kangtsungyinsen villages, and Tuli Town), authorities prohibit slaughter and sale without authorization and advise avoiding pork purchases. ASF is highly contagious among pigs but not transmissible to humans, causing economic losses to pig traders and farmers; public health risk remains low, with calls to report suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランドでアフリカ豚熱が拡大；予防措置を強化、複数地区で豚飼料販売禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は動物疾病であり、人への感染性はなく公衆衛生への直接的な影響は低い。しかし地域内での持続的な感染確認と多地区への拡大、経済的影響、動物衛生上の懸念から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは豚など家畜に対する病原体であり、人への感染リスクはない。ナガランド州の複数地区（ディマプル、コヒマ、モコックチュン、ペレン等）で確認されており、地域的には拡大傾向。政府による移動・販売制限措置が講じられている。動物衛生上のシグナルであり、公衆衛生IHR基準への該当性は低いが、地域での持続的感染と多地区拡大から経過観察が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: أستاذ علم جراثيم: تأخر اكتشاف سلالة "بونديبوجيو" وراء الارتفاع الحاد فى إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor of Microbiology: The delayed discovery of the Bundibugyo strain behind the sharp rise in Ebola cases in Congo - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Dr. Mahmoud Halblab, Professor of Microbiology, explains that the WHO's Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration expands intervention and support powers for Congo to contain Ebola. In the past 24 hours, WHO raised the Congo outbreak risk to very high, though global risk remains low. The first death in the Ituri outbreak was recorded on April 20, but official confirmation was delayed by about 25 days due to diagnostic challenges. Samples were sent to a Kinshasa laboratory roughly 1,600 kilometers away, delaying identification of the rare Bundibugyo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) strain. The delay appears to have facilitated a sharp rise in cases; Bundibugyo is reported for the third time in Ebola history. Experts warn the crisis could last months, calling for intensified surveillance, earlier diagnostics, stronger healthcare infrastructure, and rapid interventions to prevent spread to other parts of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 微生物学教授：「ブンディブギョ」株の発見遅延がコンゴのエボラ患者数の急増の原因 - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の国際的関心の高い稀な株がDRCで検出・確認されており、WHO PHEIC宣言がなされている。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、重症度）及びWPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（キンシャサ市及びイトゥリ州）での確認されたエボラ・ブンディブギョ株発生を主題としている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、診断遅延（約25日間）による急速な感染拡大が指摘されている。エボラ史上3度目のBundibugyo株検出であり、稀有性が高い。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: India Issues Ebola Health Advisory For Travellers: What To Know About The Bundibugyo Virus
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggers India's DGHS advisory, with heightened airport screening for travellers from high-risk nations including DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. Delhi airport is targeted; travellers from affected regions undergo fever screening and symptom checks for 21 days after travel, with thermal screening and health checks at arrivals. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, vomiting, diarrhoea, sore throat, muscle pain, fatigue, weakness, and unexplained bleeding. Travellers should report symptoms immediately and share travel history; isolation protocols and emergency preparedness are in place at designated hospitals. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola strain identified in Uganda in 2007; unlike Zaire, there are no licensed vaccines or targeted antivirals for Bundibugyo in the article. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces, not airborne. WHO lists DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as high-risk, and India reports no Ebola case so far; monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: インドが渡航者向けエボラ健康勧告を発表：ブンディブギョウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョウエボラウイルスの発生がDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンで確認され、インドが公式な健康勧告と空港スクリーニング措置を発令。IHR基準で国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも管理可能性（国際サーベイランス・対策）が明確。フルリスク評価（RRA）に進む必要あり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはDeli（India）が含まれているが、サマリーではインドはブンディブギョウエボラの発生国ではなく、勧告・対応措置を発令している国として述べられている。実際の発生地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであり、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。しかしインドは公式勧告を発令した国として対象国リストに含まれているため、WPRO地域の関心事として verified_locations に含める。ブンディブギョウはザイールエボラと異なり罹患者情報が限定的だが、病原性と人間-人間感染経路が確認されている稀な株（2007年ウガンダで初同定）。

article.articleHeadline: La nouvelle épidémie d'Ebola, entre inquiétudes et riposte (le point santé)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new Ebola outbreak, between concerns and a response (the health section).
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, has prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16. Deaths total 150–177 (suspected and confirmed), with roughly 750 suspected cases since the alert from Mongbwalu, Ituri. Uganda reports 12 imported cases and two deaths in Kampala. A US physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, infected at Nyankunde Hospital near Bunia, was evacuated to Berlin for high-security care. The response includes rapid logistics—11.5 tons of supplies delivered within 72 hours from Kinshasa, Dakar, and Nairobi; 35+ experts deployed; MONUSCO air support; Ethiopian Airlines transport; emphasis on contact tracing, supportive care, infection prevention, and community outreach. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; experimental vaccines are under evaluation by Africa CDC, Gavi, WHO, UNICEF, and partners. US aid cuts are cited as weakening outbreak surveillance and response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱の流行、懸念と対応の間で（保健情報）
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo）による150-177名の死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への国際的拡大、米国医師の国際輸送と高度対応が確認される。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで抽出された発生地域にはベルリン（ドイツ）、ナイロビ（ケニア）、ダカール（セネガル）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではこれらは医療移送先、ロジスティック拠点、またはモニタリング参照地点として機能しており、実際のエボラ発生地点ではない。verified_locationsはDRCとウガンダのみに限定した。ワクチン未承認、Bundibugyo型の高致死率、治療法不足が管理困難性を増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka Steps Up Surveillance After WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak Global Health Emergency
article.articleSummary: Karnataka has intensified Ebola surveillance following the World Health Organization’s declaration of an ongoing Ebola Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. In Bengaluru, the Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Chest Diseases (RGICD) is the isolation centre and the Epidemic Diseases Hospital the quarantine and treatment facility; in Mangaluru, Srinivas Port Hospital (NMPA) is the quarantine centre and Wenlock District Hospital the isolation and treatment facility. Suspected-case samples are sent to NIV Bengaluru for confirmatory testing at NIV Pune. India has reported no Ebola cases so far. Returning travelers from Ebola-affected countries should self-monitor for 21 days and report symptoms promptly. Preparedness covers IDSP surveillance, airport/PoE coordination, PPE stocks, laboratory capacity, training, rapid-response teams, and ready isolation facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラアウトブレイク世界公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言後、カルナタカ州が監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR 基準において「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」の3基準に該当し、WHO PHEIC 宣言後の能動的監視拡大という重要な公衆衛生対応が報告されている。インドでは未検出だが、DRC/ウガンダでの PHEIC 認定により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事主題はインドにおけるエボラ監視強化。DRC・ウガンダはエボラ発生国として言及されているが、記事の地理的焦点はインド。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。WHO PHEIC 宣言は 2026 年 5 月 17 日付。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandassa kolme uutta ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases in Uganda raise the total confirmed cases to five as of May 23, 2026. The newly identified cases are a Ugandan driver who transported the country’s first confirmed patient, a healthcare worker who was exposed while caring for that patient, and a Congolese woman. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. The epidemic is active in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Last week, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring the international health risk posed by the cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで3つの新しいエボラ症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言しているエボラ出血熱の国境を越えた拡大。ワクチンなし、治療法なし、ヒト-ヒト感染性の高い重篤疾患。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーおよびWHO声明によると、ウガンダでの症例確認はDRC由来のBundibugyo ebolavirus による。発生地域にはウガンダ（ID: 226074）も記載されているが、対象国リスト外であるため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、これを verified_location として列挙。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: OMS vê risco muito alto em surto de Ebola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees very high risk in Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO raises Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo to very high risk. As of the report, 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, spanning North Kivu and South Kivu along the front line with M23. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the epidemic is spreading rapidly. A U.S. citizen was evacuated to the Czech Republic as a high‑risk contact, with another U.S. patient treated in Germany. The circulating variant is Bundibugyo, with a mortality of 30–50%; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WFP warns that without a rapid, large‑scale international response, health crises could worsen food insecurity in the region. UN OCHA has allocated $60 million to the response, supplementing WHO’s $3.9 million emergency fund. Bunia, Ituri Province, is the epicenter, with 46 tons of supplies distributed; $23 million is urgently needed to assist over 146,000 people in Ituri over three months. UN Women notes women are disproportionately affected in Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で非常に高いリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認症例82名、死亡7名、疑い例750名以上の大規模流行で、Bundibugyo型（致死率30-50%）、ワクチン・特異的治療なし、急速な拡大、国際的対応が進行中。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は南キブ州・イトゥリ州（ブニア中心）でのエボラ流行を報告。米国市民がチェコに疑い接触者として搬送、ドイツでも患者治療中と記載されているが、実際の症例発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ドイツ・チェコは患者搬送先であり、本流行の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHO事務局長による警告、UN資金配分、急速な拡大報告により社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus Symptoms: इबोला वायरस के क्या हैं लक्षण, एक्सपर्ट से जानें बचाव के तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus Symptoms: What are the symptoms of the Ebola virus? Learn prevention methods from experts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus infection presents in India with initial symptoms resembling a viral fever. In Gorakhpur, patients may experience high fever, severe headache, muscle and body pains, weakness, sore throat, and extreme fatigue. As the illness progresses, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and in some cases internal or external bleeding can occur. Transmission occurs through direct contact with an infected person or their bodily fluids. Prevention hinges on avoiding contact with infected individuals or their fluids and using protective gear such as masks, gloves, and other PPE when caregiving. Regular handwashing with soap and water or sanitizer is essential. Suspected cases should be isolated and evaluated promptly by a clinician. Travelers returning from Ebola-affected regions should monitor health closely. Timely recognition and precaution are emphasized over alarm.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス症状：エボラウイルスの症状は何か、専門家から予防方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラウイルス感染について症状と予防方法を説明する記事。症例の具体的な発生状況や重症度の詳細が不明であり、情報不足のため段階的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は教育的な内容（症状と予防方法の説明）であり、確認された症例数や死亡情報が記載されていない。ゴラクプルおよびハリヤナ州での発生状況の詳細が不明確。警報的な記述よりも啓発的なトーンが強い。続報による確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN Allocates $60 Million From Emergency Fund To Combat Ebola Outbreak In Congo
article.articleSummary: UN allocates up to $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to accelerate the Ebola response in Congo and the wider region, targeting the Bundibugyo strain for which no licensed vaccines or treatments exist. The UN says conflict and high population movement complicate access, and it seeks safe, sustained access by responders across air, land and water routes, including areas controlled by armed groups. Containment depends on rapid, coordinated community action, strong government communication, and effective early warning and detection systems. Teams from the UN, Congo, Uganda and South Sudan are being deployed to reinforce the effort. Norway contributes 50 million NOK to WHO’s Contingency Fund for Emergencies after confirmed imported cases in Uganda, with WHO already disbursing $3.9 million. WHO risk is very high nationally, high regionally, low globally. No case/death counts are provided; imported cases in Uganda are noted.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴのエボラ出血熱対策にために緊急基金から6000万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された発生であり、IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認と地域的脅威により即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にコンゴでのエボラ発生を主題としており、ウガンダでの輸入症例確認も言及されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。ノルウェーとスーダンは資金提供・支援国として登場するが疾病発生地ではないため除外。記事の「スーダン南部」への展開言及もあるが南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo株による無認可病原体での高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде выявили новые случаи заражения лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, new cases of Ebola virus disease have been detected.
