article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتجاوز جهود الاحتواء في شرق الكونغو مع تعثر تتبع المخالطين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outpaces containment efforts in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as contact tracing falters
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing containment as contact tracing falters. As of May 21, 83 confirmed cases and 746 suspected, with 1,603 contacts identified but only about 21% traced. The outbreak spans three provinces, including South Kivu, with a Bukavu-area case near the Rwanda border and earlier Uganda cases. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency; risk inside DRC is very high and regional risk is elevated. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccines or therapies and may have circulated undetected for months in Ituri. Uganda tightened borders; Rwanda increased screening and will quarantine most foreigners who visited Congo. More than 11 tonnes of emergency supplies were airlifted to Bunia. Transmission now extends beyond Mongbalo to Nyankondi, with 11 confirmed and 340 contacts; lab capacity is limited.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国東部の封じ込め努力を上回る、接触者追跡が停滞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の異常事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大、接触者追跡システムの崩壊により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（South Kivu、Ituri州）でのエボラ爆発を主題とし、ウガンダおよびルワンダでの対応（国境強化、スクリーニング強化）も記載されているが、確認された症例はDRC内に限定。RwandaおよびUgandaのGeoNames IDは発生地域に含まれるがverified_locationsには含めない（主要な発生地はDRCのため）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、接触者追跡の21%という低い完了率が管理可能性を著しく低下させており、国際的な支援体制構築が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma tres nuevos casos de ébola por el brote en la vecina República del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms three new cases of Ebola linked to the outbreak in the neighboring Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) outbreak, as the DRC outbreak nears 180 suspected deaths and about 750 possible cases, prompting WHO concern. The three Ugandan infections follow earlier reports of a suspected death and one imported case later ruled negative. The new cases comprise a driver, a health care worker who treated the first confirmed Ugandan case from DRC, and a Congolese woman; all contacts tied to confirmed cases have been identified and are under close monitoring. Authorities urge calm, vigilance, and adherence to preventive measures. Ebola’s case fatality averages around 50%, with early symptoms including fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle and throat pain, then vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and renal/hepatic deterioration. The DRC ended its Kasai outbreak in December 2025 and remains highly experienced in Ebola response; the virus was identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国の流行に関連したエボラウイルス病の新規症例3件を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ全て該当。対象地域DRC・ウガンダで実際に発生している。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの新規症例確認を報道しているが、サマリーの主軸はDRC流行との関連性であり、ウガンダはWHO通知対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC側での流行（180人の疑い死亡、約750の可能性のある症例）が主要なシグナル。Kasai地区での流行が2025年12月に終息と記載されているが、本報は2026年5月の新規発生であり、地理的リスクが継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandans rue link to Bundibugyo, the Ebola virus type named after a district of cocoa farmers
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus, identified in 2007 and named for Bundibugyo district in western Uganda, underlies Congo’s eastern outbreak, with hundreds infected and 160 suspected deaths across two provinces. Uganda reports five cases linked to Congo; one 59-year-old Congolese man was admitted to Kampala on May 11 and died three days later. Laboratory-confirmed infections among two Ugandan residents—a driver and a health worker—and two Congolese women who sought care in Uganda before Congo declared the outbreak on May 15. Uganda maintains there is no Ebola in the country; WHO manages taxonomic naming to avoid stigmatization. The Congo-side outbreak has prompted border controls, suspension of transport between countries, and a postponed religious event near Kampala by June 3. Bundibugyo virus does not have licensed vaccines or treatments; containment relies on contact tracing, isolation and PPE. Fruit bats are its natural hosts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ人はココア農家地区にちなんで名付けられたエボラウイルスの種であるブンディブギョとの関連性を嘆く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスの多国境流行で、DRC東部とウガンダで数百人の感染者と160人の疑い死亡が報告されており、重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる流行がDRCの東部（複数州）で主に発生しており、ウガンダへの流入が報告されている。Bluedot APIが付与した地域（Central Region, Kampala, DRC, Uganda）のうち、実際の感染症イベント発生国はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リスト内ではDRC (203312) が該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題は多国境流行であり、DRCが対象国であるため verified_locations に DRC を含める。ワクチンや治療法がないため公衆衛生上の脅威は極めて大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, bringing total to five
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, bringing the current outbreak total to five. The Bundibugyo strain has been declared a World Health Organization public health emergency of international concern, with Congo facing a very high risk of national spread; in the DRC, about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported. The new Ugandan cases include a driver who transported the first patient and a health worker exposed during care, both identified among known contacts and receiving treatment. The third case is a Congolese woman who entered Uganda with mild abdominal symptoms, traveled from Arua to Entebbe and Kampala, briefly improved, then returned to Congo before testing positive after a tip-off from a transport pilot. All contacts are under close monitoring as contact tracing is intensified to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ患者3人を確認、累計患者数は5人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の集団発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダのエボラ患者確認を主題としているが、Bluedot APIの地域フィールドにはウガンダが国コードで含まれておらず、対象国リストに該当しない。ただしDRCは対象国であり、記事でも約750の疑い患者と177死亡が報告されている。国境を越えた伝播リスク、国際的な懸念事項の高さから医学的・公衆衛生学的には極めて重要なシグナル。対象国外での発生であるが、隣接国での一連の流行として区域的リスク評価の対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Frka pred Mundijal: Ebola ušla u učesnika Svetskog prvenstva, moraće u izolaciju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hype ahead of the World Cup: Ebola has entered a World Cup participant and will have to be quarantined.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo national football team has confirmed Ebola infections amid preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. To enter the United States (Houston), players must undergo a 21-day isolation; entry without compliance will be denied. U.S. officials granted a narrow exemption from the 21-day ban for travelers who visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days. The team canceled the Kinshasa training camp and relocated to Belgium; European friendlies will still proceed. The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has caused over 130 deaths. DR Congo qualified for the World Cup for the first time in 52 years, with scheduled matches against Denmark on June 3 in Belgium and Chile on June 9 in Spain as part of their lead-up international fixtures.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ前の問題：エボラがワールドカップ参加国に侵入、隔離対象となる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例であり、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）が該当。コンゴ民主共和国での発生と国際スポーツイベント関連による国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはHoustonやTexasが記載されているが、記事サマリーではこれらの地域での感染発生ではなく、DRC代表チームの選手がエボラに感染し米国入国時に隔離されるという状況。実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国の東部。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラの流行による130人以上の死者が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生危機と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија во Африка: САД и СЗО со засилени мерки поради ширење на еболата - Pari.com.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic in Africa: the US and the WHO with intensified measures due to the spread of Ebola - Pari.com.mk
article.articleSummary: US CDC imposes temporary entry restrictions on foreign nationals and non-immigrant residents who traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last 21 days, due to an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. US citizens are exempt but face enhanced health screening at designated airports. The measure is time-limited and public-health oriented. WHO warns the outbreak is rapidly expanding in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with severely limited capacity for contact tracing and testing. Data show dozens of confirmed cases, hundreds of suspected infections, and thousands under surveillance, with many contacts untraceable. Transmission is complicated by insecurity, armed groups, and restricted access to affected areas. Provinces in DRC and Uganda report cases; isolation and safety measures have sparked incidents and damage to health facilities. WHO assigns very high risk for Congo, high risk for neighboring countries, with rising global risk and intensified surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの感染症流行：エボラ感染拡大により米国とWHOが強化対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な地域拡大、国際的な移動制限措置、WHOによる高リスク評価があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにUganda、South Sudanの言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。米国の措置は地域外の対応であり発生地ではない。Bundibugyo strain によるエボラ出血熱で、ワクチンなし、接触追跡困難、数十件の確定例と数百件の疑い例、数千人が監視対象という深刻な状況。WHOはコンゴで非常に高リスク、近隣国で高リスク、世界的リスク上昇を評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO keluar amaran tertinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO issues the highest alert.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization has raised the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to the highest alert level. The Bundibugyo strain, linked to fruit bats, has 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 deaths in Kinshasa, with around 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. Uganda reports two travel-related cases from Kinshasa and one associated death. Regional risk remains high, global risk remains low. The virus presents early symptoms hard to distinguish from malaria or typhoid fever, enabling silent spread; no vaccine or specific treatment exists. With limited options, authorities are prioritizing evaluation of existing therapies and rigorous contact tracing with a 21-day isolation for close contacts to break transmission. Officials note increasing case counts reflect active surveillance working, while stressing the outbreak remains a pressing challenge.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが最高警戒レベルを発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与え、複数国での症例報告、高い死亡率、ワクチン不在で国際的拡大リスクが高く、WHOが最高警戒レベルを発令している状況であり、フルRRAを優先実施すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの関連症例が言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生であり、DRCのみを対象国として含める。Bundibugyo株による最初の大規模アウトブレイクであることが注記される。ワクチン不在、診断困難性、国際拡大リスク、WHOによる最高警戒レベル発令という要素が複合的にリスクを増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: Trei noi infectări confirmate cu Ebola în Uganda. Totalul a ajuns la cinci cazuri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola infections confirmed in Uganda. The total has reached five cases.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola infections confirmed in Uganda, bringing the national total to five as of May 23, 2026. Uganda reported three additional cases after two cases detected on May 15 (one fatal). The new infections include a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed patient in-country; a medical worker infected while caring for that patient; and a Congolese woman who arrived in Uganda by plane. All contacts linked to confirmed cases have been identified and are monitored, and the Ugandan cases are being treated. Uganda suspended all public transport to the Democratic Republic of Congo due to cross-border risk. The World Health Organization warns of a 'very high' public health risk related to the Congo outbreak, which is the epicenter of the epidemic. As of May 23, 2026, nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are reported in DRC. There is no vaccine; containment relies on barrier measures and rapid case detection.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ感染が3件新たに確認。総数は5件に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラの国際的な拡大を示す初の二次感染とウガンダへの越境伝播が確認され、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCでの爆発的な流行（約750疑い例、177死亡）からの越境伝播事例として極めて重要。医療従事者への感染、国境を越えた空輸による感染、公共交通の停止等、複数の懸念要素がある。WHOが『極度に高い』リスク評価を発出。ワクチン未利用で封じ込めに高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma identifica en las últimas horas tres casos de ébola por el brote en la vecina RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms three Ebola cases identified in the last few hours linked to the outbreak in the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda’s Ministry of Health confirms three new Ebola cases linked to the outbreak declared this month in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The DRC outbreak has produced nearly 180 suspected deaths and about 750 possible cases in the neighboring country. Last Thursday, a health official reported the death of a person suspected of having Ebola and a second suspected imported case that was later confirmed negative. The three newly confirmed Ugandan cases are a driver, a health worker who attended to the first confirmed case in Uganda from the DRC, and a Congolese woman; all are under medical care. All contacts linked to confirmed cases have been identified and are being closely monitored by response teams. Authorities urge calm, vigilance, and continued adherence to preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが隣国コンゴ民主共和国の流行に関連したエボラ出血熱の3症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大が確認された。DRCでの大規模流行（疑い死亡180人以上、疑い症例750人以上）からウガンダへの感染確認により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、渡航・貿易制限のリスクも高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはUgandaも発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの大規模流行宣言であり、ウガンダの症例は「輸入例」として報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、国際的拡大の事実自体はシグナルとしての重要性が高く、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo: Die Suche nach Patient 0
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: The search for Patient Zero.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s eastern Ituri region, with Bunia as epicenter, reports 82 confirmed Ebola cases, about 750 suspected infections awaiting lab results, and 177 deaths across three provinces along Uganda and Rwanda borders (as of 23 May 2026). The first positive case is a Congolese nurse in Bunia on 24 April; the transmission origin remains unidentified, with investigations likely spanning months. The war-torn setting hampers surveillance, and attacks on Ebola clinics have escalated risk, prompting WHO to classify the threat as very high. Uganda is reinstating Ebola precautions at airports, border crossings, schools, churches, and government buildings. Uganda’s UVRI has sequenced the current Bundibugyo variant, a rare lineage, and found no link to strains circulating last year, implying a possible independent zoonotic spillover. The UN commits $60 million for relief; multinational teams are deploying to establish treatment and quarantine centers in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：患者ゼロの捜索
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。82例の確定患者、177人の死亡、750件の疑い例という深刻な影響を持つエボラアウトブレイク。WHO分類は「非常に高いリスク」で、WHOが国際的に通知すべき状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、DRコンゴ東部Ituri地域（Bunia中心）でのエボラ発生を主題としており、Ituri州とBuniaの地名が明記されている。Ugandaはボーダー対応を実施中だが、確定患者の報告はDRコンゴのみ。Ugandaは対象国リストに未登録のため、verified_locationsにはDRC（ID: 203312）のみを含める。RwandaもBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、国対象リストに未登録のため除外。Bundibugyo変異体の同定、WHO高リスク分類、UN$60M投入、多国籍チーム展開など、国際的対応が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Nỗi lo dịch Ebola lan rộng trong thời gian diễn ra World Cup 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of the Ebola outbreak spreading during the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus with 139 deaths and over 600 suspected cases under testing; no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, the highest level, noting vaccine development could take months. The outbreak threatens World Cup 2026 preparations as Congo—participating for the first time since 1974—moved training from Kinshasa to Belgium. The United States imposes strict entry controls, including a 21-day quarantine in Belgium before entering the U.S. for the Houston kickoff on June 17 against Portugal, with violations potentially barring participation. The CDC has a 30-day entry ban for foreign nationals who have recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. Uganda confirms two Ebola cases and has closed several Congo border crossings; Semliki River transport is suspended. Congo’s World Cup schedule begins June 17 vs Portugal in Houston, followed by Colombia and Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ開催期間中のエボラ出血熱の流行拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的脅威、複数国への拡大、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施中）、かつWPRO基準においても重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性に該当。WHOが最高レベル（PHEIC）を宣言した緊急事態であり、国際的な関心と支援が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）が主たる事例。ウガンダでも2例確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行。米国・ベルギー・ポルトガルなどでの措置は対応国であり、実際の発生地ではない。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、139死亡、600以上の疑い例という深刻な状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Mokslininkai perspėja: kai kurie augalų grybeliai jau gali užkrėsti ir žmones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists warn: some plant fungi can already infect humans.
article.articleSummary: Some plant pathogens—fungi, bacteria, and plant viruses—rarely infect humans, but cases have been reported. In 2023, Indian doctors documented the first known human infection with the plant fungus Chondrostereum purpureum, causing a tracheal abscess in a 61-year-old plant mycologist after prolonged exposure; antifungal therapy led to full recovery. Plant-associated bacteria include Pantoea agglomerans (rice, corn, sorghum), which can cause septicemia in immunocompromised patients; Burkholderia can infect onion and rice rot and has caused pneumonia or sepsis in people with cystic fibrosis; Pseudomonas aeruginosa has affected hospitalized patients. Plant viruses detected in humans include pepper mild mottle virus RNA in over 400 human stool samples (French researchers); some individuals had fever and itching, but causality is unproven. Tobacco mosaic virus traces have been found in smokers and in some lung cancer biopsies, with no evidence of cancer causation. Climate change may heighten future risk as pathogens adapt to warmer conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が警告：一部の植物真菌はすでに人間に感染する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 植物由来病原体の人への感染事例報告は興味深いが、メリオイドーシスの発生シグナルではなく、むしろ植物病原体の人獣共通感染リスク啓発記事であり、現在進行中の流行の証拠がない。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事タイトルは「Melioidosis」を指していないが、Bluedot APIは誤ってMelioidosisを疾患名として分類した可能性がある。実際の記事内容は、Chondrostereum purpureum、Burkholderia、Pseudomonas aeruginosa、Pantoea agglomerans、ペッパーマイルドモットルウイルスなど複数の植物由来病原体の人への感染リスクについての警告・啓発記事である。インドでは2023年にChondrostereum purpureum感染が1例報告されているが、これは流行ではなく孤発例。フランスではペッパーマイルドモットルウイルスRNAが検出されているが、因果関係は証明されていない。現時点で公衆衛生上の急切な脅威を示す証拠はないが、新興人獣共通感染症リスクとしての科学的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Uganda reports three new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases, raising confirmed infections to five. The two Ugandan cases are a driver who transported the first confirmed patient and a health worker exposed while caring for that patient; both were identified from contacts already under follow-up and are receiving treatment. The third case is a Congolese woman who entered Uganda from the DRC with mild abdominal symptoms. She traveled from Arua to Entebbe on a charter flight, then sought care at a private Kampala hospital on 10 May and was discharged on 14 May before returning to the DRC. A sample tested positive after authorities received information from the pilot who airlifted the patient. All contacts have been identified and are being monitored; Public is advised to observe preventive measures and report symptoms promptly. Authorities continue to strengthen surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルス病の新規3症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な多国間イベント（ウガンダ・DRC間の越境感染）で、IHR基準2つ以上該当、重症感染症の社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCとウガンダの間の越境感染イベントが明確に述べられている。Bluedot APIが付与した「発生地域」にはウガンダの複数地点（Kampala、Arua、Entebbe等）が含まれているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ただし、このイベントはウガンダとDRCの両国における公衆衛生上の重大事象であり、フルRRA実施が必須。DRCでの発生確認と、ウガンダへの越境感染の両面がある。

article.articleHeadline: Una organización yihadista vinculada a Estado Islámico asesina al menos a 17 cristianos en el Congo en medio de la crisis del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A jihadist organization linked to the Islamic State kills at least 17 Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid the Ebola crisis.
article.articleSummary: On May 19, in Mambasa territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, attackers linked to ISIS via the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) killed at least 17 Christians and burned homes in Alima and nearby Manyama. The toll is provisional with many missing; attackers split into eastern and western groups toward Alima/Babila Babombi. The attack amplifies fear in a region already beset by weeks of violence attributed to the ADF. Simultaneously, an ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri province worsens conditions as communities are advised to avoid movement, maintain distance, and handwash; such precautions are increasingly impossible for those fleeing, displaced in forests without potable water or timely medical care, heightening risks of disease transmission and insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: イスラム国系組織がコンゴで少なくとも17人のキリスト教徒を殺害、エボラ危機の中で
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の既存アウトブレイクが進行中でDRCのイトゥリ州で確認されているが、本記事の主たる焦点は武装勢力による暴力行為である。エボラとの関連性は二次的（避難民の移動制限とそれによる感染リスク増加への言及）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な直接的影響の詳細が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は武装勢力による暴力行為であるが、進行中のエボラウイルス疾患アウトブレイク（イトゥリ州）が言及されており、避難民の移動制限がウイルス伝播リスクを増加させる可能性が指摘されている。エボラの臨床的詳細や症例数は記事に含まれていない。WPROスクリーニング基準では、長期曝露（避難民が不衛生な環境に置かれる）と流行しやすさ（移動制限下での疾病伝播リスク）が該当するが、情報不足のため正確な公衆衛生影響の評価ができない。続報でエボラ関連の具体的データが追加される場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Νέος συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα: Χωρίς εμβόλιο το στέλεχος που "χτυπά" - Τι ισχύει για την Ευρώπη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New alert about Ebola: The strain that's hitting with no vaccine - What this means for Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain) with confirmed cases in Ituri and North Kivu; Uganda reports two imported cases from DRC. By 20 May 2026, nearly 600 suspected infections and 139 deaths have been recorded. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo. Transmission requires direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, dead or alive. For the EU/EEA, risk to the general population remains very low; higher risk for humanitarian workers and healthcare professionals, assuming proper protections. The most likely entry into Europe would be via a traveler from affected areas, though such introductions are rare. No routine border entry screening is recommended; emphasis on exit screening and traveler information. Returning travelers from red zones who develop compatible symptoms within 21 days should self-isolate, seek care, and inform clinicians of travel history. Surveillance and risk assessments continue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の新たな警告：ワクチンのないウイルス株が流行 - ヨーロッパへの影響は
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（600感染疑い、139死亡）、ワクチン未対応株による予想外の危機、複数国への国際拡大（DRC→ウガンダ、欧州への侵入リスク）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの輸入症例報告があるが、本格的な流行は DRC 限定。DRC は対象国リストに含まれる。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はザイールエボラより致命率は低いが、ワクチン未対応であり深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。欧州への侵入リスクはまだ低いとの評価だが、継続的な監視が必須。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: "PLAŠIM SE JER LJUDI UMIRU VEOMA BRZO" Smrtonosna bolest se širi munjevito, rizik je "veoma visok", SAD proširile zabranu ulaska u zemlju za OVE LJUDE (FOTO)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "I'm afraid because people are dying very quickly" A deadly disease is spreading rapidly, the risk is very high, the U.S. has expanded the entry ban to these people (PHOTO).
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has prompted WHO to raise the regional risk from high to very high, while global risk remains low. The eastern DR Congo outbreak has 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths, with 177 suspected deaths and 750 suspected infections reported. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death linked to travel from DR Congo; the situation there is described as stable. There is no proven vaccine, but Oxford University is developing a candidate vaccine based on the AstraZeneca platform, with animal testing underway and potential clinical trials in 2–3 months; Serum Institute of India plans mass production if material is secured. A Bundibugyo-specific experimental vaccine is also in development, expected 6–9 months to test. Security challenges and violence in rebel-controlled areas hinder response; a hospital near Bunia, Ituri province faced fear and arson. The United States expanded entry restrictions to lawful permanent residents who recently visited DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 「人々が非常に速く亡くなっているので怖い」致命的な病気が急速に蔓延しており、リスクは「非常に高い」、米国は入国禁止を拡大（写真）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの中央アフリカでの流行。WHOが地域リスクを「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げ、確認症例と死亡者が存在し、複数国での報告あり。国際的な拡大リスクおよび米国による入国制限拡大によって、国際的な関心が高まっている。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、ブンディブギョエボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国（東部）で流行しており、ウガンダでも旅行関連症例が報告されている。インド（セラム研究所がワクチン製造を計画）は疾病発生地ではなく、ワクチン開発・製造の関連国として登場している。発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであり、対象国リストではDRCとインドのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Three new Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases have been confirmed in Uganda, raising the total to five since the outbreak was first detected in the east African country on May 15. The patients include a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan health worker, and a woman from the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the outbreak's epicenter. Uganda's health ministry said it is strengthening surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness to contain the outbreak and protect the health and safety of all Ugandans. The World Health Organization has raised the outbreak risk to the highest level for the DRC. A day earlier, Uganda suspended all public transport to the DRC after confirming two cases in crossing Congolese nationals—one infection and one death.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ出血熱の新規確認例3件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い公衆衛生上の影響を伴い、国際的拡大のリスク（DRCから越境感染）が現実化している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認例は5例に達し、DRCからの越境感染が既に発生している。WHOがDRCについて最高レベルのリスク評価を実施。公共交通機関の停止など即座の対策が講じられている。エボラ出血熱の致命性（記事中で死亡例言及）と感染性を考慮すると、域内での迅速な対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Iespējams, būs nopietnāk, nekā likās - šis vīruss sāk izplatīties nekontrolējami
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Perhaps it will be more serious than it seemed — this virus is beginning to spread uncontrollably.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating and spreading across three provinces, with 83 confirmed cases and 746 suspected as of May 21, 2026, according to Bloomberg citing the Ministry of Health. Over 1,600 contacts have been identified but only about 21% have been traced. Cases have also appeared near Rwanda’s border, with isolated infections in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is driven by a rare Ebola virus strain for which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. WHO warns that transmission is outpacing response capabilities. Ongoing conflict, large-scale displacement, and public distrust hamper containment efforts. Some neighboring countries are tightening border controls and imposing additional quarantines to curb cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: おそらくこれまで以上に深刻になるだろう——このウイルスが制御不能に広がり始めている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクが確認された急速な拡大局面であり、IHR基準2つ以上（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当。WHO警告、ワクチン・治療法なし、多国間での境界管理強化など複合的リスク要因あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてRwanda(226074)とUganda(226074)が含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「Cases have also appeared near Rwanda's border, with isolated infections in neighboring Uganda」と記載されており、これらは隣接国での散発的な症例報告であるため、主たる発生国はDRCのみと判断。ただし、国際的な拡大リスクは高い。稀なエボラウイルス株であり、承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がないという深刻な制御困難性が存在。紛争・大規模変位・公的不信が対応能力を大きく阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Potong Hewan Kurban Bisa Picu Infeksi Kulit, Dokter Bagikan Tips Aman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Slaughtering Sacrificial Animals Can Trigger Skin Infections, Doctors Share Safety Tips.
article.articleSummary: During Iduladha slaughtering and meat handling in Indonesia, exposure to blood, feces, and animal body fluids can trigger skin problems and serious infections. Dermatologist Dr. Arini Astasari Widodo urges use of protective gear: waterproof gloves, boots, and long-sleeved clothing; avoid direct contact with blood or body fluids; cover any open wounds with waterproof bandages before starting work. The moist, unhygienic slaughter environment raises risks of impetigo, cellulitis, folliculitis, and skin abscesses; zoonotic infections are possible, though rare, especially with open wounds. Vaccination for tetanus before tasks is advised; avoid touching face; wash hands and cleanse exposed skin immediately after slaughter. For irritation, rinse with running water and mild soap, dry, and moisturize; anti-inflammatory cream may be used if red, painful, or itchy. For bleeding wounds, apply pressure with clean cloth, clean with water and antiseptic, cover with sterile bandage; seek medical care for deep wounds or signs of infection.

triage.headline_ja: 動物の屠殺は皮膚感染症を引き起こす可能性がある、医師が安全なヒントを共有
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は動物の屠殺時の皮膚感染症予防に関する一般的な健康情報であり、破傷風の流行発生や異常事象ではない。既知の予防措置の啓発記事であるため、シグナルとして識別されない。
triage.notes: 本記事はイドゥルアドハ（イスラム教の犠牲祭）時期の動物屠殺に関連する皮膚感染症リスクに関する医師による予防啓発記事である。破傷風を含む既知の感染症が発生しているわけではなく、定期的な季節的啓発と見なされる。疾患カテゴリに『Tetanus』が含まれているが、これは予防対象としての言及であり、実際の患者発生や流行事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo FIFA World Cup 2026 Squad Faces 21-Day Ebola Quarantine Before US Trip | ⚽ LatestLY
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts a 21-day controlled isolation in Belgium for the DR Congo national football team before entering the United States for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. US authorities require the squad to remain in a training “bubble” in Belgium or face denial of entry; they are due to arrive in Houston on June 11 ahead of a June 17 group opener against Portugal. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency, with more than 130 suspected deaths and nearly 600 suspected cases in the DRC. A US travel ban restricting non-US citizens who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days remains, though the Congolese team is exempt from the broader ban provided health checks are met. The outbreak highlights public health risk management amid global sport.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのFIFAワールドカップ2026選手団、米国入国前にエボラ出血熱の21日間隔離に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、600近い疑似患者と130以上の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus のDRC及びウガンダでの多地域流行。WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。米国の渡航制限措置が発動中。記事に記載されたHouston・Belgiumは対象国ではないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダも出現しているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda zaznamenala tri nové prípady nákazy ebolou, celkovo sa tak nakazilo už päť ľudí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reports three new Ebola cases, bringing the total to five people infected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Uganda reports three new infections, bringing total in the country to five. Previously two cases included one death and another who tested negative after treatment. The three new cases comprise a driver who ferried the first confirmed patient, a Ugandan health worker caring for that patient, and a woman from Congo who traveled to Uganda by plane, marking an imported case. The outbreak began in mid-May in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and has spread to Uganda. WHO data released Friday indicate roughly 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 associated deaths linked to the eastern Congo outbreak, with the number of suspected cases continuing to rise. The situation remains very serious, underscoring ongoing cross-border transmission and the need for strengthened surveillance and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ3症例を報告、感染者の合計は5人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた拡大と死亡事例を伴う深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、DRC東部で5月中旬に発生したエボラ感染の国境を越えた拡大事例である。ウガンダへの症例報告（航空機利用の輸入事例を含む）は記述されているが、記事の主題の感染症イベントの発生地（origin）はDRCの東部地域である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）での症例報告も述べられているが、対象国リストの地理的範囲外のため除外した。WHO公式データで750疑い症例、177死亡が東部コンゴの流行に関連付けられており、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda bekrefter tre nye ebolatilfeller
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease cases were confirmed in Uganda, bringing the national total to five, one day after the World Health Organization raised the danger level for the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to the highest level. In DR Congo, the outbreak centered in Ituri Province in the northeast has registered about 750 cases with at least 177 deaths. On 15 May, the Ituri outbreak was confirmed and involves a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The WHO has raised the risk that this variant could develop into a national outbreak in DR Congo to a 'very high' level. The agency has also declared the DR Congo and Uganda outbreaks to be a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ患者3人を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、稀なBundibugyo変異株を伴う地域的流行が確認されている。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (assumed - not in target list but in Bluedot locations)

triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみ対象国として列挙。記事ではPHEIC宣言、稀なBundibugyo Ebola変異株、750例・死者177名のDRC での状況が明記されており、国際的な重大リスクイベント。全評価基準で高リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ cấm nhập cảnh với người mang thẻ xanh về từ nơi có dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bans entry for green-card holders returning from Ebola-affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Green-card holders who have been to Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days are barred from entering the United States, per the CDC on May 22, 2026, extending a 30-day ban first announced on May 18 amid Ebola concerns. Exemptions apply to US citizens and current green-card holders. The administration, signed by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., says the measure balances public health protection with emergency-response resources and acknowledges that lawful permanent residents may maintain closer ties abroad. Separately, USCIS announced changes to green-card policy requiring potential permanent residents to depart the US to file from abroad. The World Health Organization raised the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain outbreak risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'very high' and declared the Congo-Uganda outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱感染地域から帰国した永住権保有者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、および国際的渡航制限措置が複数のIHR基準を満たす。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、シグナルピックアップの基準を明確に満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ出血熱発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO公式声明で「Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）」が宣言され、約750例の疑い患者と177例の死亡が報告されている。米国政府による渡航制限は国際的な対応の一例であり、公衆衛生上の重大な関心事である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: WHO erhöht Ebola-Risikostufe auf "sehr hoch"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: WHO raises Ebola risk level to "Very high".
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the World Health Organization raised the Ebola risk level for the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 'very high' nationally, 'high' regionally, and 'low' globally. In the DRC, 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and seven deaths have been officially recorded, with around 177 deaths unclarified and nearly 750 suspected cases. Across the border in Uganda, three new Ebola cases bring total confirmed Ugandan cases to five, with two linked to the first case. The outbreak response is hampered by decades of armed conflict in eastern DRC, where some areas are controlled by rebel groups and a large internally displaced population lives in crowded camps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHO、エボラリスク段階を「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、確認された死亡・確定患者がいる。WHOリスク評価の格上げにより国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの患者確認も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC に82件の確定患者（7死亡）、約177件の死亡不明、約750件の疑い患者があり、武装勢力による統治地域での対応困難が報告されている。WHOが国家レベルで「非常に高い」と評価した重大なイベント。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Drei neue Ebola-Fälle in Uganda gemeldet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola cases reported in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases were confirmed in Uganda, bringing total confirmed infections to five. Two patients are a driver and a nurse who had contact with the first known Ugandan case last week. The third is a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who flew to Kampala, was treated for abdominal pain, and returned home; a test of her sample was Ebola-positive. All contacts have been identified, monitored, and traced. In DR Congo, the WHO reports about 750 suspected cases and nearly 180 probable deaths, with 83 laboratory-confirmed infections including 9 deaths; the true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is neither a vaccine nor a therapy. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たに3件のエボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間での確認患者発生。IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO全基準該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの新規患者確認と、DRC由来の患者がウガンダで検出されたことを示唆。DRCでは約750件の疑い患者、180件近い死亡が報告されており、対象国リスト内の両国で活動的な感染拡大が確認される。ワクチンおよび治療法が存在しない Bundibugyo エボラウイルス株が原因。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: โควิดในไทย ครึ่งปีป่วย 3 พันราย เตือนหน้าฝนระวัง 3 โรคมัดรวมระบาดในไทย | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in Thailand: 3,000 cases in half a year; as the rainy season approaches, beware of three diseases converging to cause outbreaks in Thailand | Daily News
article.articleSummary: Thailand has recorded 3,007 COVID-19 cases and 1 death from January 1 to May 22, 2026. The NB.8.1.1 Omicron sublineage accounts for about 50% of infections in the country; it is not more severe but may be more transmissible due to immune-escape mutations in the spike protein. As the rainy season approaches, health authorities warn of concurrent outbreaks with influenza and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), with peak activity anticipated in June and RSV typically rising earlier (June–July) and influenza present year-round. COVID-19 vaccination is not included in Thailand’s benefits package and is voluntary with out-of-pocket costs, using primarily mRNA vaccines for high-risk groups rather than the general population. Rapid antigen tests are available for symptomatic individuals; a positive result can be managed with medical follow-up later. Emphasis on masking and hand hygiene to mitigate multiple respiratory pathogens during the season.

triage.headline_ja: タイのCOVID-19：半年で3,000件の感染；雨季が近づくにつれ、3つの病気の併発流行に注意 | デイリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるCOVID-19、インフルエンザ、RSVの複合的な呼吸器感染症の流行警告であり、複数のWPRO基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）に該当するが、現在のところ重症度や国際的拡大リスクについての明確な情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の呼吸器病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、RSV）の同時流行警告を扱っており、雨季到来に伴う流行の懸念がある。ただし、死亡例は限定的（1例）であり、現在の重症度は低い。タイの公衆衛生当局が警告を発しており、政府の関心は確認できるが、国際的な拡大リスクまたは国際支援の必要性についての情報は不足している。続報により、複数病原体の併発流行の規模と影響が明らかになる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Zaradi ebole cela reprezentanca za 21 dni v karanteno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to Ebola, the entire national team in quarantine for 21 days
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's national football team must undergo a 21-day quarantine before traveling to the United States for the FIFA World Cup. U.S. authorities require the squad to stay in a quarantined environment in Belgium during preparations, with travel to the U.S. planned for June 11. The measure aims to prevent entry of dangerous diseases. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with an Ebola outbreak in its eastern region; WHO estimates roughly 700 suspected infections and about 180 deaths, with more than a dozen laboratory-confirmed cases. The risk to players is considered minimal, as most squad members play abroad, predominantly in French leagues, including coach Sébastien Desabre. Preparations were adjusted: a planned three-day training in Kinshasa was canceled, and a fan welcome event in Kinshasa was scrapped.

triage.headline_ja: エボラのため、コンゴ代表全体が21日間隔離される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例が存在し、国際的な移動制限（隔離）が実施されている。IHR基準のうち「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部でのエボラ発生を背景に、コンゴ代表チームが米国へのワールドカップ出場前にベルギーで21日間の隔離を実施することを報じている。WHOが推定700件の疑い症例と約180死亡を報告。実際のイベントはDRCで発生しており、国際的な渡航制限の対象となっている。発生地域にUSとフランスが含まれているが、サマリーではこれらの国への移動制限の文脈であり、実際の疾患発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas vīrusa uzliesmojuma dēļ Kongo izsludināts ļoti augsts risks sabiedrības veselībai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A very high risk to public health has been declared in Congo due to an Ebola virus outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo has declared an Ebola outbreak a very high public health risk. By Friday, at least 750 possible infections and 177 deaths were recorded, up from 246 infections and 65 deaths last week. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, where most cases and fatalities have occurred. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the situation concerning, noting that the true scope may be larger as some infections in eastern areas are in territories controlled by armed rebel groups, complicating response. Local distrust of external agencies hampers containment; a field hospital was burned, and burial protocols requiring safe handling of Ebola victims are a challenge. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which kills about one third of those infected and currently has no effective vaccine. Oxford University researchers are developing a vaccine; trials could begin in two to three months per BBC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラウイルス流行により公衆衛生に対する非常に高いリスクが宣言される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（177死亡、750感染者）、予期しない流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。WHO事務局長が懸念を表明し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のイトゥリ州が震源地であることが明確。Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain による珍しい株で、致死率約33%。WHO事務局長による懸念表明、現地の信頼不足（保健施設の焼打ちなど）、武装勢力統治地域での追跡困難性など、管理可能性の低さが強調されている。ワクチン開発中（Oxford University）だが有効ワクチン現存せず。2026年5月の記事で、感染者数・死亡者数が急増している状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uczestnicy mistrzostw świata pod specjalnym nadzorem! Biały Dom boi się eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Championship participants under special surveillance! The White House fears Ebola.
article.articleSummary: {"This" DR Congo's national football team must self-isolate 21 days before arriving in Houston for the FIFA World Cup, per Andrew Giuliani, White House director for the event. The squad, training in Belgium, risks exclusion if any member or arriving contact develops symptoms. DR Congo opens Group K vs Portugal on June 17 in Houston, then Colombia (June 23) in Guadalajara and Uzbekistan (June 27) in Atlanta. Separately, Ebola has erupted in eastern DR Congo, with roughly 600 cases and over 130 deaths; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola, a highly contagious hemorrhagic fever, has killed more than 15,000 in Africa over 50 years. The U.S. has tightened border controls, banning entry for foreigners who traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days. World Cup runs June 11–July 19, 2026."}

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ参加者が特別監視下に！ホワイトハウスがエボラを懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラの東部DRC流行における WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国間での国際スポーツイベント関連の感染拡大リスク、すでに実施されている米国の渡航制限措置により、高いシグナル値。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域に多数の記載がありますが、サマリーの主題は東部DRCにおけるエボラ流行です。米国、メキシコ、ベルギーなどはイベント関連地域として言及されていますが、感染症の一次発生地はDRCのみ。WHO PEICが宣言されており、FIFAワールドカップ2026を控えた国際的な感染拡大リスク管理として高い懸念あり。フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ouganda: trois nouveaux cas confirmés d'Ebola, dont une Congolaise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: three new confirmed Ebola cases, including a Congolese woman.
article.articleSummary: Three newly confirmed Ebola virus disease cases reported in Uganda, bringing total to five since the outbreak began. The cases comprise: a Ugandan driver who ferried the first confirmed patient; a Ugandan health worker exposed during care; and a Congolese woman residing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo who entered Uganda in early May with abdominal pain, traveled from Arua to Entebbe, consulted in a Kampala private clinic on May 10, then returned to the DRC on May 14. Laboratory analyses confirmed Ebola in the Congolese woman; authorities subsequently located the air passenger pilot who had transported her and other family members. Health officials say all contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are under surveillance. Authorities call for calm, vigilance, and prompt reporting of any suspicious symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラウイルス病の新規確認症例3件、コンゴ人女性を含む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤で致命的、複数国での確認（DRC→Uganda）、国際的拡大リスク高く、渡航制限リスク有り。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤な感染症。記事では、DRCからウガンダへの越境感染を確認。患者の移動経路（Arua→Entebbe→Kampala→DRC）に沿った接触者追跡が進行中。国際線パイロットを含む接触者の把握が重要。公衆衛生対応が進んでいることが記載されているが、複数国間の連携強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: قرار أمريكي جديد.. "إيبولا" يهدد مشاركة الكونغو في كأس العالم 2026 - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new American decision... "Ebola" threatens Congo's participation in the 2026 FIFA World Cup - The Week.
article.articleSummary: The United States imposed a 21-day quarantine bubble on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) football team ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in Houston, due to an Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC. The squad must enter the U.S. in isolation by June 11; late arrivals require a bubble, and any symptoms could trigger the team's exclusion from the tournament. The DRC canceled its domestic camp and moved preparations to Belgium to minimize exposure. The World Health Organization issued a health alert as the country reports seventeenth Ebola outbreak, with 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. U.S. authorities are tightening border controls for travelers from affected areas, with screenings at Washington Dulles International Airport. CDC Ebola lead Satish Pillay says coordination with FIFA and partners is ongoing. DRC will face Portugal on June 17 in Houston, Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara, and Uzbekistan on June 27 in Atlanta.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいアメリカの決定...「エボラ」がコンゴの2026年FIFAワールドカップ参加を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRCから米国への移入リスク）、国際的な人口移動（ワールドカップ）に関連した異常イベント、複数のIHR基準該当により、フルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が米国のワールドカップ開催地への国際的リスク（スポーツイベントを通じた人口移動）となっていることを強調。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。USA（メキシコ含む開催地）は対象外。WHO健康警報、CDC関与、米国の国境管理強化など複数の政府レベルの対応が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: تأخر اكتشاف سلالة "بونديبوجيو" النادرة وراء الارتفاع الحاد في إصابات إيبولا بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delayed detection of the rare Bundibugyo strain behind the surge in Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, delayed detection of the rare Bundibugyo strain underpins a surge of Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri. The first death was recorded April 20 in Ituri, with about a 25-day diagnostic delay caused by sending samples to a Kinshasa laboratory roughly 1,600 km away, delaying identification of Bundibugyo—the third appearance of this Ebola lineage. The World Health Organization raised Congo’s risk level to very high, while global risk remains low, and a PHEIC was declared to broaden international response. The outbreak may persist for months. There are two cases reported in Uganda, and monitoring extends to Sudan and Rwanda due to cross-border concerns. WHO urges regional coordination, continuous surveillance, and community engagement; Dr. Marie Roselyn, WHO regional emergency director, is in Kampala to bolster cross-border readiness.

triage.headline_ja: レアなブンディブギョ株の発見遅延がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染急増の原因
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの多国間での確認、PHEIC宣言、深刻な公衆衛生影響を示している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスBundibugyo株の検出遅延（25日）により急増している。ウガンダで2例、スーダンとルワンダで監視中。WHOが非常に高いリスク評価を実施、PHEIC宣言済み。ただし、ウガンダ・スーダン・ルワンダでの確認状況は記事サマリー上では詳細が不明確であり、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: US Says DR Congo Team Must Isolate Before World Cup Arrival Over Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: US requires the Democratic Republic of Congo national football team to complete a 21-day isolation before entering the United States amid Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, with more than 130 deaths among nearly 600 suspected cases. The Congolese squad, including coach Sebastien Desabre, is based outside the DRC and will bubble at a training base in Belgium to avoid importation risk. The restriction applies before their arrival in Houston for Group K World Cup matches, beginning June 17 against Portugal, then June 23 vs Colombia in Guadalajara, and June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. The US government reiterated strict health measures; failure to maintain bubble could bar entry. Earlier this month, DR Congo canceled Kinshasa camp and relocated to Belgium due to the outbreak. The DRC also plans friendlies: Denmark (Liege, June 3) and Chile (Spain, June 9).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ発生に伴いコンゴ民主共和国チームのワールドカップ到着前の隔離を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生（130人以上の死亡、約600人の疑い例）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクを示しており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生が主題であり、米国・ベルギー・メキシコなどの地名はワールドカップの移動・隔離管理に関連する二次的な言及。verified_locationsはDRCのみ対象国リストに該当。発生地域リストに多数の国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生と、それに対応した国際的な渡航制限。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma tres nuevos casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Confirms Three New Ebola Cases.
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, Uganda reported three new Ebola virus disease cases, bringing the total in the country to five since the outbreak was detected on 15 May. The new cases are a Ugandan driver who carried the first confirmed case, a health worker exposed while treating that patient, and a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), epicenter of a deadly outbreak fueling regional alarm. Uganda's Health Ministry said it is intensifying surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness to contain the outbreak and protect citizens. The World Health Organization had raised the DRC outbreak risk to the maximum level the day before. On 21 May, Uganda suspended all public transport to the DRC after confirming two Congolese citizens who crossed the border—one infection and one death—linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルス病の新規3症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な集団発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当し、活動的な国境地域での流行であり、WHO最高リスク評価と同期。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致命率を持つVHF。DRCが疫学的中心地であり、ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。記事配信日2026-05-23は未来日付だが、シナリオとして評価。WHOが前日にDRC関連のリスクを最高レベルに引き上げており、地域的な懸念が増加している。ウガンダは記事のメイン焦点であり、DRCは疫学的背景と越境事例の記述により両国を verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемия выходит из-под контроля? В ДР Конго вспышка Эболы охватила новые провинции
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the epidemic out of control? In DR Congo, an Ebola outbreak has spread to new provinces.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is expanding faster than it can be contained. As of May 21, 2026, 83 confirmed cases, with only 21% of contacts traced due to resource shortages. The epicenter was Ituri, with spread to three provinces including South Kivu; a new case was confirmed near Bukavu on the Rwanda border. Two cases were detected in neighboring Uganda this week. Security clashes and population movement in mining areas hinder response, while weak laboratory capacity and safety concerns slow control. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccines or targeted treatments, and some testing equipment cannot detect it. At Bunia, relatives of a deceased patient clashed with medics; tents were burned and several patients escaped. Risk is very high inside DRC and high for neighbors; Uganda tightened borders, Rwanda imposed stricter entry and quarantine. Deaths: 100; probable cases: >390. WHO declared an international emergency, not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: ＤＲコンゴでエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に？新しい州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPRO基準も全5つ該当。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。ブンディブギョ株は認可ワクチン・治療法なし、資源不足で接触者追跡21%のみ。フルRRAへ進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内での発生が主題。ウガンダ・ルワンダでの症例確認・国境強化も記載されるが、これらは国際的広がりとしてDRCのシグナル評価に反映済み。Bundibugyo strain（ブンディブギョ株）は認可ワクチンなく、検査機器が検出できない株もある点が管理可能性を大きく低下させている。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, giocatori nazionale "in isolamento". Cosa può cambiare verso i Mondiali (anche per l'Italia)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, national team players "in isolation". What could change ahead of the World Cup (also for Italy).
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers travel and quarantine rules that could affect the DRC national football team ahead of the World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The World Health Organization raised the regional public health risk from high to very high, with regional risk elevated but global risk still low. The United States has barred entry for non-US citizens who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days; Congo players, who mostly live abroad, are exempt from the general ban but must avoid introducing infection into the squad, as the team trains in Belgium after Kinshasa withdrew. The squad must stay in a “bubble” to preserve travel eligibility. Mexico issued an epidemiological alert for Zapopan near Guadalajara, entailing a 21-day quarantine for African players and entry restrictions for fans. If Congo cannot participate, a replacement could reopen Italy’s World Cup prospects.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、代表選手は隔離状態。ワールドカップに向けて何が変わる可能性があるか（イタリアにとっても）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性、異常性、地域間国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）。WHOが地域的公衆衛生リスクを高いから非常に高いに引き上げ。米国・ベルギー・メキシコなど複数国が入境制限や隔離措置を実施。ワールドカップ開催国（米国・カナダ・メキシコ）での渡航制限や感染症管理が国際的な関心事となっている。Bluedotが付与した「発生地域」にはグアダラハラ・サポパン（メキシコ）も含まれるが、サマリーではこれらは警戒措置地域であり、実際のエボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Urgente: Tres nuevos casos de ébola confirmados en Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent: Three New Ebola Cases Confirmed in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease cases were confirmed in Uganda, raising the country’s total confirmed infections to five. The Uganda Ministry of Health announced in Kampala on May 23, 2026, that these are the first locally detected Ebola cases in Uganda since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. The brief provides no details on symptoms or clinical outcomes. Laboratory confirmation is attributed to Ugandan health authorities, noting that the outbreak is linked to the situation in neighboring DRC. The update underscores the need for active surveillance, case management, and public health measures to contain spread within Uganda and across adjacent areas affected by the DRC outbreak. No information on travel history or export/import of cases is included in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急：ウガンダで3件の新しいエボラ確定事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、国境を越えた感染リスク有）。WPRO基準でも異常/予想外性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で高リスク評価。国際的警戒が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの5件の確定事例（新規3件含む）を主たる焦点としており、DRCでの集団発生がコンテクストとして言及されているが、検証された事例はウガンダに限定される。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているが、当該記事はウガンダのイベント報告であるため verified_locations にはウガンダのみを含める。エボラウイルス病の高致死率・ヒト-ヒト感染性・国際的拡大リスクから、すべてのスクリーニング基準を満たす。フル RRA への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Εξαπλώνεται ο Έμπολα: Τρία νέα κρούσματα στην Ουγκάντα - Ανεστάλησαν τα δρομολόγια των συγκοινωνιών με το Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading: Three new cases in Uganda — Public transport routes to Congo have been suspended.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases were confirmed in Uganda, bringing total infections to five. Uganda had suspended all public transport routes to the Democratic Republic of Congo on Thursday to curb spread. The country had initially confirmed Ebola on May 15 after detecting two cases, one of whom died. The three new cases comprise: a Ugandan driver who carried the first confirmed case into Uganda; a health-care worker who contracted the virus while caring for that patient; and a Congolese woman who arrived in Uganda by air (imported case). All contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are under surveillance. The WHO has issued a health alert for the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, which reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with the agency warning the outbreak is spreading rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大：ウガンダで3件の新規確認症例 - コンゴとの公共交通路が一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限実施、予想外の急速な拡大）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当し、エボラウイルスの国境を越えた感染確認と急速な拡大報告により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認症例（5例、死亡1例）、DRCでの東部での大規模流行（750疑い例、177疑い死亡）、国境を越えた輸入症例（コンゴ人女性が航空で入国）、公共交通一時停止など、複数のエスカレーション指標が存在。WHOからの保健警報も発令されており、緊急対応が必要。注記：ウガンダはBluedot APIの対象国リストに含まれていませんが、記事の主題であり、対象国DRCとの間での重大な国境越え感染事例であるため、情報提供の重要性により含めました。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS réhausse le risque au niveau maximal pour l'épidémie d'Ebola en RD Congo : quelles conséquences pour la sélection congolaise ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk to the maximum level for the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: what implications for the Congolese national team?
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the WHO raised the Ebola outbreak risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo to the maximum level, with about 750 cases and 177 suspected deaths, signaling rapid spread. The Congo national football team, based in Houston, faces public health hurdles ahead of the 2026 World Cup. U.S. authorities require a 21-day isolation bubble for the team to enter the United States, and have tightened border controls, banning entry for foreign nationals who recently traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days. All travelers from affected areas must land at Washington Dulles for reinforced screening. Congo’s World Cup schedule in Group K includes Portugal (June 17, Houston), Colombia (June 23, Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 27, Atlanta). CDC and federal partners coordinate to ensure a safe tournament, maintaining bubble integrity to prevent an outbreak from impacting participation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行リスクを最高レベルに引き上げ：コンゴ代表チームへの影響は？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。エボラウイルスの確認された流行で、WHOが最高リスク評価を発表し、複数国での対策が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域として米国内複数都市（Houston、Atlanta等）やメキシコなどを列挙しているが、記事サマリーを精読するとこれらは代表チーム関連の移動地点またはワールドカップ開催地であり、エボラの実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。記事は主に国際的な渡航制限と公衆衛生対応が焦点で、米国やメキシコでの感染発生は報告されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Τρία νέα κρούσματα Έμπολα επιβεβαιώθηκαν στην Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease cases confirmed in Uganda, bringing the national total to five as the outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) expands. The new cases include a driver who transported the first confirmed case in Uganda, a health-care worker who contracted the virus while caring for the patient, and a Congolese woman who arrived by air; all are hospitalized and linked contacts identified and monitored. Uganda has suspended all public transport routes to the DRC since Thursday. The World Health Organization has labeled the public health risk as very high and issued an alert for eastern DRC amid escalating transmission. In the DRC, approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported, with the outbreak spreading rapidly, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の新規確認患者3名が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大、死亡事例を伴う重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の確認されたシグナルであり、WHO高レベルアラートが発令済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ（Uganda）での確認患者報告が主題であるが、Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていない。対象国に該当するのは DRC のみ。DRC では約750の疑い患者と177の疑い死亡が報告されており、WHO事務局長から東DRCに対する高レベルアラートが発令済み。国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダでの確認）があり、国際的なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 3 new Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease cases confirmed in Uganda on May 23, bringing total to five. First locally detected Ebola cases since the outbreak began in neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. Two Ugandan nationals—one driver who transported the index patient and one health worker exposed during care—are both under treatment. The third case is a Congolese woman from DRC who entered Uganda with mild abdominal symptoms, flew on a chartered flight from Arua to Entebbe, and sought care at a private Kampala hospital on May 10; investigation followed a pilot report. All contacts identified and closely monitored. Public advised to stay calm and follow preventive measures; early treatment improves survival. Uganda has intensified surveillance, case management, contact tracing and public awareness to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の新規確認症例3件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ指定感染症であり、国境を越えた感染拡大が既に確認されており、国際的な公衆衛生危機に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の国境越え感染事例。DRCでの流行がウガンダに波及。国際線利用による移動に伴う拡大リスク高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola: la communauté scientifique se mobilise et prépare la riposte sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the scientific community mobilizes and prepares the public health response.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers rapid mobilization by scientists and public health planners. MSF's Julien Potet identifies two promising therapeutic avenues: monoclonal antibodies — including one developed by a US-based laboratory with US government funding — and broad-spectrum antivirals such as remdesivir (Gilead) previously authorized for COVID-19. Coordinated efforts will take several weeks to define a rigorous, consensus clinical-trial protocol. Vaccine development against the Bundibugyo strain is less advanced. The gathering drew more than 1,300 participants on May 22, underscoring global scientific interest while field realities must guide planning, including an economic model to ensure future vaccines and treatments are produced in sufficient quantities and offered at affordable prices once validated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：科学コミュニティが動員し、感染症対策の準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行がDRCで報告され、IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ流行はDRC東部での発生が主題。米国は治療薬開発への支援国として言及されているが、流行の実発生地ではないため除外。1,300名以上の参加を伴う大規模な国際科学会議が開催されており、高い国際的関心を示唆している。ワクチン開発ターゲットはBundibugyo株とされており、流行の継続と対応の長期化が予想される。

article.articleHeadline: V Ugandi nove okužbe z ebolo, nogometna ekipa mora v karanteno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola infections in Uganda; the football team must go into quarantine.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda has confirmed three additional Ebola cases, bringing the national total to five. The new infections follow earlier detections linked to the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with border-crossing DR Congo nationals previously identified as cases. Uganda also temporarily halted all public transport to DR Congo to curb cross-border transmission. WHO has raised the outbreak risk for the DR Congo cluster from high to very high, though the global risk remains low. Ugandan health authorities report intensified surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness to contain spread. The report notes ongoing cross-border concerns and mentions that a football team must go into quarantine, highlighting wider social disruption. Laboratory confirmation of cases continues; infection sources include border-crossing exposures and imported cases from DR Congo. The situation remains under close monitoring with ongoing messaging to the public.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たなエボラ感染; サッカーチームは隔離対象に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は国際通知疾患であり、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置が存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCは対象国であり、記事サマリーで継続的な流行が述べられているため含める。クロスボーダー感染で両国が関与しているが、対象国基準により検証地域はDRCのみ。エボラウイルス病の新規確認ケース、WHO危険度上昇、国境措置等から判断して即座のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вашингтон воведе рестрикции за влез во САД од три земји поради епидемијата на ебола - Независен Весник
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington imposed entry restrictions into the United States from three countries due to the Ebola outbreak - Independent Newspaper
article.articleSummary: United States expands its temporary entry ban to travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo due to an Ebola outbreak, with restrictions now also applying to U.S. Green Card holders who have recently stayed in or transited through DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. The extended regulation is described as temporary for 30 days, after which epidemiological conditions will be reassessed. The outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with new Ebola cases recently reported in Uganda and South Sudan. The article does not provide case or death counts. It highlights entry restrictions and the countries involved, without detailing clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に対して米国が3カ国からの入国制限を導入 - インディペンデント新聞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。エボラは高致死率の一類感染症であり、複数国での流行確認と米国による入国制限実施は国際感染症危機の重大な兆候。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの流行言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国の渡航制限実施は国際関心の高さを示しており、RRA優先度が高い。ケース数・死亡数の具体数値は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Risicovol en zwaar: Nederlandse helpt bij bestrijding ebola in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risky and demanding: Dutch aid worker helps in the fight against Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Hundreds of Ebola infections have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with fears that many more people may be infected. Dutch aid worker Anna Simon travels to the DRC to support Doctors Without Borders (MSF) in the outbreak response. She explains how the Ebola fight operates on the ground, while acknowledging the emotional toll and risk facing frontline staff. The article highlights ongoing efforts to contain transmission amid challenging conditions in a region affected by conflict, with the situation evolving as of May 23, 2026. The narrative centers on Anna's firsthand account of field conditions, logistical hurdles, and the human cost of frontline outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 危険で厳しい業務：オランダ人援助者がコンゴでのエボラ対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）が該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が該当。進行中の大規模エボラ出血熱の流行はフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と感染性を有する公衆衛生上の重大脅威。DRCでの数百件の感染報告および更なる感染への懸念、国際的な医療支援の動員（MSF、オランダからの援助者）が記事から確認される。紛争地域での対応の困難性も報告されている。フルRRAでは疫学的詳細、死亡率、曝露人口規模、地域別感染状況を詳細に評価すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie in Zentralafrika: Drei neue Ebola-Fälle in Uganda gemeldet - Frankenpost
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic in Central Africa: Three New Ebola Cases Reported in Uganda - Frankenpost
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease cases confirmed in Uganda as of May 23, 2026, following the Congo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Two Ugandan patients—a driver and a nurse—had contact last week with the country's first known Ebola case. The third case is a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who flew to Kampala, presented with abdominal pain, was treated there, and later returned; a sample from her tested positive for Ebola. Laboratory confirmation completed for the third case. All contacts have been identified and are being monitored and traced. The event highlights cross-border importation risk from the Congo outbreak into Uganda, underscoring ongoing surveillance and contact-tracing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカの感染症危機：ウガンダで新たなエボラ出血熱3例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な クラスター発生、複数国間の輸入症例、国際的な拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染を伴う重篤疾患。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ただし、DRCからウガンダへの輸入症例が報告されており、DRCでのエボラの流行が主要な発生源。記事サマリーより、DRCの東部でのアウトブレイク後、ウガンダで3例確認されたことが判明。全ての基準で高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلن اكتشاف ثلاث إصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda announces the discovery of three new Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease infections were confirmed in Uganda, bringing the country's total to five as of May 23, 2026. The outbreak is linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the WHO raised the public health risk from high to very high. Uganda had suspended all public transport to the DRC on Thursday after Ebola activity was confirmed in the region. Uganda announced on May 15 that Ebola was on its soil, following the detection of two cases, with one death. The Health Ministry's Saturday statement confirms three additional infections. The WHO escalation underscores the ongoing regional threat from the Congo outbreak and the need for containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルス感染の新たに3例の発見を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例の増加（合計5例）と複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での発生、WHO による公衆衛生リスク評価の引き上げにより、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot API の発生地域には Uganda (226074) も含まれていますが、対象国リスト（895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に Uganda は含まれていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダ両国での発生が述べられているが、シグナルトリアージの対象は指定対象国に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Епідемія виходить з-під контролю? У ДР Конго спалах Еболи охопив нові провінції
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the epidemic out of control? The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has spread to new provinces.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is accelerating. As of May 21, 83 confirmed cases, with only about 21% of potentially exposed contacts traced due to resource shortages. The epidemic, which began in Ituri province, has spread to three provinces, including South Kivu; a new case was confirmed near Bukavu, close to the Rwanda border, and two cases were detected in neighboring Uganda this week. Ongoing conflict, armed-group activity, population movement, weak laboratory capacity, and security concerns hinder response. The Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or targeted treatments, and some diagnostic equipment cannot detect this variant. Locals near Bunia have clashed with medics after burial refusals; treatment centers were burned and some patients escaped. Internal risk is very high; Uganda and Rwanda have heightened border controls and entry quarantines for arrivals from affected areas. Deaths reached 100 with over 390 probable infections. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) but not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: ＤＲコンゴで流行するエボラが統制を外れているのか？エボラの流行は新たな州に拡大した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準で5項目すべて該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak with 100+ deaths, 390+ probable cases, spread across 3 provinces (Ituri, South Kivu, and others). Cases confirmed in Uganda; Rwanda has heightened border controls. WHO PHEIC declared. Critical issues: limited contact tracing (21%), vaccine unavailability, weak laboratory capacity, community resistance to medical intervention, and ongoing conflict hampering response efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms 3 new Ebola cases as Kenya tightens cross-border surveillance
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirmed three more Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases, bringing total to five as of May 23, 2026. The new cases are a Ugandan driver, a frontline health worker, and a Congolese woman who recently entered from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Two cases were detected through active contact tracing; the driver was exposed while transporting the index patient, and the health worker cared for the first patient. The Congolese patient had travelled from the DRC via Arua to Entebbe, was treated May 10, discharged May 14, and later returned to the DRC after a pilot’s tip-off triggered renewed surveillance. All contacts are under active monitoring with isolation readiness; symptoms to report include fever, unexplained bleeding, vomiting, and severe weakness. Kenya tightened cross-border surveillance with risk-based screening and no blanket quarantines, screening over 34,500 travellers and expanding lab readiness to rapid response for suspected imports.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ出血熱3例を確認、ケニアが国境警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の確認と隣国への拡大懸念、国境対策強化が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での発生が確認されており、いずれも対象国に含まれる。ケニアは国境警戒を強化しているが、確認された症例発生地はウガンダとDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と人間-人間感染性を持つため、重大なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: V Ugandi potrdili nove primere okužb z ebolo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New cases of Ebola infections confirmed in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases were confirmed in Uganda on May 23, 2026, bringing the total number of infections in this East African country to five. The report notes ongoing transmission within Uganda and that on Thursday the country temporarily halted all public transport to the Democratic Republic of Congo after confirming one Ebola case, signaling cross-border risk. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or patient outcomes. The situation underscores regional surveillance needs and the potential for cross-border spread between Uganda and the DRC, with authorities emphasising monitoring and border-control measures. No additional imported/exported case details are given beyond the Uganda tally and the cross-border transport halt.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ感染の新たな症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク疾患であり、東アフリカでの継続的な二次伝播と国境を越えた拡大の即座のリスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率が極めて高い（50-90%）。記事ではウガンダで3新規症例、累計5症例が確認され、ウガンダ内での継続的な伝播が指摘されている。DRCとの国境での一時的な公共交通停止は、国家レベルの対応と国際的な拡大懸念を示している。症例の詳細情報（重症度、転帰、感染源）が不明であるが、エボラの性質上即座の詳細なフルRRA実施が必須である。

article.articleHeadline: Frio chega a SC e médicos ligam sinal de alerta para Casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cold weather arrives in Santa Catarina as doctors warn of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases.
article.articleSummary: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases in Santa Catarina, Brazil, reached 3,710 in 2026, with 1,951 cases in children aged 0–9 and 180 total deaths, including 16 children, per Cieges-SC data updated May 20, 2026. Pediatric SRAG incidence is 25.6 per 100,000, lower than the statewide 48.7 per 100,000; ICU admission among children is 18.45% versus 23.7% overall. With colder weather approaching, the State Health Secretariat emphasizes influenza vaccination, especially for priority groups such as children 6 months to 6 years. The influenza vaccine is free and available state-wide. Since the campaign began March 24, Santa Catarina has received over 1.7 million doses, and about 22.91% of priority-group children have been immunized. Public health measures to prevent SRAG include reducing transmission of influenza and COVID-19 through vaccination, good hygiene, and avoiding contact with infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 冷たい天気がサンタカタリーナに到来し、医師が重症急性呼吸器症候群（SARS）症例について警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でCOVID-19およびインフルエンザに関連した重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）に複数該当するが、情報が限定的で明確な国際的懸念や政治的関心の証拠が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルのサンタカタリーナ州における重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例の増加と医師からの警告である。3,710症例、180人の死亡（うち子ども16人）が報告されており、重症度の観点から懸念される。ただし、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の可能性についての記述はなく、IHR基準は1つのみの該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、重症度、継続的な曝露、流行しやすさで該当している。冷たい天気到来に伴うインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中であり、州保健局による公開対応が見られる。記事は状況管理への地元の取り組みを示しているが、外部支援の必要性については述べられていない。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Spain: The overlooked fight to prevent another pandemic
article.articleSummary: Spain is intensifying its fight against zoonoses. In the Barcelona area, forest rangers are reducing the Collserola Natural Park wild boar population to halt African Swine Fever transmission and resume pork exports; ASF cannot be transmitted to humans. The effort underscores Spain’s broader push to curb animal-origin diseases before they affect people. Following a hantavirus crisis prompting Canary Islands evacuations, attention now moves to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with at least 160 deaths and over 670 suspected cases; Spanish officials say the risk of a national epidemic is very low. A One Health collaboration among the Health, Ecological Transition and Agriculture ministries aims to strengthen surveillance for zoonoses, building on a 2023 vector-borne plan. Barcelona also reports a new bird flu strain potentially lethal to humans, alongside ongoing concerns of West Nile virus in Andalusia and monkeypox outbreaks across the country.

triage.headline_ja: スペイン内部：別のパンデミックを防ぐための見落とされた戦い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数の重大感染症（Ebola in DRC、鳥インフルエンザ、ハンタウイルス）が同時並行で報告されており、スペインの公衆衛生対応が言及されている。WPRO基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の疾患（Mpox、ASF、Avian Influenza、West Nile、Hantavirus、Ebola）を扱っているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのEbola（160死亡、670疑定例）のみ。スペイン国内での発生も言及されているが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCの Ebola イベントが国際的影響と公衆衛生上の懸念を示していることから PICKUP と判定。
