article.articleHeadline: 快訊／今年首例！高雄前鎮區6旬男「肌肉痠痛」3症狀確診第1型登革熱 | 健康 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: First case of the year! A man in his sixties from Kaohsiung's Qianzhen District diagnosed with dengue fever serotype 1 after presenting with three symptoms, including muscle pain.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's 2026 first locally acquired dengue case: a man in his 60s from Kaohsiung City’s Qianzhen District diagnosed May 23 with dengue fever serotype 1 after fever, headache, and muscle pains; NS1 rapid test and PCR were positive. Two close contacts are asymptomatic and test negative. Authorities consider domestic transmission and will conduct expanded community screening, implement emergency vector-control around home and workplace, and strengthen mosquito-density surveys and breeding-source cleanup while educating contacts. Year-to-date Taiwan has 64 confirmed dengue cases: 1 local and 63 imported from Southeast Asia and South Asia (Indonesia 19, Maldives 14, Vietnam 8). Globally, by April there were over 1.02 million cases and 300+ deaths, with Brazil and Bolivia among affected; Cuba and Guyana rising. Nearby Asia reports increases (Malaysia, Vietnam, East Timor, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Laos). Public advised to practice 巡、倒、清、刷, wear protective clothing, seek prompt care if symptoms occur, informing travel history and TOCC.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：今年初例！高雄市前鎮区の60代男性が「筋肉痛」など3症状で第1型デング熱と診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での2026年首例となるデング熱の局所感染例であり、当該国での異常な発生（IHR基準2項目該当）、および国際的な広がりリスク（東南アジア・南アジアでの流行）が認められるため、フルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主体は台湾（対象国リストに非掲載）での首例デング熱確認例であるが、サマリーに示される関連地域として、対象国内のベトナム、ブラジル、インドネシアが該当する。台湾はWPRO地域で重要な位置付けであるが、対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。ただし、グローバルな流行状況（アジア・南米への広がり）とIHR基準への該当状況から、この事例はシグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Three new Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases were confirmed in Uganda on 2026-05-23, bringing the total to five since the outbreak was detected on 15 May. The patients are a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan health worker, and a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda suspended all public transport to the DRC after two earlier cases involving Congolese nationals crossing the border. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV); no approved vaccines or treatments exist for BDBV, though a small number of experimental vaccines and therapies are being assessed. Globally, about 177 suspected deaths and nearly 750 suspected cases have been reported, with a fatality rate up to 40%. The WHO has declared the outbreak an emergency, with risk to the DRC at the highest level. obeldesivir, a Gilead antiviral, is viewed as promising, with vaccine development expected in six to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス感染の新規症例3件が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)による大規模アウトブレイク、高い致死率（最大40%）、国際的拡大（DRC-Uganda間の越境感染）、WHOによる緊急宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの新規確認3件が主題だが、記載されている患者情報から1名はコンゴ民主共和国出身で越境感染が関係していることが明示されている。WHO による緊急宣言、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療法の不足、国際的な支援ニーズがすべて確認される。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当し、リスク評価対象として優先度が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises risk level of Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in DR Congo to "very high"
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has WHO risk assessments at very high national, high regional, and low global levels. There are 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths; authorities report 177 suspected deaths and nearly 750 suspected cases, suggesting the outbreak may be larger than documented. The strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. In Uganda, two confirmed cases linked to travel from the DRC, with one fatality, indicate cross-border transmission. WHO notes high transmission potential and measures in Uganda such as expanded contact tracing and cancellation of a mass gathering. International concern rose after a US national working in the DRC tested positive and was moved to Germany; another American high-risk contact was moved to the Czech Republic. An experimental antiviral, Obeldesivir, could be used for contacts under strict protocols. The outbreak likely began about two months ago before the formal declaration.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョエボラ株アウトブレイクのリスク水準を「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ、チェコ共和国に及ぶ）、高い死亡率と重症度、国際的な懸念の高まりを示すシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生である。ウガンダへの越境伝播と米国・ドイツ・チェコへの個別患者の移動が報告されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。本アウトブレイクは確認症例82名、確認死亡7名、疑い死亡177名、疑い症例750近くで、ワクチンおよび承認済み治療法がないブンディブギョ株であり、極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／今年首例本土登革熱現蹤高雄　前鎮男發燒、肌肉痛確診 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: This year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case detected in Kaohsiung; a man from Qianzhen District diagnosed after fever and muscle pain
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever case of 2026 in Kaohsiung City’s Qianzhen District: a man in his 60s with fever, headache and muscle pains tested positive for dengue type 1 by NS1 rapid test and PCR on May 23. Two close contacts were asymptomatic with negative tests. No overseas travel; authorities classify it as domestic and have begun expanded community screening, vector-control around the home, and intensified mosquito surveys and breeding-site elimination, plus education for contacts. Nationally, 64 dengue cases have been confirmed this year: 1 local and 63 imported from Southeast Asia; Indonesia 19, Maldives 14, Vietnam 8. Globally, by April there were over 1.02 million dengue cases and 300+ deaths, with rising outbreaks in the Americas and parts of Asia. Citizens are advised to drain water, keep surroundings clean, wear light clothing, use approved repellents; seek care for fever and report travel or exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：今年初の本土登革熱がコオシュンで確認　前鎮地区の男性が発熱・筋肉痛で診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での本土デング熱の初確認は異常かつ予想外であり、既に国内スクリーニングと蚊媒介対策が展開されている。国際的な拡大リスクがあり、スクリーニング基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾での本土デング熱の初確認。Bluedot APIで列挙されたカナリア諸島（スペイン）、モルディブ、インドネシア、ベトナムは、台湾の症例の流行源（渡航者の感染源）として参照されているが、実際の本土イベント発生地ではないため除外。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないが、WPROスクリーニング基準を満たしシグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Nepali Army plans 21-day isolation for peacekeepers returning from Ebola-hit Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the Nepali Army orders a mandatory 21-day isolation for peacekeepers returning from the Ebola-hit Democratic Republic of Congo. More than 970 Nepali troops are deployed in DRC under the UN mission, including in Bunia, Ituri province—the outbreak epicenter last month. The Bundibugyo strain has 51 confirmed cases, 144 deaths, and over 600 suspected cases reported in the Congo and Uganda; no vaccine exists for this strain. Brigadier General Raja Ram Basnet said arrivals from affected countries will remain isolated and not meet anyone until the 21 days elapse, with UN and health ministries coordinating safety measures. No Nepali peacekeepers have contracted Ebola so far. India issued travel advisories and postponed the India-Africa Forum Summit amid the health emergency. WHO notes the Bundibugyo outbreak does not meet pandemic criteria. Nepal urges strengthened lab capacity, surveillance, and trained health workers given high mobility.

triage.headline_ja: ネパール軍がエボラ出血熱流行中のコンゴから帰国する平和維持軍要員の21日間隔離を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事態、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の高い致死率（51確定例、144死亡）と多数の疑似症例、国際的展開と政府レベルでの対応が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC での Bundibugyo 株エボラ出血熱流行であり、ネパール平和維持軍の対応とインドの渡航勧告が言及されている。Uganda は DRC 隣接国で患者報告あるが、記事の主題は DRC が中心。対象国リスト外の Nepal（ネパール）は軍事的対応の実施国として記載されるが、実際のエボラ流行地ではない。DRC と India が verified_locations として適切。WHO 見解では pandemic criteria を満たさないとされるが、51確定例・144死亡・600+疑似症例による深刻な公衆衛生影響、ワクチン未有無、国際的な移動リスク（平和維持軍展開・インドの対応）が認められ、IHR・WPRO 両基準で高スコアとなる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo World Cup squad told to isolate for 21 days before entering US after Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 2026 World Cup squad must isolate for 21 days before entering the United States due to an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo. CDC entry rules prohibit non-US citizens who have recently been in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the last 21 days. The team, training in Belgium after Kinshasa camp cancellation over health concerns, faces strict travel controls to avoid breaching protocols that could cancel participation. The World Health Organization has raised the Ebola-related public health risk from high to very high, with regional risk in Africa remaining high and global threat still low. Additional visitors to the training camp could jeopardize travel. DR Congo are set to play Denmark in Belgium on June 3 and Chile in Spain on June 9 as warm-ups before the World Cup starts June 11 in the US/Canada/Mexico, with a group match vs Portugal on June 17.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行後、コンゴ民主共和国のワールドカップ選手団は米国入国前に21日間の隔離を指示される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり、WHOがリスクを「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げた。国際的なスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）との関連性により、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行。Kinshasa市での発生であり、WHOがリスク評価を引き上げている。ウガンダと南スーダンも記事で言及されているが、発生地域として明記されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。米国、ベルギーなどの言及は渡航制限や隔離措置の実施国であり、発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola crisis deepens as WHO warns of regional spread beyond DR Congo - TheNewsGuru
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) worsens, with suspected cases rising to about 750 and 177 suspected deaths linked to Bundibugyo. WHO raised the national risk assessment to very high, regional risk high, and global risk low. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, where authorities confirmed two Ebola infections and one death among travellers from DR Congo. Insecurity in eastern Congo is hindering emergency response, slowing contact tracing, testing, treatment, and public awareness campaigns. Despite the crisis, Oxford researchers are developing a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, with clinical trials expected in coming months. Public health authorities urge strengthened border surveillance, emergency preparedness, and community engagement to prevent a repeat of large-scale outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機が深刻化、WHOがコンゴ民主共和国を超えた地域的拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクが複数国に拡大し、WHO全レベルリスク評価が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。ブンディブギョ株エボラは過去20年間希少な株系であり、750例以上の疑い患者と177例の死亡が報告されている重大事態。国境を超えた感染確認、国内不安定性による対応困難が特徴。即座のフルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congolese province bans wakes to curb Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: In the northeastern Congo's Ituri province, authorities banned wakes and the transport of deceased Ebola victims in non-medical vehicles, with burials to be conducted in a specialized manner, as the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak tightens its grip. Ituri, centered on Bunia, reported the outbreak's acceleration after a victim died April 24 and mourners touched him during funeral rites. The measures also cap public gatherings at 50 and suspend local football leagues. The Ebola body remains infectious; safe and dignified burials are urged to curb transmission. WHO said about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths in northeastern Congo, with two cases detected in Uganda, and elevated Bundibugyo strain risk to very high nationally in DR Congo and high regionally. Violence and insecurity hamper response; authorities are tracing contacts and delivering emergency supplies. Symptoms include body aches, vomiting, diarrhea; incubation 2–21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの州がエボラ蔓延を抑制するため葬儀を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の国際的拡大（ウガンダへの確認例あり）、WHO評価で全国レベルでの非常に高いリスク、死亡例と多数の疑い症例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BVD)の現在の流行。IturiおよびBuniaで主な発生が確認されており、ウガンダでも2例が検出されている。暴力と不安定性が対応を阻害しており、管理可能性に懸念あり。WHOによる全国レベルでのVery High リスク評価に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie in Zentralafrika: Drei neue Ebola-Fälle in Uganda gemeldet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic in Central Africa: Three new Ebola cases reported in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in Uganda, following a severe outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Two cases—a driver and a nurse—had contact last week with the first documented Ugandan case. The third case is a woman from the DRC who flew to Kampala, Uganda's capital, was treated there for abdominal symptoms, and then returned; a sample from her tested positive for Ebola. All contact persons have been identified and are being monitored and traced for exposures. Public health authorities are maintaining surveillance and contact tracing to curb further transmission as of May 23, 2026. Key locations: Uganda; Kampala; DR Congo (eastern region).

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカの流行：ウガンダで3件の新しいエボラ症例が報告されました
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体による国境を越えた感染事例である。複数国への拡大と国際的な保健上の脅威が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（Kampala、Uganda）が含まれているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国であり、記事本文でも東部DRCでの重症流行が明記されている。ウガンダでの症例は、DRC由来の輸入症例および二次感染として報告されており、主たる発生地はDRCと考えられる。エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の最優先事項であり、複数国への拡大リスク、高い致死率、医療体制への負荷が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 烏干達爆發伊波拉疫情！新增3例確診包含醫護人員 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Ebola outbreak! Three new confirmed cases, including a healthcare worker - Minshi News Network.
article.articleSummary: Three more people in Uganda have tested positive for Ebola, bringing the eastern outbreak to five cases since May 15. The Ugandan Health Ministry on Saturday confirmed the three new infections: a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan healthcare worker, and a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The healthcare worker’s infection underscores the high risk faced by frontline responders. The outbreak’s core remains in eastern DRC, where the risk level has been raised to the highest. Given frequent cross-border movement, Uganda has intensified border screening and medical surveillance and urged the public to stay vigilant and adhere to preventive measures to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ出血熱が流行！新規確診者3人（医療従事者を含む）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という高い致死率を持つ病原体であり、国際的拡大リスク（DRCでの流行、ウガンダでの新規感染、医療従事者の感染）が明確。IHR基準3項目、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCは対象国(203312)に含まれている。記事サマリーでは両国でのエボラ流行が明記されているため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。ウガンダでの新規感染が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱は最高致死率のカテゴリIVに分類される病原体であり、医療従事者への感染、国境を越えた感染拡大の懸念がある点で重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ουγκάντα: Τρία νέα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη χώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: Three new confirmed Ebola cases in the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease: Uganda confirms three new cases, bringing the national total to five. The country, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo, had earlier confirmed Ebola on May 15 after two cases, with one death. The three new cases comprise: a driver in Uganda who transmitted the first confirmed case; a healthcare worker who contracted the virus while caring for that patient; and a Congolese woman who arrived by air in Uganda (an imported case from DRC). All contacts linked to these cases have been identified and are under surveillance; both initial cases are receiving care. Uganda has suspended all public transport routes to DRC. The WHO has issued a health alert for Ebola in eastern DRC, where the outbreak has approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; the virus is described as spreading rapidly by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：国内で3件の新たなエボラ確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患の国際的な越境拡大（DRC→Uganda）、確認死亡者、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限措置を伴う重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが識別した発生地域にはRepublic of Uganda（226074）が含まれていますが、対象国リストに含まれていません（対象国リストに1605651=Thailand等は含まれるがUgandaは含まれない）。一方、DRC（203312）は対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーにおいても東部DRCでの本格的な流行（750疑い症例、177疑い死亡）が主たる発生地点として記載されています。Ugandaはシードケース（DRC由来の輸入症例および越境感染）として位置付けられているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとします。本件はエボラウイルス疾患による国際的な保健危機として極めて高い優先度でフルRRAを実施するべき案件です。

article.articleHeadline: ಎಬೋಲಾ ತಂದ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟ; ಫಿಫಾ ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್‌ಗೂ ಮುನ್ನ ಕಂಗೋ ತಂಡಕ್ಕೆ 21 ದಿನ ಕ್ವಾರಂಟೈನ್‌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trouble caused by Ebola; Congo team under a 21-day quarantine ahead of the FIFA World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has prompted strict U.S. health protocols ahead of the FIFA World Cup. As of May 23, 2026, authorities report over 130 deaths and around 600 suspected cases in Congo. Andrew Giuliani, executive director of the White House FIFA World Cup task force, says Congo’s squad must undergo 21 days of quarantine in Belgium before entering the United States; failure to maintain quarantine would prevent travel to the U.S. Congo is in Group K, with matches: June 17 vs Portugal in Houston; June 23 vs Colombia in Guadalajara, Mexico; and June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. Congo relocated training from Kinshasa to Belgium, planning a warm-up vs Denmark in Liège on June 3 and a June 9 fixture vs Chile in southern Spain. Officials emphasize readiness to manage public health and border-security risks during the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がもたらす困難；FIFAワールドカップを前にコンゴチームに21日間の隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行が発生し、130名以上の死亡と約600名の疑い患者が報告されている。国際的なスポーツイベント（FIFAワールドカップ）を契機とした国際拡大リスクが存在し、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC（Kinshasa）でエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行が明確に記述されている。発生地域フィールドに含まれた米国、ベルギー、メキシコ、ウズベキスタン、スペイン、ポルトガル、チリはいずれもDRCでのイベント発生地ではなく、FIFAワールドカップの試合会場や隔離実施地として記載されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙した。エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の全項目が該当する。フルRRAへの進行が急務。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تؤكد 3 إصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms 3 new Ebola virus infections.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola virus disease infections, bringing total confirmed cases in the country to five. The new cases include a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed patient, a health-care worker who contracted the virus while providing care, and a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo. WHO Africa Regional Director Mohammed Yaquob Janabi warned that even a single case can fuel cross-border spread, noting the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine. In neighboring DRC, authorities report 160 deaths among about 670 suspected cases and 61 confirmed cases. The World Health Organization has raised the risk level for Bundibugyo and designated the Uganda and DRC outbreaks as a public health emergency of international concern. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated materials, or contact with the deceased; common symptoms include fever, body aches, vomiting, and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルスの新規感染3件を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の国際的拡大事例であり、WHOが既に「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）」に指定しており、ウガンダとDRC両国で同時進行的な流行が確認されている。

verified_locations.name: Uganda（記事主題：ウガンダでの確認3件）
Democratic Republic of the Congo（記事サマリーで言及：DRCでの同時流行160死亡）

triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月23日配信で、ウガンダでの新規確認3件に加え、DRCでの同時流行（160死亡、約670疑い例、61確認例）を報告。ウガンダのケースには DRC からの患者が含まれており、国境を超えた感染の実証。WHO Africa Regional Director が国際的拡大警告を発出。Bundibugyo 株はワクチン未承認の株種。PHEIC指定により、国際公衆衛生面でのハイプライオリティイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола заплашва участието на ДР Конго на Световното първенство
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens DR Congo's participation in the World Championship.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens its national team’s participation in the 2026 World Championship. ESPN reports that Andrew Giuliani, executive director of the White House’s World Cup task force, said the team must complete a 21-day quarantine in Belgium, where they are currently training; without this quarantine, players may not be granted entry into the United States for the tournament in Houston. Because of the health crisis, DR Congo has moved its training camp from Kinshasa to Belgium. At the World Championship, DR Congo is drawn in a group with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia. The situation highlights how the Ebola outbreak is affecting international travel and preparation for the event, and the need for public health measures to ensure participation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国のワールドチャンピオンシップ参加を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生が国際的なスポーツイベント参加に影響を及ぼし、国際的な移動制限と渡航規制が発生しており、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクが主題であり、ベルギー（訓練キャンプの移転先）やアメリカ（ワールドチャンピオンシップ開催地：ヒューストン）は二次的な影響地である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地域として該当。エボラは致命的な人獣感染症であり、出血性質を特徴とするため重症度は高い可能性が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Ουγκάντα: 3 νέα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη χώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: 3 new confirmed Ebola cases in the country.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, raising the national total to five. The new cases include a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed case into the country, a health worker infected while caring for that patient, and a Congolese woman who arrived in Uganda by air. All contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are under surveillance. Uganda suspended all public transport routes to the Democratic Republic of Congo on Thursday. The World Health Organization issued a health alert for Ebola in eastern DRC, where the outbreak is spreading rapidly and the risk is described as very high. In DRC, there are about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, in a population of roughly 100 million. Authorities continue monitoring and containment in Uganda as of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：国内で3件の新たなエボラ確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上極めて深刻、ウガンダでの発生は異常、DRCからの越境感染で国際的拡大リスク高、渡航制限も実施済み。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのエボラ新規確認症例を主題とし、DRCとの越境感染を示唆。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていないが、記事サマリーから実際の発生地はウガンダである。DRCでの急速な流行拡大とWHOの健康警告、ウガンダによる公共交通の一時停止措置などから国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 風險評估列最高等級！民主剛果伊波拉迅速擴散 世衛坦言「棘手」 - 國際 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk assessment at the highest level! Ebola spreads rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO admits it's “tricky.”
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization warns that the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is spreading rapidly and has been raised to the highest risk level (very high). The epidemic began in Ituri province and has expanded to South Kivu, with Uganda reporting two imported cases from DRC and one death. As of May 22–23, 2026, the tally includes 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 confirmed fatalities, plus about 177 suspected infections deaths and roughly 750 suspected cases. There is no licensed vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, while WHO is prioritizing evaluation of existing therapies for effectiveness. Contact tracing has expanded to around 1,400 individuals. To disrupt transmission, authorities emphasize rapid case finding and a 21-day isolation period for contacts. The cross-border cases into Uganda highlight the outbreak’s international risk.

triage.headline_ja: リスク評価が最高レベルに！民主共和国のエボラが急速に拡散、WHO「対処困難」を認める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病による確認死亡例・疑い例多数、ウガンダへの越境感染例あり、国際的拡大リスク高い。WHOが最高リスクレベルを発表。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）への越境感染2例・死亡1例が報告されているが、主要な流行地がDRCのため、DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な亜種）であり、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。WHO最高リスク判定により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Radboudumc admits patient with possible Ebola infection - Vox magazine
article.articleSummary: Radboudumc in Nijmegen admitted on 21 May a patient to its High Level Isolation Unit with a low suspicion of Ebola, at the request of the Dutch National Coordination Centre for Infectious Disease Control (LCI) for diagnostics and care. Final laboratory results were expected over the weekend. The unit is housed in Gebouw P on Erasmuslaan, opposite the university library. Ebola can be deadly and is highly contagious; the outbreak has centered on the Democratic Republic of Congo and nearby countries, with the World Health Organization declaring a global health emergency, while the risk of widespread global transmission remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: ラドバウド大学医療センターがエボラ感染の可能性のある患者を入院させた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。さらにWPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、WHOが世界的保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にオランダ（ニイメーヘン）での疑い患者の入院を報道しているが、エボラの実際の発生地は民主共和国コンゴ及び近隣地域であると明記されている。オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHOが世界的保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 750 إصابة بإيبولا تشمل أمريكيين ونقلهما للعلاج
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 750 Ebola cases, including Americans, and their transfer for treatment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of May 21, 2026, the DRC reports 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths, while Uganda has 85 confirmed cases (including 2 in Uganda) and 10 deaths (including 1 in Uganda). Transmission concentrates in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with insecurity hindering response efforts. Two imported American cases have been identified: one American citizen confirmed after working in the DRC and evacuated to Germany for treatment, and another moved to the Czech Republic. National authorities, with WHO, are deploying rapid-response teams, delivering medical supplies, and enhancing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関: 750件のエボラ患者、アメリカ人を含み、治療への移送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際拡大リスク、複数国での発生確認）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生地はDRC（South Kivu, Ituri）およびウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。アメリカ、ドイツ、チェコは輸入症例の治療国であり、発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: UK Scientists Race to Develop Ebola Vaccine Amid DR Congo Outbreak - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths, intensifying concerns as scientists race for a vaccine. The World Health Organization has raised the outbreak's risk level from high to very high, while saying the global threat remains low and noting it was previously declared a public health emergency of international concern. Bundibugyo, one of Ebola's least understood strains, lacks a proven vaccine, unlike Zaire. Oxford University researchers are advancing an experimental vaccine using the ChAdOx1 platform, carrying Bundibugyo genetic material to provoke immunity; animal studies are underway, with early human trials possible within two to three months. India's Serum Institute is lined up to mass-produce if successful. A separate candidate is not expected to be ready for 6-9 months. Deployment would likely be via ring vaccination of contacts and frontline health workers; prior Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DR Congo (2012).

triage.headline_ja: UK Scientists Race to Develop Ebola Vaccine Amid DR Congo Outbreak - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolaはワクチン未承認株で約750疑似症例・177死亡を有し、WHO活動化と国際的な対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はDR Congo Bundibugyo Ebola感染拡大を主題とし、WHO危険度を『high』から『very high』に引き上げた。インドはSerum Instituteのワクチン製造候補国として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。Uganda は記事では歴史的参考（2007年感染例）としてのみ記載されており、現在の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Seleção da RD Congo fica em isolamento por surto de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo national team in isolation due to an Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, DR Congo's national football team will quarantine in Belgium for 21 days before entering the United States for the FIFA World Cup due to an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain; WHO reports confirmed cases and deaths, with hundreds of suspected cases under investigation, and there is no vaccine approved specifically for this variant. U.S. authorities say the team may enter without violating travel bans for non-Americans who were in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days. The World Cup is hosted by the United States, Mexico, and Canada; Congo will base in Houston and opens Group K against Portugal on June 17 in Houston. Organizers will monitor the situation and schedule trainings and travel, prioritizing protection of athletes, staff, and the public while maintaining the bubble.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国代表がエボラ流行により隔離状態に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例と死亡、疑い症例数百件という深刻な影響、複数国への国際的拡大リスク（ベルギーでの隔離、米国への移動、スポーツイベントを通じた大規模集団接触の可能性）があり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラBundibugyo株の流行が主題。ベルギー、米国、メキシコ、カナダは国際的な二次的接触地点として言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンは旅行禁止期間の定義として言及されているが、発生地としては明記されていない。WHO公式発表なし（2026年5月時点は将来日付のため、架空シナリオと推定されるが、本評価は提供情報に基づき実施）。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Confirms Three New Ebola Cases.
article.articleSummary: Uganda on May 23, 2026 confirms three Ebola cases, bringing infections to five, all linked to the Bundibugyo strain spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The cases involve a driver who transported an infected person, a health worker treating patients, and a woman who had visited a Kampala hospital. All infections stem from previously imported cases from the DRC outbreak; contact tracing is underway and enhanced surveillance at borders and facilities has been activated. WHO declared the outbreak a PHEIC on May 17 due to uncertainties about scale, cross-border movement, and lack of approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus. DRC has hundreds of suspected cases and significant deaths; Uganda’s initial cases were imported by travelers. Authorities urge vigilance, hygiene, and early reporting of fever, vomiting, or weakness. Uganda seeks about $24 million to bolster preparedness with international support.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の新規症例3件を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が PHEIC 宣言済み。DRC からの越境感染が既に発生しており、複数国での症例確認と国際的な支援必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域に Uganda が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの症例は DRC からの越境感染であり、DRC の流行が原因。DRC が対象国リストに含まれており、現在の流行の中心地は DRC である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。既に WHO が PHEIC を宣言（2026年5月17日）している重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 위험...WHO '매우 높음' 상향
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola risk... WHO raises to 'Very High'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization raised national risk to Very High and regional risk to High, and declared a public health emergency. In one day, suspected cases increased from 670 to 750, with deaths rising from 160 to 177. Human-to-human transmission is confirmed, with localized clusters pushing overall threat from moderate to high. The outbreak centers in armed-conflict areas, hindering response efforts. Authorities have implemented measures including restrictions on funerals and large gatherings, and strengthened quarantine and surveillance. The report does not mention imported/exported cases; the emphasis is on containment, public health measures, and expanding response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の危険性...WHO「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRC内でのエボラ流行加速、Bundibugyo変異体による重篤な公衆衛生影響、WHOによる緊急事態宣言、急速な症例増加（24時間で疑い例670→750、死亡160→177）、ヒト-ヒト感染確認、地域リスク引き上げはすべて国際的拡大と渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示唆。
triage.notes: WHOが国家レベルのリスク評価を『非常に高い』に引き上げ、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo変異体による流行であることが特に懸念される。武装紛争地域での発生により対応が困難化している。緊急RRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Три нови случая на зараза с Ебола в Уганда
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new cases of Ebola infection in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, bringing the national total to five. The new cases include a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed patient, a medical worker infected during treatment, and a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who arrived by plane. One of the initial two cases had died; all contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are under surveillance. Uganda halted all public transport links to the DRC on May 15. The outbreak in eastern DRC has prompted the WHO to declare an international public health emergency; the risk to global health is very high. In DRC, about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths have been reported; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus involved in this outbreak. Imported cases underscore cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ感染の新規患者3人を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済みであり、国際的な拡大リスクと死亡例の報告があるため、即座にフルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: DRC東部での約750の疑い例と177人の死亡が報告され、WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言がなされている。ウガンダへの越境感染の証拠（DRC出身者による航空渡来）があり、ワクチンや承認治療法が利用できないBundibugyo ebolavirus株の関与で高いリスク。国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго под заплаха от отстраняване от Мондиал 2026 заради епидемия от ебола - По света и у нас - БНТ Новини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo under threat of disqualification from the 2026 World Cup due to Ebola outbreak - Around the World and in Our Country - BNT News
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces potential exclusion from the 2026 FIFA World Cup due to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. To travel to Houston for the tournament, the squad must complete a 21-day quarantine in Belgium before June 11, or risk being barred from entering the United States, a host nation. White House World Cup task force head Andrew Giuliani said the precaution aims to prevent the disease reaching the U.S., prompting the team to cancel a training camp in Kinshasa and shift preparations to Belgium, where it will also play friendlies. In the World Cup, DR Congo is drawn against Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia, with two group-stage matches in the United States and one in Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行により2026年ワールドカップから除外の脅威にさらされる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生であり、IHR基準を複数満たす（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。国際的スポーツイベントへの影響を伴う高い社会的・政治的関心があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ホスト国（米国、メキシコ）への国際的拡大リスクが明記されている。Bluedot の発生地域には複数国が列挙されているが、サマリーで実際の感染が述べられているのは DRC のみ。Houston、Texas、Belgium などは隔離・準備地点として言及されているだけであり、感染の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: SAMARITAN'S PURSE AIRLIFTS EBOLA TREATMENT CENTER TO THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF THE CONGO
article.articleSummary: Samaritan's Purse will airlift an Ebola Treatment Center and more than 34 tons of PPE to combat a deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The 767 cargo plane will land in Uganda and supplies will be transported to the DRC. Disaster response specialists—including an outbreak specialist, an infection prevention and control specialist, and medical personnel—have deployed, with more team members en route, to establish effective infection prevention and control protocols for local mission hospitals and communities and to coordinate with the Ministry of Health to operate an Ebola Treatment Center, an emergency field hospital adapted to treat Ebola patients. The effort builds on past missions: an Ebola treatment center in Liberia (2014) that educated more than 1.6 million people, and a DRC center (2018) that treated more than 600 patients.

triage.headline_ja: サマリタン・パース、コンゴ民主共和国へエボラ治療センターを空輸
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外/異常性）。エボラウイルス病の発生・拡大対応であり、国際支援体制の展開が進行中。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生は確認されている。記事中でウガンダはエボラ治療センターの搬入経由地として記載されているが、エボラ発生地の主題ではなく、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。国際支援体制（NGO）の展開、感染予防・制御対応、治療センター設立準備が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: САЩ затвори границите си за участник на Мондиала заради смъртоносна епидемия
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States closed its borders to a World Cup participant because of a deadly epidemic.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo threatens the DR Congo national football team’s participation in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The team relocated training from Kinshasa to Belgium and faces possible exclusion from host countries if it cannot comply with quarantine rules. A White House task force requires a 21-day quarantine in Belgium before the squad can travel to Houston for a June 11 arrival date; failure to comply could bar entry to the United States. Consequently, the team canceled its Kinshasa camp due to the Ebola outbreak. They are placed in Group C with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia. The outbreak underscores heightened border controls to prevent disease importation during major sporting events.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がワールドカップ参加国に対し致命的な流行病を理由に国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行により、国際的な移動制限と渡航規制が実施されており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当する。スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）への影響により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月のシナリオであり、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が主題。発生地域にはHouston（米国）やPortugal等が含まれるが、実際のイベント発生地はDRCのKinshasaである。米国での隔離措置は予防的なもので、米国内での流行は記されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: L'ebola s'escampa al Congo sense vacuna ni tractament mentre creix l'alarma internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in Congo without a vaccine or treatment as international alarm grows.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo variant of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with no vaccine or specific treatment; early detection remains the main weapon. As of the latest WHO data, nearly 180 deaths are suspected and over 740 cases are under investigation. The mortality rate ranges from 25% to 90%. NGOs urge rapid reinforcement of overwhelmed health facilities, isolation spaces for patients and staff, and ample PPE to prevent further transmission. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids; public gatherings and traditional funeral rites are high-risk, as viral concentration is strongest in corpses after death. Conflict and insecurity across several regions hinder response, restrict movements of medical teams, and complicate contact tracing and sample transport; over 1 million people displaced, health system is weak. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and raised the national risk to very high, allocating $3.9 million to bolster the response and prevent cross-border spread from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで広がる―ワクチンも治療法もない中、国際的警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo型エボラの確定的な流行で致死率25-90%、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国境越え拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラ（確定型）、疑い死亡数約180、調査中の症例740以上。紛争・不安定性により保健対応が著しく阻害されている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。国境越え拡大リスク（370万人の難民・国内避難民）、ワクチン・治療法なし、致死率極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ուգանդայում Էբոլա տենդի նոր դեպքեր են հայտնաբերվել
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New cases of Ebola virus disease have been detected in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease cases were confirmed in Uganda, raising the total to five as of May 23, 2026. The health ministry announced three new confirmed infections: two linked to contact with the initial case (a driver and a health worker) indicating secondary transmission, and a third case—a citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo who was in Uganda. No deaths are reported in the article. This development shows ongoing transmission within Uganda, with laboratory-confirmed cases. The report emphasizes transmission risk from close contacts of the initial case. No details are provided on vaccination or public health measures in place. Keywords: Ebola, Uganda, outbreak, laboratorial confirmation, imported/DR Congo national.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の新たな症例が検出された
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準において「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」「異常か」「国際的に拡大するリスクがあるか」の3基準に該当。エボラウイルス病の二次感染と国境を越えた症例確認は、フルRRA評価が必要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのエボラ症例確認が主題。DRC国籍の患者がウガンダにいた点が記載されているが、DRCは対象国リストに含まれていない（203312は対象外）ため、verified_locationsはUgandaのみ。本記事は対象国リストに含まれていないため、実運用ではスコープ外の可能性があるが、シグナルトリアージの評価基準では重大度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Τρία νέα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπλα στην Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirmed Ebola virus disease on May 15 after two initial cases, one of whom died, and three new confirmed cases on May 23 raised the country's total to five. The new infections include a driver who transported the first confirmed case into Uganda, a health worker who contracted the disease while caring for that patient, and a Congolese woman who arrived by air. All contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are under surveillance. Uganda had already suspended all public transport to the Democratic Republic of Congo. The World Health Organization issued a health alert for the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC. In the DRC, there are about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with the outbreak described as spreading rapidly by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たに確認されたエボラ症例3件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、既に国境を越えた拡大が確認されており、国際的な対応が必須。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (note: not in target list but included as actual epicenter)

triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC東部でのエボラ発生が950件超の疑似症例を含む大規模流行であり、ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認されている。WHO総長による「急速な拡大」コメント、保健労働者への感染、多国籍の患者関与など、高いリスク指標。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載するが、実質的には両国での発生を評価対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Governo inicia nova fase de pagamento de indenização a vítimas do Zika vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Begins a New Phase of Compensation Payments to Victims of the Zika Virus.
article.articleSummary: Brazil began paying a one-time indemnity to 337 families of children with permanent disability from congenital Zika syndrome, totaling BRL 16.85 million, with payment scheduled through May 28, 2026. Another 1,485 families have received BRL 50,000 each. In addition to the indemnity, families receive a monthly lifelong pension equal to the Social Security ceiling. The benefit is regulated by Joint Ordinance No. 69 (Sept 2025) from the Ministry of Social Security and INSS. The indemnity is tax-exempt and paid into the same account as the pension; amounts are inflation-adjusted by IBGE from July 2, 2025 to payment date. To receive the indemnity, families must not be collecting another financial compensation for the same reason, and if a court already awards compensation, they must choose between benefits.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がジカウイルス感染症の被害者に対する補償金給付の新段階を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは過去のZika感染症の被害者補償制度の実施段階であり、新規の感染症の流行・拡大を示していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルにおける過去のZika感染症の被害者に対する既定の補償制度の実施進捗についての報道であり、新規の感染症イベント（新規症例発生、流行拡大、重症化傾向など）を示すものではない。公衆衛生危機管理の観点からのシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Mỹ mở rộng hạn chế nhập cảnh với các thường trú nhân hợp pháp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: United States Expands Entry Restrictions for Lawful Permanent Residents.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the U.S. CDC expanded temporary entry restrictions for Lawful Permanent Residents (green cards) who have spent the past 21 days in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, due to Ebola outbreaks in East and Central Africa. The move extends earlier May 18 public health emergency measures that increased screening, traveler surveillance, and entry limits for non-U.S. citizens visiting affected areas. The policy does not permanently bar green-card holders but temporarily restricts entry to safeguard public health and allocate emergency resources. No Ebola cases have been detected in the United States; public risk remains low. As of May 23, Uganda reports five Ebola cases since May 15, with the latest addings two Ugandan nationals and one Congolese national, including a healthcare worker; Uganda suspended public transport to the Congo from May 21. WHO has declared an international public health emergency; vaccine development could take months. The outbreak coincides with World Cup 2026, prompting widespread containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：米国が合法的永住者（グリーンカード保有者）の入国制限を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ一類感染症であり、東アフリカ・中央アフリカでの流行は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限を伴う。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済みであり、直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及される発生国はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみに該当。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国外のため除外。世界保健機関により既に国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。米国が法的永住者にも入国制限を適用する段階であり、エスカレーション傾向が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, tre nuovi casi confermati in Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, three new confirmed cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases were confirmed in Uganda on May 23, 2026, bringing the total since the outbreak began on May 15 to five. Kampala's Ministry of Health reported the patients—a Ugandan driver and a Ugandan healthcare worker—along with a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak's epicenter. The cases follow cross-border transmission from the DRC; Uganda had already suspended all public transport to the DRC after the confirmation of two Congolese nationals who crossed the border (one positive, one fatal). The Ugandan response emphasizes strengthened surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public-awareness campaigns to contain the outbreak and safeguard Ugandan health and security.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ウガンダで3つの新たな確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラの国際的多国間発生であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限が全て確認される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の国際的な多国家発生。DRCが震源地であり、ウガンダへの国境を越えた伝播を確認。公開輸送の停止等の措置が実施されており、WHO通知レベルの事例。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当し、フルRRA対象として明確に識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Cruz Roja informa de la muerte de 3 de sus voluntarios en el brote de ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Red Cross reports the death of three of its volunteers in the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers died amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo, and Ajiko Chandiru Vivian were deployed with the national Red Cross in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, one of the outbreak’s epicenters. The ongoing outbreak reports about 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths to date. The deceased are believed to have contracted the virus while on duty, during cadaver-management activities on March 27 as part of a humanitarian mission not related to Ebola. At the time, the community lacked knowledge of the outbreak and the virus had not yet been identified. The deaths occurred between May 5 and May 16 and are among the earliest fatalities; the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行における3人のボランティアの死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の死亡、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEICが既に宣言されており、医療従事者の死亡報告はシグナルとして確実に拾うべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確に民主共和国コンゴ（DRC）のイツリ州マングバワルにおけるエボラ出血熱流行を主題としている。既にWHO PHEICが2026年5月17日に宣言されており、アクティブな大規模流行中。医療従事者（赤十字ボランティア）の3名の死亡報告は、流行の重篤性を示す重要なシグナル。疫学的には約750人の疑い症例、177人の死亡が報告されており、対応能力に関する懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en DRC: riesgo muy alto y desafíos en la respuesta - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Very High Risk and Challenges in the Response - Notiulti.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is now assessed by the World Health Organization as 'very high' risk due to rapid spread of the virus. In eastern DRC, outbreak response capacity is under intense pressure from insecurity, distrust, and weak local clinics, with health facilities reportedly operating at full capacity as transmission accelerates. Uganda has confirmed new Ebola cases, triggering expanded surveillance efforts and intensified contact tracing to contain downstream spread. The report frames the situation as an ongoing emergency with cross-border implications, highlighting the challenges of rapid expansion, limited access, and the need for enhanced regional coordination to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラウイルス：非常に高いリスクと対応における課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。WHO評価で「非常に高いリスク」との公式判定があり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの新規症例確認が言及されているが、主題はDRCの状況であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO による「非常に高いリスク」評価、国境横断的含意、地域調整強化の必要性が明記されている。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে ভয়াবহ রূপ নিচ্ছে প্রাণঘাতী ইবোলা | বাংলাদেশ প্রতিদিন
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola Assumes a Terrifying Form in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease is spreading alarmingly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with deaths rising to 177. The World Health Organization notes this is the 17th outbreak in DRC. The highly contagious virus has a case fatality ranging from 25% to 90%. After the first death in late April in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, transmission has intensified across the region. Weak health infrastructure hinders containment. Traditional funeral rites involving the handling of the dead are identified as a major transmission driver. Authorities have sought stricter corpse-management to curb spread, but many families resist. Near Bunia, in the Rwampara area, disputes over body transfer sparked violence, including a crowd setting fire to a medical center. Aid agencies warn that the true number of infections and deaths may be higher than reported, underscoring the need for regional and global assistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで致命的なエボラが恐ろしい形をとっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。死亡者177名、高い致死率、保健インフラの脆弱性、地域伝播の加速が確認される。
triage.notes: DRC内のIturi州Bunia市での17番目のエボラアウトブレーク。死亡者177名、高致死率（25～90%）。伝統的な埋葬儀式による接触感染が主要な伝播経路。保健インフラの脆弱性、地域の紛争による医療施設への抵抗が対応を困難にしている。ルワンダとの国境付近での事例報告あり（Rwampara地区）。WHO通知基準を満たし、地域・世界的支援が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Neue Ebola-FÃ¤lle in Uganda, WHO warnt vor Epidemie im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola cases in Uganda, WHO warns of an epidemic in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda reports five confirmed Ebola cases, with three new infections: a driver who transported the first confirmed patient and a medical professional who treated him, plus a third case—a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo who entered Uganda with mild symptoms, sought care in Kampala, returned to DRC, and was later confirmed positive after a pilot linked to her transport alerted authorities. The outbreak’s epicenter remains the DRC, which has about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, warning the risk of a national epidemic in the DRC is very high and that actual numbers may be underreported. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo-type Ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or therapy, with Ituri province in eastern DRC particularly affected.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たなエボラ出血熱患者が報告、WHOがコンゴでの流行の危険を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、高い死亡率、WHO PHEICの宣言があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの5例を報告しているが、発生地域にUgandaが含まれるにもかかわらず、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが対象国であり、また流行の実質的な中心地（約750疑い例、177死亡）であることから DRC のみを検証地域として列挙。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）、PHEICの宣言、国際的拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の高リスクから、最高レベルの関心を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma três novos casos de Ebola em meio a surto em país vizinho | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases amid outbreak in neighboring country | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026 — Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, raising its outbreak total to five. All cases involve the Bundibugyo strain, which the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with the agency noting very high national epidemic risk for the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the DRC, approximately 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are linked to the virus. The three Ugandan cases include a driver who transported Uganda’s first confirmed patient and a health worker exposed while caring for that patient; both are receiving treatment and identified among known contacts. The third case is a Congolese woman who entered Uganda from the Congo with mild abdominal symptoms, traveled from Arua near the border to Entebbe for care in Kampala, initially improved, returned to Congo, and later tested positive after a transport-linked alert. All contacts are monitored; the public should stay vigilant and report suspected symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の新規感染3例を確認、隣国での流行の中 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラはWHO PEICの最重要疾患であり、DRCでの大規模発生（750疑似症例、177死亡）と国際的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）、WHO PEICの公式宣言済み。DRCでの大規模流行（750疑異例、177死亡）に続きウガンダで確認症例増加。国際的な移動（コンゴ人女性の移動）による越境伝播の証拠あり。緊急対応レベルの高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: FIFA World Cup 2026: Congo Football Team Asked To Undergo 21-Day Isolation Period Due To Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, an Ebola outbreak in Congo prompts the United States to impose a 21-day isolation period for Congo's national football team ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026. The team must remain in a strict isolation bubble for 21 days before traveling to Houston, with arrival slated for June 11. Andrew Giuliani, executive director of the White House Task Force for the World Cup, confirmed the measure to ESPN. The policy reflects precautionary health protocols to mitigate Ebola transmission during preparations. The brief does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or specific symptoms. The outbreak’s location is Congo, with the event in focus being the World Cup in 2026 in Houston.

triage.headline_ja: FIFA ワールドカップ2026：エボラ出血熱の流行を理由にコンゴのサッカー代表チームが21日間の隔離期間を要求される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱発生は確認されているが、記事は主にワールドカップの予防措置に焦点を当てており、発生地の詳細情報、症例数、確認例がなく、実際の流行の規模や公衆衛生への影響が不明である。
triage.notes: 記事はワールドカップの行政措置に重点を置いており、エボラ出血熱の実際の流行状況（症例数、死亡数、確認例、地理的範囲）についての具体的情報が不足している。コンゴでの発生は記述されているが、詳細が限定的であるため、WATCH段階とし続報を注視する必要がある。IHR基準では2つ該当（異常性と渡航制限）、WPROでは2つ該当（異常性と流行可能性）。

article.articleHeadline: Tres nuevos casos de ébola confirmados en Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease cases confirmed in Uganda, bringing the total to five. The outbreak’s first locally detected Ebola cases since the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo’s outbreak started. Two Ugandan nationals linked to the index case: a driver who transported the initial patient, and a healthcare worker exposed while treating him. The third case is a Congolese woman from DR Congo who entered Uganda with mild abdominal symptoms, flew on a charter from Arua to Entebbe, and sought care at a private Kampala hospital on May 10. Authorities have identified and closely monitored all contacts. Uganda has intensified surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness to contain the outbreak. Early treatment significantly improves survival; the population is urged to maintain preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラの新規症例3件が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な流行拡大（DRC⇔ウガンダの越境感染）であり、重篤な公衆衛生影響と渡航制限リスクが明白。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の越境流行事例。DRCからの輸入症例が確認され、ウガンダ国内で二次感染が発生。チャーター便利用による航空輸送リスク、複数の医療機関への受診による接触者多数化が懸念される。既に当局が積極的な接触者追跡・監視体制を展開しており、管理可能性の評価も高い。フルRRAの早急な実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Tailandia: Aumentano i controlli sanitari per l'Ebola da zone a rischio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand: Health screenings for Ebola from high-risk areas are increasing.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Thailand has intensified health screenings and lab preparedness after designating the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as Ebola risk zones. The designation follows the WHO's classification of the Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Government spokesperson Lalida Phumwitthayawan said the move mirrors a Public Health Ministry announcement in the Royal Gazette naming DR Congo and Uganda as areas with dangerous Ebola-transmissible diseases. Travelers from these risk zones must pre-register and undergo 21 days of monitoring, including temperature checks and symptom assessments. Measures led by the Department of Disease Control will boost surveillance and border checks, with pre-registration via the Thai Digital Arrival Card for inbound travelers from affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: タイ：リスク地域からのエボラ出血熱に対する保健スクリーニングが増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC指定に伴う複数国での対応で、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱がWHOによってPHEIC指定されており、DRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイク、タイによる国境スクリーニング強化という多層的な対応が実施されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めないが、記事の文脈ではDRCとタイの対応が主題。リスク評価対象国として検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, suspends flights to Kinshasa
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports three new Ebola Virus Disease cases, totaling five infections: a Ugandan national, a health worker, and a Congolese woman who recently arrived from the DRC. The woman travelled from Arua to Entebbe on May 10 seeking medical care, was treated and discharged, then tested positive after a pilot alerted authorities. All contacts have been identified and are under close monitoring as surveillance, case management, and contact tracing are intensified. Uganda Airlines suspended flights to/from Kinshasa effective May 23, 2026 as a precaution. Last week, one patient died and a second recovered after testing negative on May 18 and May 20; 127 contacts remain under institutional quarantine. The US issued new travel restrictions and enhanced screening for travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. WHO warns the outbreak risk in the DRC is very high, with rising cases, notably in Ituri Province and other conflict-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の新たな3症例を確認、キンシャサへのフライト停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大が進行中（DRC→ウガンダ）で、複数国での対応・渡航制限が実施されており、公衆衛生上の重大な影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCからウガンダへのエボラウイルス病の越境伝播が確認されている。DRC国内ではIturi州などの紛争地域で症例が急増している。米国が渡航制限を発令し、複数国での監視体制が強化されている。WHOがDRCでの爆発的リスクを警告。シグナルは確実で、フルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: ALARMANTNO STANJE PRED MUNDIJAL! Ebola među fudbalerima, ova reprezentacija će morati u izolaciju!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ALARMING SITUATION AHEAD OF THE WORLD CUP! EBOLA AMONG FOOTBALLERS, THIS NATIONAL TEAM WILL HAVE TO QUARANTINE!
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola presence among the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team has prompted a 21-day isolation as a condition for entering the United States for the World Cup. The squad must undergo mandatory 21-day quarantine before traveling to the U.S., with American authorities informing FIFA of the entry restriction. The primary aim is to safeguard the health and safety of all participants and spectators, as the team undergoes strict surveillance prior to competition. The plan requires containment measures before the World Cup kickoff in the United States, with Houston identified as the arrival city for the team. Officials stressed that noncompliance could prevent entry to the United States.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ前に深刻な状況！エボラがサッカー選手間で、この代表チームは隔離が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスの確定例とワールドカップという国際スポーツイベントでの集団曝露リスク、渡航制限の実施に該当するため。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの確定例がDRC代表サッカーチーム内で発生し、ワールドカップ参加のため米国への渡航制限が実施されている。21日間の隔離が条件。国際的なスポーツイベントでの感染リスク、複数国への拡大可能性がある。Houston（米国テキサス州）は到着予定地だが、実際の発生地はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: US says that DR Congo World Cup team must isolate
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts U.S. authorities to require the DR Congo national team, the Leopards, to isolate for 21 days in a bubble in Belgium before travel to Houston for the 2026 World Cup. Andrew Giuliani said the team must maintain the bubble and then fly to the United States for a June 11 arrival to prevent any importation. As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, with around 180 deaths and more than 700 suspected cases. The Leopards canceled a Kinshasa training camp and will play warm-up matches in Belgium (June 3 vs Denmark) and Spain (June 9 vs Chile). They qualified after winning a playoff in Mexico in March; many players are based overseas (notably France), and coach Sebastien Desabre is in DR Congo. Congo last played at the World Cup in 1974 (as Zaire). Group K includes Portugal, Colombia, Uzbekistan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国がコンゴ民主共和国のワールドカップチームの隔離を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が PHEIC 宣言、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な隔離措置実施により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC でのエボラ爆発を主題としており、米国・ベルギー・スペイン等での対応は二次的言及。WHO が PHEIC を宣言済み、死亡180名以上、疑い例700名以上。スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）絡みの国際的懸念事項として高いメディア関心。対象国リストの DRC のみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah DBD di Lingga, Polisi dan Petugas Kesehatan Fogging Permukiman Warga Desa Jagoh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Dengue Fever in Lingga, Police and Health Officials Fog Jagoh Village Residential Areas.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, Lingga Regency in the Riau Islands intensified dengue prevention in Jagoh Village, Singkep Barat District, with fogging to suppress Aedes aegypti. The operation involved police (Bhabinkamtibmas Brigpol Dedy Marzuki), health workers from UPT Puskesmas Singkep Barat, village officials, and residents. Fogging targeted areas deemed high risk for mosquito breeding; before spraying, authorities stressed environmental cleanliness, urging residents to regularly empty and clean water storage, cover containers, and maintain a clean, healthy lifestyle. The P2M team of UPT Puskesmas Singkep Barat, including coordinators Nindy Wardani and Yusniar, oversaw the effort. Lingga Police Chief AKBP Pahala Martua Nababan, through Singkep Barat Police Chief Iptu Young Risa, praised cross-sector cooperation to reduce mosquito populations and raise dengue awareness. The article does not report dengue case counts or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: リンガ県のデング熱予防、警察と保健職員がジャゴー村の住宅地で防除活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱予防活動の報道だが、確定症例数や検査確認情報がなく、異常事象の詳細が不明。スクリーニング基準は複数該当する可能性があるが、具体的な疫学情報の不足により、PICKUP判定には至らない。
triage.notes: インドネシアのリンガ県シングケップ・バラット地区ジャゴー村で実施されたデング熱予防活動の報道。防除（fogging）の対象となったAedes aegyptiの繁殖リスク地域が存在することが確認されているが、実際の症例数、死亡数、重症度に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。既存の予防措置の強化であり、新規かつ異常な事象の報告ではない。デング熱はインドネシアで流行性疾患であり、蚊媒介感染の可能性があるため、WPRO基準では2項目以上該当。ただし、具体的な疫学的リスク情報（症例数、死亡者、感染率の急増など）が不足しているため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Congo in isolamento prima dei Mondiali per l'epidemia di Ebola: "Rischiano di non partecipare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo in isolation ahead of the World Cup due to the Ebola outbreak: "They risk not participating."
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo forces the DR Congo national football team into a 21-day isolation in Belgium before they can travel to the United States for the World Cup in Houston. The team must remain in a sealed bubble for three weeks, with arrival in Houston planned for June 11; violating quarantine could bar them from participating. Andrew Giuliani, executive director of the White House World Cup task force, has alerted FIFA, the Congolese federation, and Kinshasa that the squad must maintain the bubble. FIFA says there is no ban, since players and head coach Desabre live outside the Congo and are not at immediate contagion risk, though some staff could be in a separate bubble. U.S. authorities may deploy medical personnel in Belgium to monitor the squad.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ流行でワールドカップ前に隔離：「参加できないリスクがある」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行により、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、2基準以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、国際スポーツイベント絡みで社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した地域にはHouston、Texas、United States、Belgiumが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ国内のエボラ流行であり、これらは隔離地や試合開催地として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。対象国リストでは203312=DRCのみが該当する。2026年のワールドカップを前提とした架空シナリオと見られるが、エボラ流行の深刻性と国際的影響は明らかである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, lotta fra amnesie e tagli alla ricerca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, a battle between amnesia and cuts to research funding.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has returned to Congo, now extended to parts of Uganda, underscoring a global gap in preparedness and sustained funding for research. Virologist Roberto Burioni emphasizes that the current Ebola strain is dangerously virulent, with no vaccine and no specific therapy available. Unlike COVID-19, Ebola does not spread through the air—transmission occurs via direct contact with symptomatic individuals and their blood or body fluids (saliva, vomit, feces, sweat, urine), as well as through bodies of the deceased and contaminated objects such as needles, sheets, or medical instruments. The virus remains ferocious and poorly understood, but theoretically controllable. A warning note centers on mutation, which could alter transmissibility or virulence. The piece frames this resurgence as both a health crisis and a mirror of neglect and the erosion of funding for infectious disease research.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、記憶喪失と研究資金削減の間での闘い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生という極めて重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダの両国でのエボラ発生が言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（1814991=Chinaなど対象国に含まれない）が含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラは高い致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染能、治療法の欠如があり、国際公衆衛生上の最優先課題。記事では新規株の出現と変異リスクが強調されており、早急なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Hanta Virus: किन लोगों को Hanta Virus से ज्यादा खतरा, एक्सपर्ट ने बताया ऐसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Who is at greater risk from Hantavirus, an expert explains how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Hantavirus poses a higher risk to people in India, with experts citing exposure to rodent-contaminated dust as the primary transmission route. Gorakhpur's Regency Hospital internal medicine specialist Dr. Vijay Kumar Sharma notes that long-unmaintained spaces with dust, dirt, or rat presence—such as warehouses, farms, basements, old closed rooms, and storerooms—pose elevated risk. Occupations including farmers and sanitation workers, and anyone frequently in contact with rats or their droppings, are particularly susceptible. Early symptoms are non-specific: high fever, body and muscle pain, headache, fatigue; in some cases, breathing difficulties, chest tightness, and lung infection may develop. Prevention focuses on cleanliness to deter rodents, wearing masks and gloves during cleanup in rodent-prone areas, and using disinfectant rather than sweeping dry dust.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：ハンタウイルスからのリスクが高い人々は誰か、専門家が自分自身を保護する方法を説明する
triage.triage_reason: インドでハンタウイルス感染のリスク増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、重症度の可能性、流行しやすさ）だが、実際の患者数・死亡数など定量的エビデンスが記事に記載されていないため、情報不足の段階。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家による予防啓発記事であり、既発生の具体的な患者数・死亡数・疫学情報が明記されていない。ハンタウイルスは重症化リスクがあり、職業関連・環境関連の曝露リスク（農民、衛生労働者、げっ歯類接触者）が指摘されている点は注視が必要だが、アウトブレイク・エピデミック段階であるかは不明。フルRRA前に追加情報収集が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 'എബോള', 'ഹാന്‍റ' വൈറസ് ഭീഷണികളെ നേരിടാൻ രാജ്യം സജ്ജമെന്ന് സൗദി അറേബ്യ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saudi Arabia says the country is ready to face threats from Ebola and Hantavirus.
article.articleSummary: Saudi Arabia says it is fully prepared to counter Ebola and Hantavirus threats linked to outbreaks in the Congo and Uganda, as declared by the public health authority Vikhaaya. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted the World Health Organization to declare an international public health emergency. Saudi authorities stress safeguards to protect worshippers heading to Mecca and Medina. Since July 2019, the country has applied strict precautions, including a temporary halt on entry visas for travelers from affected areas; these controls remain in place. Border screenings have been intensified across air, sea, and land routes, with deployed special response teams and daily health surveillance at pilgrims’ accommodations from neighboring countries. While Hantavirus is not currently a threat to Saudi Arabia or the Hajj season, monitoring continues. No Ebola or Hantavirus cases have been reported in Saudi Arabia. Asianetnews is the preferred source.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、エボラ出血熱とハンタウイルスの脅威に対抗する準備が整っていると発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、社会的・政治的関心も存在するが、サウジアラビアでの実際の症例報告がなく、DRCおよびウガンダでの既知の公衆衛生上の状況への反応報告であるため、フルRRA実施の前段階として情報の更新を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はサウジアラビアが準備状態にあることを述べており、同国での症例報告はない。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行は既知の状況。発生地域にはサウジアラビアも含まれるが、サマリーではDRCとウガンダの流行への対応措置として記述されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、実際の新規症例報告による新規リスクシグナルではないため WATCH とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ուգանդայում էբոլա տենդի նոր դեպքեր են հայտնաբերվել
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola virus disease cases have been detected in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports three new Ebola virus disease cases, bringing the total in the country to five as of 23 May 2026. The infections include two locally detected cases in individuals who had contact with an infected driver and a health-care worker, and a third case involving a Democratic Republic of the Congo citizen who was in Uganda. The Ministry of Health says all contacts have been identified and that necessary containment measures are under way. Authorities urge anyone with Ebola-like symptoms to seek medical care promptly, noting that early treatment markedly improves recovery chances. The response includes intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and risk management for cross-border transmission with DR Congo as Uganda continues to monitor the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の新規症例が検出される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な脅威であり、国境を越えた拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、フルリスク評価（RRA）を実施すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、ウガンダでのエボラ症例報告と、DRコンゴからの越境感染が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、DRC のみを記載。エボラウイルス病は IHR Annex2 の除外されない感染症であり、2名の新規患者と国境を越えた感染があるため国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: V Ugandi je število primerov okužb z ebolo naraslo na pet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, the number of Ebola infections has risen to five.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, bringing the total in the country to five. The health ministry says it is strengthening surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness. The World Health Organization has raised the global risk level for the Ebola outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo to very high, though global risk remains low. Uganda had temporarily halted most public transport to DR Congo after confirming one Ebola infection and one death among Congolese citizens who crossed the border. In related developments, Congo’s football team must complete a 21‑day quarantine before the FIFA World Cup in the United States; preparations in Belgium require players to stay in a quarantined environment, and a Kinshasa welcome event for fans has been canceled. The team is expected to travel to the USA by June 11; most players work abroad, minimizing individual infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ感染者数が5人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、また WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行可能性・管理性に該当。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確定事例あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確定事例5例（新規3例含む）、DRC国境越えによる死亡者1例あり。WHOが世界的リスク評価を『非常に高い』に引き上げた。ただし記事サマリー上、米国・ベルギーは競技団の隔離・移動管理の関連でのみ言及されており、実際の感染症発生地としては扱われていないため除外。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土登革熱現蹤高雄！  6旬男發燒肌肉痠痛確診  - 生活 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case detected in Kaohsiung! A man in his 60s diagnosed with dengue fever presenting with fever and muscle aches.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Centers for Disease Control reports the year’s first locally transmitted dengue fever case in Kaohsiung City, a man in his 60s from Qianzhen District, who presented with fever, headache and muscle pain; NS1 rapid test and PCR were positive for dengue fever serotype 1. No travel abroad during incubation indicates local transmission. Kaohsiung City Health Bureau has begun expanded community screening, emergency control measures, vector-density surveys, and breeding-source elimination, with health education for the case and contacts; two close contacts tested negative by NS1 and PCR. Nationally, Taiwan so far this year has 64 dengue cases, 1 local and 63 imported, mainly from Indonesia (19), Maldives (14), and Vietnam (8). Globally, as of April 2026 there are over 1.02 million cases and 300+ deaths, concentrated in the Americas (Brazil, Bolivia) with rising Cuba and Guyana; Asia also reporting increases (Malaysia, Vietnam, East Timor, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Laos). Public health advice emphasizes eliminating standing water, wearing light-colored long sleeves, using approved repellents, and seeking prompt care while reporting travel/activity history.

triage.headline_ja: 今年首例本土登革熱現蹤高雄！6旬男發燒肌肉痠痛確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における2026年初の本土デング熱症例であり、IHR基準のうち異常性（異常/予想外）と国際的拡大リスク基準に該当。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・管理可能性で該当。全球的なデング熱の流行拡大（100万症例以上、複数地域での増加）を背景とした地域内での本土感染確認はフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はTaiwan（対象国外）における本土デング熱第1例であるが、サマリーで言及される対象国は Vietnam、Indonesia、Brazil（輸入症例の出所）。台湾は評価対象国に含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。本事象はWPRO地域の流行拡大の一部として捉えられるべき重要なシグナルであり、全球的なデング熱増加傾向（特にアメリカ大陸と東南アジア）を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: OMS fa sapere che l'Ebola si sta diffondendo rapidamente in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says Ebola is spreading rapidly in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the World Health Organization reports that Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the local risk raised to 'very high' due to medical resource shortages and public anger that hinder outbreak response in a conflict-affected region. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the risk of global spread remains low, but Congo's risk assessment has been revised upward from the previous 'high' classification. The update underscores the challenges posed by fragile health systems and ongoing instability that affect surveillance, case management, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大していると報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラの急速な拡大は重篤なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: エボラの急速な拡大、医療資源不足、紛争地域での対応困難、WHOによるローカルリスク上方修正など、複数の重大リスク要因が同時に存在。DRCのみが実際の発生地であり検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital Infantil do Valentina alerta para os sinais de dengue em crianças e orienta famílias sobre atendimento e vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Valentina Children's Hospital warns about dengue symptoms in children and advises families on care and vaccination.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa, Brazil – As of May 23, 2026, the Municipal Health Secretariat warns families to monitor dengue symptoms in children and reinforces vaccination as the main preventive strategy. The Valentina Municipal Pediatric Hospital (HMV) serves as a pediatric care reference, guiding parents to identify early warning signs and seek urgent help. In children, dengue can mimic viral infections; in babies, persistent crying, irritability, or poor feeding signal dehydration and possible progression. The danger peak occurs days 3–5 after fever onset, when deterioration can be rapid. Avoid self-medication. Vaccination is prioritized: two dengue doses for ages 10–14; a single dose for health workers up to 59. Vaccines are available Monday–Friday at all USFs and municipal clinics, plus the Centro Municipal de Imunização. Severe cases are triaged to HMV or UPAs in Valentina, Cruz das Armas, Manaíra, and Bancários.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァレンティナ小児病院、小児のデング熱症状について警告し、家族に治療とワクチン接種についてのアドバイスを提供
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱に関する公衆衛生警告ですが、症例数、死亡報告、国際的拡大の具体的な証拠が記事に明記されていません。情報不足のため、続報を注視する必要があります。
triage.notes: 記事はジョアン・ペッソア（パライバ州）とリオデジャネイロの小児科施設からの予防的警告です。具体的な症例数、死亡者、入院数が記載されていないため、深刻度の正確な評価ができません。デング熱は流行しやすい疾患で、シーズナルな警告は一般的ですが、現在の発生規模や異常性については不明です。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคเผยยอดป่วยโควิด-19 ในไทยยังต่ำ แนวโน้มคงที่ แต่ยังเฝ้าระวัง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control reports COVID-19 cases in Thailand remain low, with a stable trend, but surveillance continues.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Thailand remains low with a stable trend through May 22, 2026, despite international activity. The NB.8.1.1 sublineage, a mutation-derived offshoot of JN.1 within the Omicron family, is circulating globally and in Thailand, accounting for about 50% of NB.8.1.1 cases in the country. Singapore has reported rising cases linked to this lineage. In Thailand, from the start of 2026 to May 22, there have been 3,007 accumulated cases and 1 death. Overall activity is lower than the same period last year. Health authorities maintain surveillance as monsoon season begins, underscoring ongoing vigilance against potential seasonal increases while NB.8.1.1 remains the dominant local concern.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健当局、COVID-19患者数は低水準で安定推移と報告、監視継続へ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知疾患で現在のタイの流行は低水準・安定傾向。ただし新規系統NB.8.1.1の国際的循環とシンガポールでの増加傾向、モンスーン季節への警戒がWPRO基準で複数該当するため、経過観察対象。
triage.notes: シンガポールは記事に言及されているが、発生地域リストに含まれても対象国でないため除外。タイは対象国で実際に流行監視中。新規系統の国際循環と季節的懸念により監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Чемпионат мира-2026 - сборную ДР Конго могут не пустить на мундиаль из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026 — the DR Congo national team could be barred from the World Cup due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo threatens DR Congo’s participation in World Cup 2026. U.S. authorities require a 21-day isolation before entry, with the squad in Belgium for training and two friendlies. White House task force director Andrew Giuliani warned that maintaining a strict ‘bubble’ is essential, or entry could be denied. Some staff have already left the country to avoid travel issues; players and head coach Sébastien Desabre are largely abroad, mainly in France and Belgium. The World Health Organization has raised the outbreak risk to very high, with dozens of confirmed Ebola cases and hundreds of suspected infections. Mass gatherings and funeral processions have been canceled to curb transmission. DR Congo’s World Cup opener is June 17 against Portugal in Houston, marking the team’s first World Cup appearance in over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026 — エボラ出血熱の流行によりコンゴ民主共和国代表がワールドカップ出場を禁止される可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO も発生リスクを「非常に高い」と評価している確認済みのエボラ出血熱流行。対象国（コンゴ民主共和国）での実発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによる検証：エボラ出血熱の流行は実際にコンゴ民主共和国で発生しており、確認症例と疑い症例が報告されている。WHOが発生リスクを「非常に高い」と評価。米国当局が21日間の隔離措置を要求するなど、国際的な渡航制限リスクが顕在化している。Bluedot APIが示した他国（米国、フランス、ポルトガル、ベルギー）は二次的な関連（代表チームの訓練地、試合開催予定地）であり、疾病流行の主発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS déclare une urgence de santé publique de portée internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurgence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).
