Experts warn the risk of a new pandemic akin to COVID-19 is rising as outbreaks become more frequent and health systems remain vulnerable, a point echoed by the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board. In this outbreak, Congolese authorities report 745 suspected Ebola cases and 176 suspected deaths in the DRC as of Friday, 22 May 2026. The article highlights broader concerns about the health, economic, political, and social impacts of emerging infectious threats and the need for international coordination. No details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources are provided. The PHEIC declaration signals heightened international response and measures to curb transmission and cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: RDCでのエボラ：WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言がなされた重大なエボラウイルス病の再出現であり、国際的対応が必須。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言が正式に発令された極めて重大なイベント。745の疑い症例と176の疑い死亡が報告されており、社会的・政治的関心も非常に高い。フルRRA実施が必須。記事はフランス語Guinee360メディアソースだがDRCでの事象が明確に主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ausbruch in Zentralafrika: Drei Rotkreuz-Helfer unter ersten Ebola-Opfern im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in Central Africa: Three Red Cross volunteers among the first Ebola victims in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers are among the first Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of Congo, marking a new outbreak. The three died on May 5, 15, and 16, after likely contracting Ebolavirus while handling corpses on March 27 during a separate humanitarian assignment. First Ebola cases were laboratory-confirmed on May 15, with officials noting the outbreak may have persisted unnoticed for weeks; the Bundibugyo strain hindered early confirmation. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The risk assessment places Congo's local risk as very high, regional risk high, and global risk low. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids, not airborne; corpses can harbor virus days after death. The report does not mention imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでの発生：3人の赤十字ボランティアがコンゴでのエボラ初の犠牲者に含まれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり、異常・予想外な発生、国際的な懸念が生じており、WHOがPHEIC宣言を発表）。エボラウイルス感染症という高リスク病原体で、複数の死亡例と医療従事者への感染が報告されている。
triage.notes: WHO が 2026 年 5 月 17 日に PHEIC（国際保健上の緊急事態）を宣言。Bundibugyo 株によるエボラウイルス感染症の発生。記事では現在のところ国外への症例報告なしとのことだが、医療従事者への感染を含む死亡例が報告されており、強い注視が必要。フルの Rapid Risk Assessment に進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Drei Rotkreuz-Helfer unter ersten Ebola-Opfern im Kongo - WELT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Red Cross volunteers among the first Ebola victims in the Congo - WELT
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers are among the first Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. They likely contracted the virus on March 27 while handling the corpses of Ebola-infected individuals, dying on May 5, May 15, and May 16, before the outbreak's pathogen was identified. First Ebola cases were laboratory-confirmed on May 15. Officials say the outbreak likely went undetected for weeks; the Bundibugyo strain of Ebolavirus is involved, which initially eluded standard tests. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The assessed risk is very high for local transmission, high regionally, and low globally. Ebola spreads through close contact with body fluids, not through airborne droplets; even corpses can carry high viral loads days after death. The outbreak location remains the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ初のエボラ犠牲者の中に赤十字ボランティア3名 - WELT
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスによる確認された集団発生で、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。死亡例および医療従事者への感染あり。国際的拡大リスク評価は記事で言及されている。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株であることが確認されている。医療従事者への感染が確認されており、接触感染リスクが高い。記事は配信日時が2026年となっており、将来日付であるが、報告されたイベント日時は2026年5月である。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 750 إصابة بـ"إيبولا" في إفريقيا - شفق نيوز | آخر الأخبار العاجلة في العراق وكوردستان والعالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 750 Ebola cases in Africa - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq, Kurdistan, and the world.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced Ebola outbreaks caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, following confirmation in both countries. On May 16, 2026, he declared Ebola with Bundibugyo virus a Public Health Emergency of International Concern under the International Health Regulations. As of May 21, 2026, the DRC reported about 750 suspected cases with 177 deaths among the suspected; 85 cases were laboratory-confirmed (including 2 in Uganda), with 10 deaths. The outbreak spans DRC and Uganda, prompting international concern, though the article does not provide details on transmission routes, symptoms, or control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：アフリカでエボラ患者750人 - シャファク・ニュース | イラク、クルディスタン、世界の最新速報
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）の国際的な公開衛生上の緊急事態宣言であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。複数国での多数の患者と死亡が報告されており、WHOが正式に国際的懸念事項として宣言した。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでも確認されたと述べているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。2026年5月16日付けでWHOが国際的懸念事項として正式宣言されており、極めて重大なシグナル。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Drei Rotkreuz-Helfer unter ersten Ebola-Opfern im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Red Cross volunteers among the first Ebola victims in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers are among the first Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, killed after likely treating and burying Ebola-infected corpses. The federation IFRC says the three probably contracted the virus on March 27 while handling bodies in the course of humanitarian work, before the outbreak's scope was known. They died on May 5, May 15, and May 16. Ebola cases were laboratory-confirmed for the first time on May 15, with experts believing the outbreak had remained undetected for weeks as clusters of unexplained deaths were investigated. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, which initially escaped confirmation with standard tests. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). Transmission occurs through close contact with infected body fluids, not via airborne droplets; corpses can remain highly infectious days after death.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染で赤十字ボランティア3人が最初の犠牲者に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。希少なブンディブギョ株による大規模な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的な重大感染症イベントとして公式認定済み。希少なBundibugyo株の検出、医療従事者の感染、数週間の検出漏れなど複数の懸念要因が存在。フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Ibiporã orienta moradores sobre infecções respiratórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ibiporã Health Department Advises Residents on Respiratory Infections.
article.articleSummary: Ibiporã's Municipal Health Department in Paraná, Brazil, warns residents as Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin reports a nationwide rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), based on data from May 10–16. SRAG incidence remains higher in young children and is mainly linked to Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), while increases in other age groups are driven by Influenza A. The dry autumn weather is facilitating circulation of viruses and bacteria that cause respiratory infections, including RSV bronchiolitis in infants. The bulletin emphasizes vaccination and reinforces respiratory etiquette. Measures include avoiding handshakes, kisses, and hugs; avoiding crowds; ensuring well-ventilated spaces; covering the mouth when coughing or sneezing; regular handwashing; not touching the eyes, nose, or mouth in public; avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals; staying home during transmission; seeking medical care if needed.

triage.headline_ja: イビポラ市保健部、呼吸器感染症について住民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでRSVとインフルエンザAの増加が報告されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性があるが、情報が予防措置の強調であり、重症度や管理上の懸念の具体的な記載が不足しているため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル全国的なSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の増加を報告。RSVはしばしば深刻化し得るため、小児への影響に注意。Fiocruzによる全国的な監視データが引用されており、公衆衛生当局の関心が示唆されている。ただし死亡数や入院数などの具体的な重症度指標の記載がないため、スクリーニング基準は3/5となるが、詳細なRRA実施時に重症度が明らかになる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo World Cup squad forced to isolate because of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Disrupted DR Congo World Cup prep as the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts a 21‑day isolation for the squad before they can enter the United States. The team, training in Belgium, must maintain a bubble to Houston ahead of their June 11 arrival, with travel restrictions requiring strict adherence to the bubble to avoid border risk. US CDC rules bar entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have been in DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan in the previous 21 days. DR Congo reports about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths as of Wednesday. The squad’s World Cup schedule places them in Group with Portugal (Houston), Colombia (Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (Atlanta) as Canada, Mexico, and the US host. The team had canceled build-up events in Kinshasa due to the outbreak; a send-off ceremony with President Tshisekedi was also affected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行のためDRコンゴのワールドカップ選手団が隔離を余儀なくされている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生（疑い例600件、疑い死亡139件）、国際的な渡航制限の実施、複数国への人的移動と隔離措置が必要となる状況であり、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストには米国、メキシコ、ベルギー、ウガンダ、スーダン、コロンビア、ウズベキスタン、カナダが含まれているが、これらはワールドカップの開催国または選手団の移動先・グループ国であり、エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRコンゴのみ。記事の主題はDRコンゴのエボラ流行であり、渡航制限は米国CDCが過去21日間のDRコンゴ滞在者に対して課しているもの。本シグナルはDRコンゴでのエボラ流行事象として処理すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : De nouveaux cas confirmés en Ouganda, voisin de l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: New confirmed cases in Uganda, near the outbreak's epicenter.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Ebola in Uganda has five confirmed cases after three new confirmations on Saturday, bringing the total from two to five. The cases include a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed case, a healthcare worker who treated him, and a Congolese woman who arrived in Uganda by plane; all are under treatment or monitoring. Uganda has suspended public transport to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to limit cross-border spread. Authorities have identified and are following all contacts linked to the confirmed cases. The outbreak is centered in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern due to a rapidly expanding situation, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths reported in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダで新たな確定症例、流行の震源地近くで確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、死亡を含む深刻な影響、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み、国境管理実施中。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、記事サマリーに明示されているDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。DRCでのエボラ発生が主要なイベントであり、ウガンダでの症例はその波及である。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国への拡大確認、死亡報告あり、公共交通の制限実施中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak in Congo and Uganda a Global Health Emergency
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-23, the World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The DRC reports 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths; Uganda has two confirmed linked cases. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO and CDC urge intensified testing, contact tracing, and infection control measures. Public guidance stresses avoiding contact with infected individuals, their body fluids, bats, and wild animals. Travelers returning from affected regions should monitor for Ebola symptoms for 21 days. Early detection, isolation, and public awareness are identified as key to preventing further spread, with WHO and CDC continuing to monitor and support the affected countries. The IHR Emergency Committee held its first meeting regarding this epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴおよびウガンダのエボラ出血熱発生を世界保健上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言。WHO Emergency Committee召集により国際的懸念が確認され、複数国での確認症例と死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、DRCでの246疑い症例・80死亡、ウガンダでの2確認症例が報告されている。ウガンダはリンク症例（DRCからの二次感染）と記載されており、主な流行地はDRCである。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株、WHO Emergency Committee召集、渡航者への勧告、ワクチン・治療法の欠如など、複数の重大なシグナルが認められる。

article.articleHeadline: "بسبب فيروس إيبولا".. البيت الأبيض يؤكد ضرورة عزل المنتخب الكونغولي قبل كأس العالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to the Ebola virus, the White House confirms the need to isolate the Congolese national team before the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the White House announced that the Republic of the Congo national football team must isolate for 21 days in a health bubble to prevent Ebola infection before entering the United States for the World Cup. White House World Cup Committee chair Andrew Giuliani told ESPN that the team must complete the 21-day isolation before arriving in Houston on June 11. The squad, currently training in Belgium, would begin isolation on Friday to meet the deadline. If any new players join, they would be placed in a separate isolation bubble from the rest of the team. Officials warned that the appearance of Ebola symptoms on arrival could lead to the team’s exclusion from the World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスのため、ホワイトハウスがワールドカップ前のコンゴ代表チームの隔離の必要性を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス関連の公衆衛生措置ですが、実質的な患者発生報告ではなく予防的隔離措置に関する政策ニュースと判断される。記事サマリーに医療上の実際の発症例の詳細がないため、スクリーニング基準の判定に不確実性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は政策対応ニュースであり、実際のエボラ患者発生や流行の具体的な情報を含んでいない。コンゴ代表チームの予防的隔離措置に関する米国の政策決定に関する報道と解釈される。実際の感染症イベントの詳細が不足しており、続報で患者発生状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Travel restrictions on DR Congo as Ebola threat rises to highest level
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, has 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The WHO has raised the regional risk to very high; the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments, leaving containment to contact tracing and isolation. Rwanda restricts entry for foreign nationals who travelled through DRC in the past 30 days and imposes quarantine for Rwandan nationals/residents, with enhanced screening at Kigali airport. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death; flights to/from DRC are halted within 48 hours, and all public transport is suspended for four weeks, while cargo/food transport continues and border-zone markets are closed. The outbreak began up to two months ago and was officially declared last week.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の脅威が最高レベルに上昇したため、コンゴ民主共和国への渡航制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の地域的流行で確認患者82名・死亡7名、複数国への波及、渡航制限が既に実施されており、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi州が主要流行地で、ウガンダで確認患者2名、ルワンダは制限措置を実施。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療薬がなく、接触者追跡と隔離が主要対策。WHOが地域リスク「極めて高い」に引き上げ。

article.articleHeadline: البيت الأبيض يفرض "فقاعة صحية" على منتخب الكونغو للمشاركة في كأس العالم بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The White House imposes a "health bubble" on the Congo national team to participate in the World Cup because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, the cause of severe hemorrhagic fever, is at the center of a precautionary move by the United States ahead of the World Cup. As of May 23, 2026, the White House requires the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team to undergo a 21-day self-isolation inside a closed health bubble as a condition for entering the United States and taking part in the World Cup finals, which begin within a month. The measure aims to prevent potential spread of Ebola through international travel tied to the tournament. No additional details on confirmed cases or outbreak status are provided. The policy emphasizes entry restrictions and infection control for imported teams in the context of global sports events.

triage.headline_ja: ホワイトハウスがエボラ対策としてコンゴ代表チームに「ヘルスバブル」を強制
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症という高リスク病原体が関連しており、国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されているが、記事サマリーでは具体的な患者数やアウトブレイクの状況が不明であり、追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生に関連する国際的な渡航制限措置である。米国の対応は言及されているが、実際のアウトブレイク規模、患者数、感染状況に関する具体的情報が欠落している。エボラウイルスの高い死亡率と国際スポーツイベント関連の異例な措置により、今後の患者数報告や流行状況の更新を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تؤكد تسجيل إصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms new cases of Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Three new laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases were reported in Uganda, bringing the total confirmed cases in the country to five. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting international concern and a very high risk of a national outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. The DRC, which is the outbreak’s epicenter and shares a border with Uganda, has about 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths attributed to the virus. Authorities in Uganda are intensifying contact tracing to contain transmission and prevent cross-border spread. As of May 23, 2026, surveillance remains active to monitor and respond to the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルスの新規症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの Bundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイクであり、DRC と国境を接するウガンダでも症例が急増している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ（Uganda）での新規症例確認が主題だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはアウトブレイクの震源地として明記されており、対象国リストに含まれるため記載。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Bu ölkədə Ebolaya yoluxanların sayı artdı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in this country has risen.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda reports five Ebola virus disease cases after laboratory analysis confirmed three more infections. Two of the new cases are direct contacts of the country's first patient; the third case is a citizen of the Democratic Republic of Congo who is currently in Uganda. Health authorities have begun urgent contact tracing and monitoring to identify and supervise additional contacts to prevent further spread. The report specifies laboratory confirmation of the three new infections but provides no details on symptoms or outcomes. The resurgence underscores the ongoing outbreak in the country and the need for rapid laboratory confirmation and focused public health measures to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: この国でエボラに感染した人の数が増加した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い重症度と致死率を持つ検査確定症例で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、国際拡大リスク（DRC市民がウガンダにいること）も存在するため、直ちにフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRC市民がウガンダに滞在中であることが記載されているが、サマリーの主題はウガンダでの症例増加であるため verified_locations に含めるのはUgandaのみ。記事本文が空のため詳細情報不足だが、エボラの確定症例増加は十分なシグナル。直ちにフルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Красный Крест сообщил о смерти троих волонтеров в ДР Конго в самом начале вспышки вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Red Cross reported the deaths of three volunteers in the DR Congo at the very start of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers died in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo from Ebola virus infection, the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) said on May 23, 2026, at the very start of an Ebola outbreak. The statement confirms fatalities among Red Cross personnel in the eastern DR Congo as authorities confront early transmission. The report provides no further details on laboratory confirmation, specific sites, or the number of cases or deaths beyond these three volunteer fatalities. The wording indicates the deaths occurred at the outbreak’s outset, underscoring the risk to aid workers during the early phase of Ebola transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染症の流行初期に3人のボランティアの死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の新規流行が確認され、IHR基準2つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際拡大のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例）、流行性（ヒト-ヒト感染）、管理可能性（支援必要性）の複数が該当。フルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高いリスク疾患。記事は流行の初期段階での報告で、赤十字ボランティアの罹患・死亡という援助従事者への危険性も示唆。詳細情報（症例数、確認地域、検査確認状況）が限定的であるため、続報による情報更新が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Panic in Kisoro as Woman Who Used Chanika Border Tests Positive in Goma
article.articleSummary: Ebola panic in Kisoro District after a woman who recently passed through the Chanika border route tested positive for Ebola in Goma, Democratic Republic of Congo. Kisoro, a high-risk border district near Uganda and eastern DRC, has heightened concern given its history of vulnerability to Ebola outbreaks. The woman traveled from Uganda through Chanika to Gisenyi in Rwanda, then on to Goma, where the Ebola diagnosis was confirmed. While Rwanda has reportedly begun tracing her contacts, Ugandan officials have not yet identified any contacts linked to her. Security and health officials in Kisoro report that border screening and investigations into her movements are ongoing, urging the public to follow standard operating procedures as surveillance and contact tracing continue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：キソロでパニック、チャニカ国境を使用した女性がゴマで陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の確定症例が確認され、国際的な移動と複数国への拡大リスク（DRC・ルワンダ・ウガンダ関連）が明確。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・公衆衛生影響が該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、確定症例はゴマ（DRC）で診断されており、患者の移動経路はウガンダ→ルワンダ→DRCとされている。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウガンダとルワンダも含まれているが、記事の主題は『DRC（ゴマ）での確定症例』であり、サマリーにおいてウガンダとルワンダは接触者追跡対象国としてのみ言及されている。したがって、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダとルワンダでの確定症例報告や独立した発生が記述されていないため、対象国リストに含まれていてもこの段階では除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 177 وفاة و750 حالة مشتبه بها جراء تفشي الإيبولا في إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 177 deaths and 750 suspected cases due to Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on May 16, 2026. As of May 21, 2026, there were 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths among suspected cases in the DRC; 85 laboratory-confirmed cases overall, including two in Uganda, with 10 confirmed deaths. Uganda reported two imported cases with no confirmed local transmission. An American citizen who worked in the DRC was infected and evacuated to Germany for treatment, and a second American citizen who was a contact of the patients was also infected. The report highlights international concern and ongoing cross-border outbreak management across the two countries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の流行により177人が死亡、750人の疑い患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大、国際的な渡航制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の流行が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アメリカ・ドイツへの輸送例は医療避難であり発生地としては計上しない。PHEC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)宣言、高い致命率(177/750)、複数国への拡大、国際的な人員配置により極度に重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 美国扩大埃博拉疫情入境限制　纳入绿卡持有者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. expands Ebola outbreak entry restrictions to include green card holders.
article.articleSummary: US expands Ebola outbreak entry restrictions to include green card holders. The US Department of Health and Human Services, via the CDC, implemented a temporary rule barring lawful permanent residents who, in the past 21 days, traveled to or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan from entering the United States. The 30-day enhanced screening and entry controls also apply to non-US passport holders with recent travel to affected areas; previously, US citizens and green card holders were allowed to enter. The CDC says the measure is not permanent. WHO increased the country-level risk of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC from High to Very High, with regional risk high and global risk low. There are no confirmed Ebola cases in the United States, and the general public risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱流行の入国制限をグリーンカード保有者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の展開、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。実在する感染症危機管理措置で、地域リスク評価の上昇と複数国での影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の入国制限措置を主題としているが、エボラ出血熱の実際の発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WHOが国レベルリスク評価をHighからVery Highに引き上げており、地域的な懸念が顕著。米国での確認症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mueren tres cooperantes de Cruz Roja tras contagiarse de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Red Cross aid workers die after contracting Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, three Red Cross aid workers died after contracting Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Identified as Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo, and Ajiko Chandiru Vivian, they were part of the Red Cross delegation in Mongbwalu, one of the areas hardest hit by the Ebola outbreak. The organization said the collaborators likely contracted the virus while performing humanitarian duties related to handling corpses in late March, a time when health authorities had not yet officially detected the outbreak in the area. The incident underscores the occupational risks faced by frontline responders during Ebola outbreaks in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染した赤十字の協力者3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認死亡例、DRCでの複数死亡事例であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が認められ、国際的拡大リスクとWPRO重症度基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死性と国際的な懸念をもたらす指定感染症。複数の医療従事者死亡例は管理能力への重大な懸念を示唆。記事サマリーで明確にDRCでのイベント発生が確認され、Mangbwalu地域がアウトブレイク最多被害地域として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in Uganda: WHO warnt vor Epidemie im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Uganda: WHO warns of an epidemic in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda, with three new infections reported on Saturday: a driver who carried the country’s first confirmed case, a medical professional who treated him, and a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who entered Uganda with mild symptoms, sought care in Kampala at a private hospital, and later returned to the DRC before testing positive after a pilot linked to her transport alerted authorities. Uganda does not publish suspected-case counts. The outbreak center is the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The Congo outbreak carries a very high risk of a nationwide epidemic; it is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus type, for which there is no vaccine or therapy, and is difficult to contain, with Ituri province in eastern DRC particularly affected.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク：WHOがコンゴでの流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。ワクチンや治療法のないBundibugyo ebolavirus型による多国間での感染確認。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ(Uganda)も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC中心のアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダの症例は二次的な国境越え感染として記述されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus型はワクチン・治療法がない稀な型として記述されており、広域流行リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄現115年首例本土登革熱　基因定序釐清感染源 | 生活 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever case in Year 115; genome sequencing clarifies the source of infection.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever case of Year 115 (2026), in a man in his 60s from Qianjin District. He presented with fever, headache, and myalgia; NS1 rapid test and PCR confirmed dengue virus type 1. No overseas travel history; two close contacts tested negative. Samples are sent to the CDC for genomic sequencing to identify the infection source, with results expected by May 26, 2026. Authorities expanded testing to over 50 nearby contacts, activated a cross-agency command center, and plan environmental cleaning and vector surveillance around the patient’s residence and workplace. Nationwide dengue cases this year total 64, with 1 local and 63 imported from Southeast Asia and South Asia. The rainy season and rising temperatures elevate Aedes aegypti–related risk in Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Pingtung; residents are advised to inspect, drain, clean, and brush to eliminate breeding sites and seek prompt medical care if symptoms occur.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で2026年初の本土デング熱患者報告、ゲノム解析で感染源を特定へ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での本土デング熱症例報告だが、対象国リストに台湾が含まれていないため verified_locations は空。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行リスク）に該当する可能性があるが、情報不足と地域制限により WATCH 判定。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（高雄、台南、屏東）でのデング熱発生を報告しているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。そのため verified_locations は空配列。ただし、気候変動による媒介蚊リスク上昇、本土感染確認、当局の積極的対応など、地域の感染症管理観点では関心の高いイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Τρία νέα κρούσματα Έμπολα στην Ουγκάντα - 750 ύποπτα κρούσματα στο Κονγκό | Parallaxi Magazine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola cases in Uganda - 750 suspected cases in the Congo | Parallaxi Magazine
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases were confirmed in Uganda on May 23, 2026, elevating the country’s total to five. The new patients are a Ugandan driver who carried the first confirmed case into Uganda, a health worker infected while caring for that patient, and a Congolese woman who arrived in Uganda by air. All contacts associated with confirmed cases have been identified and are under watch. Uganda had suspended all public transport routes to the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 21. The Congo (DRC) reports about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths in its eastern outbreak, prompting a WHO health alert. The WHO director-general warned the outbreak is spreading rapidly, underscoring the cross-border risk given Uganda’s border with DRC and population around 100 million.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の新規患者3人を確認 - コンゴでは750人の疑似患者 | Parallaxi Magazine
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国境を越えた拡大、異常事象、渡航制限措置）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当（異常性、重症度、継続的な曝露、流行性、管理可能性の課題）。WHO警告あり、社会的関心も高い。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラ確定症例および疑似患者報告。WHO警告および国境措置実施により、WHO通知相当の緊急事象と評価。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。Myanmar は記事に言及がないため誤記であるが、指示に従い対象国リスト内で実際に発生している国のみを含めるべきであり、本来はDRCのみが妥当。訂正：ウガンダは対象国外のため除外し、DRCのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Америка ја затвора вратата за патници од ебола-зоните
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: America Closes Its Doors to Passengers from Ebola Zones
article.articleSummary: CDC expands entry restrictions to the United States and permanent residents who have stayed in Ebola-affected areas—Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan—within the last 21 days, due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The measure, previously applied to foreign nationals, now also covers green-card holders; U.S. citizens may still enter but face enhanced health screenings. Repatriations are routed through Washington Dulles International Airport for additional checks and monitoring. The restriction is described as temporary to reduce importation risk, with immediate threat to the public deemed low but the situation monitored for potential adjustments. The World Health Organization has raised Congo’s outbreak risk to very high nationally, with hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of confirmed infections, and warnings that the virus may have circulated weeks before detection. This tests the balance between public health protections and immigration policy.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカがエボラウイルス感染地域からの乗客入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ）。社会的・政治的関心が高い。対象国DRCにおける実際のエボラ発生イベントであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (EBO-Bu)による確認されたアウトブレイク。WHOがコンゴのアウトブレイクリスクを「very high」に評価。数百の疑い例と数十の確認例が報告されている。米国CDCが入国制限を拡大（外国人のみならず米国永住者も対象）。記事では Uganda と South Sudan も影響地域として言及されているが、サマリーの主要な流行地はDRCであり、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Trois nouveaux cas d'Ebola confirmés en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Uganda has three new Ebola virus disease cases, bringing total confirmed cases to five. The two Ugandan nationals are linked to the first locally detected case: a driver who transported the initial patient and a healthcare worker who treated him; both are under treatment. The third case is a Congolese woman who entered Uganda from the DRC with mild abdominal symptoms, traveled on a charter from Arua to Entebbe, and sought care at a private hospital in Kampala on 10 May; authorities opened an investigation after a report from the pilot who carried her. All contacts have been identified and are under close surveillance. Officials urge calm and continued prevention, noting early treatment improves survival. Uganda has intensified surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness to contain the outbreak across the border-linked context.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで3件の新しいエボラ出血熱確認症例
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準の複数に該当する。国境を越えた感染拡大（DRCからの輸入症例）、医療従事者への感染、接触者の集中監視下にあり、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱確認症例が主題であり、DRCからの輸入症例を含んでいることが明確。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCは含まれるため記載。ただし、主要な発生地はウガンダであり、国境を越えた感染リスクが高い。医療従事者感染、複数接触者の監視下にあることから、制御困難性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Lei relembra 12 mil vítimas da Covid-19 no Grande ABC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Law recalls 12,000 COVID-19 victims in Greater ABC.
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 caused about 12,000 deaths in the Greater ABC region and about 716,000 in Brazil from 2020–2025, per the Health Ministry panel. The year 2021 was the deadliest: roughly 7,500 deaths in Greater ABC and about 424,000 nationwide. The WHO declared the pandemic on March 11, 2020; President Lula established the National Day in Memory of Covid-19 Victims for March 12. The date commemorates more than 700 victims in the region, including Zelão (José Dantas Irmão), founder of Cantina do Zelão in São Bernardo do Campo, who died at 78 on December 31, 2020. The first regional case was March 15; the first death March 25, a 68-year-old Santo André resident. Zelão’s daughters Rosemeire, Luciana and Luisa Alves Dantas now run the restaurant. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha says the day should spur reflection on future pandemics and aid for victims and families.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの大ABC地域でCOVID-19の12,000人の犠牲者を追悼する法律
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19の過去の死亡者を追悼する法律制定に関する歴史的・文化的報道であり、現在進行中の感染症クライシスではなく、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示していない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は2020-2025年のCOVID-19パンデミックの過去の影響を追悼する法律制定であり、現在の感染症シグナル（新たな流行、新規症例、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威）を報告していない。歴史的記念イベントであるため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms new Ebola cases, linked to DR Congo | International
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases confirmed in Uganda, bringing the total to five since May 15. The patients are a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan health worker, and a Congolese woman from the DRC; all are alive. Uganda confirmations follow the DRC outbreak's escalation, with WHO raising the regional risk to very high and declaring an international emergency; DRC has 82 confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, for which no vaccines or treatments exist. Uganda suspended public transport to the DRC after its first two cases (one infection, one death) involving Congolese nationals who crossed the border. The Congolese woman treated in Kampala for abdominal pains was discharged May 14 and tested positive after returning to the DRC. All contacts have been identified and are monitored. Epicenter: eastern DRC (Ituri, South Kivu) with M23 activity.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新しいエボラ症例を確認、DRコンゴと関連
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認例、高い重症度、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRコンゴが主要な感染源地であり、IturiとSouth Kivu地域を含む。Bundibugyo株で、ワクチンや治療法がない点が特に懸念される。WHO緊急宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda identifica tres nuevos casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda identifies three new Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases linked to the outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, bringing total confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda to five. The three new cases are two healthcare workers who cared for the first in-country confirmed case from DRC, and a Congolese woman. All contacts have been identified and are under close surveillance by the health response teams. The outbreak in the DRC has resulted in nearly 180 suspected deaths and about 750 possible cases in the neighboring country. Uganda has updated its tally with the World Health Organization. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised the Ugandan government's response, urging sustained vigilance, as WHO works with Africa CDC and partners in DRC and Uganda to contain the outbreak. As of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ出血熱患者3人を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（DRCからウガンダへの越境）、複数国での確認例、高い重症度、WHOの関与により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: DRCで約180の疑い死亡例と約750の可能性例を報告；ウガンダへの越境感染が確認される国際的懸念事項。WHO事務局長が声明を発表し、アフリカCDCも関与。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないが、DRCの確認拠点の隣国で重要な関連地域。verified_locationsはBluedot APIの発生地域から対象国リストのDRCのみを厳密に適用。

article.articleHeadline: Уганда потвърди три нови случая на ебола, общият им брой вече е пет - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirmed three new cases of Ebola, their total number is now five - News from Dnes.bg.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirmed three new Ebola cases, bringing the outbreak total to five, according to the health ministry on Saturday. The World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting the risk of a national outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is 'very high'. In DR Congo, about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported. The three Ugandan cases include a driver who ferried the first confirmed patient, a health-care worker infected while caring for him, and a Congolese woman who crossed into Uganda with mild abdominal symptoms, traveled from Arua, near the border, to Entebbe, sought care in a private hospital in Kampala, and later tested positive after follow-up prompted by a pilot involved in transporting her. All identified contacts are under close monitoring; the public is urged to stay vigilant. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ患者3人を確認、患者総数は5人に - Dnes.bgニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的保健上の脅威として宣言。また、複数のWPRO基準に該当し、国際的な感染拡大リスクが高い状況。
triage.notes: WHOが既に国際的保健上の脅急事態（PHEIC）として宣言。ウガンダ内での複数の市（Kampala、Entebbe、Arua）での感染拡大と国境を越えた患者移動が確認されている。DRCでの感染状況も極めて深刻（疑い患者750名、疑い死亡177名）。ヒト-ヒト感染により急速に拡大するリスク極高。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ebola varca i confini, cinque casi in Uganda. L'epidemia si espande e gli Usa vietano l'ingresso a chi ha viaggiato in tre Paesi africani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crosses borders; five cases in Uganda. The epidemic spreads and the U.S. bans entry to anyone who has traveled to three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Uganda, with five confirmed cases in Uganda as of May 23, 2026 (two initial, one death; three more confirmed later). Uganda suspended all public transport toward the DRC on May 15. In response to the cross-border outbreak, the U.S. government expanded entry restrictions under Title 42 to bar not only non-immigrant visitors but now legal permanent residents who have traveled in the prior 21 days to the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. The HHS issued a final interim rule; the CDC emphasized it is discretionary, temporary, and not a permanent ban to protect public health during fast-evolving epidemics. Earlier, six Americans exposed to Ebola in Congo were being monitored. Separately, Congo’s national team must maintain a 21-day health bubble in Belgium before likely arrival to Houston for the World Cup, or risk denied entry.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がウガンダで5例報告。流行が拡大し、米国が3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航歴のある者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは高い重症度と死亡率を有し、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染）が顕在化し、米国による入国制限など国際的な渡航・貿易制限措置が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの5症例確認は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはリスト対象国。記事は米国・ベルギムでの措置言及も含むが、実際のエボラ流行はDRC/ウガンダで発生しており、DRCのみを verified_locations に列挙。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达本轮埃博拉疫情首次出现本土病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's current Ebola outbreak reports its first locally transmitted case.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda reports three new Ebola virus disease confirmed cases, bringing the outbreak total to five. Two locally transmitted cases are Ugandan nationals linked to the first confirmed patient: a driver who transported the initial patient and a healthcare worker exposed while caring for the first patient; both are receiving treatment. The third case is a female from the Democratic Republic of Congo who recently entered Uganda from DR Congo with mild abdominal symptoms, traveled by charter from Arua to Entebbe, sought care at a private Kampala hospital from May 10–14, and then returned to DR Congo after testing positive for Ebola virus. Earlier Kampala cases were imported from DR Congo; one died (body repatriated) and the other remains in isolation in a Kampala hospital. Contacts are being monitored; authorities urge vigilance and adherence to control measures, noting early detection improves survival.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの現在のエボラ流行で初めて本土病例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例5例（本土感染2例含む）がウガンダで報告され、国際的拡大リスク（DRC-ウガンダ間の越境感染）が明確。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、シグナルレベルの事象。
triage.notes: 本土感染（医療従事者と初期患者の接触者）の確認は流行拡大の重要な指標。DRC発症者のウガンダ国内の複数地域への移動（アルア→エンテッベ→カンパラ）による二次感染リスクが存在。医療施設での感染の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms three more Ebola cases linked to Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, Uganda confirmed three additional Ebola infections linked to the Congo outbreak: two cases— a driver and a nurse—had contact with the initial patient last week, and a Congolese woman who travelled by plane to Kampala and later returned to Congo. She had been treated for abdominal complaints at a private hospital in Kampala before testing positive after a pilot alerted authorities. Uganda now reports five confirmed Ebola cases; suspected infections in Uganda are not published. WHO reports about Congo: nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; lab-confirmed infections total 82 with seven deaths, with true numbers likely higher due to undetected/unreported cases. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment, drives a rapidly escalating outbreak starting in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan; Congo declared a public health emergency of international concern, with very high risk. One imported case to Uganda noted; ongoing contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがコンゴ流行に関連するエボラ感染者3例を追加確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも全5基準該当。複数国での確認、死亡例、ワクチン/治療法なしの株、国家間の感染拡大が認められる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがUgandaを発生地域に含めているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴでの発生（Ituri州、750疑い例、82確認例、177疑い死亡例）であり、ウガンダは二次的な拡大地点（5確認例）。同時にウガンダへの国際的な感染拡大（飛行機利用による輸入例）が記述されているため、国際拡大リスクは明確。ただしverified_locationsは対象国リスト内で実際のイベント発生国のみであり、DRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo株はワクチン/治療法なし、公衆衛生上の国際懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言済み。フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: White House Tells Congo's Soccer Team to Isolate, Citing Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo triggers U.S. isolation orders for DR Congo's national soccer team ahead of World Cup 2026. The team must maintain a 21-day bubble in Belgium before entering the United States for a June 11 arrival and a June 17 opener in Houston against Portugal. WHO estimates >170 deaths and about 750 infections; risk is high nationally/regional, low globally. The outbreak is in a conflict-affected area with over a million displaced, allowing a rare form to circulate undetected for weeks. Congo canceled its Kinshasa training camp; any symptomatic person would jeopardize the team's participation. U.S. authorities have tightened border measures, including a 30-day entry ban for people who had been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior three weeks.

triage.headline_ja: ホワイトハウス、エボラ感染拡大を理由にコンゴのサッカーチームに隔離を指示
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的に重要な感染拡大事例。WHOが170人以上の死亡と約750人の感染を報告しており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク（複数国への入国制限、国際イベントへの影響）を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRCでのエボラ感染拡大を主題としており、WHOが170人以上の死亡と約750人の感染を報告。米国が30日間の入国禁止措置を発令し、2026年ワールドカップへの影響も生じている。発生地域リストにはKinshasa、Houston、Texas、米国、スーダン、ポルトガル、ベルギー、ウガンダが含まれているが、実際の感染拡大の主舞台はDRC（東部）である。ベルギー、ポルトガル、米国は隔離・隔離措置や国際イベント関連の対応地域であり、一次的な発生地点ではないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is now third largest in history. Here's what to know. | Mint
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Ituri province of northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo is the third largest Ebola outbreak in history. As of Friday, at least 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths in Congo, with two traveler-related cases in Uganda. The outbreak began with an April 24 health worker case who died; spread followed burial of the virus-ridden body. Ituri is war-torn, densely populated, with displacement and hunger; cross-border transmission to Uganda noted. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola species, with two previous outbreaks and >30% case fatality in past outbreaks, though it replicates more slowly than Zaire ebolavirus. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo; vaccines/drugs exist for Zaire but differ. Lab confirmation required sending samples to a distant lab. US risk is low; travel bans and screening are in place; several Bundibugyo vaccine candidates are in development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生が歴史上3番目の規模に。ここで知っておくべきことをご紹介します。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大のリスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の稀少性、高い致死率、ワクチン/治療法の不在、国境を越えた感染事例によりWPRO基準も複数該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからウガンダでの旅行者関連症例が報告されているが、主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は既存のエボラワクチン/治療法と異なり、高い致死率（>30%）と利用可能な対策の限定性が重大なリスク因子。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma tres nuevos casos de ébola y pide calma a la población
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases and urges calm among the population.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports three new Ebola cases, bringing the national total to five as the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province is ongoing. The new cases include a Ugandan driver who ferried the first confirmed patient in Uganda, a Ugandan health worker exposed while treating that patient, and a Congolese woman who entered Uganda from the DRC. The Congolese patient arrived from Ituri to Uganda (Arua) and traveled to Entebbe for care, seeking treatment on May 10 at a private Kampala hospital, was discharged May 14 in good condition, and later tested positive after notification from the flight crew. All contacts have been identified and are under close surveillance. Authorities urge calm, vigilant monitoring, and adherence to preventive measures; early treatment improves survival. The Ituri outbreak involves Bundibugyo Ebola (30–50% CFR; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment). WHO reported 177 suspected deaths and 750 suspected cases in the RDC, with regional controls including Rwanda’s border measures.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが3件の新たなエボラ患者を確認し、国民に落ち着きを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の越境的な拡大が確認されており、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。複数国での同時流行により、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain、CFR 30-50%）の越境患者流入が確認されており、DRC東部Ituri州での流行が継続中。ウガンダ国内での市中感染リスク、隣国ルワンダへの拡大可能性もあり、地域的に高リスク。WHOが既に認知している状況（RDCで疑い症例750件、疑い死亡177件）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Was diesen Ausbruch gefährlich macht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What makes this outbreak dangerous.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is portrayed as highly dangerous amid a profound humanitarian crisis as of 2026-05-23. Six million internally displaced and 26 million facing hunger underscore the fragility of outbreak response. Financial cuts further hamper operations. Aid workers from various NGOs, including CARE, are on the front lines but risk their safety as they try to contain the virus. The interview with CARE country director Amadou Bocoum on-site provides firsthand insight into the challenges faced by communities and responders in the DRC. The article emphasizes funding shortfalls, security risks for responders, and the strain on humanitarian infrastructure impacting disease control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：このアウトブレイクが危険な理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の発生であり、深刻な人道危機下での流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明らかであり、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上最高レベルの懸念疾患。DRCの人道危機（630万人の国内避難民、2,600万人が飢餓直面）と資金不足は対応能力を著しく低下させている。NGO援助者の安全リスクも報告されており、複合的な危機状況を呈している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Forces DR Congo World Cup Squad Into 21-Day Isolation in Belgium
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo prompts DR Congo World Cup squad to 21-day isolation in Belgium; US requires bubble and 21-day isolation before arrival in Houston for June 17 World Cup opener vs Portugal. CDC bans entry of foreign nationals who've been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in past three weeks, for 30 days. Bundibugyo Ebola, rarer variant with no approved vaccine or treatment, is at the center of the outbreak, which WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern; death toll exceeds 130 with nearly 600 suspected cases. DR Congo canceled a three-day training camp and farewell event in Kinshasa. Squad members largely based in Europe, including Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham), Yoane Wissa (Newcastle), and captain Chancel Mbemba (Lille), under coach Sebastien Desabre.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症のアウトブレイク、DRコンゴのワールドカップスクワッドをベルギーで21日間の隔離に強制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo Eボラウイルス（ワクチン・治療薬未承認の稀な変異株）による公衆衛生上の重大危機であり、WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、130人超の死亡、600近い疑い例が報告されている。複数国への国際的拡大（DRコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダン）と各国による渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは複数国が言及されているが（ベルギー、米国、ウガンダ、南スーダン）、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRコンゴである。ベルギーの隔離、米国の入国制限は対応措置であり、発生地そのものではない。対象国リストではDRコンゴのみが該当。WHOによる国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo変異株という点で極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Three New Ebola Cases Confirmed in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases have been confirmed in Uganda, according to the health ministry. The patients are a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan health worker, and a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the epicentre of the deadly outbreak sowing fear in the region. The ministry says it is strengthening surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public awareness to contain the outbreak and protect the health and safety of all Ugandans. The news comes a day after the World Health Organization said the risk from the outbreak had been raised to the highest level for the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス病の新規症例3件が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高い致命性を持つ感染症の国際的拡大を示唆している。WHOが最高リスクレベルを設定した状況での国境を越えた感染確認はシグナルとして重要。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (mapped from Uganda to nearest WPRO target)

triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）は極めて高い致命性を有する感染症。記事では3名の確診例が報告され、そのうち1名はDRC国籍、2名がウガンダ国籍。DRCが流行の中心地であり、ウガンダへの国境越え感染が確認された。WHOが最高リスクレベルを宣言した直後の報告であり、地域的脅威として重大。Uganda（ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため、検証済み地域は DRC のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Three new Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda: ministry | THE DAILY TRIBUNE | KINGDOM OF BAHRAIN
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola Virus Disease cases confirmed in Uganda on Saturday, raising total Ugandan infections to five and marking the first locally transmitted cases since the outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Two Ugandan nationals—one a driver who transported the index patient and one a frontline healthcare worker exposed during treatment—are linked to the initial case. The third case is a Congolese woman who traveled from the DRC to Uganda with mild symptoms; a tip from the pilot of her chartered flight triggered the investigation in Kampala. All primary contacts have been identified for monitoring. The Ministry of Health urged calm, noting early treatment improves survival, as authorities scale up contact tracing and public health awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ出血熱の新規感染者3人確認：保健省が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例の増加、国際的な人的移動による感染拡大、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準に複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで発生したエボラが国際的に拡大し、ウガンダでの地域感染・医療従事者感染・国境越え移入症例が確認されている。死亡率の高い疾患であり、対象国内での複数国間にまたがるシグナルとして優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde reúne equipa técnica após alerta internacional de Ébola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health convenes technical team after international Ebola alert in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Cape Verde's Ministry of Health convened a technical meeting after an international Ebola alert in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The March 21–22 session, led by the National Health Directorate, aimed to reinforce national rapid-response mechanisms, assess Cabo Verde's risk, and update the national readiness and contingency plan as the WHO classified the situation as very high risk regionally and globally. Participants discussed accelerating contingency-plan implementation, issuing technical directives to health facilities, and boosting health-worker training, risk communication, and community mobilization. Attendees included the National Public Health Institute, the Office of Pharmaceutical Affairs, WHO Cabo Verde, the UNICEF/UNFPA/UNDP Joint Office, the World Bank, and the Directorate-General of Agriculture, Forestry and Livestock, plus port and airport authorities. The measures seek strengthened epidemiological surveillance and a coordinated response to a possible virus introduction, protecting the population and health system.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ国際警報後に技術チームを招集
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生は重大だが、記事の主題はカーボベルデの準備・対応措置であり、同国での患者発生確認なし。IHR基準に該当する可能性があるが、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はカーボベルデ（対象国外）での準備活動を報じており、DRCでのエボラ発生が主題。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。カーボベルデでの患者確認なし。WHO分類が「地域・世界的に極めて高リスク」との記載あり。フルRRA進行の可能性があるが、確認情報の詳細が限定的なため WATCH とする。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تسجل ثلاث إصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reports three new Ebola virus cases.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease cases were confirmed in Uganda on May 23, 2026, bringing the country's total to five amid a cross-border outbreak with the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Ugandan Health Ministry said three additional infections were confirmed, following the earlier May 15 confirmation of two cases (one of whom subsequently died). Uganda had suspended all public transport to the DRC from Thursday in response to the spillover. The World Health Organization had on May 22 raised the risk level for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola to very high, stating the outbreak in DRC and Uganda constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. No details on specific transmission links or imported/exported cases were provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルス新規感染者3例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱の国際的拡大事例。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの新規感染報告を述べているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（ガーナのID 2300660は別国）が含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC（203312）のみ対象国として該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、死亡例報告、DRC-ウガンダ間での越境アウトブレイク確認により、深刻なシグナルであることは確実。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Três voluntários da Cruz Vermelha morreram na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Three Red Cross volunteers died in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers—Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo, and Ajiko Chandiru Vivian—died in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after likely contracting Ebola while removing bodies on March 27 during a humanitarian mission not related to Ebola. The Ituri outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths. The World Health Organization notes a 30–50% mortality rate for this strain and that there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, and WHO designated it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include severe hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. A US–EU coalition urged warring parties to facilitate response operations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：赤十字の3人のボランティアがコンゴ民主共和国で死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）と WPRO基準4つ（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。WHO が PHEIC 指定済みの確認済みエボラ流行事例。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱による死亡者確認（赤十字ボランティア3名）。DRC における Bundibugyo 株によるエボラ流行。2026年5月15日に宣言、5月17日に WHO が PHEIC 指定。750 件の疑い例、177 人の死亡。Bundibugyo 株の致死率 30～50%。ワクチン・特異的治療なし。人道支援職員への感染リスク、地域紛争下での対応困難性を示す重大事例。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде выявлены новые случаи заболевания Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New cases of Ebola virus disease have been detected in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda confirmed three additional Ebola virus disease cases, bringing the total in the country to five. Two new infections occurred in individuals who had contact with an infected driver and a medical worker; a third case is a citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo who was in Uganda. Health authorities say all contacts have been identified and measures are being implemented to contain the outbreak. The Ministry of Health urged anyone with Ebola-like symptoms to seek medical care promptly, noting that early treatment significantly improves the chances of recovery.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たなエボラウイルス病の症例が検出された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク（DRC由来の症例が確認）、高い重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続的なリスク、および国境を越えた感染事例が認められる。
triage.notes: DRC由来の症例がウガンダで確認されており、両国での並行発生が示唆されている。医療従事者と運転手の感染により医療環境でのヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高い。早急なフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU ordena a la selección de RD Congo que entrene para el Mundial bajo aislamiento por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US orders DR Congo national team to train for the World Cup under isolation due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's national football team must observe a 21-day isolation in a biosecure bubble during training for the World Cup due to an Ebola outbreak declared this month in the country, with nearly 180 suspected deaths. The Leopards will train in Belgium and face Denmark on June 3 before traveling to Houston on June 11. The World Health Organization has designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Congo canceled a three-day training camp and a farewell event in Kinshasa. A June 9 friendly against Chile will be played in Cadiz, Spain, while a June 3 match vs Denmark occurs in Belgium. The team qualified via a playoff in Mexico in March and will be in Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan; their last World Cup appearance was in 1974 when the country competed as Zaire. Coach: Sébastien Desabre.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱の流行により、RDコンゴ代表がワールドカップのトレーニングを隔離下で実施するよう命令
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生で約180名の疑い死亡、WHO による国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態として認定。国際的な人の移動（ワールドカップ関連の移動）に関連し、複数国への拡大リスクと国際的な関心が高い。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには多数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRコンゴで発生したエボラ出血熱の流行である。スペイン、米国、ベルギーなどは試合会場・訓練地として言及されているが、発生国ではないため除外。対象国リストでは DRC（203312）のみが該当。WHO による PHEIC 指定、約180名の疑い死亡、国際的なスポーツイベントに関連した人の移動制限など、複数の深刻な要素が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: zampolli:'la nazionale del congo? l'epidemia di ebola e' grave: non si puo' correre il rischio di...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zampolli: 'The Congo's national team? The Ebola epidemic is serious: we cannot take the risk of....'
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s national football team cancelled part of its World Cup preparatory activities as the country grapples with an Ebola outbreak—the 17th wave—triggering a WHO international health alert. Eastern provinces, hard to reach by land amid armed conflict, bear the brunt of transmission. The outbreak has approximately 139 deaths among about 600 probable cases, with continuation possible though the WHO regards pandemic risk as low. The squad moved training from Kinshasa to Belgium; all selected players compete in Europe and had not returned to DR Congo in the prior 21 days, a requirement preceding travel to the United States. Paolo Zampolli, a Trump envoy, urged that the outbreak is so grave that allowing RDC players into the United States would be too risky, suggesting implications for Italy’s national team.

triage.headline_ja: ザンポリ：『コンゴ代表？エボラ流行は深刻だ。リスクを冒すことはできない...』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、国際渡航制限の現実的リスク）。17次波のエボラ発生により約600例・139死亡という重篤な状況であり、WHOが国際保健警報を発出している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の17次波による大規模流行。約600例の患者、139死亡、東部州での持続的な伝播。WHOが国際保健警報を発出。米国へのアクセス制限示唆など国際的政治的影響あり。発生地域にUSA・Belgium・Italyが含まれているが、記事サマリー上で実際の感染症発生は DRC のみ。選手移動はリスク回避措置であり、これらの国での発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τρία νέα κρούσματα στην Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Three new cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola cases have been confirmed in Uganda, bringing the total to five. Uganda first reported Ebola on May 15 with two cases, one of whom died; authorities have since suspended all public transport routes to the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb spread. The three new cases include a Ugandan driver who transported the index patient and a healthcare worker who contracted the virus while caring for the patient, plus a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who arrived in Uganda by air. All contacts linked to confirmed cases have been identified and are under surveillance; contact tracing is critical as transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. The World Health Organization has issued a health alert for Ebola in eastern DRC, where about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported in a population of roughly 100 million. WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak is spreading rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダで3件の新規症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは高い致死率を持ち、既に複数国での確認症例、国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからUgandaおよびDRCでのエボラ確認症例が明確に記述されている。WHOによる警告も発出されており、国際的関心が高い。Ugandaは対象国リストに直接含まれていないが、DRCはリストに含まれている。ただしサマリー上でUgandaでの新規症例が主題となっているため、地域検証ルール5に基づきUgandaも含める必要がある。対象国でない国での発生のため、リストには含めない（DRCのみ）。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تطلب عزل منتخب الكونغو الديمقراطية 21 يوماً بسبب فيروس إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States requests a 21-day quarantine of the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team due to the Ebola virus - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 130 and generated about 600 suspected cases; the World Health Organization has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The United States requests a 21‑day quarantine for the DR Congo national team before their arrival in Houston for the FIFA World Cup, with training in Belgium and two warm‑ups: vs Denmark in Belgium (June 3) and vs Chile in southern Spain (June 9). The DR Congo squad competes in Group 11 with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia. The United States has also imposed a 30‑day entry ban on foreign nationals who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan during the prior three weeks. If additional people join, they must be in a separate bubble to protect the team’s participation. The CDC is monitoring two American doctors in Europe under quarantine after Ebola exposure.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカがエボラウイルスによるコンゴ民主共和国代表チームの21日間隔離を要請 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの大規模な流行（130人以上の死亡、約600例の疑い例）がWHOにより国際的懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言されており、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染症の大規模流行が主題。発生地域にはUSA、スペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク等が含まれているが、これらは国際的な移動・対応に関連する場所であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。WPROスクリーニング基準の対象国はDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: four reasons it will be hard to contain
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo virus) declared WHO public health emergency of international concern on 17 May 2026. By 19 May, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported >500 cases and ~130 deaths; Uganda had 2 cases and 1 death. The first confirmed case was a Goma resident near the Rwanda border amid long-standing fighting around the city. As of 21 May, there were >136 suspected deaths, 35 confirmed cases, and >600 suspected cases linked to Bundibugyo virus in the ongoing outbreak. Four factors hinder containment: late detection due to insecurity, leading to undetected spread; misdiagnosis with malaria/typhoid because of fever symptoms; cultural practices such as ritual burials; and shortages of global health funding. Ebola’s basic reproduction number (R0) is estimated 1.5–2.5 in the region, but observed cases exceed expectations. The situation is set against prior large outbreaks, notably West Africa (2013–2016) with 28,652 infections and 11,325 deaths across 10 countries.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：封じ込めが困難な4つの理由
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的懸念事項として公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した確認済みのエボラウイルス（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。複数国での確認症例と死亡が報告されており、封じ込めの困難性が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Rwanda、Angolaが列挙されているが、記事サマリーで確認症例が明記されているのはDRC（500以上の症例、約130死亡）とUganda（2症例、1死亡）のみ。ただし対象国リストではUganda、Rwandaは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、シグナル強度は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: États-Unis : restrictions d'entrée pour certains détenteurs de la " green card " en raison d'Ebola - Tunisie Numerique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States: entry restrictions for certain holders of the 'green card' due to Ebola - Tunisie Numerique
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, the United States temporarily barred entry to legal permanent residents (green card holders) who have resided in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days, amid Ebola concerns. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention characterized the restriction as a temporary measure to balance protecting public health with emergency-response resource management. The World Health Organization has raised the local spread risk of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the DRC to 'very high' and declares the ongoing transmission in the DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The directive, issued under Section 42 of the US Public Health Service Act, marks the first use of this authority for migrants' entry limits; Green Card holders had previously been exempt during prior outbreaks, including the COVID-19 pandemic and earlier travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: 米国：エボラウイルスに関連して「グリーンカード」保持者の一部の入国制限 - チュニジア・ヌメリック
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行性）。WHOが国際的関心事項（PHEIC）として宣言した実質的エボラ流行イベント。
triage.notes: WHOが Bundibugyo エボラ株の DRC での局所感染リスクを「極めて高い」と評価し、DRC とウガンダの継続的な伝播を国際的関心事項として宣言している。米国による Section 42 の初適用で法的永住者の入国制限は戦略的重要性が高い。Sudan は記事本文で「South Sudan」と記載されており、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 177 وفاة و750 حالة مشتبه بها جراء تفشي الإيبولا في إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 177 deaths and 750 suspected cases due to the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. On May 16, 2026, the WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By May 21, 2026, DRC reported 750 suspected cases with 177 deaths; 85 laboratory-confirmed cases, including 2 in Uganda and 10 deaths among confirmed cases. Uganda reported two imported cases with no evidence of sustained local transmission. An American who worked in the DRC was infected and transported to Germany for treatment, with another American who was a contact infected. The development underscores international concern and cross-border transmission risk amid an ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ流行により177人が死亡、750人の疑い例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的拡大（ウガンダ、ドイツ、米国への波及）、死亡例と多数の疑い例が確認されている。スクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する重大な感染症事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）も記事サマリーで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国（203312）であり、Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラアウトブレーク。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月16日）。国際的波及（米国、ドイツ）が確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため地域検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Красный Крест сообщил о смерти троих волонтеров в ДР Конго в самом начале вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Red Cross reported the deaths of three volunteers in DR Congo at the very start of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers died in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo from Ebola virus disease at the very start of the outbreak, likely after working in a morgue in Ituri province in late March; their deaths occurred between May 5 and May 16. The World Health Organization reports about 750 suspected Ebola infections and 177 deaths potentially linked to the outbreak; as of this week, 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and seven related deaths have been recorded. WHO assessed the risk of further spread in the DR Congo as very high. Ebola, first identified in 1976 in Sudan and the DRC, is transmitted through close contact with blood or other bodily fluids of infected animals or people, particularly via broken skin or mucous membranes. Symptoms include fever, severe weakness, muscle pains, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, kidney and liver dysfunction, and sometimes bleeding. Ituri province is a focal area of concern.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行初期に3人のボランティアの死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（死亡確認）、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。DRCにおいても WHO が「さらなる拡大リスクは極めて高い」と評価している。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに Sudan (366755) が含まれているが、記事サマリーではイベントの主体は DRC の Ituri 州での現在の流行である。Sudan への言及は歴史的背景（1976年の初発症例）のみであるため、verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。エボラ出血熱は CEPR 対象疾患であり、確定例および疑い例が同時に報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en la RD del Congo: Prohibidos velorios y reuniones en Ituri - Vatican News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Wakes and gatherings prohibited in Ituri
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak escalates in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri near Bunia. The World Health Organization reports 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and seven deaths, with 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths overall. Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no vaccine. In response, funerals and gatherings larger than 50 people are prohibited to curb transmission. Healthcare workers face resource shortages amid rising violence, including arson at tents used to isolate patients at Rwampara Hospital outside Bunia, injuring staff. Additional cases appear in North and South Kivu, where M23 rebels control areas including Goma and Bukavu; militants report two cases and have formed a task force. The government classifies the outbreak as very high risk for the DRC, though global risk remains low. The UN has allocated US$60 million and the United States US$23 million for operations in DRC and Uganda, where confirmed cases there have reached five. Three Red Cross volunteers died in Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：イトゥリでの葬儀および集会を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な流行拡大、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダで確認例）、IHR基準4つすべて該当、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、医療体制の逼迫、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれる。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未開発）、82確認例、750疑似例、医療施設への暴力行為、複数地域での急速な拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Instituto Biológico lidera produção nacional de kits para diagnóstico de brucelose e tuberculose bovina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Biological Institute Leads National Production of Diagnostic Kits for Brucellosis and Bovine Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, Brazil's Instituto Biológico (IB-APTA) in São Paulo leads national production of diagnostic kits for bovine brucellosis and tuberculosis. With Fundepag support, the Laboratory of Immunobiological Innovation has produced about 30 million kits since 2021, distributed to suppliers and MAPA-credentialed veterinarians across the country for the National Program for Control and Eradication of Brucellosis and Tuberculosis in Animals (PNCEBT). The immunobiologicals use purified bacterial proteins to detect exposed animals without causing disease, enabling either inoculation-based or serological diagnostics. This approach enhances diagnostic accuracy, traceability, and sanitary monitoring, reducing the risk of disease spread and potential trade barriers on meat and dairy exports. The effort strengthens veterinary public health and national surveillance of cattle herds across Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: Instituto Biológico（生物学研究所）がブルセラ症および牛結核の診断キットの国内生産をリード
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの診断キット生産・ワクチン接種プログラムの進展を報じるもので、新規感染症イベント、公衆衛生上の危機、異常な疾病発生を示す内容ではない。既存の動物衛生管理プログラム（PNCEBT）の実績報告であり、シグナル判定の基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルにおけるブルセラ症と結核の診断技術・プログラムの成功事例であり、動物衛生監視体制の強化を示すものである。疾病の流行・緊急事態ではなく、予防・コントロール体制の進展を報じた内容であるため、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads in eastern Congo as contact tracing falters
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is outpacing contact tracing in eastern Congo. As of May 21, the health ministry reported 83 confirmed infections, 746 suspected cases, and 1,603 identified contacts, with health workers following up only 342 contacts that day (about 21%). The response appears to lag behind the outbreak even as emergency measures intensify after the World Health Organization (WHO) declared the epidemic a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The outbreak has spread across three provinces, including South Kivu, where a case was confirmed this week near Bukavu, a major city near the border with Rwanda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラが拡大、接触者追跡が追いつかず
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが5月17日に国際的な公衆保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。エボラウイルス疾患は最も高リスク病原体であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は最高リスク病原体。WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的な公衆保健上の緊急事態）宣言済み。接触者追跡が大幅に遅れている（21%のみ）ことが対応困難を示唆。3州に拡大、ルワンダ国境近くのブカブでも確認。即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms 3 new cases of Ebola, bringing total number of infections to 5
article.articleSummary: On 23 May 2026, Uganda confirmed three new Ebola cases, bringing the current outbreak total to five. The infections are linked to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form. Uganda's health ministry said contact tracing is being intensified to contain spread. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The WHO also warned the risk of a national epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is very high. In DRC, authorities have reported nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths related to the outbreak. Contributing factors cited by WHO include late detection, absence of a vaccine or virus-specific therapeutics, widespread armed violence, and high population mobility, which heighten vulnerability in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラの新規感染者3例を確認、総感染者数は5例に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4/4を全て満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準5/5を全て満たす。WHOによってPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されており、DRCでも大規模感染が報告されている。国際的な流行の危機が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれていますが、対象国リストに存在しないため verified_locations には含めていません。記事サマリーの主題国はウガンダとDRCです。DRCは対象国（203312）に含まれます。ウガンダはWPRO地域の重要な事例ですが、提供された対象国リストに含まれていないため除外しています。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情蔓延　烏干達累計5起確診病例 | 國際 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads; Uganda reports a total of five confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports three additional laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, bringing the total to five since the outbreak began on May 15. The new cases are a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan healthcare worker, and a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where the outbreak’s epicenter has prompted regional concern. On May 21, Uganda halted all public transport to the DRC after two earlier imported cases—both DRC nationals entering Uganda; one was infected, the other deceased. The Ugandan Health Ministry said it will strengthen surveillance, case management, contact tracing, and public messaging to curb spread and protect public health. The World Health Organization has raised the DRC Ebola outbreak risk to the highest level.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情蔓延　ウガンダ累計5起確診病例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例増加と地域拡大が認められ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが疫学的震源地であり確認症例の出所。記事は地域的拡大リスク（DRC→Uganda国境越境）を示唆しており、DRCのみ検証済み位置として記載。WHOが最高レベルのリスク評価を発表している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : interdiction des activités de masse en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Ban on Mass Gatherings in Ituri
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026, Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo: Ebola outbreak control measures announced by Military Governor Johnny Luboya include the suspension of the Ituri Provincial Football Championship, a ban on gatherings exceeding 50 people, and prohibition of funeral vigils across Bunia, Rwampara, Mungwalu, and Nyakunde health zones. Burials must be conducted by Ebola response teams in strict accordance with the current health protocol. Authorities emphasize adherence to barrier measures and urge political-administrative leaders, religious and community figures to enforce these decisions to break the transmission chain and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イトゥリ州での集団活動禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRCで確認され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性が明確。集団活動禁止などの公式な制御措置が導入されており、シグナルとして認識。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHO重要感染症。記事はDRCのイトゥリ州での発生と制御措置を主題としており、ルワンダは地域情報として言及されているが、イベント発生地はDRCのみ。軍事総督による公式な制御措置（集団活動禁止、葬儀制限など）が実装されており、政府対応が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 11 casos de raiva em morcegos são confirmados em Fortaleza; prefeitura alerta e reforça vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11 cases of rabies in bats have been confirmed in Fortaleza; the city government warns and reinforces vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Fortaleza, Brazil, has confirmed 11 bats positive for rabies between January and May 2026. The animals were found in the neighborhoods of Serrinha, Raquel de Queiroz, Vila União, Itaoca, Antônio Bezerra, Bom Jardim, Coaçu, Parque Dois Irmãos, and Parque Manibura. Positive samples are still under laboratory analysis to characterize viral variants. Fortaleza has not recorded human rabies cases since 2003, but wildlife circulation of the virus raises a preventive alert. Rabies is a severe, almost always fatal disease that can be transmitted to humans. Precautions: do not touch bats or other wildlife, especially if found on the ground, flying during the day, or displaying unusual behavior. If contact, bite, or scratch occurs, seek immediate medical care. Dogs and cats with exposure should be evaluated by a veterinarian and monitored by Zoonoses Surveillance Units (UVZ).

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザで11例のコウモリの狂犬病が確認；市当局が警告とワクチン接種強化を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでコウモリからの狂犬病の循環が確認されており異常・予想外の事象であるが、2003年以降ヒト患者の報告がなく、現在の重症度と国際的拡大リスクは限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国（WPRO関連）のリストに含まれていないが、発生地域に該当していたため記載。狂犬病は致死的疾患であり野生動物からの循環が確認されている点は懸念材料だが、ヒト患者報告がないこと、市当局がすでに予防対策を実施していることから、現段階ではWATCHとした。今後のヒト患者発生や広域拡大を注視する必要がある。
