article.articleHeadline: World Cup: Ebola crisis in DR Congo hands Super Eagles fresh lifeline - Businessday NG
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has caused more than 130 deaths among nearly 600 suspected cases. WHO has raised the national risk to very high as infections and fatalities rise. The health crisis disrupts DR Congo's 2026 World Cup preparations: Kinshasa training camp canceled and moved to Belgium, with the squad kept in a strict three-week biosecurity bubble before a planned arrival in Houston on June 11. DR Congo’s squad includes Aaron Wan-Bissaka, Yoane Wissa, and captain Chancel Mbemba, led by head coach Sébastien Desabre, with most players based in Europe. The team is slated to play Denmark in Liège on June 3 and Chile in Spain on June 9. If DR Congo cannot participate, Nigeria or Jamaica could benefit. FIFA previously dismissed Nigeria’s protest over DR Congo nationality switches. The 2026 World Cup will be hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico, running June 11–July 19.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ：DRコンゴのエボラ危機がスーパーイーグルスに新たな活路をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で複数該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で130人以上の死亡、国際的なスポーツイベント延期による社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが多数の地域を列挙しているが、記事サマリーはDRコンゴでのエボラ流行が主題。ベルギー、USA、メキシコなどはDRコンゴ選手団の移動先であり、エボラ発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHO national risk very high、130人以上の死亡、近600人の疑い例という深刻な状況。2026年ワールドカップ準備への影響も国際的な関心を集めている。

article.articleHeadline: Oeganda meldt nieuwe ebolagevallen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reports new Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda has confirmed three new Ebola infections, bringing the country’s total to five cases. The Ugandan Ministry of Health says contact tracing is being intensified to contain the outbreak. Uganda is the second African country after the Democratic Republic of Congo where the virus has surfaced. The WHO-designated Congo outbreak is an international emergency and authorities fear a new epidemic; Congo has about 750 suspected cases and 177 possible Ebola deaths, with shortages of vaccines and medical supplies. The three Ugandan cases were confirmed after contact investigations: a driver who transported the first Ebola patient and a nurse who cared for that patient; a third infected person is a woman who crossed the Congo–Uganda border into Uganda. Both the driver and the nurse are under treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（DRCからウガンダへの越境感染）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な状況、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCで約750疑似症例・177死亡を含む国際緊急事態が宣言されており、ウガンダはDRCとの越境感染により第二の発生地となっている。ワクチンと医療用品の不足が報告されている。対象国リスト外のウガンダは含めるが、公式スクリーニングプロセスではDRCのみが対象国（203312）に該当することに留意。

article.articleHeadline: ABD'de ebola alarmı: 3 ülkeye vize durduruldu - Dünya Gazetesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in the United States: Visas to three countries suspended.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, the United States imposes visa bans on travelers to South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda due to a rapidly escalating Ebola outbreak. The decision follows WHO reports of rising case numbers and faster spread; in the past 21 days visas have been denied to those planning travel to these countries. The restriction also applies to U.S. residents with valid status who have visited those countries. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved vaccine or definitive treatment. WHO data show about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The U.S. government announced a $23 million emergency aid package to support 50 local treatment clinics. Some experts say funding cuts weakened early warning systems, but the State Department cites a $1.2 billion, five-year public health agreement with the DRC signed in February.

triage.headline_ja: 米国でのエボラ警戒：3カ国へのビザ発給が停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行性、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス感染症による国際的な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）でのエボラ感染が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。疾患はBundibugyo ebolavirus。WHO報告による750例の疑い患者、177例の疑い死亡が記載。米国による2,300万ドルの緊急援助パッケージ発表。国際的なビザ制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, tre nuovi casi in Uganda. In Congo rischio epidemia "molto elevato" (Oms)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, three new cases in Uganda. In Congo, risk of an epidemic 'very high' (WHO).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases rise in Uganda to five after three newly confirmed infections, announced by the Ugandan Ministry of Health on 23 May 2026. Uganda, which borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), confirmed Ebola on its soil on 15 May following two initial cases, one of which died. The three new confirmations bring Uganda’s total to five. To curb cross-border spread, Uganda suspended all public transport to the DRC on 21 May. The World Health Organization (WHO) says the Congo outbreak poses a 'very high' risk to public health. The development underscores regional transmission concerns and the need for sustained surveillance, isolation, and contact tracing amid cross-border risks.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ新規確認者3例。コンゴでは「非常に高い」感染リスク（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた拡大、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、渡航制限実施により、フルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが対象国であり、ウガンダの症例はDRCからのクロスボーダー拡大として捉える。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い死亡率と感染性を有し、国境を越えた急速な拡大リスク大。WHO が「非常に高いリスク」と評価し、ウガンダが公共交通を停止するなど対応措置が実施されている。フルRRAは緊急度高。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RD del Congo desborda los mecanismos de rastreo: solo se hace seguimiento a 1 de cada 5 contactos identificados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC overwhelms contact-tracing mechanisms: only one in five of the identified contacts are being followed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 21, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 83 confirmed Ebola infections, 746 suspected cases, and 1,603 identified contacts; only 342 contacts were traced that day (~21%). Nearly 180 suspected deaths have been reported. The Bundibugyo outbreak, declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, has spread to three provinces, including South Kivu, with a case near Bukavu in M23 rebel-held territory. Uganda has confirmed three additional Ebola cases linked to earlier infections, including a health worker. No vaccines or approved antibody treatments exist for Bundibugyo; Ituri saw two months of undetected circulation. Transmission is expanding beyond Mongbwalu to areas such as Rwampara and Bunia; Nyankunde reports 11 confirmed cases and 340 contacts under follow-up. WHO warns weak surveillance and scarce PCR kits; GeneXpert cannot detect Bundibugyo. Calls for expanded testing, contact tracing, community outreach, and safe response corridors amid instability and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が接触者追跡メカニズムを圧倒：特定された接触者の5人に1人しか追跡されていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱のWHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）、死亡者報告、接触者追跡の機能不全により深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo系統のWHO PHEIC宣言済みイベント。接触者追跡率21%という危機的な状況、検査能力不足、不検出期間2ヶ月、M23反政府勢力支配地域への拡大などにより管理可能性が著しく低下。ウガンダでの追加症例報告があるが、主体は依然DRCであり verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Death toll due to Ebola outbreak in Congo rises to 160 - Pakistan Observer
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens: the Congolese Health Ministry records 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 infections and six fatalities laboratory-confirmed. Origin traced to Ituri province on the northeastern border with Uganda and South Sudan, the current outbreak is the 17th Ebola episode in Congo since 1976. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. The World Health Organization warns that actual numbers may be higher; by midweek, nearly 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths had been documented. Neighboring Uganda reports two Congolese nationals with Ebola; one death has occurred, while the second patient tested negative twice and remains under medical care. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids. The 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行による死者数が160人に増加 - Pakistan Observer
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラは公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。DRCでの確認症例および隣国ウガンダへの波及が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州での発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの波及も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため列挙。Bundibugyo株であること、ワクチンが未承認であること、WHOが実際の症例数がより高い可能性を指摘していることが懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda records three new Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports five confirmed Ebola virus disease cases on May 23, 2026, after three new infections. The cases include a Ugandan driver who transported the index patient and has since died; a hospital health worker caring for him; and a Congolese woman who entered Uganda from the DRC via Arua to Entebbe, traveled on a chartered flight, sought care at a Kampala hospital, was discharged, then returned to the DRC, with positive samples detected after departure. The Bundibugyo strain underpins the outbreak, described as the second such outbreak in Uganda and the DRC; there are no approved vaccines or specific therapeutics, with supportive treatment and about 40% fatality. Uganda has travel restrictions to the DRC; the United States issued Level 4 advisories for DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda, and Level 3 for Rwanda. An American who travelled to the DRC tested positive and was evacuated to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが3件の新たなエボラ症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認症例と死亡が報告され、IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的な拡大リスク（DRC・南スーダン・ルワンダへの米国レベル4勧告）と渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダ、ドイツ、米国が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。記事ではウガンダでの症例が報告されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074で対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCからの患者流入とDRC内での感染確認があり、DRCが検証対象地域として適切。Bundibugyo株による流行で、40%の致死率を伴う二次流行。国際的な渡航制限・勧告が複数国で発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: Red Cross mourns death of three volunteers from Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers died after contracting Ebola during dead body management in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, marking the first known fatalities of the latest outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has no approved vaccine or treatment, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern on Sunday, May 17, 2026. The volunteers—Ajiko Chandiru Viviane, Sezabo Katanabo, and Alikana Udumusi Augustin—died on May 5, 15, and 16, respectively, after exposure on March 27 during a humanitarian mission unrelated to Ebola. Transmission is linked to unsafe burials; IFRC teams are conducting door-to-door outreach to counter misinformation in the outbreak’s center. No further case counts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字、コンゴのエボラウイルスで3人のボランティアの死亡を悼む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際保健上の懸念事項）。WHO公開宣言済みの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的に懸念される公開宣言済み。Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスはワクチンと治療法が承認されていない。安全でない埋葬慣行が感染経路の中心。人道支援活動中の曝露が記録されている。アフリカの対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: ผู้ติดเชื้ออีโบลาเพิ่มขึ้นสามเท่าในหนึ่งสัปดาห์ อนามัยโลกเตือนคองโกระบาดหนัก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections triple in one week; WHO warns of a severe outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections triple in one week in the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting a heightened risk assessment by the World Health Organization. As of 2026-05-23, suspected cases approach 750 with 177 deaths, up from 246 cases and 65 deaths a week earlier. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Most cases are in Ituri Province, with a small number in other parts of the DRC and two in neighboring Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of severe risk to the country and highlighted distrust toward outsiders, including an attack on a field hospital in Rwampara that temporarily disrupted care. The center aims to reopen within 24 hours. Scientists have identified an antiviral named Obeldezivir and plan trials in affected areas; humanitarian groups report resource and staff shortages impacting response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者が1週間で3倍に増加、WHO がコンゴの深刻な流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当する。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による急速な感染拡大（1週間で3倍）、高い死亡率、ワクチンなし、ウガンダへの国際拡大、WHO による深刻警告により、直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大（2症例）が記載されているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれないため verified_locations に追加せず。DRC のみ対象国該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はまれな株であり、ワクチン不在、既存治療なしという極めて重大な状況。医療施設への攻撃による対応阻害も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola : de nouveaux cas confirmés en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: new confirmed cases in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Three more Ebola cases in Uganda bring the current outbreak total to five, per the Ugandan Health Ministry as authorities intensify contact tracing. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency for the Bundibugyo strain, warning of a very high risk of a national outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. Late detection, no vaccine or virus-specific treatments, armed conflict, and high population mobility contribute to Congo's vulnerability, per WHO. In Uganda, the new cases include a driver who transported the country's first confirmed patient and a health-care worker exposed during care; both are under treatment and were identified among known contacts. The third case is a Congolese woman who entered Uganda with mild abdominal symptoms from the Congo, traveled from Arua to Entebbe, and sought care at a private hospital in Kampala.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダで新たな確認症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。DRC・ウガンダでの同時多発。
triage.notes: ウガンダで新規確認症例（計5例）。DRCではBundibugyo株で約750疑い例、177疑い死亡。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。ウガンダ症例には医療従事者や輸送者を含む。DRCからウガンダへの症例流入も確認（Arua→Entebbe→Kampala）。武力紛争、ワクチン欠如、人口移動が脆弱性要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ausbruch in Zentralafrika: Drei Rotkreuz-Helfer unter ersten Ebola-Opfern im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in Central Africa: Three Red Cross volunteers among the first Ebola victims in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers are among the first Ebola victims in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, likely infected on 27 March while handling human remains, and dying on 5, 15, and 16 May. First Ebola cases were laboratory-confirmed on 15 May, indicating weeks of undetected transmission. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, which initially resisted confirmation by standard tests. On 17 May, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). WHO assesses the risk of spread as very high within the Congo, high in the region, and low globally. Ebola spreads through close contact with bodily fluids, not via airborne routes, and corpses can remain highly infectious for days after death. The report does not provide details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカの感染症発生：赤十字ボランティア3名がコンゴでのエボラ出血熱初期患者に含まれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。エボラ出血熱の国際的に重要な新規アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの希少なBundibugyo株による発生。赤十字ボランティアなど医療従事者の関与。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。地域内の拡大リスクが高いと評価されているが、グローバルリスクは低く評価。早期の境界検査強化と接触者追跡が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Shimla sees rise in Hepatitis A cases: What are the symptoms, causes and preventive measures - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Shimla reports a rise in hepatitis A among children, with 11 admitted at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Zonal Hospital (DDUZH) and 7 confirmed positive. Cases emerged gradually over more than a month, about one case daily or every other day. No clustering detected; affected children are from different areas and the situation is under close monitoring. The Health Department has deployed teams for active surveillance, case finding, sanitation and drinking-water assessments, and public awareness on preventive measures. Hepatitis A (and E) spreads mainly via the fecal-oral route from contaminated food or water and poor hygiene. Authorities are coordinating to ensure safe drinking water and sanitation. Public guidance: drink safe, preferably boiled water; maintain hand hygiene; avoid uncovered food and unwashed fruits; seek prompt care for fever, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, jaundice, or dark urine.

triage.headline_ja: シムラでのA型肝炎症例増加：症状、原因、予防措置について
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎の散発的増加が報告されているが、集団発生でなく単発事例の増加。死亡・重症化の記載がなく、現在のところ国際的拡大の直接的リスクは低いと評価される。引き続き情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: シムラ（ヒマチャル・プラデーシュ州）でのA型肝炎の散発事例増加。11人入院、7人確認陽性。集団発生ではなく、異なる地域からの事例。水道水汚染の可能性が示唆されており、当局が積極的監視と給水・衛生対策を実施中。死亡や重症化の報告がないため直ちにシグナルと判定せず、引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda rise to five
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-23, Uganda reports five Ebola cases after three new confirmations: a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed case, a Ugandan health worker exposed while caring for the first patient, and a Congolese woman from the DRC who entered Uganda with symptoms. All three are receiving treatment; contacts linked to the confirmed cases are identified and monitored by response teams. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised Uganda's detection and care, emphasizing vigilance while WHO, Africa CDC, and partners in the DRC and Uganda coordinate containment efforts. The WHO risk assessment for the DRC outbreak rises to very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally. UN OCHA funds up to $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to accelerate response in Congo and the wider region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで確認されたエボラ症例が5件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、国際的懸念）。エボラウイルス病の多国間発生で、WHOが自ら最高レベルのリスク評価を実施し、国連資金投入を開始している。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。エボラ発生は重大なシグナルであり、WHOが国家（DRC）レベルで「非常に高い」リスク評価を公表、地域レベルで「高い」、グローバルレベルで「低い」と評価。UN OCAが中央緊急対応基金から最大6000万ドルを配分。国際的な対応調整が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: خوفاً من انتشار "إيبولا".. الكونغو تحظر مراسم العزاء وتعلّق الأنشطة الرياضية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fearing the spread of Ebola, the Congo bans mourning ceremonies and suspends sporting activities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain prompts strict control measures: mourning ceremonies banned, funerary gatherings restricted, and the local football league suspended to curb transmission. The outbreak began with a case in Bunia on 24 April and spread during a funeral in a neighboring town after mourners touched a deceased individual. WHO reports ~750 suspected cases and 177 probable deaths, with two confirmed cases in neighboring Uganda. The risk in-country has been raised from high to very high, regional risk remains high, and global risk is deemed low. Security challenges and ongoing armed activity hinder response, including M23 influence. Rwanda restricts entry of travelers who visited DRC in the past 30 days. The UN earmarked about $60 million to support control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大への懸念から、コンゴが葬儀式を禁止し、スポーツ活動を中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、稀なバンディブギョ株による異常性、地域拡大と国際的リスク、隣国での制限措置）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: バンディブギョ株（稀な株）によるエボラアウトブレイク。約750疑似症例、177推定死亡例、ウガンダで確認例2例。葬儀での接触によるヒト-ヒト感染伝播が主要な感染経路。セキュリティ上の課題（M23の影響）が対応を阻害。ルワンダが入国制限を実施。UN資金支援約60百万ドル。国内リスク評価が「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げられ、地域リスク「高」、世界的リスク「低」。

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises Ebola risk in DRC to 'very high' as cases near 750
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization raised the public health risk of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo from high to very high, announced by Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on Friday, 22 May 2026. National risk has been upgraded, with regional risk still high and global risk low. Nearly 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths have been recorded in the DRC. Of these, 82 cases have been laboratory confirmed, with seven confirmed deaths; the true scale is likely larger than the confirmed figures. The outbreak has crossed into neighbouring Uganda, where two cases linked to travel from the DRC have been confirmed, including one fatality; Uganda's Ministry of Health later announced three additional confirmed cases, bringing Uganda's total to five. Ongoing violence and insecurity in the DRC are hindering containment and response efforts in one of the world's most volatile conflict zones.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ出血熱リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ、症例数が750近くに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の高い重症度、地域越境感染、および国際機関による公式リスク評価引き上げにより、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの波及(5例)が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国(203312)に含まれ、主要な発生地。WHO総長による公式なリスク評価引き上げ、750近い疑い症例、177人の疑い死亡者、82例確定例、紛争地帯での対応困難など複数の懸念要因が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Tragedia en el Congo: mueren tres cooperantes de Cruz Roja por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tragedy in the Congo: three Red Cross aid workers die from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Three International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent aid workers died of Ebola in Mongbwalu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed by IFRC. The deceased—Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo, and Ajiko Chandiru Vivian—allegedly contracted the virus while handling corpses in late March, and their deaths are not linked to the recent surge of cases in the country. As of May 23, 2026, the WHO has raised national risk to very high, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths under investigation. Neighboring Uganda reports two confirmed Ebola cases and one death. The report emphasizes the high-risk, dangerous conditions for humanitarian workers in Congo amid ongoing transmission, and highlights the dedication of Red Cross volunteers supporting vulnerable communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの悲劇：赤十字の3人の協力者がエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱という高い致死率を持つPHEICレベルの疾患であり、複数国での確認と継続的な感染が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダについては隣国での確認事例として言及されているのみ。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率（サマリーでは約177死亡/750疑い例で約23.6%）を持ち、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識される。WHO発表による「very high」リスク評価が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tiga lagi kes baharu Ebola di Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three more new Ebola cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Uganda has confirmed three additional Ebola cases, bringing the total to five. The new cases include a driver who transported the first Ebola patient in the country and a healthcare worker exposed while treating that patient; both are confirmed as close contacts and are under care and close monitoring. A third case involves a Congolese national who entered Uganda earlier this month to seek treatment in Kampala before returning to Congo. Authorities indicate all close contacts linked to the confirmed cases have been identified and are being closely monitored. Earlier this week, Uganda suspended public passenger transport with Congo due to the high risk of cross-border Ebola transmission. The public is urged to remain calm and seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで3件の新たなエボラ患者が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。ウガンダでのエボラ確定症例の急速な増加と国境を越えた感染リスクを示す明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのエボラ症例確認が主題であり、DRCとの国境を越えた感染リスクが明記されている。ウガンダとDRC間での渡航制限が既に実施されている。医療従事者の曝露を含む複数の感染経路が特定されており、コミュニティ伝播のリスクがある。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないが、DRC（203312）は含まれている。ただし、本記事の主題はウガンダであり、DRCは患者の出国元として言及されているのみであるため、verified_locationsにはウガンダのみを記載。実運用ではウガンダを対象国に追加すべき可能性を検討する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി: കോംഗോ ഫുട്‌ബോള്‍ ടീമിന് കര്‍ശന നിര്‍ദേശവുമായി അമേരിക്ക, ലോകകപ്പിന് മുമ്പ് നിയന്ത്രണങ്ങള്‍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear: America imposes strict directives on the Congo football team ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggers US entry restrictions on Congo’s national football team ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The United States requires Congo players and staff entering the United States to complete a 21-day isolation in a bubble before arrival in Houston on June 11, confirmed by Andrew Julianni of the White House task force. About 600 suspected Ebola cases and more than 130 deaths have been reported in Congo as the month begins. The US government says there will be no compromise on public health during the World Cup. Congo is in Group B; its opening match is June 17 in Houston against Portugal, with games on June 23 in Guadalajara against Colombia and June 27 in Atlanta against Uzbekistan. Congo relocated its training camp from Kinshasa to Belgium and scheduled friendlies on June 3 vs Denmark and June 9 vs Spain and Chile.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖：アメリカがコンゴのフットボールチームに厳しい指令を課す - 2026年ワールドカップ前
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（約600疑い症例、130死亡以上）により、IHR基準の「重大な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」の3項目に該当。米国による国際的な渡航制限措置が実施されており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイク（約600疑い症例、130死亡以上）を主題としており、米国の渡航制限措置（21日間隔離要件）の対象となっている。Bluedot APIが米国、メキシコ、スペイン等の多数の国を抽出しているが、これらは影響を受ける国であり、発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラの重大性、国際的影響、管理上の課題から直ちにRRAに進めるべきシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma novos casos de ebola e deixa OMS em alerta com expansão da doença na África Central
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms new cases of Ebola and puts WHO on alert as the disease expands in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola infections have been confirmed in Uganda since May 15, with three new cases on May 23: a Ugandan driver who carried the index case, a health-care worker infected during treatment, and a Congolese woman who arrived by air. The outbreak is linked to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where the WHO says the regional risk is very high. The strain is Bundibugyo, less common than Zaire, with no vaccine specific to this strain and no fully approved treatment. Uganda has suspended all public transport to DRC on May 21 to curb imports; authorities are tracing and monitoring contacts to interrupt transmission. In DRC, about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported. A global response via a Filovirus Research Consortium virtual meeting (1,300+ participants) aims to map tools and prioritize options, including monoclonal antibodies and broad-spectrum antivirals such as remdesivir (approved for COVID-19); protocol development will take weeks. Emphasizes isolation, contact tracing, and PPE to ensure access.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ新規症例を確認、中央アフリカでの疾病拡大でWHOが警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。緊急性の高いエボラ症例確認で国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのエボラ症例確認を主題としているが、記事の主な流行地および感染源はDRCであり、ウガンダは隣接国への拡大として位置付けられている。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれているため verified_locations に DRC を列挙。Bundibugyo株は Zaire 株より希少であり、特異的ワクチン・完全認可治療法がない点で重大性が高い。DRC での約750疑い症例・177疑い死亡と大規模な流行状況。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде выявили три новых случая заражения лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new cases of Ebola fever detected in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ministry of Health announced three new cases of Ebola virus disease on May 23, 2026, bringing the country’s total confirmed infections to five. The two newly identified cases were individuals who had contact with the first infected patient: a driver and a medical worker. A third new case is a citizen of the Democratic Republic of Congo who had been on Ugandan territory. The update was published by the ministry in a statement on X. The report confirms a linkage to the initial patient via contact exposure, while no additional details on timing of exposure or laboratory confirmation are provided in the summary. The information highlights an expanding cluster within Uganda and underscores the ongoing public health response to Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ熱の新たな3例が検出された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク病原体であり、地域的クラスタの拡大傾向が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認感染数が増加傾向にあり、ウガンダ内での接触曝露を通じたクラスタ形成が認められている。DRC国籍者がウガンダ領内に滞在していた点は越境感染の懸念を示唆する。公式保健声明（X上で発表）により政府対応が確認されている。実験室確認の詳細が限定的である点は留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Drei neue Ebola-Fälle in Uganda gemeldet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new Ebola cases reported in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases confirmed in Uganda, bringing the country’s total to five. Two cases involve a driver and a nurse who had contact last week with the first known Ugandan case. The third case is a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who flew into Kampala, presented with abdominal pain, then traveled back; a specimen from her tested positive. All contacts have been identified and are under monitoring and tracing. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, WHO reports nearly 750 suspected cases and about 180 suspected deaths; laboratory confirmation shows 83 infections with 9 deaths, though the true burden is likely higher due to underreporting during weeks of limited detection. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a highly contagious and deadly strain for which there is neither vaccine nor therapy, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで3件の新たなエボラ出血熱症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での症例確認）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による多国間の発生であり、ワクチンなし、致死的で高感染性であることからシグナルとしてピックアップが必須。
triage.notes: DRC側で約750例の疑い例、180例の疑い死亡が報告されており、実際の負担はより高い可能性。ウガンダでの症例は接触追跡中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチン・治療法なしの高致死性病原体であり、国際的波及リスクが高い。フルRRA実施が緊急で必要。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土登革熱現蹤！高雄60多歲男「肌肉痠痛」 篩檢確診 | 生活焦點 | 要聞 | NOWnews今日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case detected in Kaohsiung! A man in his 60s with muscle aches has been confirmed by screening.
article.articleSummary: First locally transmitted dengue fever case in Taiwan this year is detected in Kaohsiung City. A man in his 60s from Qianzhen District developed fever, headache and muscle aches, and on May 23 tested positive by NS1 rapid test and PCR, confirming dengue serotype 1 infection. Two nearby contacts were asymptomatic with negative NS1/PCR results; the infection source remains under investigation. Authorities will conduct expanded community screening around the patient’s residence and workplace, increase vector surveillance, and provide education to case and contacts. Nationally, Taiwan has 64 confirmed dengue cases this year: 1 locally transmitted and 63 imported from Southeast and South Asia (Indonesia 19, Maldives 14, Vietnam 8). The southern Taiwan mosquito density index is rising; with warmer temperatures and the rainy season approaching, outbreaks may persist. Globally, up to April there were over 1.02 million cases and ~300 deaths, with increases in the Americas (Brazil, Bolivia) and parts of Asia (Malaysia, Vietnam, East Timor, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Laos). Preventive guidance includes the four measures ‘‘巡、倒、清、刷’’, wearing light clothing, and seeking care for dengue-like symptoms with TOCC assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の台湾本土デング熱発症者を検出！高雄市の60代男性が確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で2026年初の本土感染デング熱が確認され、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が該当。対象国ベトナム・インドネシア・ブラジルを含む多国での流行情報も示唆されており、国際的拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 台湾での本土感染は対象国外だが、記事サマリーでベトナム・インドネシア・ブラジルを含む複数対象国での流行が言及されているため、これらを verified_locations に含める。蚊媒介感染症で季節的な長期曝露リスクあり、気温上昇・雨季接近により流行拡大の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Budi Gunadi: Indonesia Penderita TBC Kedua Terbanyak di Dunia : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Budi Gunadi: Indonesia Has the Second Highest Number of TB Patients in the World: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Indonesia ranks second globally in tuberculosis (TB) patients, according to Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin. In remarks published May 23, 2026, he stated that one Indonesian dies of TB every four minutes. Citing kemenkes.go.id, the country records more than 1 million TB cases annually. He framed this as a double-edged situation: a grim burden, yet increasing detection that allows early education, prevention, and timely treatment. The minister emphasized raising awareness of TB symptoms so people can seek care before the disease worsens, and highlighted ongoing national TB control efforts to reduce mortality and transmission through expanded screening, diagnosis, and access to treatment across Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣ブディ・グナディ：インドネシアは世界で2番目に多くの結核患者を抱える国
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、この記事は統計報告と啓発メッセージ中心で、新規の異常事象や急速な拡大を示唆していない。ただし高い罹患率と死亡率が継続的に報告されており、経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、この記事は保健大臣による公式統計報告および啓発メッセージである。新規の異常事象（新変異株、急速な患者数増加、治療失敗例の急増など）が報告されていないため、IHR基準の『異常性』を満たさない。ただし毎年100万件以上の症例と4分ごとの死亡が報告されており、重症度、長期的な集団曝露、流行性は認められ、WPRO基準では3項目該当。政府レベルでの関心が表明されているため、継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Médecins Sans Frontières : Près de 500 cas suspects d' 'Ebola' et plus de 130 décès au Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders: Nearly 500 suspected Ebola cases and more than 130 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has an officially announced Ebola outbreak in the northeast. The ministry of health reported nearly 500 suspected Ebola cases and more than 130 deaths across multiple health zones. On May 15, 2026, MSF indicates cross-border concerns as Uganda announced the virus had crossed the border. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form of the Ebola virus for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. MSF teams are continuing to support the response and work to contain transmission, despite significant challenges faced by affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団：コンゴで約500件の疑似エボラ患者と130人以上の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認事例を伴う多数の疑似患者と死亡、国境越えの確認、ワクチン・治療法がない稀なBundibugyo株による大規模流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴの北東部での発生が主題。ウガンダへの国境越えが5月15日に確認されているが、本記事では「コンゴでの発生」が中心。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれ、ウガンダは含まれていない。Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ株であり、ワクチンと承認済み治療法がない点が特に懸念される。MSFによる活動継続が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Neue Ebola-Fälle in Uganda, WHO warnt vor Epidemie im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola cases in Uganda, WHO warns of an epidemic in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Five lab-confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda as of May 23, 2026, with three new infections reported that Saturday. A driver who transported the country’s first confirmed case and a medical professional who treated him are among the new patients, both in treatment. A third case involves a woman from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo who entered Uganda with mild symptoms, sought care at a private hospital in Kampala, then returned to Congo after initial improvement; she later tested positive for Ebola following a tip from a pilot involved in her transport. Uganda does not publish suspected-case counts. The Ministry is intensifying contact tracing. The World Health Organization warns of an epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たなエボラ患者、WHO がコンゴでの流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3つに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大が起こっており、ウガンダとDRCの両国で確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例確認が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC は対象国リストに含まれており、記事でも「neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo」と明記されており、WHO が「epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo」について警告している。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Kolejne potwierdzone zakażenia wirusem ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: Further confirmed infections with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirmed three new Ebola virus infections, raising total diagnosed cases to five. Among the new cases are a driver who transported one patient, a health-care worker who treated that patient, and a Congolese woman. In neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities have logged over 750 infections and 177 deaths linked to the disease through Friday. The Ugandan health ministry, cited by Reuters, emphasized that these infections involve frontline responders and cross-border movement, illustrating ongoing regional transmission. The report reflects the cross-border nature of the outbreak and the need for heightened infection prevention measures for health workers, transit workers, and close contacts. No further laboratory confirmation details or clinical information are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラウイルスのさらなる確認感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスの確認感染、国境を越えた感染拡大、医療従事者への感染、地域的な流行の継続。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はウガンダでのエボラ感染確認ですが、対象国リストにウガンダ（Uganda）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみです。ただしウガンダでの確認感染はDRCとの国境を越えた伝播を示唆する重要なシグナルです。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）として含まれます。医療従事者の感染と国境を越えた患者移動は地域的対応の深刻さを示しています。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll rises to 160 in Congo
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have killed 160 people, with laboratory testing confirming 64 infections and six deaths. The Congolese health ministry reports 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths; the World Health Organization cautions the true scale could be much higher, noting many suspected cases may go unreported, with earlier estimates around 600 suspected infections and more than 130 suspected deaths in the same week. The current wave involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. In neighboring Uganda, authorities report two Congolese nationals as confirmed cases; one patient died, while the second tested negative on a follow-up test and remains under medical observation. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; the 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が160人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認例）が現実化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生地はDRCであり確定例160人の死亡が確認されている。ウガンダは隣国で事例報告がされているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アンゴラはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーに直接的な言及がないため除外。Bundibugyo株でワクチンが存在しないことが管理上の大きな障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Qırmızı Xaç könüllüləri Ebolanın qurbanı oldular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Red Cross volunteers fell victim to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers infected with Ebola died in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The victims contracted the virus in late March while working in a morgue in Ituri Province, an area later identified as a hotspot for transmission. They died between May 5 and May 16, 2026, with officials saying there was no evidence of wider spread at the time. World Health Organization data show 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 related deaths reported to date, while WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said earlier this week that 82 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and seven confirmed deaths had occurred. The events underscore ongoing risk to frontline workers in Ituri amid the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字のボランティアがエボラ出血熱の犠牲者となった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を与え、異常性があり、国際的拡大リスクがあり、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。コンゴ民主共和国での進行中の流行は既知事象であるが、医療従事者への感染リスク増加は重要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月23日配信だが、事象は過去（3月感染、5月死亡）。WHO公表データでは750疑い例、177死亡が報告されており、82例が検査確定。医療従事者（赤十字ボランティア）への感染が強調されている点が重要。Ituri州はホットスポットとして特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Confirms 3 New Ebola Cases, Total Infections Rise to 5; WHO and Africa CDC Strengthen Containment Efforts | 🌎 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirmed three more Ebola cases, bringing total infections to five. The new cases involve a Ugandan driver who transported the first confirmed case, a Ugandan health worker exposed while caring for the first patient, and a Congolese woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who entered Uganda with symptoms. All three are receiving treatment, and authorities say contacts linked to the cases have been identified and are being closely monitored. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised Uganda’s surveillance, urging continued vigilance to prevent virus spread; WHO is coordinating with Africa CDC and partners in DRC and Uganda. The WHO risk assessment upgraded the DRC outbreak from high to very high at the national level. Africa CDC called for enhanced solidarity to rapidly contain the outbreak, while UN CERF allocated up to $60 million to accelerate responses in Congo and the region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが3件の新しいエボラ症例を確認、総感染数は5件に増加。WHOとアフリカCDCが封じ込め対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、複数国への波及、高い重症度、および国際支援体制の構築により、フルリスク評価へ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、対象国リストにUganda（id: 226074）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていません。DRCは対象国であり、サマリー中で明確に言及されているため含めています。なお、対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれていないため、ウガンダでの事例は評価対象外となります。DRCのみが対象国となります。

article.articleHeadline: Jabalpur News: नालियों पर हो गए कब्जे, पानी की निकासी बंद, खाली प्लाॅटों में भरा गंदा पानी, बीमारियों का खतरा बढ़ा | Drains Encroached Upon, Water Drainage Halted; Stagnant Filthy Water Fills Vacant Plots, Heightening the Risk of Disease.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jabalpur News: Drains Encroached Upon, Water Drainage Halted; Stagnant Filthy Water Fills Vacant Plots, Heightening the Risk of Disease.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, in Ganganganagar Colony, Gadha Ward 1, Jabalpur, illegal encroachments on drainage lines have blocked wastewater disposal. Residents say concrete slabs cover the main drains, stopping dirty water from draining and causing waterlogging after light rain. The drains are clogged with garbage, plastic, and soil, leaving 1–2 feet of standing water on streets. Tall weeds, 6–7 feet high, harbor snakes, scorpions, and insects, with several homes reporting snakes in the area. Health impacts are widespread: residents report viral fever, dengue, malaria, itching, and abdominal pain in every household. Officials promise action to remove encroachments and to clean the drains soon to restore drainage and curb disease risk.

triage.headline_ja: ジャバルプル：排水路の違法占拠により水の流出停止、空き地に汚濁水が堆積し病気のリスク増加
triage.triage_reason: マラリア・デング熱の発生が報告され、IHR基準で「異常・予想外性」および「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」が該当し、住民全体への健康影響が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月23日の報告。ジャバルプル（マディヤプラデシュ州、インド）における排水システムの崩壊に伴うマラリア・デング熱の流行の兆候。住民全世帯でウイルス熱、デング、マラリア、腹痛が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。蚊媒介疾患の流行条件が整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: Krisis Pangan Perburuk Risiko Penyebaran Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food Crisis Worsens the Risk of Ebola Transmission in Congo
article.articleSummary: May 23, 2026—The World Food Programme warns that political instability and a worsening food crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo heighten the risk of an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak, as the World Health Organization raised the region’s risk to very high. The response is a race against time; without rapid, coordinated action, the crisis could become a humanitarian emergency in eastern Congo. WFP notes its Air Humanitarian Service has delivered essential aid to affected areas, including remote districts, amid deteriorating security. About 26.5 million people in DRC face acute food insecurity, including 10 million severely hungry in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tanganyika. Bunia is a main logistics hub, with over 46 tons of cargo delivered to at least 14 provinces to support the Ebola response. On Sunday, WHO declared the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: 食糧危機がコンゴでのエボラウイルス病の感染拡大リスクを悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、26.5百万人の食糧不安、東部コンゴでの人道的危機リスク、複数州での感染事例が確認されている。
triage.notes: WHOがBundibugyo型エボラアウトプレイクをPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言。DRC内の複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tanganyika）で食糧危機と治安悪化がエボラ感染拡大リスクを増加させている。記事ではウガンダも言及されているが、感染事例の詳細については不明。DRCが主要な関心対象であり、verified_locationsではDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolos protrūkis Konge plinta į naujus regionus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo spreads to new regions.
article.articleSummary: As of May 21, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 83 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, with 746 cases still unconfirmed. BBC notes up to 177 deaths and about 750 suspected cases. Health authorities have traced more than 1,600 contacts, but only 342 (21%) could be reached and tested. WHO says the response is lagging behind transmission. The virus has spread to three provinces, including South Kivu near the Rwanda border, and isolated cases have been confirmed in neighboring Uganda. The article cites Bloomberg and BBC. No infection source or laboratory confirmation details are provided beyond these counts. The situation underscores ongoing regional transmission as of May 23, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が新しい地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的な越境伝播、渡航制限リスク）。さらにWPRO基準も5つすべて該当（異常性、高い重症度、継続的な曝露、流行しやすさ、管理能力不足）。多国間での確定例と高い死亡率を伴う進行中の流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラの流行が主にコンゴ民主共和国で報告されており、ウガンダでの孤立症例言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ルワンダも同様に対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。確定例83、死亡177、接触者トレーシング不十分（21%のみ検査）。複数州への地理的拡大とWHOによる対応の遅れ指摘。2026年5月23日配信の現況情報。

article.articleHeadline: الخبير جيسبرت: أوبيلديسيفير لم يتم تجربته فى علاج سلالة بونديبوجيو من الإيبولا  - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert Gisbert: Remdesivir has not been tested to treat the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus - Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected about 750 people and caused 177 deaths. An American evangelist treated in Germany for Ebola received symptom-reducing therapies; U.S. CDC declined to disclose specific treatments due to health privacy laws. No vaccines or drugs are approved specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus in DRC. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Remdesivir, an experimental antiviral, has not been tested against Bundibugyo; its efficacy for symptomatic patients remains unproven. Preclinical data show remdesivir prevented Ebola Sudan in animals (100%) and offered 80–100% protection against Ebola Zaïre and Marburg, but there are no human data for Bundibugyo. As interim measures, MBP134, an experimental antibody cocktail developed with Vanderbilt’s Thomas Geisbert and James Crow, and licensed to a San Diego–based company, is being explored.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家ギスベルト：レムデシビルはブンディブギョ株エボラウイルス治療には未テスト - セブンスデー
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行がDRCで発生し、750人以上の感染者と177人の死亡が報告されている。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常、国際的懸念、治療法の不在）を複数満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのブンディブギョエボラ流行の治療法開発状況を報道している。San Diego、California、USAに言及されているのはMBP134抗体カクテル開発企業の所在地であり、実際の流行発生地ではない。ドイツはアメリカの伝道師の治療事例の参考として言及されているのみ。対象国のうちDRCのみが実際の流行地として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Risiko Penyebaran Wabah Ebola di Kongo Sangat Tinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Risk of Ebola outbreak spread in Kongo is very high.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) centered in the eastern Kongo region amid ongoing conflict and humanitarian crisis. As of May 23, 2026, 82 confirmed Ebola cases and seven deaths have been reported in Kongo, with a likely higher true burden. WHO records about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths since the first fatality in Bunia, capital of Ituri Province, on 24 April. Health facilities are overwhelmed; MSF reports no isolation spaces and hospitals full of suspected cases. Traditional funeral practices involving direct contact are driving transmission; tensions rose in Rwampara after authorities refused burial of a victim for family burial. IFRC says volunteers are conducting home education and assisting safe burials. WHO deployed 22 international staff and released $3.9 million for response; Africa CDC and WHO are accelerating development of vaccines and experimental therapies for Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行拡大リスクは極めて高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で国際的に拡大する高リスク病原体であり、DRCにおける現在の流行はWHO通知基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo系統）の大規模流行。記事サマリーは82確認患者・7死亡、750疑い患者・177疑い死亡を報告。医療施設のキャパシティ不足、伝統的埋葬慣行による感染拡大、紛争・人道危機下の対応困難さが記載。WHOは既に国際的対応を開始（スタッフ派遣、資金拠出、ワクチン開発促進）。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー本文ではルワンダでの確定患者報告がなく、DRCの東部地域が中心地とされているため検証対象地域はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Três voluntários da Cruz Vermelha morreram na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Three Red Cross volunteers died in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers died amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, based in Mongbwalu, Ituri province. Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo, and Ajiko Chandiru Vivian reportedly contracted Ebola while performing corpse-removal duties on March 27 during a humanitarian mission not related to Ebola. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri and has about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths. The virus is the Bundibugyo strain, with a reported 30–50% case-fatality rate, and there is no licensed vaccine or specific approved treatment. The World Health Organization-designated outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, though overall risk is considered low. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; common symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. A US-EU-led group urged warring parties to facilitate response operations and seek peace through negotiations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: コンゴ民主共和国で赤十字ボランティア3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念として指定。エボラ出血熱の流行であり、死亡事例、高い致命率、国際支援の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念(PHEIC)として指定。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、疑い例約750人、死亡177人（30-50%の致命率）。イトゥリ州Mongbwaluで5月15日に宣言された。赤十字職員の感染による死亡は医療施設の安全性と人員確保の重大な懸念を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le Groupe de contact international appelle les belligérants à faciliter la réponse à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The International Contact Group calls on the warring parties to facilitate the Ebola outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: On May 23, 2026, the International Contact Group for the Great Lakes (ICG) urged all parties in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo conflict to facilitate the Ebola response, intensifying a fragile humanitarian situation amid an outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. The World Health Organization reports about 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths, including 82 confirmed cases and 7 confirmed deaths; two imported cases involving Congolese nationals were reported in neighboring Uganda. The ICG highlighted that M23-led areas complicate response due to inexperience combating epidemics, and called for ceasefire respect, safe humanitarian access, re-opening of Goma and Kavumu airports, secure humanitarian corridors in North and South Kivu, and streamlined admin procedures. The M23 rebels control key towns including Goma and Bukavu, amid allegations of Rwandan support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国際接触グループがエボラ流行への対応を促進するよう交戦勢力に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は確定症例82例および確定死亡7例を含む約750例の疑い患者が発生し、隣国ウガンダでも輸入事例が報告されており、紛争地帯での流行対応という複合危機の状況を示している。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は2026年5月15日にイトゥリ州で宣言され、北キブ州および南キブ州に拡大。ウガンダでも2例の輸入事例（コンゴ民主共和国国籍者）が報告されている。M23反政府勢力による武装紛争が人道危機を複雑化させており、国際的な対応調整が必要な状況。記事サマリーはブルンジ、ウガンダ、ルワンダの地名を言及しているが、実際の流行発生地はコンゴ民主共和国が主であり、ウガンダは輸入事例のみのため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Three more Ebola cases confirmed in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirmed three new Ebola cases, bringing total detections in the country to five as the outbreak linked to Ituri, DR Congo, continues. The DRC outbreak, centered in Ituri, has about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, and is led by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines and which can kill up to half of those infected. The three Ugandan cases include a driver who transported the first patient, a female Ugandan health worker who treated that patient, and a Congolese woman who arrived from the DRC to Kampala and later tested positive after a pilot who airlifted her tipped authorities. Lab confirmation followed testing. WHO warns of a high risk of spread to other East African countries. DRC has banned funeral wakes and large gatherings to curb transmission; tensions sparked a hospital fire in Rwampara after a body retrieval dispute.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ患者3人が新たに確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。Bundibugyo株による稀有な流行で致死率が高く、国際拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ）での流行（約750疑い例、177疑い死亡）に関連した越境感染事例。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株で致死率50%。WHO が東アフリカ諸国への高リスク拡大を警告。ウガンダ側では医療従事者及び患者搬送者を含む複数の二次感染例を確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Ερυθρός Σταυρός θρηνεί τον θάνατο τριών εθελοντών από τον ιό Έμπολα στο Κονγκό | in.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Red Cross mourns the death of three volunteers from the Ebola virus in Congo
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers—Ajiko Chandiru Viviane, Sezabo Katanabo, and Alikana Udumusi Augustin—died in the Democratic Republic of Congo from Ebola virus disease, linked to the Bundibugyo strain. They worked at Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, and are believed to have contracted the virus during corpse-management activities on March 27 amid a humanitarian mission unrelated to Ebola. They died on May 5, 15, and 16, respectively. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for this outbreak. The IFRC notes that Ebola remains highly infectious after death, with unsafe burials a key transmission factor, and is conducting door-to-door outreach to counter misinformation in the outbreak area.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字がコンゴのエボラウイルスで3人のボランティアの死亡を悼む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的懸念、WHO緊急事態宣言）かつWPRO基準複数該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による医療従事者死亡は高度な警告シグナル。
triage.notes: WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) 宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・承認治療なし。医療従事者の死亡、遺体管理時の感染拡大が懸念。国際的な支援体制が既に構築されている段階であり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mjere prevencije ebole pojačane su u Gomi zbog epidemije
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola prevention measures have been intensified in Goma due to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, Ebola prevention measures in Goma, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), have been intensified after an outbreak declared in Ituri province on May 15 spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO reports roughly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with at least 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and 7 deaths. Two imported DR Congo cases were reported in neighboring Uganda. Authorities warn the virus poses greater risk in areas controlled by the M23 rebel group, which has limited outbreak-response experience. M23 is central to ongoing eastern DRC conflict and is alleged to be Rwanda-backed, controlling major territory including the capitals of North Kivu (Goma) and South Kivu (Bukavu), seized in early 2025. The outbreak remains active across multiple provinces with cross-border and security challenges impacting response.

triage.headline_ja: ゴマでのエボラ感染症拡大に伴い、予防措置が強化された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、複数州にわたる活動的な流行、750例の疑い患者、国境を越えた感染、セキュリティ上の課題が存在するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は2026年5月15日にイトゥリ州で宣言され、北キブ州および南キブ州に拡大。750例の疑い患者、177例の疑い死亡、82例の確認患者、7例の確認死亡を報告。ウガンダへの越境感染2例も報告。M23反政府勢力支配地域での対応能力が限定的であり、セキュリティ上の課題が流行対応に影響。ウガンダへの越境感染報告があるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内での流行対応であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。
